A traditional event in Bremen
Organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, young people and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Lila-Eule-Cross
description: The 37th Lila-Eule-Cross in Kappeln is a long-running cross-country race on the Schlei that is very popular with runners. At the most recent edition, 308 runners reached the finish, setting a participation record. The course is known for its autumn atmosphere and for being less muddy than in previous years, making the race especially appealing. The event is organised by the Schleswig-Holstein Athletics Association and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race on the Schlei
Autumn atmosphere and strong performances
Less muddy course than in previous years
additional: Cross-country race on a varied course along the Schlei, including children’s and youth races, with a focus on autumn weather and state championships.

name: Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition
description: The Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition takes place in Xanten, with the 5 km race as the main distance. The race is held on an afternoon in November and promises a cross-country feel on the beach, setting it apart from a regular road race. Alongside the main distance, there are shorter 400 m races and longer 7.5 km races, offering suitable distances for both young and experienced runners. Children’s and youth races are also part of the program. The finish line for all races is at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten.
course_highlights: Cross-country feel on the beach
Distances from 400 m to 7.5 km
Finish line at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten
additional: Typical November weather, with temperatures of around 7 °C, lows of around 2 °C, and rainy weather on most days. Results are linked via RUNME.de. Children’s and youth races, a weather-dependent November event, outdoor atmosphere at Naturbad Xantener Südsee

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Kościan County Grand Prix is a series of five 5 km races, organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County under the patronage of the Kościan County Governor. Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Each race requires a separate entry fee, and the overall standings are based on the total points earned across the races.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County
Separate standings for women and men, with no age categories
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for each individual race, set locally, is payable. The races are scheduled from June to December 2025 in various locations across the county. Points from the individual races are added together, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of the individual races. The series comprises five 5 km races held from June to December, with overall standings and prizes for the top finishers. The main 10 km race is scheduled for 15 November 2026 in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather and possible rain.

name: Bolszewo dla Niepodległej
location: Bolszewo, Wejherowo County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bertusloop
description: The Bertusloop is held on the 3rd Sunday of every month, except in July and August. This recreational fun run

name: Hafkamp Groenewegen De Ronde Venen Marathon
Chocolademelkloop
description: The Chocolademelkloop is a friendly family running event in the forests of Bilthoven, suitable for runners of all levels. On Sunday, November 15, 2026, participants can choose from distances of 1, 2, or 5 kilometers. The event is known for its warm atmosphere, delicious hot chocolate afterward, and the presence of Piets who take part in the run. It is a sporty, accessible event where young and old can enjoy being active in nature together.
course_highlights: Run through the forest of Bilthoven
Mostly unpaved paths
A friendly family run with Piets and hot chocolate
additional: Parents registered for the 2 or 5 km can join their child in the 1 km family run at no extra cost. The 1 km family run is aimed at children aged 3–8 and follows mostly unpaved forest paths. There is a prize draw, with prizes awarded among all participants regardless of their time. The start and finish area is at the Werkplaats in Bilthoven. Distances: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km; no timing; parents can run alongside their children for free; start and finish at the Werkplaats grounds

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a running series consisting of three races in November, January and February, organised by AAV'36 in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races take place around the Zegerplas and offer distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as 400 m and 1,000 m youth races on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely free of traffic and runs through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers, a canteen and a massage room are also available.
course_highlights: An almost entirely traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas
Distances range from 400 m for children to 20 km for adults
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with facilities including changing rooms and showers
additional: Official timekeeping is provided by MyLaps. Walkers can choose 5 km and 10 km routes, with a time limit of 2 hours; they start at the same time as the 20 km running race. There is no drinks station along the Aarkanaal because plastic cups are prohibited, but water is available at the finish and at a drinks station on the track for 15 km and 20 km runners on their second lap. Free leg massages are available in the massage room, provided by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn. Changing rooms, showers, a canteen and a limited number of lockers are available. Registration is via the website. Free leg massages are provided by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn. Winter conditions are possible.

name: Sterke Start Loop 2026
description:
Whether you’re going for 5, 10 or 21 kilometres, every route takes you through the beautiful natural area around Zevenhuizen.
You’ll run alongside water, through the forest and on (mostly) paved paths. It’s a varied course, with a different challenge for each distance.
Whichever distance you choose, every step helps give the tiniest babies a strong start.
course_highlights: Routes through nature, alongside water and through the forest
Mostly paved surfaces, with unpaved paths on the 21 km route
1 km Kids Run with obstacles for children
additional:
Stand up for the tiniest babies
On Sunday 15 November, World Prematurity Day, the whole of the Netherlands gets moving during the Sterke Start Loop. The run for everyone who wants to give the tiniest babies a strong start.
The live event takes place in Zevenhuizen, but with your home-entry ticket you can take part wherever and whenever you like during the week leading up to 15 November.
New this year is the Kids Run in Zevenhuizen. Children run 1 km, with a few obstacles at the end. These symbolise the challenges that babies born prematurely have to overcome.
Together, we stand up for the tiniest babies. By taking part, you’ll raise money for research, kangaroo care chairs and parental support, and help give every child the best possible start.
Take part and make a difference.

name: Loetcross
description: The Loetcross in Lekkerkerk is a challenging cross-country race taking place on 15 November 2026. The course crosses varied terrain, including grass, shell paths and ditch edges, offering a varied and natural running experience. Several distances are available, ranging from 1.2 km to 7.2 km, to suit different ages and abilities. The race is known for its rugged character, so shoes are guaranteed not to stay clean. Pre-registration is open until 13 November 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course over grass, shell paths and along ditch edges
Distances ranging from 1.2 km to 7.2 km
Natural, varied terrain with challenging sections
additional: Women may enter the 7.2 km long-distance race, but their participation is not included in the women’s competition or prize-giving. Shoes will not stay clean during the race because of the terrain. Fields marked with * are mandatory when registering. The event includes several race categories for different ages and abilities, and registration is required.

name: Bommelasloop
description: The Bommelasloop is a popular recreational trail run that has been organised by Rekreatie Sport Twente for many years. The run takes place in the beautiful Het Buurserzand Natura 2000 area, between Enschede and Haaksbergen. There are four different distances, so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The start is at 11:00, and participants receive a free refreshment afterwards. The atmosphere is relaxed and focused on recreation, with no prize-giving or medals.
course_highlights: Trail run in the Het Buurserzand Natura 2000 area
Four distances: 7.6 km, 11.7 km, 16 km and 20.5 km
Start and finish at Camping Twente in Enschede
additional: Late registration and race-number collection are possible on the day from 09:45 to 10:50, subject to availability. There is no prize-giving or medal, but participants can receive a refreshment by handing in their race number at the bar at the campsite. Cycling is recommended because parking is limited. Trail run in Buurserzand; registration on the day is possible; no prize-giving or medal; free refreshment afterwards; dogs and wheelchairs are not allowed.

name: Sytze Wetting Trail
location: Outdoor centrum Copini, Leeuwarden, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Sytze Wetting Trail is an annual trail run organised by AV Lionitas in the Lytse en Grutte Wielen nature reserve near Leeuwarden. The trail features an adventurous course made mostly of unpaved paths, grass and narrow trails, with enjoying nature at its heart. There are three distances: 19 km, 7.9 km and a 1 km Kids Run. The race is more challenging than a road race and requires good trail shoes or shoes with grip. Free snert is served to participants afterwards.
course_highlights: Mostly unpaved course through the Lytse en Grutte Wielen nature reserve
Adventurous route over grass and narrow trails
Your feet may get wet; good trail shoes or shoes with lugged soles are recommended
additional: Changing facilities and showers are available. Racks are provided for storing bags. Refreshments are available on the course and after the race. Please park at Kleine Wielen (Groene Ster), not at Restaurant Groote Wielen. After the race, free snert is provided by Restaurant de Groote Wielen. The trail runs through a nature reserve over unpaved terrain, with the start and finish near Outdoor centrum Copini, Leeuwarden, and refreshments and free snert afterwards.

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Løp 2
description: Necon Winter Carousel continues today with the season's 2nd race, taking place at Fana Stadium. Race numbers can be picked up in the gym from 5:00 PM, and there will be a limited selection of Necon Winter Carousel's Craft products for sale. Payment is only accepted via Vipps, and live results from the race will be available after 7:15 PM.
course_highlights: Race numbers can be collected in the gymnasium from 5:00 PM.
We have a limited selection of Necon Winter Carousel's Craft products available for purchase at the same location.
Live results from today's race will be available here after 7:15 PM.

images.alt_text: Runners at the starting line for the Necon Winter Carousel Bergen.
Fana Stadium, the venue for Necon Winter Carousel Bergen - race 2.
Image of Fana Stadium, the venue for Necon Winter Carousel Bergen race 2.
Fana Stadium, the venue for Necon Winter Carousel Bergen - race 2.

name: Snøkuten Glestadrunden
description: The Snøkuten Glestadrunden is a trail race that takes place in Innlandet on February 10th. The race offers distances of 7.4 km and 9.5 km, and is designed to provide an exciting and challenging experience for participants of all levels. Participants will have the opportunity to experience beautiful nature and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: The race is perfect for both experienced runners and beginners.
Participants will have the opportunity to experience beautiful nature.
The Snowcut Glestadrunden will be held on February 10th.

images.alt_text: Spectacular mountain landscape with a lake and a person on a cliff.
Runners on a snow-covered road with a sunset in the background.
Winter landscape with snow-covered road, suitable for trail running.
Runners with headlamps and reflective vests in the dark.

name: Hamarkarusellen Vinter Løp 2
description: Hamarkarusellen Winter is the winter edition of Hamarkarusellen. Unlike the summer version, this one takes place on the same 5-kilometer course for all races, on illuminated walking and biking paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. We maintain the same officially measured 5 kilometers in all the races, and this is an excellent opportunity to use as a test run. The event warmly welcomes all ambitions: walkers (without time/with time), runners (without time/with time), "compete against myself," "beat the neighbor," and active super runners.
course_highlights: The race takes place on illuminated walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar.
All participants, regardless of ambition level, are warmly welcome to join, whether walking or running.
The officially measured 5-kilometer course makes this an excellent test race for everyone.

images.alt_text: Runners on the winter track during the Hamarkarusellen Winter.
Runners in the Hamarkarusellen winter race. Winter running on snow-covered roads.
Runners in the Hamarkarusellen Winter Race 2, dressed in winter clothing and race numbers, are running on a winter road.
Runners at a race, some standing, some sitting. Clear weather, green grass and trees.

name: Østmarka Trail Challenge
description: The Østmarka Trail Challenge organizes tough and challenging trail races in Østmarka. This race, taking place on Saturday, August 23, 2025, is not for the faint-hearted, as it features 37 km of technically demanding terrain and nearly 1000 meters of elevation gain. Participants will encounter trails that go over roots and rocks, and after many hours of preparation, one will feel ready for this challenge.
course_highlights: This race is not for the faint-hearted.
It is 37km of technically challenging terrain and nearly 1000 meters of elevation gain.
The race goes over hill and dale on some of Østmarka's toughest trails.

images.alt_text: Map of the Østmarka Trail race, showing the route through the forest.

name: Hodelyktløpet Østmarka
description: Østmarka Trail Challenge – The Headlamp Race is a technically demanding trail run of approximately 12 km, primarily on blue and red marked paths in Østmarka. The course will be marked throughout by the organizers, but the chances of going off course are certainly present, so it is important to pay close attention, especially in the technical sections. A good headlamp is a must! From the start at Skullerud, we follow the Refugee Route up to Rundvann, before taking the technically challenging blue trail downhill.
course_highlights: The race takes place on beautiful and technically demanding blue and red-marked trails in Østmarka, and is approximately 12 km long.
The course is marked the entire way, but there are opportunities for running off course, so it's important to pay close attention to the route.
The race includes steep hills and sections that can be described as "technical trail" and "impenetrable terrain."

images.alt_text: The Headlamp Race in Østmarka: Runners with headlamps ready for the night race in the rain.
Runners with headlamps are running in the dark before the Headlamp Race in Østmarka.
Runners with headlamps in the night race, the Headlamp Race in Østmarka.
Runners celebrate after the Headlamp Race in Østmarka.

name: Finnensturm
location: Sport- und Solepark Große Wiese, Arnsberg-Hüsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Finnensturm is an evening race in November on a joint-friendly Finnish track at the Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park in Arnsberg-Hüsten. The 1,000-metre-long and 2.50-metre-wide track has a soft, springy surface that provides a pleasant running surface, different from asphalt or synthetic tracks. The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event attracts several hundred participants each year and is ideal for a November race with a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run on a 1,000 m-long, joint-friendly Finnish track
Soft, springy surface instead of asphalt or synthetic track
The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere
additional: The Finnish track is 2.50 m wide and runs independently of the rest of the path network. It is lit from 5:00 a.m. and in the evening until 11:00 p.m. The Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park is signposted from the Hüsten exit on the A46. The event takes place on a woodchip track at the Hüsten Sports and Saline Park; in November, weather conditions can make it wet and slippery. Refreshments and showers are available on site.

name: USP Night Run - powered by Runnersworld Utrecht
description: The USP Night Run is an atmospheric night run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, with distances for both adults and children. The route passes through the beautiful, illuminated Botanical Gardens, creating a unique and spectacular running experience. The event offers an enjoyable and sporty evening, with an atmospheric start and finish area, water stations along the route and at the finish. Teams and companies are also welcome to take part together, with extra options such as running shirts and pasta meals.
course_highlights: Run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park
Spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, plus kids’ runs of 800 m and 1.5 km
additional: Start and finish at Sportcentrum Olympos. There are start corrals and water stations along the route and at the finish. Optional extras when registering: USP Night Run shirt, cancellation insurance, pasta meal. Company teams can participate in their own running shirts and with drink tokens. First name on the race bib with registration chip. The event supports charities and offers discounts and extras such as a running shirt and pasta meal.

name: Utrecht Science Park Night Run
description: The Utrecht Science Park Night Run is an atmospheric running race taking place on Friday evening, 20 November 2026. Participants run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, including a spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens. Several distances are available, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and kids’ runs. The event is organised by Central Events and supports the charity Stichting ALS Nederland.
course_highlights: Run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park
Spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, plus kids’ runs
additional: Start and finish at Sportcentrum Olympos. There are start waves and a race with a prize ceremony. Optional extras when registering include a running shirt, cancellation insurance and a pasta meal. There is also a special kids’ run of 800 metres and 1.5 km. Registration includes options for shirts, insurance, a pasta meal and donations to ALS; proceeds go to Stichting ALS Nederland.

name: Derko Night Trail
description: The Derko Night Trail is the region of Utrecht’s premier running event in the dark, organized by BodyRun and IJ-run together with many volunteers. The start and finish are at Skipiste Nieuwegein, where a lively afterparty is also held. The trail runs through a beautiful nature area and offers various distances for both trail and paved-surface runners. Participants must use a headlamp because the event takes place in the dark, adding to its unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail runs on unpaved paths through a nature area
Start and finish at Skipiste Nieuwegein with catering facilities
The route is marked with reflectors and ribbons; headlamps are mandatory
additional: All participants must use a headlamp because the event takes place in the dark; it is mandatory for the trails and recommended for the fun run. The route is marked with reflectors and ribbons. Mixed changing facilities and first aid are available. The event aims to reduce the use of cups; participants take their own waste with them. After the event, there is an afterparty at the catering venue by the start/finish. Trail and paved routes, headlamp mandatory, online registration, charities supported

name: 24H Online Running
description: 24H Online Running is a unique race that takes place over 24 hours, where participants can choose to run, walk, or cycle. This event offers the possibi

name: Bislett 24 Hour Indoor
description: Bislett 24-hour is a unique indoor race that takes place at the famous Bislett Stadium in Oslo. Participants have 24 hours to run as far as possible around the 542-meter long track. This event attracts both experienced ultrarunners and beginners who want to test their limits in a supportive and motivating environment. The race is sold out, and awards include a large performance medal for those who achieve 150 km (men) and 130 km (women).
course_highlights: Prizes for the top 3 women and men + all category winners.
Participant shirt in technical quality for all starters.
Arena: Bislett Stadium, Louises gate 1, 0168 Oslo - Entrance from Sofies gate.

images.alt_text: Bislett Stadium indoor running track. 24-hour race.
Runners on the indoor track at Bislett Stadium.
Runner under the Bislett 24-hour race, 260 km!
Bislett 24-hour indoor race. Runners and spectators at Bislett Stadium.

name: 5 Km Sport Glexe
description: The 5 Km Sport Glexe is a measured race that offers a fast course on new pedestrian and cycling paths on the way to Gvarv. This race is perfect for both beginners and experienced runners looking to set new personal records.
course_highlights: The race has been officially measured and is a fast course.
The route runs on new walking and cycling paths.
The race is on the road to Gvarv.

images.alt_text: Red 3D model of the number 5.

name: Klubbmesterskap 5k
description: The club championship 5k is a running competition that is part of Tjøme Running Club's events. The courses are officially measured, and the competition is held over a distance of 5 km. This championship gives members the opportunity to compete for club championship titles and set club records. The race takes place from beautiful Grønneset at Ånøya on Wednesday, June 25, starting at 6:00 PM, and is designed to challenge both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: The race takes participants through scenic surroundings with a flat and fast course that allows for personal records.
Participants will experience a friendly atmosphere with cheers from the audience and fellow runners, making the race a social event.
After the race, there will be opportunities for swimming, grilling, and an awards ceremony followed by applause.

name: 13. Schloss Marienburg Marathon
description: The 13th Schloss Marienburg Marathon takes place on November 21, 2026, in Nordstemmen-Adensen. This varied scenic marathon is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The course follows village streets, paved and unpaved country lanes, woodland paths, and trails, with about 560 metres of elevation gain. A special highlight is the refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg, where runners can take a break. The 21.1 km course is shaped like a figure eight, with three refreshment stations in Adensen, and offers beautiful views of the Calenberger Land and the Leinebergland in good weather.
course_highlights: Varied course featuring village streets, country lanes, woodland paths, and trails
Refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg
Figure-eight course with about 560 metres of elevation gain and views of the Calenberger Land and Leinebergland
additional: Early marathon start at 9:00 a.m. for runners who need more than 6 hours. Official electronic timekeeping. Refreshments approximately every 5 km, including water, tea, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and gingerbread. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and baggage storage in the start/finish area. German Red Cross medical service in the start/finish area and along the course. Participant limit: 550 runners, including a maximum of 300 half-marathon runners. Hilly course with trails, 560 metres of elevation gain, scenic views, aid stations every 5 km.

name: 4. Heartbeat Ultra
description: Heartbeat Ultra is a participatory charity ultrarun in Fulda, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants run laps of approximately 6 km, covering up to 112 km, and decide for themselves when to start, take breaks and finish their run. Each lap raises donations for children with half a heart, supporting research and quality of life. The event is open to everyone, from beginners to ultrarunners, and wheelchair users are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 6 km in Sportpark Johannisau, Fulda
Charity laps covering up to 112 km
Flexible start and running time between 06:00 and 21:00
additional: This is a charity run where every lap counts and the entry fee is donated in full. Participants receive a personal fundraising page where supporters can donate for each lap completed. There is a 400-metre children's run in the stadium, with each lap counted. The event is also available virtually, so people can take part from anywhere in the world. Flexible running time, virtual participation, donations for children with heart defects, registration with a personal fundraising page, medal for the first 1,500 participants.

name: 50. See-Park-Lauf
description: The 50th Bad Gandersheim See-Park Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark. Organized by SVG GW Bad Gandersheim, it offers categories for various age and performance groups, including boys, girls, men, women, juniors, open runners, and masters up to 95+. The event is closely connected with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, whose students and teachers take part and support the organizing team. After the race, results, personalized certificates, and a photo gallery are published online.
course_highlights: Road race around the grounds of Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark
Separate categories for a range of age and performance groups
Strong connection with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, with active participation
additional: There are two distances: 400 m and 10 km. Typical November weather is expected, with daytime highs of about 7 °C and rainy days. The organizing team comprises about 50 people, supported by around 80 students and teachers. Results, certificates, and a photo gallery are published online after the race. Road race in the Seepark, distances of 400 m and 10 km, organized by the school, with rainy November weather expected.

name: Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser
description: The Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser is a traditional race held at the end of the running season, taking participants through the Braunsteich nature reserve. A particular highlight is crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, which offers a picturesque view across the water. The event is for all ages, from children to seniors, who enjoy running and walking. The race is part of the Dresden District Rankings and the Niederlausitz Cup, and is officially recognized by the German Athletics Association in the walking category.
course_highlights: Crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, with views across the water
The route mainly follows public forest paths, with three short sections on quiet residential cul-de-sacs
Autumnal November atmosphere in the Braunsteich nature reserve
additional: The 5 km and 10 km routes have three short sections on public roads, which have little traffic as they are residential cul-de-sacs. The rest of the route follows moderate forest paths, some of which are cross-country style. The race is open to all age groups, and walking is also officially recognized. Participant limit of 300–500; medals for finishers; registration on site or online; free showers and changing rooms available; integrated into regional athletics.

name: Crossmeisterschaft SC Magdeburg
description: The SC Magdeburg Cross Country Championships is a traditional cross-country running competition organized by SC Magdeburg and the City of Magdeburg in Saxony-Anhalt. As a championship cross-country race in the German athletics calendar, it offers a challenging off-road course that differs from classic track races. The event is part of the DLV system, with official entries, rules, and timing, and is supported by the volunteer club and federation culture. The races take place in November, typically in cool and rainy weather, offering an authentic cross-country experience for club and federation runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country course, not on a track
Distances: 700 m and 1.4 km
Event held as part of the German athletics calendar
additional: The event is officially listed in the DLV system, with entries, rules, and timing. Typical November weather is cool (7 °C, low of 2 °C) and rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The start location is in Magdeburg; detailed directions are available. Cross-country course, distances of 700 m and 1.4 km, held in November in rainy weather

name: Lipperland Marathon
description: The Lipperland Marathon in Dörentrup offers a friendly, family atmosphere without crowds along the roads. The event is known for its straightforward organization and takes place in the beautiful Lipperland region in autumn. Runners can look forward to great views and a pleasant atmosphere in Humfeld. The event is organized by TuS Humfeld 1911 e.V. and is aimed at all participants looking for a personal running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon in a family-friendly setting
Beautiful Lipperland region in autumn with great views
No crowds along the roads
additional: The course runs through hilly terrain; start at the Humfeld sports hall; family-friendly; includes half-marathon and loop-course options; registration by bank transfer

name: Rhädenlauf
description: The Rhädenlauf takes place on November 21, 2026, in the Rhäden Nature Reserve in Wildeck-Obersuhl. The race is organized by TV 1888 Obersuhl and is part of the 2026 competition year. The event is for runners who want to experience a nature-rich route through a protected landscape. Timing has been provided by a modern ALGE system since 2022, ensuring precise results.
course_highlights: Run through the Rhäden Nature Reserve
Nature-rich and scenic route
Modern ALGE timing system in use since 2022
additional: Timing is provided by an ALGE system, including a start trigger with an integrated flash (E-Start). The department head is Luisa Wunn, who can be reached at 0177 4691132. Club training takes place on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 17:30 to 19:00 at the stadium or the Obersuhl indoor sports hall. Route through the nature reserve, training plans for participants

name: Rurbrückenlauf
location: SIG Combibloc Systems, Linnich, Düren, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 12.5 km, 11.5 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Rurbrückenlauf is a running series in Linnich, starting and finishing at SIG Combibloc Systems. Various distances are offered for children, young people, and adults. Adults can choose between a flat 5.2 km run and an 11.5 km run with a rolling profile that offers a little more variety. The event takes place in November and is aimed at runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at SIG Combibloc Systems in Linnich
Flat 5.2 km run for a straightforward, flat course
11.5 km run with a rolling profile for more variety
additional: The event includes distances from 0.5 km to 12.5 km, including races for children and young people. Typical November weather in Linnich is around 7 °C, with rainy days and an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Distances: 0.5 km, 1 km, 1.5 km, 4.9 km, 11.5 km, 12.5 km; start and finish at SIG Combibloc Systems; November weather: around 7 °C, rainy; event for all ages.

name: Werler Straßenlauf
description: The Werl Road Race is a long-standing running event taking place for the 36th time on November 21, 2026. With distances for Bambini, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes, it offers a wide range of running options. The event marks the final stretch of the DJK competition year and welcomes runners of all abilities to run together with heart. It takes place amid the autumn atmosphere of Werl and combines sporting ambition with a sense of community.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from short routes to 10 kilometers
Suitable for Bambini, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes
Long-standing event with a 36-year history
additional: Distances for Bambini, recreational runners, and athletes; takes place on November 21, 2026; ideal for fast times and personal bests

Since 2024, the start has been at Kinderopvang ’t Schoapie, improving accessibility and atmosphere. The Schalmloop offers distances for all ages and is known for its challenging, varied nature route with gentle elevation changes. The event promises a friendly, active winter day outdoors.

description: The Maarten Maartens Trail Run is a welcoming trail race held on the beautiful Zonheuvel estate in Doorn, on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The 6, 10 and 20 km routes wind through the hills of the Kaapse Bossen forest and are mostly unpaved, with the entire course marked with arrows and ribbons. There is no electronic timekeeping; participants can read their time from the race clock. After the race, refreshments are available, and the winners are honoured at the historic Maarten Maartens House. The trail run is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike who enjoy nature and a challenge.

description: Rambo Mosse Night Trail is a unique trail race through the fascinating natural surroundings of Rambo Mosse Nature Reserve in Mölndal. The race, which is just over 11 km long, takes place at dusk, with headlamps and a course marked with reflectors, offering a special and challenging running experience on forest trails. The start and finish are at Herkulesgården, where participants can enjoy a sauna, showers and warming soup in the clubhouse after the race. The race is limited to 400 participants and includes a medal and awards for the top finishers in the women’s and men’s categories.

A Trail Run Clinic will be held on 26 September in collaboration with Salomon and Runnersworld Rotterdam. The event offers solo and duo formats, with a base camp and crew facilities. Participants must follow the safety rules and code of conduct. The final route will be announced later. Trail and ultrarunning, maximum 24 hours, course with approximately 130 metres of elevation gain per lap, duo option available, close to Rotterdam

name: Walvoort Rondje Nederland
price_range: Vanaf €5,50 tot €13,00 afhankelijk van afstand en leeftijd
description: Walvoort Rondje Nederland Evening Run is a fun family run taking place on Saturday evening, 28 November 2026, at the Netherlands Open Air Museum in Arnhem. The event offers youth races split into boys’ and girls’ races to ensure equal opportunities. The atmosphere is enthusiastic and welcoming, with special attention to children and their accompanying adults. Timing is provided using the Ipico system, and ample parking and facilities are available for participants and supporters.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Netherlands Open Air Museum
Youth races split into boys’ and girls’ races
Evening run with a fun, family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Children up to and including 12 years old receive an extra wristband for an accompanying adult, which includes free admission. Other supporters pay €7.50 admission, which can be reserved via the registration form. Parking at the Open Air Museum is free. Changing space and luggage lockers are limited; there are no showers. First aid is available. Timing chips must be returned after the event, otherwise a €10 fee will be charged. Volunteers are welcome: info@rondjenederland.com. The course is at the Netherlands Open Air Museum. Registration is open until 12 noon on 28 November. Accompanying adults with a museum card receive free admission. Timing is provided using chips. The event supports childhood cancer research. There are no showers.

name: 57e AV Climax Horaloop
description: The 57th AV Climax Horaloop takes place on Saturday, 28 November 2026, in Ede. The race offers several distances, including children’s races, 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles (16.1 km). The course runs through the hills of Hoekelumse Bos and the rolling valley of the Renkumse beek, with a choice of paved cycle paths or unpaved trails. The Horaloop is an atmospheric and challenging race, with chip timing and a welcoming finish venue at Hoekelum Castle.
course_highlights: Hilly course through Hoekelumse Bos
Rolling landscape along the Renkumse beek
Choice of paved cycle paths or unpaved trails
additional: Race numbers with chips can be collected on Friday, 27 November, between 18:00 and 21:00 at Atletiek Vereniging Climax, or on race day from 8:30 until 20 minutes before the start. There is a 2-hour time limit for the 10 English miles. Water stations are available along the route. There is no supervised cloakroom, but there is a place to leave belongings at your own risk. A changing tent is available; there are no showers. Parking is at Hoekelum farm, with clear directions and traffic marshals. Dogs are not allowed during the race. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the race offers options for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Storekeeper Rijsserbergcross
location: Atletiekterrein AV Rijssen, Rijssen, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Storekeeper Rijsserbergcross is an annual cross-country race, celebrating its 27th edition this year. The race takes place in beautiful, hilly surroundings around the AV Rijssen athletics grounds, where the start and finish are located. Several distances are offered, catering to different ability levels. The cross-country race is known for its challenging course and welcoming organization.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain around the athletics grounds
Start and finish on the AV Rijssen athletics track
Various distances for different ability levels
additional: The race is part of a broader athletics program and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.

name: Nienoord crossloop Leek
description: The Nienoord Crossloop Leek takes place on Saturday, November 28, 2026, in Leek, Groningen. Participants can choose between distances of 5 and 10 kilometers. This cross-country race offers a challenging course in a natural setting, ideal for runners who enjoy a varied trail. For the most up-to-date information, please refer to the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Cross-country course in a natural setting
Held in Leek, Groningen
additional: The race takes place in a natural setting, registration is required, and the event offers a sporting challenge for runners of all levels.

name: UHUT100 Winter - Rhenen
location: Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin, Leersum, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The UHUT100 Winter is a unique ultra trail that takes you across the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The race consists of two loops of more than 50 km each, spread over two days, with the start and finish at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin in Leersum. Participants can choose to run one of the 50+ km loops or the full 109 km over both days. The route follows varied single tracks through several nature reserves and is continually coordinated with the managers of these areas. Thanks to live tracking, friends and family can follow the runners during the event.
course_highlights: Two loops of 50+ km across the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Varied single tracks through several nature reserves
Start and finish at the wooded Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin
additional: Because of the short daylight hours, the UHUT100 Winter is spread over two days, with a 09:00 start on Saturday and Sunday. Participants navigate entirely by GPX and receive refreshments every 10–15 km. The finish is before 17:00 on both days. All ultra participants receive a live tracker when collecting their race number. The race takes place in November 2026, with the start and finish at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin in Leersum. Participants can choose the 50 km distance or the full UHUT100, which covers more than 100 km. The race is characterised by winter conditions and a challenging course through the nature of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug.

name: TRAILS - Flyvestationen
description: Trails - Flyvestationen 2025 is a race taking place on Sunday, November 30, 2025, at Flyvestation Værløse. The area is a unique trail destination

name: Adventsjoggen
description:
Experience a magical start to the festive season with Adventsjoggen at Stora Hjortstorps Gård in Örebro on 29 November! Bring your friends, family or colleagues for a day filled with exercise, community and delicious food. Choose between a scenic 7.2 km or a challenging 15 km. There’s also a 600 m Kidsrun for the youngest participants.

After the race, a warming reward awaits: hearty goulash and freshly baked bread, all included in the entry fee! The course takes you through beautiful surroundings, starting and finishing at the farm, along idyllic landscapes past Rävgången and Naturens Hus.

name: Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is an atmospheric forest run in Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines sporting activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through scenic Klövensteen Forest
Choice of 6 km or 12 km distance
Race bib in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race packet pickup on event day from 09:00 to 11:15. The race bib is in the shape of a Christmas tree and must be worn visibly on the chest. Bag drop-off is available with the coupon on the race bib. Late entries are not possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Awards ceremony for the 6 km at 11:15 and for the 12 km at 13:00. The event includes race bib pickup, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Schiffenberger Wald, Giessen, is a flat running event held annually in November. It offers 5 km and 10 km races for adults, as well as races for children and young people. The event is ideal for runners looking for a fast, flat course in a natural setting. The start and finish are at the same location; exact details are available through RUNME Premium. The run takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, and starts at 10:15 a.m.
course_highlights: Flat course in Schiffenberger Wald
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Races for children and young people
additional: The start and finish are the same for all races. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium. There are also 5 km walking and Nordic walking events. Results are usually published on the RUNME results page shortly after runners finish. The event is for adults, children, and young people, with start times in the morning. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, and part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race to the 10.3 km main race, for children, young people, and adults. The course runs mostly on forest trails, with a short asphalt section before the finish at Waldstadion Syke. The event offers a varied cross-country running experience in an autumn setting and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails with only approx. 100 m of asphalt
Start and finish at Waldstadion Syke
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series, with several distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 3.6 km middle distance for U16 and older, and 10.3 km main race for U20 and older. The event is part of a series of three races, with series scoring for those who register before the first race. Switching between the middle and long distances is possible, but does not count as a series switch. Forest trails, cross-country running, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities at Waldstadion Syke

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. The main course covers 26 kilometres, mostly on hiking trails with scenic sections and historical landmarks. There is also a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children’s run, offering an accessible introduction to running. The event combines a sporting challenge with nature and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg, with approx. 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20 and 22.5
A scenic, undulating 7.5 km route around Küchensee, plus a 1.5 km children’s run with spectator support
additional: New since 2022: split-time tracking on the 26 km course, allowing spectators and athletes to follow intermediate times. The races start at the same time, with runners lining up on the right-hand side at the start on Königsdamm. The children’s run is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de. Routes around Lake Ratzeburg and Küchensee; online registration opens on 01.09.2026; participant limits apply to each distance; timing by Race Result.

name: Schmachtendorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Schmachtendorf St. Nicholas Run is a traditional running event held in late November in Oberhausen-Schmachtendorf, organized by Spvgg. Sterkrade-Nord 1920/25 e.V. The event offers races for all age groups, from a 300-meter Bambini run to a 10 km run for adults. The course runs mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag and around the Buchenweg sports ground. Every participant receives a Stutenkerl, and awards are presented promptly after each race, with prizes for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: 300-meter loop around the artificial-turf pitch on Buchenweg (Bambini run)
10 km run mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag
Start and finish at the Buchenweg sports ground; no traditional city-center course
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race bib, provided by TAF-TIMING. Certificates are available on the event day or online later. Parking is signposted at Heinrich Böll Comprehensive School and at the Schmachtendorfer Straße market square. Distances: 300 m Bambini run and 10 km for adults; course on forest trails and sports grounds; children’s and adult categories; November weather may be rainy.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race taking place for the 54th time. The races run through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used to prepare for cross-country championships. Various course distances give young people and adults the opportunity to achieve personal bests or improve their endurance. The Remels Primary School Friends’ Association will provide coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on the weather
Various course distances for different age groups
additional: U14 runners can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m; U16 runners can take part in the 4450 m middle-distance race. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m start chute. The course uses a checkpoint system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve; course distances vary; registration and results online; coffee and cake from the Remels Primary School Friends’ Association.

name: Überruhrer Adventscrosslauf
description: The Überruhrer Advent Cross-Country Run takes place on November 29, 2026, in Essen-Überruhr. Its cross-country course takes runners through wintry nature in keeping with the Advent season. The event is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, and is held in accordance with the German Athletics Regulations (DLO). The awards ceremony and certificate distribution take place right next to the course, creating a friendly, sporting atmosphere. A catering stand in the finish area serves hot and cold drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through the natural surroundings of Essen-Überruhr
Age-group categories from U8 through seniors M/W 80
Awards ceremony and certificate distribution right next to the course
additional: Parking is available in the adjacent residential area; the recommended parking location is Marktplatz Überruhr (approx. 500 m on foot). Public transport is available via bus routes SB15, 144, 166, and 177. Catering in the finish area includes hot and cold drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The race office is located in the park. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. The race takes place on the first Sunday of Advent, in typical November weather, with temperatures around 2–7°C and frequent rain. The event is open to everyone who enjoys cross-country running and offers a friendly atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held on site.

name: Oriëntatieloop Soest
distance_verbose: 8 km, 7 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3000 meter
description: The Soest Orienteering Run takes place on Sunday, 24 November 2024, in and around the Soesterduinen. This is a challenging sport in which you run while

name: Pietenloop Bemmel
location: Sportpark De Heister, Bemmel, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The Pietenloop is a small, friendly recreational run in Bemmel, suitable for the whole family. Children can choose from three distances (400, 800 and 1,200 metres), starting on the athletics track, while adults take part in a 5 km run through the countryside around Bemmel. The Pieten are there to lead the warm-up and run alongside the children, giving the event a festive atmosphere. The start is at De Heister sports park, where changing rooms and showers are also available. After the run, there is a treat for everyone, and young participants receive a lovely Pieten medal.
course_highlights: Children’s races of 400, 800 and 1,200 metres on the athletics track
Recreational 5 km run through Haalderen and along the Waal dike, free of traffic
Start and finish at De Heister sports park, with facilities including changing rooms and showers
additional: The Pieten lead the warm-up for children at 9:45. There is no electronic timekeeping; a central clock is used. The first-, second- and third-place finishers in the children’s races and the 5 km will be listed on the website. Food and drinks can be paid for by QR code in the clubhouse. The venue opens at 9:00 for race-number collection. A family-friendly event for children with Pieten, held at De Heister sports park in Bemmel.

name: Run Rondje Rhenoy
description: Run Rondje Rhenoy is an autumn classic being held for the 20th time this year in Beesd. The race takes place on Sunday 29 November 2026 at 13:00 and features a beautiful course through the villages of Beesd, Rumpt and Rhenoy. After the race, there will be a friendly get-together and a prize draw, with great prizes to be won, including a voucher for running shoes. The race is suitable for runners aged 12 and over for the 5 km, and aged 16 and over for the 10.8 km. The event is known for its sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Course through Beesd, Rumpt and Rhenoy
Start and finish at rvv BRC, Sportstraat 7, Beesd
Autumn classic with a friendly get-together and prize draw after the race
additional: Registration desk open from 11:30 to 12:50. Briefing at 13:00. Prize-giving and prize draw around 14:30. Event closes at 15:30. Entry for the 5 km is open to participants aged 12 and over; the 10.8 km is open to participants aged 16 and over. Participation is at your own risk. After the race, there will be an opportunity to chat over a drink and a snack in the sports club canteen. The main prize in the draw is a €150 voucher for running shoes at Sporthuis De Jager. The race starts and finishes at RVV BRC, Sportstraat 7, with the start at 13:02 and prize-giving around 14:30. Registration opens at 11:30, and the event closes at 15:30. A cycling event is also being organized on the same day by BBB Bike Boys.

name: Sint Nicolaasloop

description: The Sint Nicolaasloop in Zwolle is an annual running event held on one of the last Sundays before 5 December, Sinterklaas. The event offers four distances: a 1.5 km kids’ run, and the 5 km, 8 km and 10 English miles for adults. The course runs through the beautiful countryside north of Zwolle, past the Berkum and AA-landen districts, and is suitable for runners of all ages and abilities. The event is organised by an enthusiastic group of volunteers from the SNL running group, who provide a welcoming and well-organised race experience.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside north of Zwolle
Route past the Berkum and AA-landen districts
Clear yellow route arrows and guidance for the fastest runners
additional: Race numbers with chips are not sent by post and can be collected on Friday evening or Sunday morning at SV HTC. All participants receive a running shirt; participants who register before 1 October can specify their size. Parking near the start is limited, so cycling is recommended. No late registration is available. Runners with disabilities may take part in the kids’ run regardless of age. The course is not closed to traffic; traffic marshals provide guidance where needed. Registration opens from 1 September 2026 via inschrijven.nl; the maximum number of participants is 1000. The course is marked with yellow arrows; traffic marshals will be present; race numbers and shirts can be collected at the venue.

name: Tis voor niks
description: ’T is voor niks is a friendly running and walking event in Geldrop, held annually since 1999. Participation is free thanks to the efforts of many volunteers and sponsors. Five distances are available, ranging from 6 to 25 kilometres, with the start and finish at Café Brabants Bont and Winkelcentrum Coevering. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and good on-course support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Café Brabants Bont, next to the sports hall and Winkelcentrum Coevering
Refreshment stations with water, gingerbread, coffee and tea at two locations for the longer distances
Clearly marked routes with arrows; walkers do not receive route sheets
additional: Walkers start individually or in groups from the event office at Wijkgebouw De Dreef. Timekeeping stops at 14:30, and all participants must have finished by then. If participants are running late, the organisers may direct them onto a shorter route. Changing and freshening up are available at Sporthal De Coevering from 9:30. Personal drinks can be dropped off at the information stand before 9:30 for transport to the refreshment station. Multiple distances, organised annually, succeeded by Lucas Klamer Half Marathon.

name: Warandeloop (Zondag)

description: The Warandeloop in Tilburg is a versatile cross-country running event with a broad program for different categories, including youth, masters, recreational runners and the Dutch National Cross Country Championships. The event takes place on Sunday, 29 November 2026, and offers challenging courses in a natural setting. The Warandeloop is known for its rich history and for combining sporting achievements with a welcoming atmosphere for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: A variety of cross-country courses suitable for all ages and abilities
Dutch National Cross Country Championship races for seniors, U18, U20 and masters
Natural, challenging terrain in Tilburg
additional: Online late registration is available until half an hour before each event via the website. On-site payments cannot be made in cash or by card; you must show your registration confirmation on your mobile phone to receive your race number. Three-day event with approximately 5,000 participants and 6,000 spectators, including the special evening run ‘Warande by Night’ and photo and video coverage.

name: UHUT100 Winter - Doorn
location: Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin, Leersum, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: UHUT100 Winter is a unique ultra trail that takes you across the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The race consists of two laps, each more than 50 km, run on Saturday and Sunday, with the start and finish at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin in Leersum. Participants can choose one of the 50+ km ultras or run the full 109 km over two days. The route follows varied single tracks through several nature reserves and is continually coordinated with the managers of these areas. Thanks to live tracking, friends and family can follow the runners during the event.
course_highlights: Two 50+ km laps across the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Varied single tracks through several nature reserves
Start and finish at the wooded Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin
additional: UHUT100 Winter is split over two days because of the short daylight hours in November. Participants receive a live tracker when collecting their race bib. The route is navigated entirely via GPX, and refreshments are provided every 10–15 km. Finish both days before 17:00. Parking is available at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin; follow the instructions of the parking attendants. Route split over 2 days, start at 09:00, finish before 17:00, navigation via GPX, no cups at aid stations, parking at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin.

name: JulekalenderLØBET

name: Sinterklaasloop Bolsward
description: The Sinterklaas Run in Bolsward is a friendly, traditional running race held annually on the last Monday before Sinterklaas. The route runs through and around Bolsward and covers 7.2 kilometres. The race starts at 19:00 at Sporthal De Middelzee. Electronic timing is used, and approximately 25 traffic marshals are on hand to ensure safety. Participants are asked to wear reflective clothing and/or lights for their own safety.
course_highlights: Route through and around Bolsward
Distance of 7.2 kilometres
Starts at Sporthal De Middelzee at 19:00
additional: Registration on the day is not possible. Participants are electronically timed. Sponsor Sporthuis AP van der Feer makes it possible to win prizes in a draw using your race number as your lottery number. Approximately 25 traffic marshals help ensure a safe race. Reflective clothing and/or lights are recommended. The race starts at Sporthal De Middelzee. Registration is online only, with no same-day registration. Participants are advised to wear reflective clothing. There are no official performance prizes, but there are prize draws for participants.

name: Bjørgene Løpskarusell 3. Løp
description: The athletics group warmly welcomes you to a new running series in Bjørgene on February 4th! The snow is gone and the trails are nice in Bjørgene. We hope to see you at the starting line!
course_highlights: The snow is gone and the trails are nice in Bjørgene :-)
We hope to see you at the starting line!

name: Kolding Light Run 2026 powered by Andelskassen
Night Shift Trail - Växjö
location: Shooting range parking area, Notteryd, Växjö, Sweden
description: Night.Shift Trailrun Växjö is a trail running event held in scenic surroundings by the shooting range car park in Notteryd, Växjö. The event focuses on a unique experience in technical and challenging terrain rather than competition and prizes. The organisers place great emphasis on community and purpose, with a large part of the entry fee going to charity. The event is part of the Mossarun events, run by a group of friends with a passion for trails and nature.
course_highlights: Technical and challenging trails in scenic surroundings
Running across varied terrain, including forest and hilly sections
Focus on the experience and community rather than competition
additional: The event is run on a non-profit basis, and a large part of the proceeds goes to the Sangter Foundation, which helps people in Sikkim, India. The focus is on small events with few participants to create a personal and meaningful experience. Previous Mossarun events have included various distances and formats, including ultra and Backyard Ultra. The organisers are open to collaborations and innovative event ideas. The start and finish are near the shooting range car park in Notteryd. Start waves are listed as 17.30–18.00 and 19.00–19.30. Participants receive a start chip and check out and back in to record their lap time. Food and non-alcoholic beer are served after the race.

name: Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf
description: The Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf is a popular race around the Christmas market in Wiedenbrück’s old town, illuminated for the festive season. The course is a five-lap circuit of approximately 10.2 km and has not been officially measured. The race traditionally takes place in December and offers a festive atmosphere in the town centre. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück and attracts numerous runners from the region.
course_highlights: Five-lap circuit around the Christmas market
Wiedenbrück’s old town illuminated for the festive season
Approximately 10.2 km; run clockwise
additional: Start and finish on Lange Straße in Wiedenbrück. Race-pack collection on 5.12.2025 from 15:00 at the Luise-Hensel-Saal in the Stadthaus. Online registration only, opening on 8.10.2025 at 21:00. No race-day registration. Time limit: 75 minutes. Wearing headphones or earbuds is prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants are asked to keep as far to the right as possible and not to run in groups, to allow others to lap them. Participant limit: 1,100. Online registration only. Medals can be reordered. Start on 04.12.2026.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: Grønbroløbet - Julespecial
description: Grønbroløbet - Christmas Special takes place on December 2, 2023, with a start at 9:00 a.m. from Grønbrovej 1, 4262 Sandved (Grønbrohallen). The route is a bla

name: Vinterkarusellen 3. løp
description: The 3rd race of the Winter Carousel takes place in Fana, and all times achieved in this year's carousel will be approved for statistics for both 5 and 10 km. This means that a personal record set in the Winter Carousel will be permanently recognized. The Ålesund Winter Carousel has a long history that started in the mid-1980s, and from the winter of 2023, it is the Ålesund races that will serve as the organizer.
course_highlights: All times achieved in this year's Winter Carousel will be approved for statistics for both 5 and 10 km.
A personal record set in the Winter Carousel will always be recognized.
Ålesund Winter Carousel started in the mid-1980s and has had several organizers over the years.

name: Bergen Advents Maraton
description: Join the Bergen Advent Marathon on Saturday, December 6, where you can choose between a half marathon (21,097 meters) or a marathon (42,195 meters). The course consists of an out-and-back route on asphalt roads that are completely car-free or have very little traffic, and a large part of the distance runs along a disused railway track in idyllic, rural surroundings. For marathon runners, the same loop is run twice, and the course is slightly undulating except for a hilltop at Fana Stadium that must be run up and down from both sides.
course_highlights: The route runs on asphalt roads that are either completely car-free or have very little traffic.
A large part of the route is on a disused railway track and runs through idyllic, rural surroundings.
The course is slightly hilly, except for a hilltop at Fana Stadium that must be run up and down both ways.

The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.

The races start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2. Adults and older teenagers can choose between a medium 4.1 km cross-country run and a long 8.2 km run, while younger children take part in shorter, fun runs. The event has a St Nicholas theme, with a piggyback run for parents carrying babies and various races for toddlers and young people. Every participant receives a chocolate Santa Claus as a gift.

description: The Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km is an annual pre-Christmas road race in Steinfurt, Germany, held as part of the Nikolausmarkt. The race starts at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt and finishes at the Nikolausmarkt. The course first passes through the historic old town, then follows natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area before returning to the market. Since its founding in 1975, the race has become a fixture in the local running calendar, attracting both club and recreational runners from the region.

Route through the historic old town
Loop on natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area

The event is known for its sporting atmosphere, and every participant receives a keepsake.

The atmosphere is always great, and the event is open to all ages. Join in and experience running at its best in a beautiful setting.

description: Celebrate the second Sunday of Advent with a unique running experience on Halleberg, one of western Sweden’s most spectacular table mountains. The route offers varied scenery and a close-to-nature experience through enchanting forests, past lakes and along beautiful trails, with changing terrain ranging from soft forest paths to technical sections and more open plateau trails. Along the way, enjoy magnificent views of Lake Vänern and fascinating geology that tells a story dating back hundreds of millions of years. After the run, participants gather for a festive Advent fika—a cosy and well-deserved end to the second Sunday of Advent.

description: The Lierløpet is an exciting race series that offers various distances for both men and women of all ages. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km, with categories for all age groups from 11 years and up. The race takes place in scenic surroundings and follows the well-known Linnesrunden, an easy-to-run route suitable for everyone. There are also prizes for the top runners, as well as opportunities to set personal records.

description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.

description: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night is a unique trail running race taking place in Dalby on December 12. The race features a 1 km light trail course with a substantial hill at the beginning. It is a challenge combining speed and running strategy in dark, cold conditions, with the possibility of running up to 20 km. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap point, and prizes are awarded to many participants. The race is open to all levels and ambitions, and is organised with a focus on enjoying the forest.

Paved, gravel and forest roads
Start and finish at Ilmtalstadion Bad Berka

Changing rooms and showers are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße (approx. 500 m walk). The race office opens at 9:00 a.m. The routes have a rolling profile. Online registration is available. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße.

distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km

name: Ameland Adventurerun
description: The Ameland Adventurerun is an adventurous running event held in December on the Wadden Sea island of Ameland. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, as well as special children’s distances of 1 and 2 kilometres. The event combines a sporting challenge with the island’s unique natural surroundings and winter elements. It is a welcoming event with a finish party and a warm reception for runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Run between the Wadden Sea and the North Sea amid unspoilt nature
Distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, plus children’s distances
Winter elements and a lively finish party with Christmas tunes
additional: After the finish, participants in the 5, 10 and 21.1 km races receive a medal and a special Ameland Adventurerun bandana. The race office is at Sporthal Nes, where participants can collect their race pack. The organisers promote sustainability by minimising the use of cups at aid stations and offering ECO cups. Participants must book their own ferry crossing through Wagenborg Passenger Services. First aid is provided by professionals. A shirt for the Kidsrun is available through Eilandverhuur Ameland. Distances: 5, 10 and 21 km, plus children’s distances; registration opens on 1 April; winter conditions are possible; location: Nes, Ameland.

name: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra
location: Speelvijver Peddelpoel, Velsen, North Holland, Netherlands
description: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra is a unique running event in Velsen-Zuid where participants run laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes to continue to the next lap. Participants can choose on the day which distance they run. The event takes place at the Peddelpoel recreational lake and is limited to 150 participants. It is organised by volunteers from Loopmeesters and RunX Haarlem. The start and rest area has facilities including toilets and picnic tables. After the event, all runners receive hot chocolate as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve
30-minute time limit per lap
Start and finish at the Peddelpoel recreational lake, with facilities
additional: A maximum of 150 participants per edition. Participants bring their own food and drinks. There are transition cups for the fastest runners in the final lap, one per distance. The start and rest area has space for tents, chairs and support crews. All participants receive a keepsake and hot chocolate before they leave. Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km, a 30-minute time limit per lap, participants bring their own food and drinks, keepsake and hot chocolate after the event.

name: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER
description: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER is a running race taking place in Tuitjenhorn on 12 December 2026. The race is listed on Inschrijven.nl, where participants can register and find more details. The event is presented on the WeTri platform, which supports a wide range of triathlon and running events in the Netherlands. The race invites runners to take on a sporting challenge while also raising awareness of cancer.
course_highlights: Supporting cancer research
Location in Tuitjenhorn
Registration via Inschrijven.nl
additional: The event focuses on charity and running, with an emphasis on supporting cancer research. No specific distance or course information is available.

name: KNRM West Coast Challenge
location: Hoek van Holland, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands

price_tiers.distance: Duo - hele of halve challenge (halve prijs + sponsoractie)

description: The KNRM West Coast Challenge is a unique one-day endurance event in which teams of two take turns running and cycling over 130 kilometres from Hoek van Holland to Den Helder, almost entirely along the beach. There is also a 62-kilometre Half Challenge for pairs and solo entrants; solo entrants may be accompanied by a cyclist. The event raises funds for the KNRM, with all proceeds going towards its rescue work. The Full Challenge starts on 12 December 2026 at 04:30 and the Half Challenge at 11:00. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants are encouraged to strengthen their connection with the KNRM.
course_highlights: 130 kilometres, almost entirely along the beach, passing twelve KNRM coastal stations
The course is unmarked, so participants find their own way
The crossing at IJmuiden on KNRM lifeboats and the changing tides are important
additional: Participants must find their own route because the course is unmarked. Front and rear bicycle lights are mandatory in the dark (04:30–08:00 and from 17:00). If beach conditions are poor, the cyclist may ride through the dunes. There is a reserve date of 16 January 2027 in case of bad weather. The Half Challenge starts at 11:00 at restaurant Sea You in Velsen-Noord. Teams can choose to pay the full fee or pay half price by organising a fundraising campaign through samenvoorknrm.nl. Registration is confirmed after payment or after reaching the fundraising target. The event follows a run-bike-run format and has a strong focus on fundraising for the KNRM. Details about registration and participation fees are not specified.

name: Rotary Santa Run Bussum
description: The Rotary Santa Run in Bussum takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and is a fun running event for the whole family, teams, friends, and neighbors. The event starts at 15:30 and combines sport with fun and support for a good cause, Stichting Hulphond. After the run, there is an awards ceremony and a get-together in Kapelstraat. The Santa Run is a festive event that brings people together in the center of Bussum.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the center of Bussum
Festive atmosphere with a warm-up and medal ceremony
Drinks in Kapelstraat after the event
additional: Schedule: 15:00 gathering, 15:15 warm-up, 15:30 run starts, 16:00–16:45 medal ceremony, 16:15–17:00 drinks for runners in Kapelstraat. On the day, organizers can be reached through identifiable Rotary members wearing yellow vests. The event includes fun runs for families, classmates, teams, friends, and neighborhoods; several Rotary Clubs in the Netherlands organize similar events; in 2026, participation will expand to include extensive nationwide involvement.

name: Juleløbet Skamling - Et anderledes Juleeventyr
