name: Nyttårstrimmen
description: The New Year's Run is a 10 km recreational race suitable for all runners. This race has a long tradition and is Norway's oldest currently active recreational race, held every New Year's Eve since 1975. This year, we celebrate the 50th anniversary of the New Year's Run, which attracts hundreds of participants in Grenland. Participants can expect a varied and enjoyable experience, despite challenges such as snow and weather conditions.
course_highlights: The New Year's run has been going strong every New Year's Eve since 1975.
Last year there were over 1100 registrants, and the organizers hope for even more this year.
The race has a special atmosphere, with various distances and activities for all ages.

images.alt_text: Participants in the New Year Run are running through the city.
Participants in the New Year's Run are warming up before the race.
New Year Run logo: Runners and race name.

name: Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: The Silvesterlauf Bremen is a popular running event on December 31 that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers various distances, from 400 m for Bambinis to 10 km for experienced runners, through the beautiful surroundings of Werdersee. Alongside a sporting end to the year, festive music and a New Year’s Eve atmosphere make for a special experience. Participants in costumes are warmly invited to add their own creative touch to the event and run together into the New Year.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Werdersee
More accessible 2.5 km route for beginners and people with special needs
Festive New Year’s Eve atmosphere with music and medals for all finishers
additional: Start times vary by distance: 5 km run at 12:00, 2.5 km walk at 12:30, 5 km and 10 km walks at 12:50, 400 m Bambini run at 12:55, 1,000 m kids’ run at 13:00, 10 km run at 13:15. Race materials can be shipped for a fee. More accessible 2.5 km route suitable for everyone. Costumes are expressly encouraged for a special New Year’s Eve feeling. Various distances, including children’s and walking options, festive atmosphere, medals for everyone, creative costumes welcome.

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a traditional year-end race held on December 31. The event features a 7.7 km loop, mostly on paved paths through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and along the Stichkanal to the Ihme. The race starts at 13:00 at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer. After the race, participants can refuel with mulled wine and bratwurst and receive a finisher wheat beer glass as a keepsake. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and mass start.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Start and finish at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer
additional: Mass start; mulled wine and bratwurst at low prices after the race; every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass in the event design. On-the-day registration is possible on site from 12:00 (cash or PayPal). The race takes place on December 31, with online registration open until 31.12.25 at 10:00. There is a mass start and festivities that make the race a sociable way to end the year.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: The 49th Wernigerode New Year's Eve Run is the perfect end to the year in the Harz district for running enthusiasts. The race takes place on December 31, 2026, at Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., this popular event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Run through Wernigerode's picturesque old town
Festive end-of-year atmosphere in the Harz district
additional: The course goes around Wernigerode Castle; start and finish at Marstall; no shower facilities; several events, including youth races and training sessions.

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: The Burgwedel New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Burgwedel. The races cover several distances, including 10.6 km, 5.3 km and 2 km for children, and follow a scenic course with the start and finish at the modernised stadium on Ramhorst. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is organised by Schwimmverein Burgwedel. It is a popular sporting way to round off the year, with a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse range of participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the recently modernised stadium on Ramhorst
Distances: 10.6 km, 5.3 km and a 2 km children’s race
Beautiful blue running track in the stadium
additional: The starting signal is given promptly at 12:00 by the local mayor. The event traditionally takes place on Ramhorst, where the series began in 1984. There is an award for the largest group, and the event is supported by numerous volunteers, sponsors and spectators. Distances: 2 km, 5.3 km, 10 km; December weather is usually cold and snowy; the event involves local clubs, fire brigades and families; course records have been set.

name: Silvesterlauf Salzgitter
organizer: Move SZ - Wir fördern Sport e.V.
description: The Silvesterlauf at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event held on the last day of the year. The event offers various running and walking distances for different age groups and ability levels. The race is a sporting highlight and a meeting place for runners and spectators who want to end the year on an active note together. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a team classification and an awards ceremony that gives special recognition to the children’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes at Salzgittersee of 5.7 km and 11.4 km
Children’s race over 1.2 km for age groups 2013 to 2019
Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners
additional: Race number collection and late registration (plus €3) from 16.12. to 28.12.2025 at the Stadtbad Salzgitter pool cashier. Changes of registration and late registration are possible on 30.12. (15:00–17:00) and 31.12. (11:00–13:00) in the Stadtbad foyer. Online registration is available until 31.12.25 at 10:00 without an extra fee, unless the event is full. Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners. Race packs do not need to be collected in person. Online registration until 31.12.25, race number collection at Stadtbad Salzgitter, refreshments in the finish area, parking available at Salzgittersee, dogs and jogging strollers allowed

name: Silvesterlauf Magdeburg
description: The Magdeburg New Year's Eve Run is a traditional popular sporting event that has been held on the last day of the year for over 50 years. It brings together runners of all ages and ability levels in the city of Magdeburg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and its sporting end to the year, with over 900 participants crossing the finish line. The run is part of the Magdeburg City Rankings and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop, run twice
10 km main race
1.5 km children's run for the youngest participants
additional: The New Year's Eve Run is the eighth and final event in the Magdeburg City Rankings. More than 950 runners of all ages take part. The event is organized by the Magdeburger LaufKultur 08 e.V. club. Courses, registration, results, photos, press reports; the weather in December is usually cold and snowy.

name: Silvesterlauf Berlin
description: The Berlin New Year’s Eve Run on December 31 gives runners the chance to end the year on an active note. The event offers three different distances (4 km, 6 km and 10 km) through the scenic Grunewald, with challenging sections such as Drachenberg and Teufelsberg rewarded with great views over Berlin. Alongside the sporting experience, fun takes centre stage, particularly with the option to run in costume and prizes for the best costumes. At the finish, all finishers receive a delicious Pfannkuchen as a sweet keepsake to hang around their neck.
course_highlights: Route through the Grunewald, including Drachenberg and Teufelsberg
Fantastic views across Berlin before the turn of the year
A choice of distances: 4 km, 6 km and 10 km
additional: The start and finish are near Mommsenstadion (Waldschulallee 34, 14055 Berlin). The race pass and race number will be sent by email in advance. Race materials can be collected on site from 10:00 a.m. on the event day. Timing is provided by a disposable transponder attached to the race number. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes. Water, tea and Pfannkuchen are available at the finish. Only reusable cups are used. Changing facilities are available at Mommsenstadion, but there is no bag drop. Results and certificates are available online that evening. Distances vary between 2, 4, 6 and 10 km; a run for all age groups; start and finish at Mommsenstadion; refreshments include Pfannkuchen, with awards for the top finishers and the most original costumes.

name: Silvesterlauf Neuss
description: The Silvesterlauf Neuss is an established 10 km race that starts at 12:00 on December 31, 2026, at the Uedesheimer Deichtor. The course offers beautiful views of the Rhine as it passes through the Rhine meadows and Uedesheim fields, making it a perfect sporting end to the year. The event is suitable for all runners, from beginners to professionals, and combines a sporting challenge with a festive year-end atmosphere. The race also supports Aktion Luftballon, the support association for the children’s clinic at Lukaskrankenhaus Neuss, through fundraising.
course_highlights: 10 km course approved by the DLV
Start at the Uedesheimer Deichtor with views of the Rhine
Run through the Rhine meadows and Uedesheim fields
additional: A supporting program in the start/finish area at the Deichtor creates a pleasant year-end atmosphere. The race raises funds for Aktion Luftballon, the support association for the children’s clinic at Lukaskrankenhaus Neuss. Record participation in 2025, with 1,040 registrations and 859 finishers. The event begins at 12:00 on December 31, 2026, at the Uedesheimer Rhine embankment and features a 10 km course. Training plans are also available, and the event is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic running route.

name: Silvesterlauf Zossen-Ludwigsfelde
description: The 46th Zossen-Ludwigsfelde New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race covering approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde. The event begins at Zossen Town Hall Square with a ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. and the official start at 9:15 a.m. on the outskirts of Zossen. The route follows firmly frozen paths that are easy to run on in good weather. At the finish in Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, participants receive a commemorative medal and a prosecco as a reward.
course_highlights: Approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde
Start on the outskirts of Zossen, beyond the railway crossing on the old B246
Finish at Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, with a medal and prosecco
additional: Ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. at Zossen Town Hall Square. In frosty conditions, the route is firmly frozen and easy to run on. At the finish, runners receive a commemorative medal and prosecco. Registration deadline: December 28, 2025; route may be frozen depending on the weather; commemorative medal and prosecco for finishers; event away from the stadium.

name: Silvesterlauf Gießen
description: The traditional Sparkasse Gießen New Year’s Eve Run takes place on 31 December 2026 in Gießen-Ost and offers runners a varied event with four distances: a schoolchildren’s race, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The event is sold out, with 1,800 starting places, and is known for its family atmosphere and high-quality organisation. The start and finish are at Karl-Reuter-Weg, and all finishers receive a medal sponsored by Autohaus Erben. In addition to the races, there are awards and ceremonies for walkers and Nordic walkers, as well as a team competition with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Karl-Reuter-Weg in Gießen-Ost
Four distances: schoolchildren’s race, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
Separate results and awards ceremony for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: Race-number pickup is available before Christmas at Sparkasse Gießen premises and on the day before the race at Sporthalle Ost. Changing and shower facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost. Every finisher receives a medal; for the first time, fruit will be provided in the finish area. Start times are staggered to ease congestion on the course. The field is limited to 2,200 participants, and medals go to the first 2,000 finishers. Finisher shirts can be ordered at an additional cost. Parking is available at Philosophikum I and the Studierendenwerk on Otto-Behaghel-Straße. GPX files of the courses are available and can be used with navigation apps. Participant limit: 2,200. Online registration is open until 27 December 2025. Race-number pickup is on 27.12.2025. Medals for the first 2,000 finishers. Entry fee includes a deposit. Shower and changing facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost.

name: Silvesterlauf Schwalmstadt
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Schwalmstadt-Ziegenhain is a traditional race that has taken place every year on December 31 since 1970. The event offers a short 2.7 km race for children and young people, as well as a long 8.1 km race for adults. The race marks the end of the Schwalm-Eder Cup series and is known for its musical program, with samba rhythms by Sola Quente accompanying runners along the course. The event is organized by a dedicated team from TuSpo Ziegenhain and is a popular way for many track and field athletes to end the year.
course_highlights: Short race: 1 lap = 2,740 m; long race: 3 laps = 8,100 m
Samba rhythms by Sola Quente provide musical accompaniment
The course runs through Schützenwald, with parking nearby
additional: Parking is available in the woods between the hospital and the start. Access to the parking lot at the start is possible until 12:45 p.m. After 12:45 p.m., free parking is available at the Asklepios Hospital parking lot. The awards ceremony takes place at the venue in Schützenwald after the races. The race takes place in Schützenwald; online registration is available. The start and finish area is by the pond at Ziegelhütte. Parking is available nearby. There are no shower facilities. Food and drinks are available, along with a program of music and community activities.

name: Silvesterlauf Winsen (Aller)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt für Erwachsene und Jugendliche 5,00 € und ist im Vorfeld per Überweisung zu entrichten.

description: The MTV "Fichte" Winsen (Aller) New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional year-end running event that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 1,600 m for children to 10,300 m for adults, as well as a 6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure. The run starts and finishes at the Allertalsporthalle, where changing rooms and showers are also available. The event is officially sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and features a celebratory awards ceremony for the fastest participants in each distance.
course_highlights: Distances from 1,600 m to 10,300 m for all age groups
6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure
Start and finish at the Allertalsporthalle, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Race bib distribution from 2 December 2024 at the business office (Mon–Fri, 8:00–12:30). Late registration is possible on the event day from 12:00 to 13:45 for an additional fee. Plenty of parking is available at the Allertalsporthalle. Awards ceremony at approximately 15:30. Distances: 3 km, 5 km, 10.3 km, children’s race 1.6 km; walkers welcome. Start at 14:30. Register online or on site.

name: 12. Silvesterlauf an der Leine
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a popular end-of-year race that traditionally starts at 1:00 p.m. on December 31. The event offers a 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths along the Leine, through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and back along the Ihme. The race is organized by Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC), Bladerunner and Trimindous UG, and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with mulled wine and bratwurst after the race. Every finisher receives a wheat beer glass featuring the event design as a keepsake. There is also a walking category, making the event appealing to a range of participants.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course runs through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Return route along the Ihme
additional: Mass start at 1:00 p.m. Late entries are available on site on the day of the event from 12:00 p.m., payable in cash or via PayPal. Every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass featuring the event design. There is a walking category. The event venue is the clubhouse of Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC) at Weddigenufer 23, near Unisport. The race has a relaxed atmosphere, with mulled wine, bratwurst and a wheat beer glass for finishers. There is also a walking category, and the course is ideal for anyone who wants to round off the running year in good company.

name: 25. VR-Bank Mitte Silvesterlauf
location: Seeburger See, Bernshausen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The VR-Bank Mitte New Year’s Eve Run is an active way to round off the year, taking place around Lake Seeburger See in Bernshausen. The flat loop course on paved paths offers runners an attractive route of one or two laps around the lake, depending on the distance. The event traditionally takes place on 31 December and welcomes runners of all abilities for a festive end to the year. The start and finish areas are on Kreisstraße 106, near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall.
course_highlights: Flat loop course around Lake Seeburger See
Paved paths
5 km lap (1 lap around the lake) and 10 km lap (2 laps around the lake)
additional: Bib pickup on event day from 10:30 a.m. at the Bernshausen multipurpose hall, until 30 minutes before each start. Online late registration is not possible after 26.12.2025. The start and finish are on Kreisstraße 106, near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall. No bib pickup at Laufline Göttingen. No refund of the entry fee is available if a participant does not start or if the event is cancelled. Run on paved paths, online registration until 26.12.2025, bib pickup in Bernshausen, no late registration, no showers, winter conditions possible, recommended parking in Seeburg.

name: 38. Silvesterlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The SC Altenrheine New Year’s Eve Run is the region’s sporting finale to the year and, with up to 800 participants of all ages, is one of the largest running events in the area. The event offers various distances that run through Altenrheine and each finish with a lap of the stadium. The varied courses include out-and-back sections and loops through the town. The run is a popular opportunity to end the year on a sporting note and enjoy a sense of community.
course_highlights: 600 m out-and-back section along Schürweg towards the car park, plus 1 lap of the stadium
2,000 m out-and-back section along Schürweg towards Außenhook, plus 1 lap of the stadium
10,000 m with 3 loops through Altenrheine, plus 1 lap of the stadium
additional: The event is designed for up to 800 athletes of all ages. Each course finishes with a lap of the stadium. Distances range from 600 m to 10,000 m. Registration is online; registration details and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The run offers a festive atmosphere at the end of the year, with courses in the region and a broad participant base.

name: 40. Haseder Silvesterlauf
description: The Hasede New Year's Eve Run is a friendly, community-oriented event in Hasede, organized by TuS Hasede, a local sports club with a range of activities. The run is part of the club calendar and is aimed primarily at the local community, without a commercial focus or large numbers of visitors from further afield. There are two distances, 600 meters and 10 kilometers, but no detailed course description has been published. The event offers a relaxed way to close out the year in the Giesen region.
course_highlights: Two distances: 600 m and 10 km
Organized by the local sports club TuS Hasede
Typical winter weather; snow cover is possible
additional: The run takes place in Giesen. December weather is typically cold, with temperatures around 3 °C, lows of about -2 °C, and frequent snow cover. In addition to the New Year's Eve Run, TuS Hasede offers running groups, sports badge activities, and hikes. This is a local club event with no detailed course information, but a friendly community atmosphere. No exact entry fees are provided.

name: 44. Bad Harzburger Silvesterlauf
location: Sportpark an der Rennbahn, Bad Harzburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Bad Harzburg New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event organized by MTK Bad Harzburg since 1981. The race takes place every year on December 31 in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn and is the oldest New Year’s Eve run in the region. The event offers several distances, including 2,500, 5,000 and 10,000 meters, run on a 2,500-meter loop. Participants can record and follow their lap times electronically, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: 2,500-meter loop in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn
Electronic chip timing with split times after each lap
Traditional New Year’s Eve run since 1981, with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The race office opens at 11 a.m. on race day. Live results are available online for the first time at https://oresults.eu/events/2639. Timing is provided by a SportIdent chip, which is scanned after each lap on the 5,000- and 10,000-meter courses. Certificates and trophies are presented at 3:30 p.m. Distances: 2,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m; registration by post or on race day; electronic timing; awards ceremonies for top finishers; start at 1:30 p.m.

name: 47. Silvesterlauf rund um die Thülsfelder Talsperre
description: The 47th International New Year’s Eve Run around the Thülsfelder Talsperre is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve in Molbergen, Lower Saxony. The course runs around the Thülsfelder Talsperre and offers two distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km. Organized by SV Molbergen since 1975, the race is the final competition of the year for many runners and officially counts toward rankings. After the finish, traditional pea soup provides a sociable end to the event.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Thülsfelder Talsperre
Scenic route in Lower Saxony
Traditional start with a cannon shot
additional: The race starts with a cannon shot fired by a local fireworks club; traditional pea soup is served after the race; the event attracts many local runners and club runners; December weather is typically cold, with possible snowfall. Distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km; held on December 31, 2026; traditional communal meal after the race; large fields of participants can cause bottlenecks at the start.

name: Active Laufshop Silvesterlauf
description: The ACTIVE LAUFSHOP New Year’s Eve Run in Münster is a popular running event traditionally held on December 31. Organized by Laufsportfreunde Münster e.V., one of Germany’s largest running clubs, the event offers several race distances for runners of all abilities. The routes pass through the city of Münster, creating a varied and lively atmosphere to round off the year. The event is open to recreational runners and competitive athletes and supports community and running in the region.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 5 km and 10 km
Routes pass through the city of Münster
A varied and lively running atmosphere at the end of the year
additional: Course maps for the 3 km, 5 km and 10 km races are available as PDFs on the website. The run takes place annually on December 31 and is a popular way to end the year on an active note. Registration is already open.

name: Dübener Silvesterlauf
description: The 47th Dübener New Year's Eve Run takes place on December 31, 2025, in Bad Düben and is organized by SV Bad Düben, Athletics Department. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to end the year on an active note. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben and promises a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Registration is online via SV Bad Düben.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben
Traditional New Year's Eve run to close out the year
Event for children, young people, and adults
additional: The registration deadline is December 27, 2025. Registration is online via SV Bad Düben. The event is for children, young people, and active runners. The venue is the Obermühle sports facility, Parkstraße 1, Bad Düben. Cross-country run through heathland and woodland, children's and walking races, compact club event

name: Emmerthaler Silvesterlauf
description: The Emmerthal New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal, celebrating its 51st edition in 2026. Organized by TSG Emmerthal, the event gives runners the opportunity to track their performance with detailed lap times. It is supported by local sponsors and volunteer helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and the club. The race is known for its friendly, community spirit and warmly welcomes all participants.
course_highlights: Distances: 300 m and 7 km
Results published with lap times
Race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal
additional: Supported by local sponsors and helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and TSG Emmerthal. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The venue is in Emmerthal, with directions provided. December weather is typically cold and snowy; results are published with lap times; the event is very popular with runners and families.

name: Geraer Silvesterlauf
description: The Gera New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held annually on December 31 in Gera. The event offers various distances from 3 km to 20 km, with varied routes featuring elevation changes. The run is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners and ends in a festive atmosphere to mark the close of the year.
course_highlights: A range of distances: 3 km, 4 km, 11 km, and 20 km
Varied routes featuring elevation changes
Start and finish in front of the Panndorfhalle in Gera
additional: Online registration includes direct payment by credit card, Klarna, or PayPal. Participant certificates can be printed after the race until March 31 of the following year. The event offers extensive online media galleries and result records. The run takes place on December 31; details about the terrain and registration are available on the website.

name: Haseder Silvesterlauf
location: Dorfgemeinschaftshaus Giesen, Giesen, Hildesheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hasede New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Giesen. With courses for children and adults, the run offers a sporting and sociable way to see out the year with friends and family. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, professional timing and dedicated team of volunteers. The courses run through the residential area around the sports hall and offer both short and longer distances for different ability levels.
course_highlights: The 600 m course loops once around the sports hall, through the residential area and back
5 km and 10 km courses for ambitious runners
Family-friendly atmosphere with children’s races over 0.6 km and 1.2 km
additional: Professional timing is provided by Eichels-Event from Hanover. The event is supported by a large team of volunteers. Bambini races are offered for children over 0.6 km and 1.2 km. The awards ceremony takes place in the sports hall, which also serves as a meeting point. Courses for children and adults, results, photo gallery, timing by Eichels-Event, refreshments on site

name: Kieler Silvesterlauf
description: The Kiel New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held on December 31 in Kiel-Ellerbek at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz. The event is organized by LTV Kiel-Ost e.V. and is limited to 250 runners. In addition to the sporting competition, there is a costume contest for individuals and teams, as well as a draw for prizes. The awards ceremony takes place in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School, and every participant receives a memento and has the option to order a certificate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz
Limited to 250 runners
Costume contest for individuals and teams, with prizes
additional: Race materials can be collected at the sports hall on 30.12.2026 from 15:00 to 16:30 and on 31.12.2026 from 11:00 to 12:30. Late entrants must pay a fee and may receive a place if any are still available. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 14:30 in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School. There are no age-group rankings, but men and women are ranked separately. Participants who hand in their race number after the run are entered into a draw for prizes; attendance is required. Participant limit: 250; start times on 30.12.2026 and 31.12.2026; late registration possible; awards ceremony at approximately 14:30; certificates and prizes

name: Kölner Silvesterlauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportverein Köln rrh. 1874 e.V.
price_range: Schülerlauf 6 €, 5 km Lauf 10-15 €, 10 km Lauf 10-15 €, Staffellauf 25 €
description: The Kölner GAG Silvesterlauf celebrates its 50th edition on 31.12.2026 and invites both experienced runners and newcomers to a traditional sporting end to the year. The course runs through the traffic-free parkland of Merheimer Heide and is flat, fast, DLV-certified, officially measured, and eligible for rankings. The start and finish are in front of the stadium. The 10 km race covers three large laps, while the 5 km race covers two shortened laps, each including a lap inside the stadium. Relay teams share the course and make their handovers in the stadium. The event offers races over 950 m for students, 5 km, 10 km, and relay races.
course_highlights: Course through the traffic-free parkland of Merheimer Heide
Flat and fast, DLV-certified and officially measured
Start and finish at the stadium, with laps through the stadium and park
additional: Online registration is open until 27.12.2026 at 24:00. Late registration is available on the event day until 45 minutes before the start. The race office is in the TuS Köln rrh. tennis clubhouse. Race numbers can be collected on the event day from 09:45 to 12:45. The relay changeover zone is in the stadium. Changing rooms and showers are available. Courses through Merheimer Heide; online registration until 27.12.; late registration on the event day; start and finish at the stadium; timing with the Raceresult system.

name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: The Nellschütz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional 10 km road race in Lützen, Saxony-Anhalt, held on the morning of December 31. Since 2000, it has been a regular fixture in the local running calendar and offers runners in the Burgenlandkreis a chance to end the year together. The race starts near the church in Nellschütz and is officially organized within the German athletics framework, including insurance and coordination of the event date. Its characteristic relaxed style means runners usually run and chat in small groups rather than aiming for a personal best. After the race, participants are traditionally treated to hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family.
course_highlights: 10 km road race through Lützen and the surrounding area
Dedicated aid station on the course
Finish area with hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family
additional: Typical December weather: around 3 °C, a low of -2 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The race is designed as a communal year-end event, with runners taking part in small groups. The start is near the church in Nellschütz. The race starts in Nellschütz near the church, with a dedicated aid station on the course. The event is known as a year-end race with a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf
description: The Oberlichtenau New Year's Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race in Pulsnitz, Saxony. With a 1.2 km children’s race, a 4.8 km fun run and a 9.2 km long-distance race, it offers a sporting option for all ages and ability levels. The race is popular with runners and spectators and always takes place on New Year’s Eve, giving participants a chance to end the year on an athletic note. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated organizers.
course_highlights: 1.2 km children’s race
4.8 km fun run
9.2 km long-distance race
additional: The race traditionally takes place on December 31 and includes three distances for different age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and provides a sporting end to the year. The website has no information on start times or pricing tiers. The organizers provide a welcoming race environment, with mulled wine and a gymnasium as a meeting point. Start times on December 31, 2025: 13:10, 13:50 and 14:00; on-site registration available; race distances: 1.2 km children’s race, 4.8 km fun run, 9.2 km long-distance race; refreshments provided by club members.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: The OTB New Year’s Eve Run in Osnabrück is a traditional year-end race that welcomes recreational runners, walkers and competitive athletes alike. On the last day of the year, participants can choose from several distances, including a 10 km main race, walking routes, a 5.6 km short race, an accessible fun run and a Bambini run. The event offers a lively atmosphere and modern timing with a disposable chip. The route passes through scenic areas such as Rubbenbruchsee and Natruper Holz, and the race has been a fixture on Osnabrück’s running calendar since 1980.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race goes to Rubbenbruchsee, through Natruper Holz and over Finkenhügel before returning to Illoshöhe
Walking route along Rubbenbruchsee (approx. 8 km), not timed
Accessible fun run on the Illoshöhe track, with up to 5 laps of 400 m each
additional: Timing uses a disposable chip attached to the race number (walking is not timed). From 2025, the Bambini route goes through the “big finish.” The accessible fun run is new from 2025. Start times vary by distance: walkers at 11:20, Bambini at 11:30, fun run at 11:50, 5.6 km short race at 12:10, and 10 km main race at 12:20. Spikes are not allowed on the 10 km and 5.6 km routes. Several race options are available, including an accessible run, a children’s race and walking; spikes are not allowed; online registration is available; field limited to 3,000 runners.

name: Pönitzer Silvesterlauf
description: The Pönitz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional road race held in Pönitz, a district of Scharbeutz in Schleswig-Holstein. On December 31, 2026, runners set off at 9:00 a.m. to choose between 7.5 km and 15 km on a flat course that finishes at Lindenstraße 34. The event is organized by SVG Pönitz and features electronic timing. After the race, participants receive a hot drink, a Berliner doughnut and a commemorative medal, as well as a personalized certificate on request.
course_highlights: Flat course in Pönitz, finishing at Lindenstraße 34
Electronic timing
Traditional New Year’s Eve event with refreshments and a medal
additional: Registration is easy and available on race day. The event has a long tradition, with more than 40 editions, and attracts numerous runners and walkers even in adverse weather conditions. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with occasional snowfall. A traditional New Year’s Eve run with a sense of community, electronic timing and small celebrations to round off the year.

name: Oudjaarsrun
description: On 31 December 2026, LSV Invictus will organize the second edition of the Oudjaarsrun in Appelscha, a sporting event to end the year actively. Participants can choose between two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The course is fully paved and runs through the beautiful Drents-Friese Wold National Park, with the start and finish in the center of Appelscha. After the finish, there will be an opportunity to celebrate the sporting year with music and a convivial atmosphere in the Steegdenhal.
course_highlights: Fully paved course
Run through Drents-Friese Wold National Park
Start and finish in the center of Appelscha, on Boerestreek
additional: Bib pickup and the awards ceremony will take place in the Steegdenhal. After the event, there will be a festive gathering with music and a convivial atmosphere. Ample parking is available for participants and visitors. Start times are 11:00 and 11:10. Parking is available at Pretpark Duinenzathe and in the center of Appelscha. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. Festive gathering in the Steegdenhal.

name: Oliebollenloop
description: The Oliebollenloop is the final sporting challenge of the year in the north, held on 31 December in and around Gorredijk. The race offers 4-mile and 10 km distances, with separate starts for solo runners and businesses. There is also a kids’ run with three distances for different age groups. The route is safe from traffic and well marked, and a delicious reward awaits afterwards: oliebollen.
course_highlights: 4-mile and 10 km courses through Gorredijk with aid stations
Low-traffic route with traffic marshals for safety
Kids’ run with distances of 600m, 900m and 1600m for different age groups
additional: Kids’ run start times: 600m at 10:45, 900m at 11:00, 1600m at 11:15. 10 km starts at 12:05, 4 miles at 12:20. Business run available for teams of 3–5 participants; finishing time is based on the first 3 finishers. No race-day registration. Register online until 30 December at 22:00 or until the limit is reached. Entries in October and November receive a free Craft Oliebollen running shirt. Bib transfers are possible via the platform until 13 December at 23:59. Registration is online until 30 December; no race-day registration is available. Start times are around 12:00, with the start location at Sportcentrum Kortezwaag. Parking advice: cycle or carpool; road closure from 11:00.

name: Sylvestercross
description: The Sylvestercross is an annual running event in the Lange Duinen of Soest, known as the most beautiful cross-country race in the Netherlands. The event takes place over two days, with atmospheric Sylvester by Night runs on 30 December and various fun runs and official races on 31 December, including cross-country races for different age groups and ability levels. Since 2025, the Sylvestercross has held bronze status in the World Athletics Cross Country Tour, making it an important event for competitive runners. The course features challenging routes through dunes and woodland, with special loops for young runners and recreational runners, as well as a new 21.5 km trail run.
course_highlights: Course in the Lange Duinen of Soest, through dunes and woodland
Four different loops ranging from 400 metres to 3,300 metres
New Sylvester Trail Run of 21.5 km along the former forest marathon course
additional: The Sylvestercross includes various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a relay cross-country race and a G-cross. The relay cross-country race is a team event with 4 participants, each running one 1,900-metre loop. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The Sylvestercross is part of the National Cross-Country Circuit and gives athletes the opportunity to earn points in the World Athletics rankings. Various distances and categories, including a night run and relays; event on 30 and 31 December 2026; registration available via the website.

name: Katerloop
description: The Katerloop is a traditional running race organized by the Limmer IJsclub during the Limmer Kermis. The race attracts both children and adults and offers various distances, including 5 and 10 kilometers. The course passes through, among other places, the garden of the Cornelius Church and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race starts in the morning, with the youngest children setting off at 10:00 and adults at 10:30. The Katerloop is an annual event with a warm community and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the garden of the Cornelius Church
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Starts during the Limmer Kermis in Limmen
additional: Registration is handled via email confirmation. After confirmation, the site administrator will get in touch. There are separate start times for children and adults. The organizer is the Limmer IJsclub, founded in 1895. The Katerloop in Limmen is held during the Limmer Kermis and is known for its small-scale, welcoming atmosphere. The edition in Numansdorp on January 1, 2027, offers participants a race bib including a commemorative cup, and registration is open until December 28.

name: Florijn Winterloop
location: Sportpark De Koekel, Woudenberg, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The Florijn Winter Run is an annual running and walking event in Woudenberg that has marked the athletic start of the new year for more than 30 years. The routes pass through the beautiful Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug, combining paved and unpaved paths. The event is suitable for recreational runners and experienced athletes alike, with several distances, including 5 km and 10 km forest runs. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with a rich tradition and a true Florijn spirit.
course_highlights: Routes through Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
A mix of paved and unpaved paths
The private ‘Ravensloot’ path is accessible exclusively during the event
additional: Chip timing by ChronoRace; results can be followed live on the website and social media; race bibs can be collected on the day before the start at De Grift Sports Park; same-day registration is not possible; course records and prize money are available; multiple start times by distance (5 km starts at 13:00, 10 km starts at 14:00). The event also includes a winter walk and features an extensive route at the sports park in Woudenberg.

description: The Nieuwjaarsloop De Wilp is a welcoming running event held annually in the picturesque village of De Wilp. With distances ranging from a youth run to a half marathon, it offers a suitable challenge for every level. The route passes through the beautiful Groningen-Frisian countryside, with wide-open views and a warm atmosphere at the start and finish. The event is known for its friendly, sporty character, bringing runners and spectators together to start the new year actively.
course_highlights: Route through the picturesque Groningen-Frisian countryside
Start and finish at the former church on Plantsoen
Aid stations along the route offering sports drink, tea, water and fruit
additional: Registration is open until 3 January at 23:59 via the website, or from 11:45 until half an hour before the start in the canteen of v.v. De Wilper Boys. Collect your race number no later than 15 minutes before the start. Parking is available in the v.v. De Wilper Boys car park near the canteen. First aid is available at the start/finish and from a mobile team along the route. Refreshments include sports drink, tea, water and fruit. Results and a finish video will be available. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; advance registration; winter conditions; youth and adults; parking near the sports club; first aid available; memento and refreshments included.

name: Lierløpet
description: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses, running on a wide pathway that is well-used by runners and fitness enthusiasts in the Drammen area. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km), and is open to both those who wish to jog or walk, as well as to those who are well-trained and fast. There is also a children's race, where all participants receive ice cream. Race numbers can be purchased at Lier Station, and the race starts at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses.
The race takes place on a wide pathway and is well-used by runners and joggers in the Drammen area.
Children's race with ice for all participants.

name: De Nieuwjaarsloop
location: Leiden Atletiek, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Nieuwjaarsloop in Leiden is an accessible running race and a sporty way to start the new year. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with the start and finish on the athletics track. The race is organised by Leiden Atletiek in collaboration with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. The race focuses above all on the enjoyment of taking part, with prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track
Choose from 5, 10 or 15 kilometres
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The Nieuwjaarsloop is organised by Leiden Atletiek together with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. The race is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners. You can register using the registration form on the race page. The race is traditionally held on 3 January, with registration available on the day. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and is supported by local sports clubs.

name: Douwe Kleefstra
description: The Douwe Kleefstraloop is a recreational running race starting at Lionitas athletics track in Leeuwarden. It offers several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), with the routes measured exactly. The 10 km route passes through Goutum and Zuidlanden, while the 16 km route follows the same course with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel under the railway and part of the Elfstedentocht route. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. The Douwe Kleefstra and Sietske Rijpstra trophies are awarded to the fastest man and woman in the 10 English miles, respectively.
course_highlights: Starts at Lionitas athletics track
10 km route through Goutum and Zuidlanden
16.1 km route with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel and part of the Elfstedentocht route
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race number. Participation is entirely at your own risk and responsibility. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. A discounted combined entry is available for the Douwe Kleefstraloop, Leeuwarden-Marsum-Leeuward and Rondje Goutum, including a special Gouden Leeuw race number and a prize draw. The distance selected when pre-registering for the Douwe Kleefstraloop determines the distance for the other races in the combination. Distances range from 1 km to 16.1 km; advance registration is required; special combination and youth prices; starts at Nijlân athletics track.

name: Oliebollen omloop
location: Sportpark Pelzer, Boxmeer, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Olympia's Oliebollen Omloop is an annual running event held on the first Sunday of the new year at Sportpark Pelzer in Boxmeer. The race is intended for members, interested participants, and entrants in the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. With several distances to choose from, it’s a great opportunity to end the Christmas holidays actively, start the new year in a sporty way, and enjoy team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. The route runs through the sports park and the adjacent Brestbos. There are prizes for the winners—and, of course, eternal glory.
course_highlights: Run through Sportpark Pelzer
Route through the adjacent Brestbos
Several distances available
additional: The run is part of the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. Prizes are awarded to the winners, and the event promotes team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. Running race over several distances, through the sports park and Brestbos, with prizes for the winners.

description: The Snertloop is a friendly running race organized by TAV80, held in 't Veld with the start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg. The race takes place on public roads and offers several distances: 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus a 16 km walking route. After finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert, a traditional treat. Prizes are awarded to the top runners in each distance and age category, and race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Registration is online only and closes a few days before the event.

Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus 16 km walking
Coffee stop for walkers at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel
additional: Race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday evening before the race or on race day. Timing is recorded using a MyLaps chip in the race number; personal chips are not permitted. Volunteer traffic marshals accompany the race. Participation is at your own risk, and traffic rules must be followed. Walkers can stop for coffee at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel. Immediately after finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert. The race takes place on public roads near Sportcomplex de Kogge, with the course and registration online, and starts and finishes at JT Bloembollen.

description: The 5th race of the Winter Carousel was held at Fana Stadium, where it was crowded with people and 515 finishers in the 5 km as well as 247 in the 10 km. Participation increased significantly compared to the previous winter race, and the racing conditions were good despite a brisk wind in some areas. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were the fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km. This race is part of the Ålesund Winter Carousel, which consists of 5 races tailored for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Sylvesterloppet Göteborg
description: The Sylvesterloppet in Gothenburg is a spectator-friendly 10 km race held on New Year's Eve, starting and finishing at Heden. The flat course covers two loops through central Gothenburg, including Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and the area around Svenska Mässan. The race is suitable for all runners who want to end the year with a fast and festive running experience. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and has a chance to win prizes in a draw.
course_highlights: Flat, two-loop 10 km course through central Gothenburg
Passes Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and Svenska Mässan
Spectator-friendly, festive atmosphere, with firefighters cheering runners on at Gårda fire station
additional: Start groups are assigned according to expected finish time: elite, start group 1 and start group 2. The warm-up begins 15 minutes before the start. Race bibs can be collected on 29–30 December and on race day from 09:00 to 11:30 at Exercishuset at Heden. Electronic chip timing using the chip on the race bib is used, and net times are shown in the results. The race starts at 12:00 on 31 December. Registration via MittLopp is available until one hour before the start, unless the race is full.

name: Zandstuve Bosloop
description: The Zandstuve Forest Run is a challenging cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition. The race takes place in the beautiful, wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap, and is organised by Loopgroep de Zandstuve in collaboration with Sportlust Vroomshoop. The event offers different distances for children and adults, in a friendly and sporty atmosphere. The competition consists of five races in the region, with participants competing in various age categories for the overall win.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap
Cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition
Distances: 1,500 m for children, 5 km and 10 km for adults, with laps of 750 m and 5 km
additional: On-the-day registration for individual participation is available until half an hour before the start at the Sportlust Vroomshoop clubhouse. Children run 1,500 metres (2 laps of 750 m), 5 km participants run 1 lap, and 10 km participants run 2 laps of 5 km. Prizes are awarded in all categories for the 5 km and 10 km, children receive medals for the 1.5 km, and Canicross participants receive a commemorative gift. Individual entrants can make a contribution to Landschap Overijssel. Distances: 1,500 m (children), 5 km, 10 km; advance and on-site registration; option to donate to Landschap Overijssel; prizes in various categories.

name: StardGRL
description: The Stard Grote Rivieren Running Circuit (StardGRL) is a running competition in the Drechtsteden region, consisting of nine running events spread throughout the year. The races take place in a variety of typical Dutch landscapes and range in distance from 5 km to a half marathon. Participants compete in age categories, and standings are based on their best six performances from the nine races. The atmosphere is informal and sociable, with plenty of attention to personal goals and friendly rivalry.

Distances range from 5 km to a half marathon
Standings based on the best six performances from nine races

Die Teilnehmer können zwischen vier ausgeschilderten Rundkursen mit unterschiedlichen Schwierigkeitsgraden in den landschaftlich reizvollen Bückebergen wählen. Es gibt keinen gemeinsamen Start und keine Zeitmessung, sodass der Lauf stressfrei zur eigenen Leistungsüberprüfung genutzt werden kann. Am Ziel erhalten alle Teilnehmer einen warmen Tee im Sporthaus.

description: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit, a winter competition featuring ten unique cross-country races in different villages across Salland. The course in Broekland offers a challenging and atmospheric cross-country running experience in a natural setting. The races are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The competition encourages participation in multiple races, with points based on the best performances of the season.
course_highlights: Unique cross-country course in beautiful Salland
Varied terrain with rolling hills, forest trails, meadows and sandy stretches
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
additional: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of a competition with 10 cross-country races in Salland. The best 6 races count toward the standings (instead of 7). There is a 1 km kids’ run that does not count toward the standings. The organizers place great importance on safety and may decide to cancel a race in poor weather conditions, as happened recently because of slippery conditions and low feels-like temperatures. name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held throughout the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer cash prizes and gift vouchers. The organizers provide electronic timing, and showers are available after the race.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in Woolderes
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Pre-registration closes on 3 January 2027; on-the-day registration is available from 9:00 a.m. until half an hour before the start at IKC De Wooldermarke. A race number with chip is issued once for all four races and can be collected on the Saturday beforehand or on race day. A running shirt and medal can be ordered as optional extras and collected. Showers are available at the Gymzaal Woolderesweg. Race numbers must be worn on the chest. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. Animals, strollers, etc. are not permitted. Start times: 11:00 a.m. for 10 and 15 km, 11:06 a.m. for 5.1 km, and 11:10 a.m. for 1.4 km. Registration on Sunday morning from 9:00 a.m.; start and finish in Woolderes. Weather conditions may affect the race. Prizes consist of cash and gift vouchers.

name: Flevo Fun Run

The event offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometres, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The run is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic routes. The Flevo Fun Run is part of TVZ Zeewolde’s activities and attracts runners from the region.

Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners

description: On Sunday 10 January 2027, Eindhoven Atletiek is organising a sociable coach trip to the Egmond Quarter and Half Marathon. The coach trip is popular with runners from various athletics clubs and running groups. Participants will be provided with free food and drinks during the trip. The departure and return point is Sportpark de Hondsheuvels in Eindhoven. The coach leaves at 07:30 and returns at 16:30. To take part in the race itself, participants must register separately via the official Egmond Half Marathon website.

name: Snøkuten Nordhagarunden
description: The Snøkuten Nordhagarunden takes place on October 17, 2023, and has a distance of 9.5 km. The race is part of the Snøkuten series and offers participants the chance to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings. The course is quite demanding but takes you through stunning nature, and it is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. This is a popular event in Veldre Athletics' schedule.
course_highlights: The Nordhagarunden was the second to last of the season's six Snøkuter, and only 24 participants raced for time, while many others jogged along the course with reflective gear.
The fastest of them all was Helge Holthe from Gjøvik, who completed the lap in just under 33 minutes, while Therese Sjursen from BGF Fana was the fastest woman with a time of 39 minutes.
The course record from 1987, set by Edvard Dahl, stands at 30 minutes and 11 seconds, while Ragnhild Kvarberg holds the women's record at 35:29.

name: HOKA Solastranden Halvmaraton
description: HOKA Solastranden Half Marathon offers a unique running experience with distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. For the half marathon, runners should be aware that the course marshals will leave after a time limit of 2:40, but timing is open for up to 3 hours. There are also pacers available for all distances, and aid stations provide both water and sports drinks. The race takes place in a scenic area, with parking available at alternative locations nearby.
course_highlights: The race offers options for everyone, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km.
Timing for the half marathon is open for up to 3 hours, with officials monitoring the race times.
There are pacers available for all distances, as well as hydration stations with both water and sports drinks.

name: Vinterkarusellen 6.løp
description: The 6th race of the NECON Winter Series took place on January 20, where 721 participants completed the race despite heavy rain. 382 runners finished the 5 km, while 169 reached the finish line on the double distance. Hector Breivik from Ask was the fastest on the 5 km with a time of 18:13, while Miriam Emilie Stensland Donovan from Lerøy won the women's class with a time of 21:31. In the 10 km, victories went to Magne Knudsen (35:48) and Vanja Flatberg (40:26).
course_highlights: The duo of Linda Grøning (5 km/20:26) and Trine Larsen (10 km/38:20) were the best among the women.
Bjørn Tore Kronen Taranger (5 km/17.24/BFG Bergen Running Club) and Jens Larsen Åstveit (10 km/34.10/Gneist) were the best among the men.
The race was held on winter conditions, which resulted in a slight decrease in the number of participants.

name: 5 Km Sport Glexe
description: Sport 1 Glexe is organizing a 10 KM race on October 12th at 11:00 AM! The race starts at MSG car wash, heading towards Gvarv from Bø. The course has been certified and is a fast route on new pedestrian and cycling paths. The trail is easy to run, and there will be an unattended water station after approximately 3.4 km, 6.6 km, and at the finish line. Restrooms are available at Circle K, but there are no shower facilities.
course_highlights: The race has been officially measured and is a fast course on new pedestrian and bicycle paths.
The route is easy to run on walking and cycling paths.
Unmanned drink station after approximately 3.4 km, 6.6 km, and finish.

name: Bislett Spring 5k
description: The Bislett Spring 5k is held at Bislett Stadium and offers you a juicy opportunity for a personal best in the 5 km. The waves are divided by desired finish time, and all groups receive pacers to help guide them to the finish line. But remember, you still have to run!
course_highlights: Bislett Stadium is the place for running, and it provides a great opportunity to set a personal record.
The groups are divided according to the desired finish time, giving all participants a chance to achieve their goals.
All waves will have pacers to help guide them towards the finish line, creating a motivating atmosphere.

description: The 3 Meren Gieten Cross is a cross-country race taking place on Saturday, 16 January 2027, in Gieten, near Eext. The race is part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos. The course follows unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos, with woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills. Distances of 5 km and 9 km are available for different age categories, with timing provided without a chip. The race is limited to 300 participants, and no showers or changing rooms are available.

Woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills

The event offers two distances, 10 km and 4 English miles, and runs mostly along forest trails and quiet roads. The route passes several hunebeds, making for a unique and atmospheric running experience. A cash prize is offered for breaking the course record, providing an extra challenge for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes several hunebeds
Mostly along forest trails and quiet roads
A forest race in the Klijndijk area
additional: There is a €100 cash prize for breaking the course record. The official 10 km course records are 30.59 for men and 35.43 for women. The event lasts approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes. The route passes hunebeds and includes forest and road sections. Registration is available in advance and on the day. Prizes are offered for breaking the course record.

name: Zuurbergcross
description: The Zuurbergcross is a challenging cross-country race organised by Atletiekvereniging Holten and part of the SNS CrossCircuit van het Oosten. The start and finish are at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37, in Holten. The varied course includes a few crossings over paved roads and a short stretch of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge. There is ample parking, first aid is available, and a speaker adds to the atmosphere during the event.
course_highlights: Course with a few crossings over paved roads
Around 500 metres of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge
Start and finish at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37
additional: Ample parking, first aid and a speaker are available during the event. Participation is entirely at your own risk. The course is suitable for spikes and includes a few crossings over paved roads and brick paving that can be avoided. The race takes place in Beuseberg, Holten, and offers practical facilities including registration at the MAC Stuurhuus, parking, first aid and sound equipment.

name: Sørlandstesten 5
description: The Sørlandstest is a low-threshold recreational run for everyone who wants a positive running experience, regardless of ambition level. Whether you are training for a larger goal, feeling the competitive nerves, or just looking for a social and active day – this is the race for you! We welcome both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the opposite side of the road from Gumpens Auto, along Setesdalsveien in Kristiansand, and participants follow a flat and fast course up Setesdalsveien to Strai, before turning around and running back.
course_highlights: The Sørlandstest is a low-threshold recreational run for everyone who wants a positive running experience, regardless of ambition level.
You don't need fancy equipment or extensive experience – the most important thing is that you show up with a good attitude and a desire to run.
We cheer just as much for the one who crosses the finish line first as for the one who completes their very first race.

description: The Bosmarathon & Minder is a running event in Assen featuring a full marathon and several shorter distances. The routes run mostly along unpaved paths through the Asserbos, a woodland area of approximately 100 hectares. The start, refreshments and finish are at the AAC'61 athletics track. The lap is just over 7 km, with six laps making up the full marathon. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink, and changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Route mostly along unpaved paths in the Asserbos
Start, refreshments and finish at the AAC'61 athletics track
Lap of just over 7 km; six laps for the marathon

Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink. Changing rooms are available at the venue at Achterpad 1, 9405 BN Assen. Participation is at your own risk. Results and photos will be published afterwards on the club page. Unpaved paths, registration in advance and on the day, changing rooms available.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplasgebied, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a series of three running races held in November, January and February around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races offer running distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as special youth distances of 400 and 1,000 metres on the athletics track. There are also walking distances of 5 and 10 km, starting at the same time as the 20 km running race. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a canteen are also available. The race features official timing and a nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas.
course_highlights: Nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
A range of distances for beginner and experienced runners, including youth races on the track
additional: There is a 2-hour time limit for the walking distances. There is a drinks station on the track for participants in the 15 and 20 km races on their second lap. A free massage is available afterwards in the AAV'36 massage room (bring your own towel). Youth race keepsakes are free; other keepsakes and stamp cards for taking part in all three races are available for a fee. First aid is available on the track and course. The canteen is open and a limited number of lockers are available. Distances for runners and walkers; course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas; traffic-free course; start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track; changing rooms and showers available; free leg massage by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn.

name: Goedhart Drechtloop
location: Leimuiden, Kaag en Braassem, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Goedhart Drechtloop has been organized annually since 1969 by Vereniging S.V. Kickers ‘69 on the third Sunday in January. The event offers several distances: a 1.4 km children’s run, 4 km, 10 km and 10 English miles. The route passes through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude and along the Drecht, offering a scenic and varied running experience in the Groene Hart.

Route along the Drecht river
Varied course in the rural Groene Hart
additional: The start and finish are on Beukenlaan in Leimuiden. The event runs from 11:00 to 14:00. Several distances are available, including a 1.4 km children’s run. The event is organized by S.V. Kickers ‘69. It takes place on 17 January 2027 from 11:00 to 14:00, with several running options and a convivial atmosphere for participants of all ages.

price_range: Kind- en jeugdcross: € 3,5; Korte- en lange cross: € 7; Na-inschrijving: € 5 en € 10
description: The Leemkuilcross is one of the most beautiful cross-country races in the Netherlands, organised by NSAV ’t Haasje and AV Cifla. It takes place on a hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal and is known for its challenging nature, particularly the notorious staircase. The race offers several distances for children, young people and adults, and attracts athletes who enjoy a tough cross-country race. Race bibs can be collected at the Berg en Dal tennis club, and parking is limited. The Leemkuilcross takes place annually on the third Sunday in January.
course_highlights: Hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal
Laps around the Leemkuil, with the notorious staircase as a challenge
Distances ranging from 1200m to 8400m
additional: Race bibs can be collected in the canteen of the Berg en Dal tennis club, Molenbosweg 10. Parking is limited. Late registration is possible until just over half an hour before the start of the relevant race, at a higher cost. Prize ceremonies take place immediately after each event. Cancellations are possible up to one week before the event, subject to an administration fee. The course is a hilly, unpaved woodland route with the notorious staircase; registration is possible until one week before the event; prices include registration fees and late registration is available.

name: Watermolenloop
description: The Watermolenloop in Haaksbergen is a popular running race that attracts many sports enthusiasts every year. The race takes place in a welcoming setting, with a varied course that runs through nature and past distinctive places in Haaksbergen. The 2026 edition drew enthusiastic runners early in the morning, despite the chilly weather, which only added to the sporting atmosphere. The event is organised by Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH) and is a great opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: A varied course through nature and past distinctive places in Haaksbergen
A welcoming start at Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH)
A traditional event with a sporting and friendly atmosphere
additional: The Watermolenloop is organised by Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH). The event takes place in January and attracts a wide range of runners. It has a sporting and friendly atmosphere, even in cold weather. The race is part of Haaksbergen’s local sporting activities. The Watermolenloop draws sports enthusiasts to Haaksbergen and is known for a route past the Oostendorper Watermill and through the Lankheterbos, with support from volunteers and safety services.

name: Vinterkarusellen Løp 4
description: The Winter Carousel is an annual running series that includes several distances, with the courses measured and certified. This means that times achieved during the events will be approved for statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. Participants have the opportunity to set personal records that will be recognized forever. The series has a rich history that began in the mid-1980s, and as of winter 2023, it is Ålesund Races that is once again the organizer.
course_highlights: The courses are measured and certified, ensuring that times achieved during the race will be approved for statistics for both 5 km and 10 km.
Participants have the opportunity to set personal records that will be recognized forever.
The carousel has a participant record of 144 finishers in a single race.

This event warmly welcomes all ambitions, whether you walk or run, with or without a time. There is no registration at the start, and the race provides an excellent opportunity to test your fitness, with 6 races throughout the winter.
course_highlights: We maintain the same controlled 5 kilometers in all the races; this is an excellent opportunity to use it as a test run.
Premiering for participation in all races in the winter series with a unique mug featuring the inscription "Hamarkarusellen Winter 2022/2023."
Serving of juice (and cake on most occasions) at the finish line.

name: Sandsjöbacka Trail 180
description: Sandsjöbacka Trail is one of western Sweden’s most exciting and challenging winter trail races, offering distances of 30k, 60k, 90k and 180k. The races feature varied terrain, from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running in a magical setting. Whether you’re an ultrarunner or a recreational runner, there’s a challenge to suit you. Welcome to experience the community, challenge and joy of Sandsjöbacka!
course_highlights: Terrain ranging from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running
Elevation gain from approx. 1,000 m (30k) up to approx. 5,000 m (180k)
Magical winter scenery in the Gothenburg area
additional: The 180k race is an out-and-back race starting in Skatås and turning around at Tjolöholm. The Friday start time can be chosen freely between 11:00 and 20:00, but all 90k and 180k runners must start together at 06:00 on Saturday morning. Drop bags and a place to rest are available in Tjolöholm. Self-support applies on the Skatås–Tjolöholm section, according to Fastest Known Time rules. A headlamp is recommended for dark sections. There are time limits and several aid stations with closing times along the courses. The event is known for its scenic course and challenging terrain, making it a popular choice for trail runners in the region.

name: Becksvart
description: Becksvart is a unique night race held in total darkness, with headlamps and reflectors as the only guides. Choose between two challenging and varied courses of 6 km or 12 km, taking you over logs and rocks, along narrow trails and across rocky outcrops around Gunnebo Castle, Kallebäck and Lackarebäcksfjället. The races are a perfect Friday activity focused on adventure and experience, with an AfterRun featuring food, drinks and music waiting in the finish area. There is also a secret contest within the race for anyone looking for an extra challenge.
course_highlights: Run in the dark, with headlamps and reflectors as the only guides
The course follows unique trails around Norra Långevattnet, Lackarebäcksfjället and Kallebäck
Gothenburg’s most legendary hill—Hobo Hill, with 80 metres of elevation gain over approximately 200 metres (12 km course)
additional: Start and finish at Gunnebo Castle & Gardens. The courses are marked with reflectors attached to clothespins and trail markers. Bibs and timing chips can be collected at Nordic Wellness Krokslätt the day before and on race day. Unsupervised bag drop is available. There is one water station halfway around the course, and refreshments are provided after the finish. Medical staff will be on site. Bus 754 goes to Gunnebo Park. Parking is available below the castle, but not at the start/finish. AfterRun with food, drinks and music takes place in the finish area. Trail shoes with a substantial sole are recommended; a headlamp is mandatory. A headlamp is strongly recommended and described as mandatory on the race information page; trail shoes are recommended. There is a water station approximately halfway around the course. AfterRun with music, food and drinks awaits after the finish.

name: Bergen Vintermaraton
description: The Bergen Winter Marathon will be held for the 5th time on Saturday, January 18, 2025. The start and finish area will be at Fana Stadium. The course consists of a round-trip route on asphalt roads that are either completely car-free or have very little traffic, and a large part of the distance runs along a disused railway track in idyllic, rural surroundings. Exactly half a marathon is run per lap, and the same lap is run twice for a full marathon. The half marathon is run for 1 lap, while the marathon is run for 2 laps.
course_highlights: Bergen Winter Marathon is the first race of the Marathon Carousel's 6 annual races.
The race is always held in January, and the distances you can choose from are half marathon and marathon.
The course is slightly hilly and easy to run, except for a hilltop at Fana Stadium that must be run up and down.

description: The Gewoon COOP Crossloop in Luttenberg is a popular, traditional cross-country race and part of the Sallands Cross Circuit. Since 1976, participants have run through the forests and hills of Luttenberg on a challenging course that is largely unpaved and includes steep climbs, including the famous climb to the bench. Combining a unique atmosphere, a demanding course and a rich history, the race offers an unforgettable experience for all ages.
course_highlights: Course is 70% unpaved
Notorious climb to the famous bench
Route through forests and over hills, with views of the Sallandse Heuvelrug
additional: Race bibs are personal for the entire season and must be brought to every race. Spikes are not allowed because they could damage the timing mats. Participants receive a unique Sallands Cross Circuit running shirt when they register. The cross-country race features several distances, with start times between 10:45 and 12:40. The start and finish are at Gemeenschapscentrum Elckerlyc, Butzelaarstraat 22. The event offers various distances for all ages, including a final stretch past the Lourdes grotto. The event is sponsored by Charlot Jalink of Gewoon Coop and has a strong community atmosphere.

name: Halve Marathon Zoetermeer
description: The Halve Marathon Zoetermeer is a welcoming running event taking place on Sunday, 24 January 2027. The 14th edition offers four distances: the 1.5 km Kids Run, 5 km, 10 km, and the 21.1 km half marathon. The routes pass through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark, Balijbos, and the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker, on a fast, straightforward course. The event is suitable for all ages, with a special focus on school competitions and a business run for teams.
course_highlights: Routes through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark and Balijbos
Course through the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker
Clear, colour-coded kilometre markers for each distance
additional: Running shirts can be ordered for €12.50 each and collected on Saturday, 23 January, between 15:00 and 17:00, or on Sunday, 24 January, from 10:00. There is a school competition for the 1.5 km Kids Run and a business run for teams in the 5 km. The half marathon has mandatory time cut-offs at certain points on the course to allow roads to be reopened to traffic. Parking arrangements are in place, and volunteers are being sought for the event. Multiple distances, registration details, running shirts available to order, a colour-coded course, and timing and pace limits for the half marathon.
