name: Götas ungdomsspel
location: Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, Karlstad, Sweden
price_range: 110–120 kr per gren; efteranmälan i mån av plats mot dubbel avgift
description: Götas Youth Indoor Games is an athletics competition for young people, held at the modern Eva Lisa Holtz Arena in Karlstad. The event provides a welcoming and supportive environment for young athletes to compete and develop in various athletics disciplines. The arena is a multifunctional indoor facility with seating for 1,700 spectators, creating a great atmosphere for both participants and spectators. The event is organised by IF Göta Karlstad, one of Sweden’s most successful athletics clubs, and offers a safe and inspiring competition environment.
course_highlights: The competition is held indoors at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, a modern venue with seating for 1,700 spectators
Multifunctional facility for both competitions and training
Organised by IF Göta Karlstad, a club with a long tradition and a strong record in athletics
additional: The competition takes place at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, which opened in 2022 and is a modern indoor venue for athletics and physical training. The multifunctional arena is also used for meetings and training courses. IF Göta Karlstad covers the entry fees for a maximum of three events per competition for its members. Entries for children and young people under 14 should be sent to the relevant group email address, or to tavlingsanmalan@ifgota.se if no group email address is available. Enter by 24 January via EasyRecord or gus@ifgota.se. Participants compete in their age category or the senior category.

name: Midwintercross Heeten
location: Sportpark SV Heeten, Heeten, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Midwintercross in Heeten is a regional cross-country race that is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and is organised by SV Heeten. The 54th edition takes place on Sunday, 3 January 2027, at Sportpark SV Heeten. The course runs through the sports park and the woods around Schoonheten, with approximately 70 per cent unpaved terrain and gentle elevation changes. The routes offer green landscapes and wooded sections, and the prize winners are honoured in an annual ceremony after the race. The Midwintercross has a long history and has become a regular cross-country race in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the sports park and woods around Schoonheten
Approximately 70% unpaved terrain with gentle elevation changes
Green landscapes and wooded sections along the route
additional: The Midwintercross offers several distances. The 6 km and 10 km routes were revised in 2024. There is an annual prize-giving ceremony after the race. After the race, there is a prize-giving ceremony and a friendly atmosphere, with registration open to participants.

name: Rondje Roege Baarg
description: Rondje Roege Baarg is an atmospheric cross-country run and walking event organised by Hardloopclub Onstwedde in collaboration with Stichting Wandelen in Westerwolde. The running routes range from 6.4 to 22.8 kilometres and pass through the beautiful Westerwolde countryside, including Ter Wupping, Veele and Wessinghuizen. Walkers can enjoy a marked 10-kilometre route with a refreshment station. The start and finish are at MFA de Bast in Onstwedde, which also has changing and shower facilities. After the event, participants can enjoy delicious snert from slagerij Hemmen.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the beautiful Westerwolde countryside, with routes of 6.4, 11.3, 18.9 and 22.8 km
Three refreshment stations along the route for runners
10 km walking route marked with yellow arrows, with one refreshment station
additional: Start and finish at MFA de Bast, with changing and shower facilities. Manual timekeeping; results available via uitslagen.nl. Dogs are not allowed. Snert is served to all participants after the event. Walkers can start between 10:30 and 11:30. Walkers can get their walking book stamped. An emergency phone number is available for walkers. Walking route of 10 km; running distances from 6.4 km to 22.8 km; start and finish at MFA De Bast; changing and shower facilities; advance registration open until 24 January; participation at your own risk; dogs are not allowed.

name: 19e Rhoonse Griendentocht
description: The 19th Rhoonse Grienden Tour is a beautiful walking tour that takes place in Rhoon on Saturday, January 30. Organized by the Royal Dutch Walking Association (KWbN), it gives walkers the opportunity to enjoy a healthy and rewarding walking experience in beautiful surroundings. The tour is suitable for both beginners and experienced walkers and promotes physical activity and well-being.
course_highlights: Walk through the Rhoon nature reserve and surrounding area
Options to take part on two days
Discover local landscapes and historic surroundings
additional: Participants who want to take part on both days can register for both days using the form: first register for Saturday, then use “+ add participant” to register for Sunday as well. Wandel.nl is an initiative of KWbN, the Netherlands’ largest walking organization, which inspires and supports walkers. Two-day participation, registration forms, membership discounts

name: Winterlaufserie (10 km)
location: Sportzentrum Hamm-Ost, Hamm, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Winter Running Series in Hamm is a traditional running event held at the Hamm-Ost sports centre by Jahnstadion. The officially measured out-and-back course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the spa gardens in Bad Hamm. The series includes several races over different distances, including 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon, with individual-race and series rankings. Timing is provided by the Race Result system, and awards are presented to the fastest runners as well as age-group prize winners.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back course in accordance with international competition rules
The course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and Bad Hamm spa gardens
Start and finish on the tartan track at Jahnstadion
additional: Timing is provided by the Race Result system using a chip in the race bib. A €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib with chip (refunded upon return), and a €1.00 donation goes to the support association for the hospice in Hamm. Youths and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). Awards ceremonies take place approximately 45 minutes after the finish in the marquee at Jahnstadion. The event comprises a series of three 10 km races held in Hamm’s natural landscape and spa gardens. Registration is online, timing is provided by Race Result, and awards are given to the top participants and series winners.

description: The Hilden Winter Running Series is an annual running event that has attracted runners from the region since 2012. The series takes place on three dates in January and February and offers different series for various performance and age groups, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and half marathon, as well as walking and children’s races. The races run through the wintery Hilden City Forest and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the TC Stadtwald Hilden club grounds. Race numbers can be collected in advance at the HAT fit fitness studio, and late entries are possible on site.
course_highlights: Races through the wintery Hilden City Forest
Start and finish at the TC Stadtwald Hilden club grounds
Various series with distances from approx. 500 m to the half marathon
additional: Race numbers can be collected in advance at the HAT fit fitness studio, Holterhöfchen 22 in Hilden. Late entries are possible on race day on site for a fee. The walking series is without Nordic walking poles. Start and finish at the TC Stadtwald Hilden club grounds. Parking at the Waldbad is signposted. Public transport via bus route 784 (Waldschenke stop) is recommended. Various distances, online registration, race in the city forest, family-friendly and performance-oriented

name: Rondje Oeken
location: De Vroolijke Frans, Brummen, Gelderland, Netherlands
price_range: geen grote inschrijfgelden, mogelijk kleine kosten voor inschrijving
description: Rondje Oeken is a welcoming, small-scale running event held in the beautiful countryside around Oeken and Brummen. The route passes along rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths, and is fully marked and largely traffic-free. The event is open to all levels, from beginners to keen runners, and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at De Vroolijke Frans in Brummen, where ample parking is also available.
course_highlights: Beautiful scenery with rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths
Fully marked and largely traffic-free course
Start and finish at De Vroolijke Frans, Knoevenoordstraat 51, Brummen
additional: There are two start times: 10:00 for the 21.1 km and 10:30 for the 12 km. Parking is available at De Vroolijke Frans and on the field behind it. You can register using the registration form on the website, either in advance or on the day. The event is welcoming and focused on a friendly atmosphere, sportsmanship and safety, with experienced volunteers and first aid on site. The course varies from unpaved paths to trail; there is a children's run, and registration is available on the day. The start is at De Vroolijke Frans.

name: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop
description: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop is a welcoming and well-organized running race in Uithoorn, known for its varied and safe course. The race attracts many participants each year, including long-distance runners and children, and is supported by a large group of volunteers and traffic marshals. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and offers a festive day of sport, with a focus on participants and a special anniversary atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied and safe course
Special atmosphere and good organization
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The race is supported by around 125 volunteers and more than 50 traffic marshals. Participants are catered for with water stations along the course, fruit and a memento at the finish. At the 40th anniversary, special treats were handed out, including cream cakes and flower bulbs. There are multiple distances, including a children’s race and special categories, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl; the course runs through Uithoorn and the surrounding area, with traffic marshals and measures to minimize disruption.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held during the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometers. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer a friendly, sporting atmosphere for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
Distances ranging from 1.4 to 15 kilometers
additional: Pre-registration closes on 3 January 2027; late registration is available on race day from 9:00 a.m. until half an hour before the start at Semmelweisstraat 46, IKC De Wooldermarke. Race numbers can be collected on the preceding Saturday between 3:00 and 5:00 p.m. or on race day. The race number includes a timing chip and is valid for all four races. Shower and changing facilities are available in the small sports hall on Woolderesweg, which closes at 1:15 p.m. A running shirt and medal can optionally be ordered during pre-registration and collected with the race number or after the finish. The standings are based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. Bringing pets, strollers, etc. is not allowed. Participants can register for different distances, with the start and finish at Woolderes. The event offers prizes such as cash and gift vouchers. The race takes place on 31 January 2027 and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

location: Openluchttheater Hoessenbosch, Berghem, North Brabant, Netherlands
price_range: 7 euro voor korte en lange cross, 3 euro voor jeugdcross

description: The Hoessenbosch Cross is part of the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition and takes place near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem. The race offers a challenging course, with a short cross of approximately 5 km, a long cross of approximately 10 km, and several junior cross distances. The short and long cross start at 10:00, followed by the junior cross at 11:10. The race is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is part of a series of cross-country races in the Oss region.
course_highlights: Unpaved course near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre
Short cross of approximately 5 km and long cross of approximately 10 km
Junior cross with several shorter distances
additional: Registration is open until 30 minutes before the race. The junior cross starts at 11:10. The race is part of a cross-country competition with several events in the Oss region. The location is near the car park of the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem. Start times: 10:00 and 11:10; location near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem

description: The Midwinter Marathon in Apeldoorn is a three-day running event held on the first weekend of February. It offers several distances, including a marathon with a unique route through the Natura 2000 area and the Kootwijkerzand, a 10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, and shorter distances such as the Night Run and Kidsrun. The marathon route is partly off-road and passes iconic locations such as Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk. The Midwinter Marathon is known for its welcoming organisation, beautiful natural scenery, and a broad field of participants, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Marathon route with 900 metres off-road across the Kootwijkerzand
Route through a Natura 2000 area, passing Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk
10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, with its highest point at 100 metres above sea level
additional: The marathon starts and finishes at AV’34 in the Orderbos. There is a welcome with coffee or tea and a treat, followed after the race by pea soup with rye bread and bacon, or a vegetarian option. The 10EM starts and finishes on the Loolaan, with changing rooms and showers in nearby gymnasiums. Start corrals for the 10EM are assigned based on expected finish time. The marathon is limited to 700 participants and registration closes once this limit is reached. There is no on-the-day registration. The 10EM has a maximum of 4,200 participants. There are several refreshment stations and medical support. The Midwinter Marathon also offers an app for live runner tracking. Several distances, including the Kidsrun, 8 km and marathon; event in February 2027; registration opens in October 2026.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Hammer Bakker Trail
BTR Winter 12 km
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race offering runners a unique opportunity to experience the Åkulla beech forests in their winter dress. With distances of 5, 12 and 24 km, the race features magical trails and a wonderful atmosphere in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and finish are at Öströö Fårfarm, and the event is characterised by community, commitment and respect for nature. Only 600 exclusive starting places are available, making this an intimate and special experience for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Winter trail in the Åkulla beech forests
Start and finish at Öströö Fårfarm
A magical winter landscape experience
additional: A total of 600 starting places are available: 5 km (150 places), 12 km (300 places) and 24 km (150 places). You must help other runners if needed. The start list is available online. Startklar and Startklar Plus insurance are offered for refunds in case of illness or injury. Traffic rules apply at road crossings. Littering will result in disqualification. For urgent assistance, call 076-8159678 or 112. The race starts at 10:00 from Öströö Fårfarm. There is one refreshment station with energy supplies along the course. The final registration date is 2 February 2027.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail is a winter race offering three distances: 43 km, 22 km and 10 km, all starting and finishing at Nävekvarns IP in Nävekvarn. The routes pass through varied terrain, including forest trails, hilly landscapes and scenic coastal sections, providing a challenging and picturesque experience. The race uses electronic timing and has several aid stations with food and drinks along the course. After the finish, all participants are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic recovery beer. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment and access to showers and changing rooms at the start.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, hilly slopes and coastal paths
Several aid stations with food, hot drinks and Umara Energy
Electronic chip timing and clear cut-off times for each distance
additional: Start times: 43 km at 09:00, 22 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00. Maximum cut-off times: 8 hours for 43 km, 5 hours for 22 km, 2 hours for 10 km. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a mobile phone, windproof jacket, thermal base layer, hat, gloves, water bottle (at least 500 ml), whistle, emergency blanket and headlamp when running in the dark. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at Nävekvarns IP. Parking is available for a fee at the start/finish area. After the race, runners are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager. The distances are 10, 22 and 43 km. Race numbers can be collected at the start area at Nävekvarns IP. Aid stations offer food and hot drinks, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a charged phone, wind jacket, water and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is available for a small fee.

name: Blaauwbek Marathon
description: The Blaauwbek Marathon is an atmospheric winter marathon around Oldambtmeer in Blauwestad. The half and full marathons start in Bad Nieuweschans and finish at De Rietkraag, with bus transport from the finish to the start. There are also 5 km and 10 km distances that start and finish at De Rietkraag, featuring a unique course across the airfield. In addition to running events, there are 10 km and 20 km walking routes and special distances for children. The organizers provide warm refreshments along the way and a warm welcome at the finish.
course_highlights: Course around Oldambtmeer, with beautiful scenery and trails
Separate start and finish locations, with bus transport for marathon runners
Unique course across the airfield for the 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: The half marathon starts at 11:15 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The full marathon starts at 9:45 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The finish closes at 16:30 for both marathon distances. Children start the 5 km at 15:30. Walkers can start independently after receiving their route. The event offers various distances, including youth and walking routes, and bus transport for marathon runners. The event returns after several years’ absence and is marked by a winter theme and a convivial atmosphere.

name: Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross
organizer: Loopgroep SGO, Vomos UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug
description: The Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross is a challenging cross-country race set in the unique landscape of the Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark. The race takes place in Ees and offers two distances: a short route of approximately 5 km and a long route of approximately 9 km, both along unpaved paths through woodland and heathland. The route passes along narrow paths, several glacial pits and the storm-damaged forest with fallen trees, making for an adventurous run surrounded by nature. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course, except for two crossings of cycle paths
Route through narrow heathland paths and several challenging glacial pits
Passage through the mysterious storm-damaged forest with fallen trees
additional: The cross is run without chip timing. No shower or changing facilities are available. The start location is Land van Bartje, Buinerweg 8, 9536 PG Ees. Public transport is available via Belbus line 59 from Borger. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is the 5th race in the circuit. Course through a nature reserve, starts at 11:00 and 11:10, registration via inschrijven.nl, no changing or shower facilities.

name: Kruikenloop
description: The Kruikenloop in Tilburg is an energetic and convivial race that traditionally marks the start of carnival in Kruikenstad. The course runs partly through nearby Stadsbos 013 and offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres, with the 5-kilometre loop available to run multiple times. There is a special 1,111-metre race for children, with fun and sportsmanship at its heart. After the finish, a festive after-party takes place in the Sarto clubhouse, and prizes are awarded for the best carnival outfits.
course_highlights: The course runs partly through Stadsbos 013
A 5 km loop that can be run 1, 2 or 3 times (5, 10 or 15 km)
Children’s race of 1,111 metres
additional: Bib number changes are possible until 8 February at 18:00 via your personal dashboard. Bib transfers and resales are permitted via the official platform. After the finish, there is a convivial after-party in the Sarto clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to creatively dressed participants, and there is a costume prize for the children’s race. Timing is recorded via a chip in the bib, with results available online shortly afterwards. Registration is via the website; the course runs partly through Stadsbos 013; expect a festive atmosphere with music and costumes; organised during carnival in Tilburg.

description: Leeuwarden Marsum Leeuwarden is a classic running race starting on the Lionitas track in Leeuwarden. The 21.1 km half-marathon course runs through the cold fields northwest of the city, where the wind has free rein. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km distances, all measured exactly. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course through cold fields northwest of Leeuwarden
Precisely measured distances of 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish on the Lionitas athletics track
additional: Start times by distance: 1 km kids’ run at 11:00, 21.1 km at 11:10, 10 km at 11:20, 5 km at 11:35, 2 km at 11:40. Participants can check the route in advance via afstandmeten.nl and download GPX files for sports watches. The Gouden Leeuw race number is valid for this race and Rondje Goutum, includes entry into prize draws and offers the option to purchase a special medal. Terrain: farmland and athletics track; Online registration via afstandmeten.nl; Race on 7 February 2027; Start and finish location at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, Leeuwarden

description: The Twentse Ven’n Loop is a small-scale running event held in Twente’s beautiful natural surroundings. It is known for its relaxed atmosphere and unique running experience. In 2027, the event will be held for the eleventh time, offering participants not only a sporting challenge but also the opportunity to support a good cause. The start and finish are at Camping de Meene in Buurse, and the event is known for Twentish hospitality.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful Twentse countryside
Start and finish at Camping de Meene in Buurse
Small-scale event with a maximum of 250 participants
additional: The maximum number of participants is 250. After costs are deducted, proceeds from entry fees go to a sponsored cause. Participants must follow the rules and the organizers’ instructions. Pets, strollers, and similar items are not allowed. The organizers reserve the right to change the route or cancel the event in extreme weather conditions. The Road Traffic Act remains in force during the run. Distances: 4.8 km, 10.3 km, 16.2 km; course through nature, wet terrain, facilities at the start/finish, charity initiative

name: Bocksten TrailRun Winter
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race held at Öströö Sheep Farm, featuring magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests. The race offers three distances: 5 km, 12 km and 24 km, with the 24 km distance consisting of two laps of the 12 km course. With a total limit of 600 starting places, the organizers aim to give runners a unique experience of the beauty and challenge of the winter landscape. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads in a scenic setting. Safety and respect for nature are key principles of the event.
course_highlights: Magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests amid winter scenery
Varied terrain with trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads
The 24 km distance consists of two laps of the 12 km course, making it spectator-friendly and safe
additional: Start and finish at Öströö Sheep Farm. Maximum of 600 starting places in total. Start times: 12 km at 10:00 (300 places), 5 km at 10:15 (150 places), 24 km at 10:30 (150 places). The option to purchase Startklar insurance for reimbursement in case of illness or injury. The lap course allows runners to change equipment and is spectator-friendly. The event is environmentally friendly, with a focus on not littering. In case of an accident, call 076-8159678 or 112 in an emergency. The lap section allows runners to change equipment and makes the course more spectator-friendly.

name: Snapphane Race
location: Hjortakrokskolans idrottshall, Sölvesborg, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Snapphaneracet is a challenging trail race that follows in the footsteps of the Snapphanar through the beautiful Ryssberget in Sölvesborg. The race offers several distances from 13 km to 50 km, with plenty of elevation and varied terrain, including beech forests and mossy coniferous forest trails. The winter edition offers an extra-tough challenge, with icy and muddy sections. The organizers look forward to welcoming runners for a tough and scenic experience in February.
course_highlights: Ryssberget, home to one of Sweden’s largest beech forests
Moss-covered, winding coniferous forest trails
Challenging hills and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. Sweden Runners members and members of FysKompaniet Träningscenter receive a 15% discount on the entry fee. Startklar insurance can be purchased to receive a refund in the event of illness or injury. Name changes are possible for a fee up to 8 days before the race. Trail race in Ryssberget with distances from 13 km to 50 km, a winter challenge, course updates via GPX, headlamp required for some distances, start and finish at Hjortakrokskolans sports hall, no cups at aid stations.

name: Bieg Walentynkowy Run in Sopot II
AVT Valentijnscross
description: The AVT Valentine Cross in Wierden is a challenging cross-country race held at Het Lageveld. The course runs over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods of Het Lageveld recreational park. The terrain is mostly unpaved and varied, making for a surprising and diverse running experience. The race is part of the MD Stoffering CrossCircuit van het Oosten and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Course over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods
Mostly unpaved, varied terrain
Changing surfaces make for a challenging cross-country race
additional: Pre-registered participants can collect their race number with timing chip at the pickup desk. Circuit participants may keep their race number with timing chip for subsequent races. On-the-day registration is possible until half an hour before the start. Spikes are not permitted because of the timing mats. The race number must be worn visibly on the front. Dogs and unregistered companions may not take part. In extreme weather conditions, the organisers may decide to cancel the race without refunding the entry fee. Cross-country race held at Het Lageveld recreational park in Wierden, with distances of 10 km and youth distances of 1.5 km and 2.5 km, usually in February.

name: Krokusloop
description: The Duinloop Circuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune trails with fast beach sections. The Krokusloop, part of this series, offers a great atmosphere for both dedicated runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. With distances for different ages and ability levels, the event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy running at its best.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Start times by distance: 500m Kids Run at 09:30, 1 km Kids Run at 09:35, 2 km Kids Run at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are maintained for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the four best results in the circuit. The race offers several distances, including 3.5, 7, and 10 English miles, on a fast, fully paved course through the open polder. The Polderrun is known for its atmospheric start and finish in the middle of the village, and for the combination of nostalgia and renewal in the course. The event also supports a good cause, Stichting Moz Kids, making a meaningful contribution to vulnerable children in Mozambique.

There are several distances for both youth and adults, ranging from 1 km to 10 km. The Dinkelcross is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants and embraces the Olympic ideal that taking part is more important than winning. After the race, participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and homemade cake at the Zaandhoes, the start and finish location.

It offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere for participants of different levels. Photos and results from previous editions are available via the official Facebook page and website.

Medals for kids and participants taking part in multiple races. Minimum ages vary by distance.

Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, with special youth distances of 400 and 1000 metres on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely traffic-free and runs through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a cafeteria are also available. Official timing is provided by MyLaps. Runners in the 15 and 20 km races pass a refreshment station on the track at the start of their second lap. On race day, registration is available in the cafeteria from 9:30 a.m. The races take place in winter conditions and offer options for walkers and young participants, with a maximum time limit of two hours for the walking distances.

The race is known for its scenic, demanding courses and its focus on sustainability, with participants encouraged to bring their own reusable cups. The start and finish are at RCN Het Grote Bos, with refreshments available along the way and at the finish. The organizers provide a well-run event with chip timing and a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Königsforst Marathon
description: One of Germany’s six oldest marathons. With 17 small start groups from 08:45 to 14:00. With prizes for course and age-group records. With a single entry fee for all three distances, so you can switch distances at any time at no extra cost. With a reforestation initiative to offset the environmental impact of travel. With a DLV-certified course through nature.
additional:
The course:
The loop through the Königsforst includes several sections of the original 1973 course. The website has a dynamic GPX map of the course and an option to download the GPX file.

The course has only two longer, steeper climbs:

From km 3 to km 4, the route climbs 28 m to “Monte Troodelöh” (Cologne’s highest point). It then descends to the first aid station at km 5.
After km 15, at the “Wassertretstelle” (water-treading pool), you climb 40 m over a distance of 630 m. The third aid station comes shortly afterwards.

You reach the highest point shortly after the third aid station. From here, the route is flat along the path of the former railway line back to Bensberg. In the final kilometre, it leaves the forest after the underpass. 400 m before the finish, turn right and head up Schloßfeldweg.

The event offers a well-organised and scenic running experience, with multiple start times and good services in the finish area.
course_highlights: The “grusåttan” course in Skatås, approximately 7,777 metres per lap
Vårtävlingarna Trail: approximately 16 km of trail running, with around one-third gravel road and the rest trail
Water stations and sports drink at the lap point and finish, depending on distance
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 08:30 on race day at Solvikingarna’s clubhouse in Skatås. The start and finish are at the start of the grusåttan course. Changing rooms and showers are available at Skatås Motionscentrum for a fee. A disposable chip is used for timing. The prize ceremony takes place in the finish area after the race. A café is available at Skatås Motionscentrum. Results are published live and officially after the race. Solvikingarna states that Vårtävlingarna is usually held on the second Saturday in March. Vårtävlingarna Trail premiered in 2026.

name: Alfa Laval Stevensloop
description: The Alfa Laval Stevensloop is Nijmegen’s city run, taking place on 20 March 2027. The start is in the iconic Kronenburgerpark, and the finish is right in the centre of the oldest city in the Netherlands. The different courses offer varied routes through the city centre, past the city island, along Nijmegen’s skyline and through the natural surroundings of the Ooijpolder. The event is organised by Stichting Zevenheuvelenloop, which aims to get as many people as possible moving and provide a great running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Kronenburgerpark and finish at the Grote Markt
Climb up the Voerweg, featuring the Alfa Laval Cheering Zone
Varied routes through the city and nature, passing iconic sights such as the Stevenskerk and the Ooijpolder
additional: A supervised cloakroom for small bags is available at the start in Kronenburgerpark. The Voerweg is a challenging climb towards the end of the 5 km and half marathon, with a special Alfa Laval Cheering Zone where spectators and music provide extra encouragement. The Alfa Laval Hill Challenge rewards the fastest climb up the Voerweg with a €100 gift voucher for Runnersworld. Registration opens on 1 October 2026, race numbers can be collected in March 2027, and the event takes place on 20 and 21 March 2027.

name: Molenloop Vrouwenparochie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De online verkoop van startkaarten kan tot en met vrijdag 26 december 2025.

description: The Midseumer Molnkoier is a unique evening walk that invites walkers to enjoy nature and culture in and around Vrouwenparochie. This walking event is made possible in part by many volunteers and sponsors, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The route passes the old grain mill and winds through the beautiful Frisian countryside, offering a special experience for lovers of walking and cultural history.
course_highlights: Evening walk past the old grain mill, De Vrouwbuurtstermolen
Natural and cultural surroundings of Vrouwenparochie
Unique atmosphere during midwinter and a scenic route
additional: Entry tickets can also be purchased at the start desk. The walking event is held at the old grain mill, De Vrouwbuurtstermolen, in Vrouwenparochie. Registration is available for several distances, and participants can enjoy a course through the beautiful countryside and mill surroundings.

name: Monnikenloop
description: The Monnikenloop is an annual running race held on the beautiful island of Schiermonnikoog. The race offers several distances, including a kids’ run, 5 km, 10 km and 10 English Miles, and attracts both recreational and dedicated runners. The event combines sporting spirit with a friendly atmosphere and invites participants to experience the island’s unique nature. The start and finish are centrally located, and there is plenty of opportunity to enjoy an atmospheric weekend with accommodation available on the island.
course_highlights: Routes across the island of Schiermonnikoog, through nature and dunes
Distances ranging from a 1 km kids’ run to 10 English Miles (16.1 km)
Start and finish in the village, in an atmospheric setting
additional: Kids’ runs start from 11:20, the 5 km starts at 12:40, the 10 km at 12:50 and the 10 English Miles at 12:30. The race pack includes a race number with chip and a bus pass for transport on the island. Participants must reserve their own ferry ticket. A running shirt can be ordered. Changes to registration can be made for a fee until the end of March. The start and finish are in the village, with changing and shower facilities. Several distances; registration opens on 1 October 2026; accommodation is available on the island; the event takes place in March.

name: Oldemeijercross
location: Recreatieplas De Oldemeijer, Hardenberg, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Oldemeijercross is one of the oldest running races in the region and is organized annually by AV Spurt'88. The race takes place around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake in Hardenberg and offers a challenging course with tough climbs, sand, and mud. This running event is for all ages, with the start and finish on the event hill at Oldemeijer. Spectators can cheer on the runners from several spots, adding to the lively, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Tough climbs along the course
Route around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake
Sandy and muddy terrain
additional: Race-day registration is possible. The start and finish are on the event hill at Oldemeijer. The course is suitable for all ages, and there are several places for spectators to cheer on the runners. The 3 km course around Oldemeijer is challenging, with climbs, sand, and mud; the start and finish are at the event hill; registration via inschrijven.nl; no showers available.

name: Reeuwijkse Plassenloop
description: The Vosplan Reeuwijkse Plassenloop is one of the oldest running events in the Netherlands and has been held for more than 70 years. Each year, the event attracts runners from the region and beyond, who enjoy an active and sociable day. The course is completely flat and has little traffic. It runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the distinctive Reeuwijkse Plassen, making it an appealing and fast course. There are distances for all ages, from kids’ runs to 15 kilometres, including supervised youth distances.
course_highlights: Completely flat course with little traffic
Runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the Reeuwijkse Plassen
Clear kilometre markers and one lap per distance (5, 10 and 15 km)
additional: MYLAPS BibTag timing is used. The chip is attached to the back of the race number and does not need to be returned. Late registration is available on race day from 10:30 until half an hour before the start. The start and finish area is at Reeuwijkse Houtwal in the De Reeuwijkse Hout recreation area. Ample parking and toilets are available. There are no changing or shower facilities. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Cash prizes are awarded for the 5, 10 and 15 km races for men and women, plus an additional prize for a course record. Registration opens on 1 January 2027 via Inschrijven.nl. The event offers prizes and keepsakes for the winners, and preparation training sessions are available. Participants can register for different distances and age groups.

name: Marathon Alblasserwaard 750
description: The Alblasserwaard 750 Marathon is a unique, one-time marathon taking place on 20 March 2027 to celebrate 750 years of Alblasserwaard history. The 42.195-kilometre route runs from the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk, through characteristic polders, windmills, historic waterways and villages, to the finish at AV Typhoon in Gorinchem. The marathon offers runners a special experience through the open peat-meadow landscape and past iconic windmills and duck decoys, with the region’s landscape and history at its heart.
course_highlights: Start at Kinderdijk’s 19 windmills, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Route along separated cycle paths and roads with limited traffic
Past historic waterways, polder windmills and characteristic villages
additional: Shuttle buses will run between Gorinchem and Kinderdijk for participants. Parking at the start is not possible and is discouraged. Bicycle parking is available at both the start and finish. The organisers aim to be sustainable by using biodegradable cups and cleaning the course after the event. Sweeper vehicles are available for runners who drop out. The minimum age to participate is 18. The marathon is a unique, one-time event celebrating the region’s history and beauty, with a maximum limit of 2,500 runners.

name: Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer
location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog, Municipality Noardeast-Fryslân, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer is a unique nighttime running and walking event held in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer, one of the darkest areas in Europe. The race offers three events: canicross, trail running and a walking tour, all approximately 10 km long. Participants run in the dark, with headlamps permitted only in emergencies, creating a special experience. Registration raises awareness of light pollution through a donation for each participant.
course_highlights: Nighttime route in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer
Approximately 10 km for canicross, trail running and the walking tour
Headlamps permitted only in emergencies
additional: The start location and meeting point is Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, De Rug 1, 9976VT Lauwersoog. A drink is available at the finish. Estimated duration is approximately 1 hour 45 minutes for trail runners and canicross participants, and approximately 2 hours 45 minutes for walkers. night run, canicross, walking tour, 10 km, start location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog

KÖZON21

description: On March 21, 2027, the inaugural Fühlingen–Zons Half Marathon gets underway. For the first time, a running event will connect Blackfoot Beach in Cologne-Fühlingen with the historic Zons customs fortress on a unique route along the Rhine.
additional: The start and finish are in different locations, and the route runs along the Rhine.

name: De VoorschotenLoop
description: The VoorschotenLoop is a running race organized by Voorschoten '97 Athletics, held in the beautiful village of Voorschoten. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and is open to everyone, whatever their level. The course is fast and passes some of the village’s most beautiful spots, with various distances for children and adults. The longest distance runs through the scenic countryside, including Park Rosenburgh and Duivenvoorde Estate. There is also a special Voorschoten Championship for the fastest residents of Voorschoten.
course_highlights: Fast course passing some of Voorschoten’s most beautiful spots
5 km and GeZZinsloop through welcoming neighborhoods
10 km and 10 English miles through the countryside, including Park Rosenburgh and Duivenvoorde Estate
additional: The GeZZinsloop is free and starts at 10:15 for ages 6–9 and 10:35 for ages 10–12. The start and finish are at Sportpark Adegeest, Weddeloop 6, 2253ST Voorschoten. To take part in the Voorschoten Championship, you must live in Voorschoten and wear a green dot on your race bib, which can be collected beforehand in the canteen. There is no race-day registration. Distances range from 1.25 km to 10 English miles; registration is possible on 21 March; prizes for top participants; championship for Voorschoten residents; prepare with a beginners’ course organized by Voorschoten '97.

name: Moore DRV Halve Westland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten voor deelname aan de halve marathon zijn € 15. Dit is exclusief de aanschaf van de SAW tijdregistratiechip.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten voor deelname aan de 10 km zijn € 12,50. Dit is exclusief de aanschaf van de SAW tijdregistratiechip.

description: The Moore DRV Half Westland is a popular half marathon in the Westland, Haaglanden and Rotterdam region, held in Naaldwijk. The race is a fitting finale to the Olympus '70 Runners Project and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The route passes through the polders and alongside greenhouses, with aid stations along the way and a lively start and finish venue at the Olympus '70 athletics facility. The half marathon is part of the aaff Summer Run Circuit and offers a varied, fast, traffic-free course.
course_highlights: Route through the polders and alongside greenhouses in the Westland
Aid stations at 6.3, 12.7 and 17.5 km with water and sports drink
Start and finish at the Olympus '70 athletics facility, with changing rooms and showers
additional: The use of reusable SAW timing chips is compulsory; a chip can be ordered for €4,50 when registering. Race numbers can be collected on race day at the Van Dijk Flora indoor hall at Olympus '70. The facility has spacious changing rooms and showers. First aid is available at 17 km and at the finish. Prize ceremonies for various categories. The half marathon is part of the aaff Summer Run Circuit. Entries for the half marathon are completely sold out; the event also includes a 10 km, 5 km and a children's walk.

name: Emmy Run
description: De Emmy Run in Slagharen is een gezellig en toegankelijk hardloopevenement voor jong en oud, met afstanden variërend van 1 tot 10 kilometer. De wedstrijd vindt plaats rondom Cafetaria Lunchroom Emmy en biedt voor elk wat wils, van de Kidsrun tot een bedrijven- en verenigingenrun. Het evenement staat in het teken van plezier en samen sporten, zonder prijzengeld maar met leuke attenties voor alle deelnemers. Na afloop is er een bescheiden afterparty in de speciale Emmy tent op het kerkplein.

name: Cross Island Bornholm 2027 - ½ marathon og 10 km
Förslöv Trail
location: Förslövs idrottshall, Förslöv, Båstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Förslöv Trail 2027 is a scenic trail race held at the foot of Hallandsåsen, starting and finishing at Förslöv Sports Hall. Participants can choose between three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 24 km. Everyone runs the same first 2 km and final kilometre. The race features varied terrain, including forest trails and grass, with beautiful views of the small settlement and the natural landscape on the ridge. After finishing, participants can enjoy a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day or in advance in Båstad, where registered runners receive a discount on Sportshopen’s range.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Förslöv Sports Hall
Terrain with forest trails, grass and hills on Hallandsåsen
Sports drink and water available at several stations along the course
additional: Umara sports drink and water are served at several stations, depending on the distance. After the race, participants are offered a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:30 a.m. or in advance at Sportshopen in Båstad, where registered runners receive a 20% discount. Changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Start times: 24 km at 10:00 a.m., 10 km at 10:30 a.m. and 5 km at 11:00 a.m. Race bibs must be collected on race day at least 20 minutes before the start. Changing rooms are available at the sports hall, and drinks and refreshments are provided along the course and after the finish.

name: Drents Friese Woldmarathon
description: The Drents Friese Wold Marathon is a challenging marathon held in the beautiful Drents-Friese Wold National Park near Diever. The course consists of laps of just over 10 km on paved and semi-paved cycle paths and minor roads, mostly through the forest. The marathon has a rich history, with fast course records, and attracts many runners each year who enjoy its natural surroundings. The start and finish are in Diever, and the organizers provide professional chip timing. The marathon is suitable for runners aged 18 and over, with a shorter distance for young people aged 14 and over.
course_highlights: Laps of just over 10 km on paved and semi-paved cycle paths and minor roads
Mostly through the wooded surroundings of Drents-Friese Wold National Park
Start and finish in Diever
additional: Collect your race number on 27 March from 10:00 to 11:45 at the start location. Registration is also available on the day, during the same hours. Timing is by a chip attached to the race number; returning the race number after finishing is strongly requested. Age limits: 18 years for all distances except 10.1 km; 14 years for the 10.1 km. If you withdraw before 24 March, the entry fee will be refunded minus €1 in administration costs. Registration is open until 24 March; start times vary by distance; age limits follow KNAU guidelines; the event promotes sport and experiencing nature.

name: Hollen door de Bollen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten bedragen € 14,- per persoon (minimaal 5 personen per team).

description: Hollen door de Bollen is an annual running and walking event in the beautiful Bollenstreek area around Lisse, organised by Stichting Team Bollenstreek in collaboration with AV De Spartaan. All proceeds from the event go to Stichting Roparun, which supports palliative care for cancer patients. Routes range from short children’s runs to 30 km walks, with music and entertainment along the way and a convivial finish. The event puts taking part for charity ahead of competition, with no official timekeeping.
course_highlights: Walking routes of 6.5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 30 km through the Bollenstreek
Running distances of 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles
Music and entertainment along the route and a festive finish
additional: The start location is AV De Spartaan, Spekkelaan 8, Lisse. There are various start times for walking and running distances, starting from 07:30. Entries are personal and include a personalised race number; no refunds are available in the event of cancellation. High-visibility vests are recommended on sections of the walking routes that use public roads. A special Shirt Action allows participants to earn a free anniversary shirt by finding sponsors. Routes range from 4.6 km to over 30 km. Advance registration is required; race numbers and shirts can be collected. Volunteers and sponsors are welcome.

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

name: Hallarydsloppet
description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual running race held on Easter Monday at Hallaryd School. The race is suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from 1.2 km for the youngest participants to 21 km in the main event. The courses run mostly along gravel roads and paved sections through beautiful landscapes of winding stone walls, meadows and forests on the border between Skåne and Småland. Shorter routes of 3.2 km, 6 km and 9.8 km are also available and are suitable for both running and walking. The event offers timing, water stations and prizes for the top finishers in each class, as well as a plaque for everyone who completes the race.
