description: The Culemborg City Run is an annual running event in Culemborg, with various distances for individual runners, schools, and businesses. The race offers a varied course with distances of 400 metres, 1, 3, 5, and 10 kilometres, suitable for all ages and levels. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the involvement of the local community. The City Run promotes sportsmanship and togetherness in a beautiful urban setting.
course_highlights: Course through the centre of Culemborg
Distances ranging from 400 metres to 10 kilometres
Specific routes for schools and businesses
additional: There are separate categories for schools and businesses. The Roll Run is a special 400-metre race. The event has a varied programme, with different start times for each distance. Attention is given to accessibility and facilities for participants. The event also includes a school run and a business run, along with historical results and sponsors. It is an annual event that brings the community together.

name: De Wielenloop
location: De Groote Wielen, Rosmalen, North Brabant, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld € 5,- betaal je contant of met pin.

description: The Wielenloop is an annual running event held on Easter Monday in De Groote Wielen, Rosmalen. The event is suitable for all ages, with various distances including a kids’ run, 5 km and 10 km. The routes offer varied terrain and are accessible to both beginner and experienced runners. The atmosphere is friendly, with space for family and supporters along the route.
course_highlights: The 10 km route consists of two laps of the 5 km route
Varied terrain suitable for experienced runners
Kids’ run for the youngest runners; participation is free
additional: You can register through the morning of the race, on Monday, at the start. The kids’ run is free. The 5 km and 10 km start at 10:30. There is a warm-up beforehand, and family members can join the kids’ run. On-site registration is possible; the start time is around 10:30; the routes will be announced soon.

name: Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen
description: The Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen is a traditional competitive and recreational race, held for the 60th time on Easter Monday, 29 March 2027. The race offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 km, suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. Participants run through the beautiful polder landscape around Aarlanderveen and receive a medal at the finish. Part of the proceeds go to a local good cause; this year, the playground.
course_highlights: All distances follow paved roads around and through the Aarlanderveen polder
Water stations halfway along the course and at the finish
Kilometre markers are displayed along the course, and a running clock is provided
additional: Race numbers will not be mailed out; they can be collected on 29 March at the Dorpshuis during late registration. Timing is provided using MYLAPS BibTag on the race numbers. Parking, changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall on Aarlanderveenseweg. Parking is limited, so cycling is recommended. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 15 km; children's fun run; proceeds go to a good cause (playground); location: Aarlanderveen; organised by AAV'36

name: Klap tot Klaploop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgelden voorinschrijving Deelname 5 km en 10 km (vanaf 18 jaar): € 15,-

description: The Klap tot Klaploop is a unique running race with no laps. You travel by bus to the start in Musselkanaal, then run straight back to the centre of Stadskanaal. The flat, fast course is ideal for setting a personal best, while the enthusiastic crowds and friendly atmosphere along the route make for a special experience. The 35th edition takes place on Easter Monday, 29 March 2027—a day of sport, challenge and fun for everyone.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course from Musselkanaal to Stadskanaal
No laps—just one continuous route
The crowds and atmosphere along the route make for a unique experience
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday before Easter from 10:00 to 14:00 at De Jonge Sport in Stadskanaal, or on the day of the event until 11:30 at the organisers’ tent. Free bus transport is provided from Europalaan in Stadskanaal to the start locations in Musselkanaal for the 5 km and 10 km runners. Wheelchair racers and handcyclists arrange their own transport. Clothing trucks and portable toilets are available at the start locations. There are no showers. Start in Musselkanaal, finish in Stadskanaal; no transport is provided from Stadskanaal to the start locations. The event is supported by local businesses and has a long history, with the 32nd edition in 2027.

name: Paaspolderloop
description: The Paaspolderloop in Nieuwe Niedorp is a friendly running event held on Easter Monday. The race takes you through the beautiful polder, with several distances for all ages, including a 250-metre fun run for the youngest participants and challenging 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes. The 10 km is open to participants aged 16 and over and offers a varied course through meadows and over bridges, including a nostalgic stretch along Dorpsstraat. The organisers create a festive atmosphere with a large prize fund and a quick prize-giving after the race.
course_highlights: Beautiful green meadow and sheep path
Several bridges along the course
Nostalgic Dorpsstraat in Nieuwe Niedorp
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Dorpshuis De Prins Maurits. Parking is available at the Winkelcentrum van Nieuwe Niedorp, a 900-metre walk away. There are no changing rooms or showers, but toilets are available in the Dorpshuis. First aid is available at the start/finish. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The event starts at 9:30 a.m. on Easter Monday, with registration opening in January and parking at Winkelhart. There are also fun activities for children alongside the race.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Varberg Municipality, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly running event held in the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers several distances, from 1 km for the youngest participants to 30 km for those looking for a serious challenge. The event combines nature experiences with health and outdoor activities in a scenic setting. It is organised by IK Granit and has a tradition of welcoming runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Scenic trails in the Eco Park
Distance options from 1 km to 30 km
Family-friendly, with activities for all ages
additional: The event is organised by IK Granit. Nordens Ark is a zoo and nature reserve that is open year-round. Parking is free, and there are good bus connections. Participants are encouraged to register well in advance, but current information about registration and prices is not available on the website. The race is cancelled in 2026 but is planned to return in 2027. The event is scheduled to take place on 8 April 2027, with distances from 1 km to 30 km. It is an opportunity for participants to enjoy the arrival of spring in a scenic, family-friendly setting.

name: Påskrundan 2026
description: Vänersborgs AIK warmly welcomes you to Påskrundan, a popular trail race suited to both elite runners and recreational runners. The race has quickly become a lovely Easter tradition, attracting participants of all ages. Starting and finishing at the ski lodge in Vänersborg, the course offers approximately 7 kilometres of varied running along gravel roads and trails. The first section is easy to run, while the final section is hillier and more challenging. Påskrundan is a celebration of running with a focus on community, and children’s and youth races make it a day for the whole family. Alongside the race, there’s a wonderful atmosphere, prizes for the top finishers in each category, and prize draws for all participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 kilometres of trail running on gravel roads and trails
The first section is easy and fast to run
The final section is hilly and challenging
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and all participants are entered in prize draws. The start and finish are at the ski lodge in Vänersborg. The race is a celebration of running focused on community, attracting both elite and recreational runners.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running event in Sölvesborg organised by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers several distances of varying lengths and difficulty, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced runners. It is part of Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic, challenging course through beautiful terrain. The organisers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organised and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, painted lines and ribbons at every kilometre
Water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish
The terrain varies, with sections through woodland and hilly stretches
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla, no later than 30 minutes before the start. All participants must wear their race number on the front of their chest. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish. Refreshments, including coffee and grilled sausages, are available. Marshals are stationed at junctions to show the way. There are several race distances, with start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club’s website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running event in Säter that includes the district championships in the half marathon. The event offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and welcomes runners of different levels. It is organized by Säters IF FIK and is known for its friendly atmosphere, focus on the joy of running, and sense of local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, with a focus on the half marathon and 10 km
Held in Säter amid scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km remains open as usual.

name: Allstarsmilen
description: ALLSTARSMILEN is one of Sweden’s fastest 10 km races, run on a flat, officially measured and sanctioned course. It’s the perfect course for setting a personal best or using as a qualifying result for other races. Welcome to this fast, well-organized race in Skrea-Herting-Hjortsberg.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Officially measured and sanctioned
Suitable for setting a personal best and qualifying for other races

name: Vårruset (Malmö)
description: Vårruset in Malmö is a women’s fun run offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km in the lovely spring surroundings of Slottsparken. The event is all about the joy of movement and community, and welcomes participants regardless of their fitness background or level of ambition. You can enter individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset is an inclusive and inspiring movement for recreational running that has been promoting women’s health and well-being since 1989.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Slottsparken
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Emporia in the days before the event. You can choose not to have your time recorded. Changing at home is recommended, as there are no changing facilities at the venue. Bag storage is available in a tent at the race bib collection point. The start and finish are on Kung Oscarsväg in Slottsparken. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members can run different distances. Teams receive a picnic after the finish. Registration is binding and can be completed up to one hour before the start on race day.

name: Lauf Rund um das Schaubergwerk Röhrigschacht
10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid
description: The 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid is an annual running event with three distances: Kidsrun, 5 Mijl and 10 Mijl. The routes pass through the residential area of Zwolle-Zuid and the beautiful countryside near the IJssel, with the start and finish at Wijkcentrum SIO. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organisation, and attracts both recreational and competitive runners. The 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid is a great challenge for runners who want to enjoy a varied course in a green setting.
course_highlights: Course through the residential area of Zwolle-Zuid and the countryside near the IJssel
5 Mijl route of 8047 metres, starting at 17:00
10 Mijl route of 16093 metres, passing Harculo
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Lopers Company, Gasthuisplein 2, from Wednesday 9 April through Friday 11 April during opening hours, and on Saturday 12 April from 12:00 to 16:30 at Wijkcentrum SIO at Thorbeckelaan 2. The 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid is not an official Atletiek Unie race. Minimum age is 14 for the 5 Mijl and 17 for the 10 Mijl. Race numbers must be worn visibly. The course is not suitable for wheelchair users or wheeler users. Distances: Kidsrun, 5 Mijl, 10 Mijl; registration opens in January; supports charities; location in Zwolle-Zuid.

name: 2Bruggenloop
description: The Ned Air 2Bruggenloop in Kampen is a lively running event that starts and finishes in the heart of the city. The routes cross two iconic bridges, the Stadsbrug and the Molenbrug, and offer beautiful views of the historic city skyline and the waterside natural scenery along the IJssel. The certified half marathon and 10-kilometre race are challenging, including a climb over the Molenbrug. There is a special Kidsrun through the city centre for young runners. After the finish, participants can unwind in the welcoming city centre during the Nacht van Kampen.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the atmospheric Oudestraat in the heart of Kampen
Cross the impressive Stadsbrug with its golden wheels and the 600-metre-long Molenbrug, which stands 21 metres high
Beautiful views of the iconic city skyline and the waterside river scenery along the IJssel
additional: Starting corrals are assigned according to expected running time (Red, Purple, Yellow) to ensure a smooth flow. The start and finish area is at Van Heutszplein. Race numbers can be collected on the Friday evening before the race. Lockers are available for safely storing belongings. Merchandise is on sale, including hoodies, socks and shirts. The Kidsrun has separate start times: 13:00 for ages 4–9 and 13:15 for ages 10–12. After the finish, participants can unwind in the city centre during the Nacht van Kampen (band night). The event also offers a Kidsrun and Businessrun, and has a strong local reputation as one of the best running events in Kampen and the surrounding area.

name: Rondje Zegveld
description: Rondje Zegveld is a running event in the heart of Zegveld. Participants can choose from a 1.5 km Kids Run, a 5 km route or a 10 km route through the beautiful Groene Hart polder. Times are recorded electronically, and results are available online after the event. The event is open to all ages and offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere. Late registration is also possible on the day, up to half an hour before the race starts.
course_highlights: A loop through the Groene Hart polder
A 1.5 km Kids Run through the centre of Zegveld
Water station after approximately 5 km on the 10 km route
additional: Late registration is possible on the day until 30 minutes before the race starts, while places are available. The awards ceremony is expected to take place around 15:15–15:30. Traffic measures and temporary road closures will be in place in and around the village during the event. First-aid personnel will be present along the route and at the finish. Photos and videos will be taken for promotional purposes. The event on 3 April 2027 offers recreational and competitive runners alike a great opportunity to explore the area and take part in a local running event.

name: Woest Lochemsebergloop
description: The WOEST Lochemsebergloop is a friendly running event in Barchem, with distances for both children and adults. The kids’ run is specifically for children up to 16 years old and covers 1,000 metres, while adults can choose between a 5 km run or power walk and a 10 km run. The event takes place in a beautiful natural setting, with a focus on preserving nature. There is a drinks station and a litter zone along the route, and parking is well organised at Bon Aparte. The organisers are available to answer questions by email and aim to create a sporty, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances for children (1,000 m) and adults (5 km and 10 km)
Drinks station and litter zone along the route to help keep nature clean
Start and finish near the Bon Aparte car park in Barchem
additional: Parking and bicycle parking at the Bon Aparte car park. Toilets available at Bon Aparte. No changing or shower facilities at the start/finish. Drinks station and litter zone along the route. Start times by distance: kids’ run at 13:00 and 13:01, 5 km at 13:30, 10 km at 14:30. Trail run with various distances, located in Barchem, parking at Bon Aparte, no changing facilities or showers available.

name: Hoka Torekov-Båstad Lördag
description: Hoka Torekov-Båstad is a scenic trail race offering 28 or 21 km of varied running between Torekov and Båstad. The race features beautiful views of mountains, forests and the sea, and is part of Trails of SWE c/o Dacia, which showcases Sweden’s diverse natural landscapes. After the race, you can join an After Run buffet with good food and live entertainment at Hotel Skansen. A perfect race for anyone who wants to enjoy the freedom of nature and challenge their ability.
course_highlights: Varied trail running over 28 or 21 km
Beautiful views of mountains, forests and the sea
Part of Trails of SWE, with four unique nature experiences
additional: An After Run buffet is available after the race at Hotel Skansen for 445 SEK/person, with food and live entertainment. Buses run from the Tourist Parking in Båstad to the start in Torekov; your race bib serves as your ticket. Shoes with metal studs are not allowed. An After Run buffet with food and live entertainment is available at Hotel Skansen for 445 SEK per person.

name: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT)
description: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT) is a technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen, offering three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km. The races are open to all runners, from elite athletes to recreational runners, and participants in the 25 km race must be at least 17 years old. The courses include both classic routes and new trails, with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful views of nature. After the race, a classic Giffa burger is included for the 10 km and 25 km races, or a hot dog in a bun for the 5 km race, along with a drink. There is no time limit, and the 25 km race is part of the Skåne Trailcup.
course_highlights: A technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen
Courses with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful natural views
Three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km, featuring both classic routes and new trails
additional: Showers and changing rooms are available after the race. Water and energy stations are located along the course and at the finish. The 25 km race is the first event in the Skåne Trailcup. There is no time limit; the race ends when all participants have reached the finish. Previous editions have had water and energy stations along the course and at the finish, as well as showers and changing rooms. Food and drink after the finish have been included in the entry fee.

name: Bredase Singelloop 2027
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.9 km, 0.8 km

name: Drutenloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Drutenloop is a sporting event held in the atmospheric town centre and along the beautiful dikes of Druten. The event offers a range of events for all ages, including children’s races, shorter distances, a 10-kilometre race and a half marathon. Since 2026, new events have also been added, including the Crossfit fitness race and the Bendefit nature walk. The Drutenloop is known for bringing people together and for its convivial atmosphere.
course_highlights: A beautiful route along the Waalbandijk and through the centre of Druten
A range of distances, from a 500-metre children’s race to a half marathon (21.1 km)
New since 2026: Crossfit fitness race and Bendefit nature walk
additional: Race bibs are required and include a BIB tag for timekeeping. Race bibs can be collected on Saturday 11 April from 15:00 to 18:00 at the bondsgebouw, and on Sunday 12 April until half an hour before the race at the information point on the Markt. There is a first-aid station at the start/finish, and first-aid responders also ride along on bicycles. The first three boys and girls in each age category will receive awards. All 500 m and 1 km runners receive a medal at the finish. The event is actively promoted on social media, with updates and results on Facebook and Instagram.

name: Gemert City Run
location: Het centrum van Gemert, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Gemert City Run is an atmospheric running event in the historic centre of Gemert, where runners of all levels come together for a day full of energy and fun. With distances ranging from Kids Runs to 15 km, as well as a relay, there is a suitable challenge for everyone. The route passes iconic places such as the castle and Ridderplein, with the start and finish in the lively town centre. After the finish, everyone raises a glass to celebrate their achievements, giving the day a festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic centre of Gemert
Past Gemert Castle and St. John’s Church
Start and finish at atmospheric Ridderplein
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:30 at the Town Hall. Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the race starts; payment is accepted in cash or by debit card. There is a Business Run and a relay (4 x 700 m lap). The programme includes multiple start times for different distances and a festive ceremony afterwards. Participants can choose from various distances, including special Kids Runs for children. The event promotes sport, fun and community involvement.

name: Halve van Den Helder
description: The Halve van Den Helder is a unique event where you can experience the city of Den Helder in a special way, both walking and running. The course follows the coast, passes forts, the iconic De Lange Jaap lighthouse, the Marsdiep and the Helderse Zeedijk, and includes surprising locations that are normally closed to the public. The event combines sport with cultural heritage and nature, giving participants a varied experience. The walking event takes place on Saturday 3 April 2027, and the running races on Sunday 4 April 2027.
course_highlights: Along the coast and the Marsdiep
Past forts and the De Lange Jaap lighthouse
A visit to surprising locations that are normally closed to the public
additional: The walking event takes place on Saturday 3 April 2027, and the running races on Sunday 4 April 2027. Running distances: 21 km, 10 km and 4 km. There is also a corporate race and a kids’ run. Registration for the 15th edition in 2027 is currently closed and will reopen in September. Distances: 21 km, 10 km and 4 km; the course passes along the coast, forts, the lighthouse and cultural heritage sites; the event takes place on 3 and 4 April 2027.

name: Marathon Amersfoort
description: Marathon Amersfoort is a sporting and festive running event held in the city of Amersfoort. The event offers a range of distances for all levels, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, mini marathons and walking distances. The marathon is held in early spring to ensure favourable weather conditions. A varied music programme along the course supports and encourages runners and spectators.
course_highlights: A range of distances from a 1.1 km mini marathon to a 42.2 km marathon
Music along the course with 20 DJs, brass bands and samba bands
Start and finish in the centre of Amersfoort, with lively support
additional: On Saturday, there is a 42.2 km training marathon starting at 8:30. On Sunday, there are 5, 10 and 21 km runs, various walking distances and mini marathons for primary school pupils. The organisers ask participants and spectators to travel by bike or on foot wherever possible. Parking is available in the Eemplein and Oppidium car parks. Amersfoort Centraal station is about a 10-minute walk from the event. Participants can register from 1 November; the event also includes walking routes and a training run on 30 May. The race is organised in cooperation with the municipality of Amersfoort and includes various course options.

name: Stoomtramloop
description: The Stoomtramloop is a unique recreational running experience in which participants travel by historic steam tram from Medemblik to Opperdoes or Twisk. Participants then run 5 or 10 kilometres back to Medemblik. The focus is on fun and the experience. Because the start and finish locations vary, exact timekeeping is not possible, and every participant is a winner. The event takes place on the first Sunday of April and offers a special combination of sport and history.
course_highlights: 5 km route from Opperdoes station to Medemblik
10 km route from Twisk station via Opperdoes to Medemblik
Travel by historic steam tram from Medemblik to the start locations
additional: Maximum 500 participants, split equally between the 5 km and 10 km distances. Registration includes steam tram transport and a unique running shirt. Time limits: 45 minutes for 5 km and 90 minutes for 10 km. There is a drinks station at Opperdoes station. Traffic marshals are present at crossings. There is a small chance of waiting at railway crossings. Participation includes a running shirt and steam tram transport. The event is limited to 500 participants and is known for its friendly, non-competitive atmosphere.

name: Reakt-Brijderloop
location: Atletiekvereniging Hylas, Alkmaar, North Holland, Netherlands
price_range: Prestatieloop 5/10 km: € 10,00; Kidsrun: € 5,00; op de dag zelf: Prestatieloop € 15,00; Kidsrun € 10,00
description: The Reakt-Brijderloop is a recreational road race in Alkmaar, specially organized for people with a history of addiction, mental health vulnerabilities, and anyone who enjoys running. The event includes a 5- or 10-kilometer race and a kids’ run with three distances. The start and finish are at Atletiekvereniging Hylas. The run supports recovery through exercise and has a long tradition spanning 26 years.
course_highlights: 5- and 10-kilometer races
Kids’ run in three categories: 400m, 800m, and 1200m
Start and finish at AV Hylas in Alkmaar
additional: If you register in advance, you’ll receive a race number bearing your own name. The event welcomes participants with physical disabilities and para-athletes. Registration on the day is possible at a higher price. Participants can register until 15 March; the kids’ runs range from 400m to 1200m; the event promotes recovery and self-confidence among participants.

name: SpriT Frontyard - Genarp
description: SpriT Frontyard Genarp is a fast and fun trail running race at Genarpsbadet, suitable for all levels and ambitions. The course is approximately 1 km long and consists of gravel road, forest trail and sand, with no asphalt, and two small hills at the beginning. The aim is to run as many laps as you can within time limits that gradually decrease. Water, cola and other treats are available at the lap point and after the finish, and great prizes are awarded to many participants.
course_highlights: A mix of gravel road, forest trail and sand
Two small hills at the beginning of the course
A fast course with a thrilling finish along the final straight
additional: You have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9 minutes and 40 seconds for the second lap, 9 minutes and 20 seconds for the third lap, and so on. Water, cola and other treats are available at the lap point and after the finish. Great prizes are awarded to many participants. Registration is binding once payment has been made. The organizer recommends insurance in case of injury or illness. The race information found applies to previous editions; the price and details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Halmstad is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in the scenic Alet Nature Reserve. The event is all about the joy of movement and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event is part of a long-standing tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and community.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Alet Nature Reserve and on Skepparegatan in Halmstad
Measured 5 km course
Scenic area, with the event area accessible on foot or by bicycle
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden in the days before the race. Teams of 5 receive a picnic after the finish. You can opt out of timed results. Recommended ages: 2.5 km from age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult); 5 km from age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult). Changing at home is recommended, as there are no changing facilities at the venue. Water stations and toilets are available at the event area. Parking is available, but environmentally friendly travel is encouraged. Participants can choose to have their 5 km time recorded, and the event features a festive atmosphere with opportunities for community and well-being.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
description: Varvetmilen Jönköping is a 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken. The course consists of two clockwise laps around scenic Lake Rocksjon and offers a wonderful running experience. Your Varvetmilen result can be used for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet, giving runners the chance to secure a better starting group. The race is organised by Göteborgsvarvet in cooperation with IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb and is part of the Varvetmilen tour of Sweden.
course_highlights: Two clockwise laps around Lake Rocksjön
Start and finish in scenic Knektaparken
Qualifies for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet
additional: Race bib collection and bag drop take place at Knektaparken on race day. Minivarvet also takes place alongside Varvetmilen: a 210-metre race for children aged 0–6, with a medal for every participant. Registration for Minivarvet is available on site via Swish (80 kr). The race starts in Knektaparken and covers two laps around Lake Rocksjön. Race bibs can be collected the day before and on race day. Showers, changing facilities, bag storage and a small café are available on site.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vill du ha bästa priset? Du vinner på att anmäla dig tidigt!

description: Vårruset in Vänersborg is a recreational race for women offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances on a course that has been officially measured. The event is all about the joy of exercise and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. After crossing the finish line, teams of five are treated to a picnic, making for a lovely spring evening together. The event starts and finishes at Sanden in Vänersborg and offers every participant a medal, a finish-line bag, optional timing, and a race bib.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Sanden, Vänersborg
Picnic after the race for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Överby in Trollhättan in the days before the race. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Picnic collection is made using the team leader’s race bib. The recommended ages are 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part when accompanied by an adult. The event area is easy to reach by public transport, and free parking is available at Sanden. Teams consist of 5 people, and members can run different distances. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s recreational race series, with a focus on community, the joy of exercise, and health. Participants can choose to have their time recorded or run without timing, and there are marshals, music, and entertainment along the course.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a six-leg relay race that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied gravel and asphalt surface, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, and all teams start at the same time. In the anniversary year, a Mini Race for children is also held, with a medal and certificate for every participant.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Start and finish in the heart of Bruksparken, Bromölla
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is provided by data chip, and both the total finish time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and prizes are also drawn for all participants. The Mini Race for children starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing, all children receive a medal, certificate, drink and fruit. The event includes a mini category for children and is open to both recreational and elite runners. Participants can expect chip timing to record total and individual times.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a popular running event featuring a scenic six-kilometre course through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course runs along the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches, on an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children’s race, Bostadsbolaget Lilla Stadsparksloppet. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal in recognition of their achievement. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Stadsparken, Mjölby
Runs along the Svartån for most of the route; 99% asphalt
Includes challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon. The warm-up is led by Fitness4You before the start. Everyone who crosses the finish line receives a medal. The children’s race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45, with age groups up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is available until 8 May for an additional fee of SEK 50. Massage is available in the start and finish area. The race takes place in Stadsparken, with options for company tents, registration via the website, race bib collection at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship.

name: Springtime Mariestads stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis deltagande för barn upp till årskurs 6 och personer med funktionsvariation

description: Springtime Mariestads Stadslopp is an annual road race organized by Mariestads AIF and Korpen Mariestad since 1982. The race takes place in Mariestad in early May and offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including 10 km, 5 km, a children’s race and a race for people with disabilities. The event is part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners in various categories. It is a traditional, well-attended running festival with strong involvement from volunteers and participants.
course_highlights: Two main distances: 10 km (2 x 5 km) and 5 km on city streets
Children’s race and race for people with disabilities, with shorter 500 m and 2,000 m routes
Part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen
additional: Start times: Funkisloppet at 10:30, Minimara at 11:15, 10 km and 5 km at 12:00. Participation in the senior and veteran categories requires membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation. Participants may run with a guide in Funkisloppet. Course maps are available via a link on the website. Multiple race distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and children’s and disability races; registration is required; medals and prizes for participants.

name: Springtime 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 150 kr fram till den 31/12

description: Springtime in Helsingborg is a traditional running event with three distances: 10 km, 5 km and HD's MiniSpringtime for children. The 10 km race is the classic event and has been held since 1981, while the 5 km race is a shorter, more intense alternative. The races also offer team competitions in which men and women compete on equal terms through time adjustments. The courses are carefully measured, with the start and finish together at Stortorget, providing a scenic and spectator-friendly running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stortorget in Helsingborg
The course includes the entire climb up Pålsjöbacken, with no detour
Certified 5 km and 10 km courses measured by Swedish Athletics course measurers
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib, medal, water and fruit at the finish. Late registration is available through 3 May on the website for an additional fee, and thereafter at Löplabbet, subject to availability. Insurance can be purchased when registering. Team competitions are offered, with times adjusted for men and women.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a trail race that welcomes everyone, from children and recreational participants to experienced runners and mountain bikers. The race follows a scenic route through the pine-covered esker between Alberga and Kungsör, along trails and gravel roads with moderate hills and technical sections. The event has an open, welcoming atmosphere created together by volunteers, spectators and participants, and is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis. Many return year after year, while new participants take part for the first time.
course_highlights: Trail running and cycling along a pine-covered esker
Trails and gravel roads with moderate hills
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday before race week. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis, with a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers and spectators.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vill du ha det bästa priset? Du vinner på att anmäla dig tidigt!

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Se prisstegen nedan. Priset avser kostnad per person.

description: Vårruset in Växjö is a fun run for women featuring 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö. The event is all about the joy of running and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ability levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event is part of a long-standing tradition dating back to 1989 and focuses on promoting women’s health and creating an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course around Lake Växjö
Start and finish at Strandbjörket
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in the days before the race. Bibs must be worn visibly throughout the race. You can opt out of timing. The event area has a water station, toilets, a café, and a sponsor village with activities. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after the finish. The race is open to everyone, and participants can register individually or in teams of five. Women born in 1994–1999 can also receive free HPV vaccinations on site during Vårruset in Växjö.

name: Startmilen
price_range: 2026 års avgifter: 50–80 kr för KnatteStarten, 100–250 kr för 5 km och 200–300 kr för 10 km
description: Startmilen is a recreational race in Örebro that welcomes runners of all abilities and marks the start of the outdoor running season for many. The event offers a 1 km race for children, 5 km for juniors and veterans, and 10 km for competitive runners and recreational participants. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen, near Örebro University, and the course runs along streets in the Almby district. The 10 km race is the district championship for Södra Svealand and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. Official timing is provided for all races except the children’s race.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen at Örebro University
The course runs along streets in the Almby district
The 5 km and 10 km courses are certified by a federation course measurer
additional: Race numbers are distributed at Tybblelundshallen from around 10:30 on race day. Timing uses a transponder, which is loaned out when race numbers are distributed and must be returned after finishing. A fee of SEK 800 applies for a lost transponder. All races except KnatteStarten are timed. Prize ceremonies take place at 13:40 for the 5 km and 15:30 for the 10 km. All finishers receive a medal. All finishers receive a medal. Information about distances and fees is from the 2026 edition and may change for 2027.

name: Tjust Trail Run
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organised by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops and through the scenic nature of Småland. Participants get to experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running across varied terrain. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Småland forest
Sections over beautiful rocky outcrops
Beautiful and varied terrain
additional: Changes to the race distance are possible by email until 31 March. On the longest distance (The Long Run), runners must complete a lap by 11:45 to be allowed to continue for the second lap. Race bibs must be clearly visible. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. If withdrawing, participants must notify a race official or call the number provided. Transport can be arranged from aid stations if needed. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. Distance changes can be made until 31 March.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.tjusttrailrun.com/): 2027-04-10 — "10 april 2027 kommer Tjust Bike & Running Club anordna den elfte upplagan av TJUST TRAIL RUN." (was estimated 2027-04-17)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: 10 april 2027 kommer Tjust Bike & Running Club anordna den elfte upplagan av TJUST TRAIL RUN.

name: BLK Trailen (Bredared)
description: The BLK Trail in Bredared is a trail race organised by Borås Running Club, a club that welcomes all runners and offers a wide range of activities. The race takes place in scenic surroundings by Björkehovsgården and features varied trails and terrain suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. The club also organises other events and challenges throughout the year to promote the joy of running and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Trail running in scenic surroundings by Björkehovsgården
Varied trails with both shorter and longer distances
Running through woodland with natural features and hilly terrain
additional: Registration takes place at the start and is free for members of Borås Running Club. The club also organises monthly challenges and the BLK Cup, with a points system based on different trails and distances.

name: Varvetmilen (Malmö)
description: Varvetmilen in Malmö is part of a tour that gives runners the opportunity to improve their starting group for Göteborgsvarvet 2027. The race takes place at Heleneholms IP and is a qualifying race for Göteborgsvarvet, meaning your result may earn you a better starting position in the larger half marathon. Varvetmilen is a fast and fun 10 km race that attracts runners of all levels and offers a great chance to compete in a spring running festival.
course_highlights: 10 km distance with the opportunity to qualify for Göteborgsvarvet
Held at Heleneholms IP in Malmö
Part of the Varvetmilen tour, with events in several locations and a virtual race
additional: Varvetmilen is a qualifying race for Göteborgsvarvet 2027, meaning your result automatically improves your starting group without any additional registration. The race is part of a tour with events in Jönköping, Göteborg and Malmö, as well as a virtual race. No specific price information for Varvetmilen Malmö is available on the website, and registration is through Göteborgsvarvet’s shared registration page. The official information states that Varvetmilen Malmö 2027 will be held on 17 April, not 10 April. Registration opens in early November, and details about Malmö will be published later.

name: Startmilen (Örebro)
description: Startmilen is a recreational race in Örebro that is suitable for all runners and marks the start of the outdoor season for many. The race offers a 1 km distance for children, 5 km for juniors and veterans, and 10 km for competition and recreational runners. The 10 km event is the district championship (DM) for Södra Svealand and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series, sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen by Örebro University, and the course runs along streets in the Almby district. Timing is by transponder, and all participants who finish the race receive a medal.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen by Örebro University
The course runs along streets in the Almby district
The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured by a certified course measurer
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Tybblelundshallen from around 10:30 on race day. Timing is by transponder, which is loaned out when race bibs are collected and must be returned after finishing. A fee of 800 kr is charged for a lost transponder. All events except KnatteStarten are timed. The 5 km awards ceremony is at 13:40 and the 10 km ceremony is at 15:30. All participants who finish the race receive a medal. Registration is through the registration system. Late registration may be available for an increased fee and subject to availability.

name: Kurts 300:e maraton - halvmaran
description: Kurt’s 300th Marathon is a special race organized by Hultsfreds Löparklubb to celebrate Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The race follows a 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred, combining park paths and asphalt. The half marathon consists of two long laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, where changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. After the race, participants are invited to a get-together with food and good company.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen
20% asphalt, the rest park paths
Two water stations offering water, sports drink, cola, and fruit
additional: The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take over 5 hours start at 09:00. After the race, a get-together with food and good company is offered at around 14:30, about 1 km from Knektavallen at the restaurant. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned. The start and finish are at Knektavallen; changing rooms, showers, toilets, and water stations are available according to the organizer’s information.

name: 4 Mijl van AvK
description: The 4 Mijl van AvK is a running event covering a distance of 6.4 kilometers in the unique peat-colony landscape of Annerveenschekanaal. The route runs alongside and through this distinctive landscape, giving the race a characteristic and atmospheric feel. The event attracts runners who enjoy a challenging and scenic running environment.
course_highlights: 6.4 km running route
Alongside and through the peat-colony landscape
Unique nature and scenery
additional: The event is popular with local runners and offers a great opportunity to run in a special setting. No specific information about registration fees is available.

name: Halve van Nijkerk
description: The Bouw Logistics Half Marathon of Nijkerk is a sporting event held in the centre of Nijkerk. Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, KidsRun, and walking routes of 10, 15, and 20 km. The course runs through and around the city, with a legendary finish at ’t Plein. The atmosphere is fantastic, with plenty of spectators along the route and a festive ambiance for all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the centre of Nijkerk, at Molenplein and ’t Plein
Walking routes of 10, 15, and 20 km through and around Nijkerk
Legendary finish at ’t Plein with plenty of spectators
additional: Start times: 15:00 walking (10, 15, 20 km), 16:30 KidsRun, 16:45 half marathon, 17:00 5 km, 18:45 10 km. The start and finish are approximately 300 metres apart. Changing rooms are available at the start area (Molenplein) and close at 20:15. Every finisher receives a unique medal. Registration is open until race day, unless the event sells out. BusinessRun is for company teams of 5 participants, competing in the 5 km, 10 km, or half marathon. The event includes a half marathon and attracts runners from the region and beyond.

name: The Royal Copenhagen City Half
description:
A flat half marathon on closed roads through Copenhagen. The route starts at the harbour in Nordhavn and passes Kastellet, Amalienborg, Nyhavn, the Black Diamond and Lille Langebro before finishing at Royal Arena in Ørestad. Flat asphalt with under 16 metres of elevation, long straight stretches and few turns—suitable both for your first half marathon and for chasing a new PR.

The first edition in April 2026 had 2,758 finishers from 66 nations. Around 10,000 runners are expected in 2027.
additional:
Start at 09:30, 2 minutes from Orientkaj Metro. From the finish, it’s 10 minutes by metro to the airport.
The entry fee includes chip timing (RACE RESULT), a medal, a digital certificate, refreshment stations approximately every 5 km and free baggage transport from start to finish.
Prices: DKK 695 until 16/1-2027 · DKK 895 from 17/1 · DKK 1,095 from 28/2. Minimum age: 15.
Please note: This is the spring race on 11 April 2027, not the Copenhagen Half Marathon in September.

name: Vårruset Göteborg
description: Vårruset Göteborg is a popular spring running event held in Slottsskogen, with the start and finish by Björngårdsvillan. The event offers two distances, 2.5 km and 5 km, with the 5 km course officially measured. It is a social and inclusive event where participants can register individually or in teams, and teams that register are treated to a picnic after finishing. The event is open to all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult. Participants receive a medal, a finish-line goody bag, optional timing, and a race bib.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course in Slottsskogen
Start and finish below Björngårdsvillan
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
additional: Registration is binding and can be completed online up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. You can opt out of timing when registering. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members can run different distances. Teams that register are treated to a picnic after finishing. The recommended minimum age is 7 when accompanied by an adult for the 2.5 km, and 11 when accompanied by an adult for the 5 km. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s recreational running series, with online registration, the option to participate as a team, and timing for the 5 km. Participants are treated to a medal, a finish-line goody bag, a picnic, and entertainment.

name: Varvetmilen Göteborg
description: Varvetmilen Göteborg is a seeding-qualifying 10 km race held as part of the Varvetmilen tour in spring 2027. The race gives runners the opportunity to improve their starting group for the Göteborgsvarvet half marathon. Varvetmilen Göteborg takes place on 10 April and is part of a multi-location running festival that also includes a digital version. The course is designed to offer a fast and inspiring running experience through Göteborg’s urban surroundings.
course_highlights: A seeding-qualifying 10 km race for Göteborgsvarvet 2027
Running through Göteborg’s urban surroundings, with spectators and music
Part of a tour featuring races in Jönköping, Göteborg and Malmö, as well as a digital event
additional: Varvetmilen Göteborg is part of a seeding tour that automatically earns participants a better starting group in Göteborgsvarvet 2027. The start area is on Margretebergsgatan, next to Slottsskogsvallen. Race numbers can be collected at the Göteborgsvarvet Expo during race weekend. More than 200,000 spectators and around 50 music stations along the course create a festive atmosphere. Travelling by public transport or taking the shuttle bus from Åby Arena to the start/finish area is recommended. Registration opens in early November. The result automatically qualifies participants for a better starting group in Göteborgsvarvet 2027.

name: Hässleholmsloppet
description: Hässleholmsloppet is a trail race held at the beautiful Hovdala Castle in Hässleholm. The race offers three distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5.4 km. All courses feature gentle, winding trails through varied woodland, with stretches alongside water. The longest course, 21 km, is part of Spring i Skåne’s Trail Cup and offers extra elevation and a scenic route. The race is open to both recreational runners and young people; the recommended minimum age for the longest distance is 17.
course_highlights: Gentle, winding trails through varied woodland
Sections alongside water along the courses
The 21 km course is a scenic route at Hovdala with extra elevation
additional: Start and finish at Hovdala Castle. Runners should arrive 10 minutes before the start. Bibs must be collected at the venue at least 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly at the front. Electronic timing is used. There are no shower or changing facilities, but toilets are available. Water and sports drink stations are available on all courses. The maximum number of participants is 400. Name changes are possible for a fee of 100 kr via the registration page. The race information specifies electronic timing, aid stations on all courses and a participant limit of 400. The prices and practical details apply to the published information for 2026.

name: 42 Bieg Szpęgawski
location: Szpęgawsk, Starogard County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Kranenbroeker Bosloop GOEDE DOELEN!!
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8.5 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km

name: Cruyff Legacy 14K
description: The Cruyff Legacy 14K is an annual running and walking event held at the Johan Cruyff ArenA in Amsterdam. The event brings thousands of participants together to take action for the Johan Cruyff Foundation, which creates opportunities for children with disabilities to participate in sport. The 2026 edition was a great success, with more than 8,000 participants and an impressive amount raised. The next edition takes place on Sunday, 11 April 2027, a special day putting sport and social engagement at the heart of the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Johan Cruyff ArenA in Amsterdam
Run and walk through the city
An event with a social mission to support children with disabilities
additional: The Cruyff Legacy 14K raises awareness of sport for children with disabilities. It is supported by main sponsors including AFC Ajax, OTTO Work Force, PWC and Basic-Fit. The 2026 edition raised €851,639. The organisers invite participants to join this socially minded sports day. Race in Amsterdam, scheduled for 11 April 2027; supports sport for children with disabilities; participants can choose between running and walking.

name: De Oude Weideloop
description: The Oude Weideloop is a running event in Wagenberg suitable for young and old. There are four distances: a 1 km and 2 km family run, plus the 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km consisting of two 5 km laps. The start and finish are at Van Elsenplein, and the course runs through various streets of Wagenberg. The event features musical support and timekeeping, with prizes for the best men and women in all categories.
course_highlights: Family run of 1 km and 2 km, suitable for all ages
5 km course through various streets of Wagenberg
The 10 km consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Start/finish at Van Elsenplein in Wagenberg. Changing rooms and a first-aider are available at the sports fields. First-aid stations are located along the route. The information point opens at 11:00 for race-number and T-shirt collection. Grandparents or parents may run for free with their child or grandchild during the family run. Timekeeping by Startnummerexpress. Musical support during the run. Prizes for the first three men and women in all categories. Registration is via the official website, and the event is aimed at residents of the municipality of Drimmelen.

name: Enschede Marathon
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Enschede Marathon, the oldest marathon in the Netherlands and Western Europe, takes place on 11 April 2027 in Enschede. The event offers a fast course, excellent support, plenty of music and tens of thousands of enthusiastic supporters. In addition to the full marathon, there are also a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and various kids’ races. The marathon supports KWF Dutch Cancer Society through the “Run Against Cancer” campaign, which encourages participants to collect donations.
course_highlights: Fast course in Enschede, starting and finishing on Boulevard 1945
Excellent support and plenty of music along the course
Tens of thousands of supporters create a vibrant atmosphere
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday 10 April from 10:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday 11 April from 07:30 onwards at the Connect-U registration office in Enschede. Race numbers can also be sent by post within the Netherlands for an additional € 5,-. The marathon features a Club Challenge in which clubs and their members can compete for prizes. There are various categories for men and women, and a special “Run Against Cancer” campaign through which participants can receive a free race entry by raising at least € 500 in donations. Multiple distances, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and kids’ race; registration discounts; charity support; electronic timing; race held since 1947

name: Halve van Helmond
description: De Halve van Helmond is a welcoming running and walking event held annually in Helmond and Stiphout. The main distance is the half marathon, consisting of two 10.55 km laps on a fully paved course, with the start and finish in the centre of Brandevoort. There are also shorter running distances of 10 km and 5 km, a corporate race, a kids’ run and a unique 2.5 km run, so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event is known for its friendly organisation, scenic routes past sports parks and an enjoyable sporting experience for both competitive runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: The half marathon consists of two 10.55 km laps on a fully paved course
Start and finish in the Brandevoort shopping centre
Aid stations every 2.5 km and a route past the sports parks of local athletics clubs
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day at wijkhuis ’t BrandPunt in Helmond (Brandevoort). There is a staffed cloakroom and changing rooms. A limited number of race entries are available for on-the-day registration for the running events; places are limited. The half marathon has a maximum time limit of 3 hours. Participants who have not started their second lap after 1 hour and 30 minutes will be withdrawn from the race. Running shirts can be ordered free of charge when registering, while stocks last. Race numbers can be collected on 11 and 12 April. Route information and timings will be shared online. The event takes place in Helmond and Stiphout.

name: IJsselloop
price_range: € 35,00 voor het loopshirt, andere prijzen niet vermeld
description: The IJsselloop in Deventer is the city’s largest running event and takes place annually on the second Sunday of April. With more than 9,000 participants and a unique atmosphere along the IJssel, the event offers a suitable distance for everyone, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. The course passes iconic bridges and follows the river, finishing on the beautiful Brink square. Organised with the support of many volunteers and AV Daventria 1906, the event encourages people of all ages to take part, with participation more important than winning.
course_highlights: A unique course along the IJssel with views of the river
Cross the Wilhelmina Bridge and the railway bridge in Deventer
Finish on the Netherlands’ most beautiful square, the Brink
additional: Generous time limits by distance: no time limit for the 5 km and kids’ run, 1.5 hours for the 10 km, and 2 hours for the 15 km. On-the-day registration is available for the G-loop and kids’ run. The 5 km prize-giving is at 15:30 and the 10 km prize-giving is at 14:45 in the barracks garden (Boreel, Houtmarkt). Race number with timing, and refreshments along the course and at the finish. Clinics and training opportunities through AV Daventria 1906. Distances range from the kids’ run to 15 km; registration runs from 25 October 2025 to 21 March 2026, with limits for some distances. Start and finish in Deventer, with clinics available to prepare.

name: Middelseeloop
price_range: Kidsrun gratis, 2,5 km € 3,50, 5 km € 5,00, 10 km € 7,50, medaille toeslag € 3,00
description: The Middelseeloop is a friendly running event in Leeuwarden, held in the Middelsee and De Zuidlanden neighbourhoods. The event offers five different distances, including a 1-kilometre kids’ run, as well as 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and 12.5 km walking routes. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys running or wants to get to know the neighbourhood better. Activities for children take place all day around the start and finish, and all participants are offered an ice cream afterwards.
course_highlights: Routes through the Middelsee and De Zuidlanden neighbourhoods
Five distances: 1 km kids’ run, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and 12.5 km walk
Start and finish at IKC Middelsee, Felling 2, 8912 CG Leeuwarden
additional: Register before 16 March to have your name printed on your race bib. Activities for children take place all day at the start-finish location, including a climbing wall, a football darts board, stilt walkers and Circus Saranti. Walkers will find a surprise along the way. After the event, all participants receive an ice cream from Diana’s IJspaleis, made possible by Zwanenburg. Distances for children, adults and walkers; registration until 11 April 2027; start and finish at IKC Middelsee; participants can enjoy an ice cream after the event.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Stockholm, with races for all ages. These include a Mini Race for the youngest participants, Lilla Skärholmsloppet for children in preschool class through grade 6, a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The event is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that supports young people in disadvantaged suburbs through personal development using running. The day features music and entertainment, with DJs along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, encouraging running experience that promotes physical activity and health equity.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up
Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approximately 1.6 km, for children in preschool class through grade 6
500-metre Mini Race for children aged 0–6, with the option to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Start times: Mini Race at 10:30; Lilla Skärholmsloppet from 11:30 in different age-group waves; 1.6 km Fun Run at 12:25; 5 km race at 13:00. All participants receive a medal and refreshments at the finish. Registration is free and open until 14 May at 17:00. Late registration may be available at bib collection and on race day, subject to availability. Music and DJs along the course provide extra encouragement. The event takes place at Puckelbollplanen in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a medal after finishing.

name: Singelloop Leiden
description: The Singelloop Leiden is an atmospheric running event held annually in the centre of Leiden. The race starts and finishes at Lammermarkt, near Molen de Valk, and takes participants along a challenging route beside Leiden’s canals. At approximately 6.5 kilometres, it is an accessible race for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. It is organised by Stichting Singelloop Leiden, which continues the city’s long tradition of sport and community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lammermarkt, next to Molen de Valk
Route of approximately 6.5 km along Leiden’s canals and historic bridges
Run counter-clockwise via Valkbrug, Rijnsburgersingel, Morspoort and Witte Singel
additional: Race numbers are available from various advance-sale outlets from 20 March to 15 April for 7.50 euros. On race day (16 April), a race number costs 8.50 euros and is available at petit-restaurant De Valk. After the race, participants receive a medal upon presenting their race number. The race is held over a route of approximately 6.5 to 7 km, with registration available via the website. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 16 April at 19:30.

name: Krogsereds Trail Run
location: Krogsereds, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdom (upp till 14 år): 50 kr

description: Krogsereds Trail Run is a scenic trail race organized by Krogsereds Idrottsklubb, offering a fantastic running experience with distances for all ages. The race follows the beautiful hiking trails around Lyngsjön and offers categories ranging from children’s races to the 10 km main race. It is a family-friendly event, with start times spread throughout the morning and prizes raffled among participants.
course_highlights: Scenic hiking trails around Lyngsjön
Several distances suitable for children, young people, and adults
Varied terrain through woodland
additional: Start times: Children 10:00, Youth 10:10, Junior 10:30, Recreational 10:30, Main race 10:30. There are no shower facilities on site. Prizes are raffled among participants. It is recommended that participants arrive at least 30 minutes before their start. Trail running on natural terrain around Lyngsjön; registration via Google Forms; no shower facilities. The race is scheduled from 09:00 to 14:00 on 24 April 2027.

name: Premiärloppet
description: Premiärloppet is a running event organized by Sävedalens AIK Friidrott at Skatås Motionscentral in Gothenburg. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km, both of which feature gently hilly terrain with gravel surfaces and sections of trail. There is a water station at 6 km with water and sports drink from Umara. All participants receive a medal and great prizes from Löplabbet, and race bibs are collected on race day.
course_highlights: 10 km: gently hilly course on gravel
5 km: gently hilly course with a downhill trail section at Brudaremossen
Refreshments at 6 km and at the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day between 10:00 and 13:15 at the start/finish area in Skatås. Changing rooms for women and men are available next to the event area. Results are published at saik.nu and sent to Friidrottsstatistik. Changing rooms are available next to the event area. Refreshments are offered along the 10 km course and at the finish. All participants receive a medal.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
price_range: 750 kr för vuxna; 400 kr för 13 år och yngre (angivna priser för 2026)
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon in which participants run a 6,706-metre loop on the Stensö exercise trail. The race starts at 10:00, with a new start every hour on the hour. To continue, runners must complete a lap within one hour. The winner is the person who completes the most laps, making the race an exciting, tactical challenge for ultrarunners of all levels.
course_highlights: Flat, gravel-surfaced trail on the Stensö exercise trail
The course is clearly marked with red-and-white ribbons and arrows
In the evening and at night, the course follows only the floodlit trail
additional: The original Backyard Ultra format: each lap must be completed within one hour, with the next start on the hour. The 6,706 m loop is on the Stensö exercise trail (gravel-surfaced trail). 24 laps equal 100 miles. Organiser: Högby IF. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02.

images.alt_text: Kalmar Backyard Ultra-logotyp.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt 300 Marathon in Hultsfred is a welcoming and inclusive race celebrating Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The event offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a scenic 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, combining park paths and asphalt. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned, with timing and refreshment stations along the route. After the race, participants are invited to a social gathering with food and good company near the start and finish area.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, with the final lap 3 km shorter
20% of the course is asphalt; the rest is park paths
Two refreshment stations with water, sports drink, cola and energy supplies, at the lap point and at 4 km
additional: Start and finish at the entrance to Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bibs are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to finish in over 5 hours start at 09:00. After the race, a social gathering with food and good company is planned for around 14:30, about 1 km from Knektavallen. Start and finish at Knektavallen. The official club announcement applies to 2026 and lists prices for the marathon and half marathon; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Amerongse Koploop
distance_verbose: 25 km, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 0.75 km
description: The Amerongse Koploop is a friendly and challenging trail run through the forests of Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park, between Amerongen and Leersum. The event offers several distances for both children and adults, including kids’ runs, trail runs and hiking routes. A portion of the entry fee goes towards nature conservation, and participants receive a voucher for local refreshments. After the event, all participants receive a sustainable medal, and there is a lively square at the start and finish where they can relax and enjoy the atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail through the forests of Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park
Distances ranging from 750 metres for children to a 25 km trail run
A lively square with local specialities and an included refreshment voucher
additional: Pre-registration closes on Thursday 16 April. On-the-day registration is possible, with an additional administration fee payable at the registration desk. Race numbers can be collected in advance on Friday evening. Timing is electronic; there is no rush at the start. Trail and walking distances vary; registration is available in advance and on the day. The location is Nuytgroep, Amerongen. Local refreshments include beer, coffee and fries. Medal and electronic timing.

name: Pop up Run Kinnekulle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår

description: Pop up Run Kinnekulle is a trail-running adventure that takes you out into exciting natural surroundings and new experiences. The race offers a fairytale-like run through beech forests, past small lakes and historical sites such as Bexell’s Talking Stones. After the run, a locally produced picnic awaits to round things off. The event is open to runners of different paces and recommends carpooling for participants.
course_highlights: Run through the beech forests of Kinnekulle
Pass small, charming lakes and Bexell’s Talking Stones
Finish with a picnic at a locally producing farm
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Fårfarm. The distance is approximately 15–17 km, with 2–3 different pace groups. A picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café is included in the price. Carpooling is recommended, and help coordinating rides is offered. The event is designed to provide a welcoming, nature-focused running experience centred on nature, views and local food.

name: Ruhrseen Halbmarathon
description:
On April 18, 2027, a running event awaits you that perfectly combines nature, emotion, and a sporting challenge. Set off from the idyllic Hengsteysee, run alongside sparkling waters and the majestic Ruhrsteilhänge cliffs, and through peaceful woodland sections—a course that will challenge and inspire you at the same time.

Whether you choose the half marathon or 10 km, this run is your moment. Your experience. Your spring highlight. Secure your place at the starting line now and be part of an unforgettable day at Hagen’s Hengsteysee!
additional:
A great race pack awaits you:

Race materials sent by post

High-quality finisher’s medal

3 course refreshment stations

3 toilet stations along the course

A generous finish-line refreshment area

Showers at the outdoor swimming pool

Lockers on site

After-party immediately after the run
