name: Sportpark 21 Run
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.1 km, 0.7 km, 0.5 km

name: Cascaderun
description: The Hoogeveense Cascaderun is an annual running race in the centre of Hoogeveen, known as the biggest and best run in Drenthe. The race offers a flat, fast course over 5 and 10 miles, ideal both for running a fast time and for a first race experience. With thousands of enthusiastic runners, plenty of spectators, live music along the route and an iconic finish on Hoofdstraat, it is an atmospheric event for all levels. There are also special events, including the DuoRun, UNICEF Children’s Run and Giga-G for athletes with a disability.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through the centre of Hoogeveen
Officially measured 5- and 10-mile races with plenty of spectators
Iconic finish on Hoofdstraat, with live music and refreshments
additional: Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 10 April 2027 from 09:00 to 16:00 at Het Klooster, and on Sunday 18 April 2027 from 10:00 to 12:30 at De Tamboer. Official chip timing, refreshments along the route and after the finish, and professional finish photos are available to download free of charge. The Cascaderun awards a medal once every 5 years; the next time will be in 2028. Start areas are on Raadhuisplein and are indicated by letters on the race number. There are separate desks for the 5-mile race, 10-mile race and UNICEF Children’s Run. There are water stations along the route (5-mile race: 5 stations; 10-mile race: 7 stations) and toilets at the start and along the route. The first few kilometres can be crowded; runners are advised to keep right and pass on the left. Registration opens in November 2026, start areas on Raadhuisplein, water stations and refreshments along the route, official timing, festive afterparty

name: PCC Maalwater Run
description: The PCC Maalwater Run and Walk in Heiloo offers a varied running and walking programme with distances for all ages. The start and finish are at the PCC and Trias grounds, where there is also an inflatable play castle for children. By taking part, you support Sport@School, a SportRaad Heiloo project that makes sports lessons at primary schools possible. The event is open to both recreational walkers and runners, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the PCC and Trias grounds
Distances range from 1 km to 16 km for walking and running
Inflatable play castle for children in the middle of the athletics track
additional: Children can play on an inflatable play castle under supervision during the event. Participants support Sport@School, a SportRaad Heiloo project that makes sports lessons at primary schools possible. Start and finish at the PCC and Trias grounds in Heiloo, with activities for the whole family.

name: Wetter- en Wille Run
location: Wetter- en Willepark, Burgum, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Wetter- en Willerun is a race through and around the beautiful Wetter- en Willepark in Burgum, with distances of 5 km and 10.5 km (quarter marathon). The event attracts enthusiastic runners and supports a local charity, with proceeds benefiting the community and promoting a healthy lifestyle. Alongside the races, there is also an ‘eleven cities’ sponsored tour and a new 25 km route. The event is known for its scenic course and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful Wetter- en Willepark in Burgum
Distances of 5 km, 10.5 km (quarter marathon), and a new 25 km course
Includes an ‘eleven cities’ sponsored tour before the race
additional: Proceeds from the race go to a local charity. A new 25 km distance has been added. The race is an annual event with a large group of enthusiastic participants and has sold out in previous years. Routes of 5 km and 10.5 km, an ‘eleven cities’ sponsored tour, proceeds go to local charities, held in Wetter- en Willepark.

name: Ride & Roast
location: Fort aan de Klop, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: Run & Roast Utrecht is an atmospheric running event held at Fort aan de Klop. Participants can choose a 5 or 10 kilometre route, which is flat and fast, with a finish at a beautiful location. After the race, there’s a relaxed get-together with music, drinks and a delicious plant-based Beyond Meat burger—ideal for a quick recovery. There’s also a 1-kilometre kids’ run for the youngest runners. The event combines sport with a summery, laid-back atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat, fast loop finishing at Fort aan de Klop
Beautiful location on an island in northern Utrecht
Kids’ run of approximately 1 kilometre for children up to and including 12 years old
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 13:15 on race day or in advance between 13 and 16 April at All4running Store Utrecht. There is no supervised cloakroom; bicycles can be parked in a temporary bike storage area. Chip timing is provided via the race number, which can be recycled after use. There is an awards ceremony for the kids’ run and the main distances. After the race, a plant-based Beyond Meat burger and drinks will be available. Partners include All4running, Karhu, Virtuoos supplements, Shokz headphones and Runbites sports nutrition. Flat course, registration in advance and on the day, post-race food and drinks, kids’ run, prizes for winners, discount offers for participants.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race starting, with exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four each run a fast-paced four-kilometre leg. The event offers a wonderful team atmosphere, with men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course stays close to the event centre, with upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish. It’s an evening filled with exercise, community and joy, where children and young people can take part for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on a fast-paced course close to the event centre
Upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish
additional: Leg massages are offered by Helhetshälsan both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes go to the first team in each category, and great prizes are drawn among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides participants with energy-packed products after the finish. The race takes place in Folkparken, with on-site late registration available; participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-packed products after the race.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances through central Västerås, with the start and finish at Lögastrand. The event celebrates the joy of being active and a sense of community, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition. Participants can register individually or as a team; registered teams receive a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive setting for exercise and socialising.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Livli Shopping Centre Erikslund in the days before the race. The event area has supervised bag drop, a water station and toilets. Picnics can be collected using the team leader’s race bib. Recommended ages are 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Training meetups are organised in several locations ahead of the race. Participants receive a race bib, a finish-line bag and a medal; teams consist of 5 people. The event is open to runners, joggers and walkers. Registration is online. The event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Stallbackamilen 2026
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Vänersborgs AIK
description: Stallbackamilen in Trollhättan is a fast 10 km race that debuted on 21 April 2026. The course is officially measured and runs along fast cycle paths around Stallbacka, on a 3.3 km loop completed three times. The start and finish are next to the tennis hall. The race is organised by Vänersborgs AIK and Trollhättans IF Friidrott, and pacers are available from 35 to 60 minutes to help runners at different paces.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km course on fast cycle paths
3.3 km loop completed three times
Start and finish next to the tennis hall in Trollhättan
additional: Pacers are available for finish times from 35 to 60 minutes. You can also register for Digitala Varvetmilen to get a seeding time for Göteborgsvarvet. The start and finish are next to the tennis hall in Trollhättan. Pacers are available for finish times from 35 to 60 minutes.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging 5 km trail race with 300 metres of elevation gain in beautiful, technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course features lovely trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The race starts at the old football field and includes steep hills, singletrack and scenic views over Lake Ågelsjön. Welcome to this somewhat classic race, which offers a serious challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 metres of elevation gain in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep hills
Beautiful views over Lake Ågelsjön and a passage past the hermit’s Jakobs Cave
additional: The race starts at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, along with raffle prizes. A ball field is located 200 metres from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are available as add-ons. The course’s technical sections include “Koklämman,” with a rope to help runners climb, and the race passes a cosy barbecue area beneath a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk; the course description includes hills and trail sections.

name: Mûzelloop Jirnsum
description: The Mûzelloop Jirnsum is a friendly running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the small river Mûzel in Jirnsum. The routes pass historical and natural landmarks, including the old lower course of the Boarn River and the Sneker Oudvaart. The race offers several distances, including a kids’ run and distances of 5, 8.3 and 10 km, with aid stations along the way. The event is organized by a foundation with the help of volunteers and sponsors. It has a warm local atmosphere, with prizes for the top finishers and special trophies for the best Jirnsummers.
course_highlights: Routes along the small river Mûzel and the old lower course of the Boarn River
Aid stations on the 8.3 and 10 km routes; refreshments at the finish for the 5 km
Historic surroundings, including the Jirnsummersyl lock and a connection to the Sneker Oudvaart
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 18:00 in the large hall of the 2 Gemeenten. No showers are available. Ample parking is available nearby at the 2 Gemeenten, opposite the transmission tower on Rijksweg. The routes are marked with arrow signs and chalk arrows, and traffic marshals are stationed at key points. All children receive a memento. Prizes are awarded to first, second and third place in each distance, with special trophies for the best Jirnsummers. The event is limited to 300 participants, and online advance registration is the only way to enter. The event takes place in April 2027, with distances for children and adults, in a beautiful natural setting for runners.

name: Rondje Vrachelen
location: Atletiekbaan ATV Scorpio, Vrachelen, Oosterhout, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Rondje Vrachelen is a friendly and sporty evening run in the natural surroundings of Oosterhout, starting and finishing on the athletics track at ATV Scorpio. Participants run a varied course with both paved and unpaved paths through the beautiful Vrachelen area. The run is suitable for recreational and competitive runners, with two distances of 6 km and 10 km. Facilities such as changing rooms, showers and first aid are available, and there is ample parking nearby.
course_highlights: A varied course with paved and unpaved paths
Start and finish on the athletics track at ATV Scorpio
Run through the natural surroundings of Vrachelen in Oosterhout
additional: Registration is open from 1 December 2026 until half an hour before the race starts, online only. There is ample parking at Zwembad de Warande and football club TSC. Shower facilities are available after the run. An AED is available for emergencies. Participation is at your own risk. Registration opens on 1 December 2026, the start time is 19:30, and the event takes place near Wilhelminakanaal Zuid 78, Oosterhout.

name: Skrylleloppet
description: Skrylleloppet is a trail race organized by Björnstorps IF at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. Races are offered over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, with the 3 km race also having recreational categories for men and women. The courses follow Skryllegården’s fitness trails through varied woodland terrain on gravel surfaces. Skrylleloppet is a welcoming race with professional timing and results reporting, and also serves as a qualifying race for the TCS Lidingöloppet.
course_highlights: Trail race on varied woodland trails
Gravel surfaces on fitness trails
The 10 km race offers the opportunity to qualify for the TCS Lidingöloppet
additional: Registration is available online until 30 minutes before the start. On race day, participants can also register on site and make a name or category change for an administrative fee of 100 kr; payment is by Swish only. Bib numbers are sent by email during race week and can also be collected from Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race. Participants who cycle to the race can enter a prize draw at the awards ceremony at 11:30. Parking is limited, so carpooling is recommended.

name: Skälbyloppet
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly race through the scenic surroundings of Skälby Gård in Kalmar. The event offers several distances, from short 600-metre youth races to 8 km for adults, on routes featuring lovely park paths, gravel, asphalt and trail. It’s a perfect race to kick off the running season, with water available on the lap and at the finish. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal as a memento.
course_highlights: The course runs on gravel and park paths, with a short section on asphalt and some trail.
Water is available on the lap of the long course and at the finish.
The 4 km and 8 km courses are one and two laps respectively, crossing the bridge.
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Skälby loge on race day from 8:30 a.m. Youth races start from 10:00 a.m.; adult men’s and women’s races start at 11:00 a.m. New: a 4 km untimed walking category. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Information about previous editions also lists a 4 km untimed walking category. All finishers receive a medal. The published information applies to the 2026 race and does not confirm the date of 24 April 2027.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
location: Olshammar, Askersund Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 550:-  för individuell start inkl. hyra för SI-pinne.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 900:- för ett lag inkl. hyra för SI-pinne.

description: Munkastigen Trailrun is an ultramarathon through the enchanted forests of Tiveden, from Olshammar on the shore of Lake Vättern to Laxå. The race follows a historic trail used by monks in the 15th century and offers challenging, scenic terrain. A new course is planned for 2027, with a longer distance of approximately 53 km for the Swedish Championship categories. The course is well marked, and participants receive a map to minimize the risk of taking a wrong turn.
course_highlights: Historic trail used by monks in the 15th century
Enchanted forest landscape in Tiveden
Well-marked course with two aid stations
additional: Bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee for individual starters. For teams, transport is included for the first runner. Timing is recorded using SportIdent every 10 km. Participants receive a plaque and are served a hot meal after finishing. Teams can consist of 2–5 runners, with exchanges permitted anywhere along the course. The regular race can be completed individually or in teams of 2–5 runners. There are two aid stations, and bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee. Finishers receive a plaque and a hot meal after finishing. The organizer’s website contains maps, an elevation profile, and a GPX file.

name: Retrovarvet 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: När du fått en plats bekräftar önskvärt din anmälan, senast under löpdagen, med 100 kr som du donerar till årets utvalda välgörenhet

description: Retrovarvet is an annual run that follows the Göteborgsvarvet’s inaugural 1980 course. It is a 21.1 km training run that has been held since 2008. It is not a race, but a social group training session focused on enjoyment, experience and charity. The event is volunteer-run and aims to support children in need. This year’s fundraiser is for Ågrenska and its work with families and children with rare diagnoses. The start and finish are at Heden in Göteborg, and the run takes approximately 2 hours and 15 minutes at a pace of around 6:30 min/km.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km course following the Göteborgsvarvet’s inaugural 1980 course
Start and finish at Heden, Göteborg
A group training session focused on social connection and experience
additional: Maximum 750 participants. The event is a training session, not a race, and participation is at your own risk. Runners are asked to follow laws and regulations, never run ahead of the pacer, and stay on sidewalks. Pace: approximately 6:30 min/km; the run takes approximately 2 hours and 15 minutes. Register by emailing premiarbanan1980@gmail.com with your name and email address. For 2026, participants are asked to gather at Heden at 07:45 and register via premiarbanan1980@gmail.com. The website states that participation is limited to 750; the registration details apply to the 2026 event.

name: VXO Ultrafest
description: VXO Ultrafest is an ultrarunning festival and Swedish Championships organized by Växjö Löparklubb in collaboration with the Swedish Athletics Association. The event takes place on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö and offers several championship distances, including 24-hour running and 100 km. The course is flat and consists mainly of asphalt with some gravel sections, making it fast and spectator-friendly. Both runners and walkers are welcome for a weekend of challenge and community.
course_highlights: Flat loop course of approximately 820 meters on asphalt and gravel
Approximately 3.2 km loop around Lake Trummen on asphalt and gravel
Event area on open grassy spaces on the southern shore of Lake Trummen
additional: The pre-race dinner is held on Friday, April 24. Lap counting takes place at the arena, where there is room for the organizer's tents and participants' own tents. The women's SM half-marathon walk starts at 10:00. The VXO24h course is approximately 820 m, while the courses for VXO100k and the SM 42 km and 21 km walking events are approximately 3.2 km around Lake Trummen. The organizer's website states that VXO Ultrafest is taking a break after five years; no event in 2027 has been confirmed.

description: Lerumsloppet is a community celebration and running race organised by the non-profit association Lerum Friidrott, with any surplus going back to its youth activities. The event offers several distances, from 250 metres up to 10 kilometres, and is a popular spring goal for runners of all ages. The start and finish are at Bagges Torg in Lerum, and the event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good service and great prizes. Lerumsloppet is an annual tradition that attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Long course – 10 km
Short course – 5.1 km
Little Lerum Race – 3.3 km
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday evening from 16:00 to 19:00 at the former Elgiganten premises by Bagges Torg, or on race day from 09:30 at the race-bib tent. All courses start at Brobacken next to Bagges Torg, except for Lerum Energiloppet, which starts at Bagges Torg. Water stations are located at Vattenpalatset and at the 5.5 km mark on the 10 km course. Changing rooms, showers and secure storage are available near the event centre in cooperation with Actic Vattenpalatset. Cycling, taking public transport or carpooling is recommended because of limited parking and the large crowds. Around 55 course marshals and guides are stationed along the course. Information about start times, parking, changing facilities, race bibs and results is available on the event website. Registration is via EQ Timing; a club discount and transfer of entry are mentioned for 2025.

Night Run Wageningen

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Night Run Wageningen is an atmospheric running event held in the centre of Wageningen, with the start and finish on the Markt. Participants run in the dark under atmospheric lighting and take on the challenging Wageningse Berg via the Holleweg. There are several distances, including a kids’ run, a 5 km run and an adventurous 10 km run. Beginners can take a Start to Run course that culminates in taking part in the 5 km. The event is open to all ages and levels and offers a fun, sporty evening in Wageningen.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Markt in the centre of Wageningen
Climb the Wageningse Berg via the Holleweg
Atmospheric lighting while running in the dark
additional: Kids’ run start times: 500 m at 19:15 (ages 3–7), 1,000 m at 19:30 (up to and including age 12). The 5K starts at 20:00, and the 10K starts at 21:00. Limited race-day registration may be available at the Grote Kerk on the Markt; participants will not receive a personalised race number. Awards ceremonies for all distances take place after the event. Registration usually opens around December for the following year, with options for early registration and late registration on site at the Grote Kerk.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Bålsta Stadslopp is a fast and enjoyable spring race held in central Bålsta, starting and finishing at Gröna Dalens IP. The race has grown steadily since it began in 2019 and is known as a PB course, where many runners beat their previous records. The course is a 5 km loop that can be run once or twice, with 99% asphalt and a finish on an athletics track. The event is marked by speed, joy and community, and welcomes runners of all ages and categories.
course_highlights: 5 km loop in central Bålsta, finishing at Gröna Dalens IP
99% asphalt, with a finish on an athletics track
Fast course with a small incline removed to make even faster times possible
additional: Bib collection starts at 08:00 outside Gröna Dalens IP. Start times are 09:30 for 5 km and 10:45 for 10 km. Runners self-seed at the start to reduce congestion. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the start, subject to availability. There is a bag drop and limited changing facilities. Take the commuter train to Bålsta station, within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking areas are nearby. Badhusvägen is closed to traffic on race day. Registration is open. The sports drink served in the cups is Umara U Sport Lemon.

name: Landsjön runt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km GRATIS

description: Landsjön Runt is a traditional road race organized by IK Vista since 1982 in Kaxholmen, outside Huskvarna. The event offers several distances for the whole family, from a children’s race and obstacle course to 5.5 km and 12.5 km in scenic surroundings around the lake. The start and finish are at Vistavallen, and the course runs clockwise around the lake, with the climbs in the first half. Participants can enjoy music and refreshments along the way for a great running experience. There are also team competitions and awards for youth and Fun Run participants.
course_highlights: The course runs clockwise around Landsjön, with climbs in the first half
The start is on the grass field and the finish is on the running track at Vistavallen
Scenic surroundings, with the course running beside the waters of Landsjön
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Vistavallen on the Saturday before the event, between 14:00 and 16:00. IK Vista members can participate for free if they register by 18/4. A team competition for teams of four is available for the 5.5 km and 12.5 km races. Each team’s total time is recorded, and teams receive a bag of treats. The children’s race for ages 0–6, approximately 500 m, starts at 12:00. The Vista FUN RUN obstacle course, approximately 1 km, starts at 12:20, with an awards ceremony afterward. Recommended parking is at Vistavallen or Hunnerydsbadet; use of public transport is encouraged. The race has been held annually since 1982.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://landsjonrunt.se/): 2027-04-25 — "25 April 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-25)

name: Orion Trail
description: Orion Trail is a beautiful running race in the scenic Ådalen valley in Jämjö, outside Karlskrona, where participants run along trails beside a winding stream. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-road sections, gravel roads and asphalt, as well as a waterfall and a sea of wood anemones. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km race consists of two laps of the course. The youngest participants can take part in a 500- or 1,000-metre children’s race. All participants receive a medal, a drink and a bun, and showers and refreshments are available at the finish. Orion Trail is part of Oriondagen, a family-friendly day with activities in nature.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5,000 metres long, including 3,700 metres of trails and off-road terrain
The route follows the scenic Ådalen valley beside a winding stream and a waterfall
The children’s race is 500 or 1,000 metres, with the option of running one or two laps
additional: The start and finish are at Orionstugan in Jämjö, with parking in the designated area. Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 on race day. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, a drink and a bun. Showers and changing facilities are available. Refreshments, including grilled sausages, hamburgers, cakes and coffee, are on offer. Entries can be made on site up to 30 minutes before the start. Oriondagen runs from 10:00 to 13:00 and includes several family activities, with drop-in participation. Start times: 5 km and 10 km at 10:30; children’s race at 12:00. The race can be completed by running or walking.

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
description: Strömsnäs Trailrun is a lovely trail race held in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd. The races mainly follow trails and forest roads, with some off-trail terrain, offering a nature-rich and challenging running experience. The event is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and welcomes runners in various classes, with honorary prizes and medals for everyone who finishes. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk, and the organiser, SK Graal, looks forward to welcoming participants for a great day in their running shoes.
course_highlights: Run on trails, forest roads and off-trail terrain
Scenic forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd
Start and finish at Graalstugan
additional: The start and finish are at Graalstugan. Timing is electronic, using a chip attached to the race bib, which must be returned at the finish. The prize-giving ceremony is at approximately 12:30, with honorary prizes for places 1–3 in each class and prizes awarded by draw. All finishers receive a medal. Changing rooms and showers are available, with limited space. There is a cafeteria near the finish area. Late registration is available on race day from 09:30 until 30 minutes before the start, with an additional fee of 60 SEK. Clubs may be invoiced when registering more than three participants. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk. Timing is electronic, and finishers receive a medal according to the 2026 information; the 2027 terms have not yet been confirmed.

name: Trollhättan 5k
description: Welcome to Trollhättan 5K, a fast, officially measured race being held for the fifth time. The course is designed to attract runners looking to run a fast 5K, either as preparation for longer races or to beat their personal best. The course record is already impressive, and it will be exciting to see if it can be broken this year. The race offers a fast course in Trollhättan with great opportunities for good times.
course_highlights: Officially measured, fast 5K course
Suitable as preparation for longer races
Opportunity to break the course record

name: Wolfsburg Run powered by VfL Wolfsburg e.V.
Koningsloop Beilen

description: The Koningsloop Beilen is a friendly running event organized by Loopgroep Beilen, suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from a Minirun for the youngest participants to 5 km and 10 km for adults. The event takes place in Beilen and offers a sporty, festive atmosphere, with medals for younger participants and trophies and prize packages for the top runners. Timing is automatic, using a chip attached to the race bib. Changing rooms and showers are available at Vitesse. Parking is available close to the start, and registration is open until 15 minutes before the start of each distance.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 200 m Minirun to 10 km for adults
Timing with a chip attached to the race bib
Start and facilities near Drenthehal and Vitesse sports park
additional: Registration is open until 15 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. Participants in the Minirun, Kidsrun, and Jeugdloop receive a commemorative medal. The first three men and women in the 5 km and 10 km events receive a trophy and a prize package. Race bibs have a chip and do not need to be returned. Pins are available when registering. Showers and changing facilities are available at Vitesse. Parking is available at Drenthehal and Sportpark Noord-West. The organizers accept no liability for lost clothing. Course: urban route with start and finish in Beilen; registration until 25 April 2025; timing by RaceResult; parking at Drenthehal and Sportpark Noord-West.

name: Koningsloop Hasselt
description: The Koningsloop Hasselt is an annual running event held in the centre of Hasselt. The event offers various distances, including 5 and 10 km for adults and juniors, a Bambino Run for the very youngest, a Kids Run and a Heroes Run. The course passes through picturesque central Hasselt, with lovely views, including along the mill and across the Stenendijk. The Koningsloop is known as a sporting orange-themed celebration where people of all ages come together for an enjoyable and challenging running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the centre of Hasselt
Course passes the mill and crosses the Stenendijk, with beautiful views
Fast 10 km with a second lap on the same course
additional: Adults and juniors run the same course and start at the same time. All participants receive a memento, and participants in the Heroes Run receive a trophy. Changing rooms and bag drop-off are available. The finish is at Burgemeester Royerplein via Justitie Bastion. Young people train on Thursday evenings; adults train on Wednesday evenings. Event photos are available and can be removed on request by email. Registration is via inschrijven.nl; the course starts and finishes in central Hasselt; parking is available at Gemeentehuis Zwartewaterland.

name: Värmlandsstafetten

description: The Värmland Relay in Karlstad is a relay race where teams of 5–15 participants compete together on a flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres long. All teams start and finish at the same time and have two hours to carry the relay baton as far as possible, changing runners after each lap. The relay is open to everyone, and teams can be mixed freely, creating a fun, social competition that promotes community and health. There is an awards ceremony after the race, and light refreshments are available on site. First-time participants buy a team baton featuring their team logo, which is used at every competition.
course_highlights: Flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres per lap
Asphalt surface
Runners change over with the relay baton in the exchange zone by the arena
additional: Each team must buy a baton featuring its team logo in its first year, for 500:-. After the race, results can be engraved on the baton for a fee. Team leaders collect race bibs, chips and the baton at the arena. Paid parking is available at Sundstabadet. Changing rooms and showers are available at Idrottshuset. The card-payment refreshments stand opens at 16:30. Medical services and toilets are available at the arena. Teams may bring their own tents and beach flags to decorate the arena. Teams consist of 5–15 participants. Runners change after each lap, and the same person may not run multiple laps in a row. The baton costs 500 kr in the first year (750 kr for late registration).

name: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar 15-17 km

description: Pop up Run Åkulla Beech Forests is a magical spring trail run in Åkulla, where the greenery is in full bloom and nature is teeming with life. The race offers a fairytale-like run past charming little lakes, Bexell’s Talking Stones, and through the beautiful beech forest. With a distance of 15–17 km and several pace groups, it suits both experienced and recreational runners looking to make memories for life. After the race, there is an opportunity to have lunch together at Öströö Sheep Farm.
course_highlights: Run through Åkulla’s beech forest
Pass charming little lakes
Pass Bexell’s Talking Stones
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Sheep Farm. There are 2–3 different pace groups. Carpooling is recommended, and help coordinating it is available. After the race, there is an opportunity to have lunch together at Öströö Sheep Farm, at participants’ own expense. Meeting at 10:00 at Öströö Sheep Farm. Lunch afterwards is optional and paid for by participants. The organizer recommends carpooling and can help coordinate it.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Winter Bay Backyard Ultra in Trosa is a unique ultramarathon where participants run laps on a 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River. Each lap must be completed within an hour to continue, and the race goes on until only one runner remains. The course is easy and flat, making it suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and enthusiasts. Sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches and food are provided during the race. There is also a team competition and a children’s race, Mini-TUB. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary with extra-special medals and prizes for the top three in the men’s and women’s categories.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to ultrarunning
Mini-TUB children’s race with its own course and medals
additional: Each participant in the main race receives a free silicone cup from Umara when collecting their race number. Umara sports drinks, fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen and food from Trosa Stadshotell are served during the race. Sandwiches and sweets are offered at each lap. There is a team competition in which the three best results from each club are counted, with prize money for the winning team. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 and is open to children born in 2017 or later. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. The race is fully booked. There is a team competition and a Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later. Tent space can be arranged in consultation with race officials; a limited number of motorhome spaces are available, but there is no electricity. Caravans are not accepted.

name: Hallandsloppet Trail
location: Gurkbänken, Vessigebro, Falkenberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Hallandsloppet Trail is a scenic trail-running race that takes you on a unique journey through Ätradalen, with views of the Ätran, birdsong and lush deciduous forest. The race is held in central Vessigebro at Gurkbänken and offers 5 km and 10 km classes, for runners both with and without dogs. It’s a perfect race for anyone who wants to experience Halland’s beautiful nature in a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A unique journey through Ätradalen
Views of the Ätran and birdsong
Runs through lush deciduous forest
additional: Classes are available for runners both with and without dogs. The race is held at Gurkbänken in central Vessigebro. The start and finish are at Gurkbänken in central Vessigebro. The published race information applies to 2 May 2026 and does not confirm the date of 1 May 2027.

name: Sevede Trail Run
location: Mariannelund, Eksjö Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Sevede Trail Run is organized by Hässleby Ski and Orienteering Club in Mariannelund and offers a challenging, scenic trail run. The race attracts runners of all ages and levels and takes place in beautiful woodland with varied terrain. It is a much-loved tradition that brings together participants and spectators for a wonderful day outdoors.
course_highlights: Trail running in woodland
Varied terrain with trails and forest roads
Scenic views around Mariannelund

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a unique ultrarun held in central Trosa on an easy, flat 6.7 km course, mostly along the Trosa River. The aim is to complete as many laps as possible, with one hour allowed per lap. Participants can start again every hour if they have completed the lap. It is a festive, social race with prize money, a team competition and prize draws during the event. Children can take part in Mini-TUB, with its own course and attractive medals. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches and food from local sponsors are served during the race.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to completing multiple laps
700 m Mini-TUB children’s course that follows the main course
additional: Start time: 10:00 on 1 May 2027. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 the same day. Umara sports drink and fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen are served during the race. Participants receive a free Umara silicone cup at bib collection. Food from Trosa Stadshotell, sandwiches and sweets are provided at each lap checkpoint. In the team competition, the three best results from each club count. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. No plastic cups are used, for environmental reasons. The 2027 race starts on 1 May at 10:00 and is sold out. The team competition counts the three best results per club. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches, sweets and food are served during the race. Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later starts at 14:15.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Ekoparken vid Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a scenic trail race that winds through the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the arrival of spring in a beautiful setting rich in wildlife. The event welcomes both families with children and adults who want to combine running with nature experiences. Nordens Ark is a non-profit foundation that works to protect endangered animals and their habitats, giving the race an especially meaningful purpose.
course_highlights: The courses run through the Eco Park and its scenic surroundings
Run in a beautiful, wildlife-rich setting by Åbyfjorden
Trail running suitable for families with children and adults
additional: The 2026 edition of Nordens Ark TrailRun has been cancelled. The park is cashless; payment is by card or Swish. The park has a café and food outlets during the peak season. The park is open daily, with opening hours varying by season.

description: The AH Abe Hunebedloop is an atmospheric running race organised by AV de Sprinter, held in the beautiful surroundings of Havelte. The course runs mostly along paved paths and passes special sights such as the hunebeds, burial mounds and sheepfold. The start and finish are at Toegangspoort Holtingerveld, which also has facilities including changing rooms and toilets. The race offers several distances and categories, suitable for a range of ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Mostly paved paths through the Havelte nature area
Past the hunebeds and burial mounds
Start and finish at the sheepfold (Toegangspoort Holtingerveld)
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 10:00 at the start/finish. Water and fruit are available after the race. Changing facilities are in the Lammerenkooi of the sheepfold. Registration is open until one hour before the start or until the maximum of 750 participants is reached. Late registration opens on 11 January 2027 and costs an additional € 2,00. Registration via inschrijven.nl; start and finish at Toegangspoort Holtingerveld; maximum 750 participants; part of the Univéloopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a popular running event that welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners and families to run through beautiful Swedish countryside along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km race and a 5 km recreational race. It is marked by a strong sense of community and scenic views along the canal. Kanallöpet is organised by Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna, and is a tradition that returns every spring.
course_highlights: Run along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Half marathon, 10 km and 5 km recreational races
Beautiful Swedish countryside and scenic views
additional: The event has competitive and recreational categories, as well as family-friendly distances. The organising clubs are Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna. Participants receive medals, although medal deliveries may sometimes be delayed. For the 2025 race, buses are reported to be arranged from Borensberg to the starting locations. Competitive categories require membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is a running event organized by Säters IF FIK, offering half-marathon and 10 km distances. The full marathon has been held in the past but is currently closed to late entries due to low participation. The event is a welcome opportunity for runners of different levels to challenge themselves in a beautiful setting in Säter. Säters IF FIK is an active athletics club with dedicated leaders and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10 km distances are offered
The event takes place in Säter, surrounded by scenic landscapes
Organized by Säters IF FIK, a club with a long tradition in athletics
additional: Late entry for the full marathon is closed due to low participation. Registration for the half-marathon and 10 km remains open as usual. The organizer publishes the invitation, course route, race information, schedule, start list, and results on the club's website.

name: Sparkassenlauf und Wandertag TuS Bergen von 1867 e.V.
Charity-Lauf des PSV Grün-Weiß Kassel e. V.
Vårruset (Halmstad)
location: Civila flygfältet vid Aleskogen, Halmstad, Sweden
organizer: Marathongruppen i samarbete med Halmstad OK och andra idrottsklubbar
description: Vårruset in Halmstad is a spring-themed fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in the scenic Alet Nature Reserve, by the Civil Airfield at Aleskogen. The event is open to everyone. The recommended minimum age is 7 for the shorter distance when accompanied by an adult, and 11 for the 5 km. Participants receive a medal, a finish-line goodie bag and a race bib, with timing available for the 5 km. Teams that register are offered a shared picnic after the finish, making for a pleasant social gathering. Race bibs are distributed in advance at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden to avoid queues on race day.
course_highlights: The route goes through Alet Nature Reserve/Skepparegatan
Certified 5 km course
Event area at the Civil Airfield by Aleskogen
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden in the days before the race. Teams of 5 are offered a picnic after the finish. There is a water station and toilets in the event area. Participants are advised to change at home, as there are no changing facilities at the venue. Valuables can be handed in in an A4 envelope. Parking is available at Kattegattskolan and Skepparegatan, but eco-friendly transport is encouraged. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. In 2026, race bibs were collected at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden; information for 2027 has not yet been provided in the sources.

description: The Pallas '67 Ultrameerdaagse celebrates its fifth edition with a challenging multi-day ultrarun around Wageningen and Bennekom. The event consists of five days, with four routes of approximately 55 km and one route of over 70 km. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas such as the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the mystical Prattenburgsebos. The base is the grounds of Hoekelum Castle, where luxury accommodation is available. The event starts on Wednesday morning, 13 May, at the Pallas '67 clubhouse in Wageningen, with the remaining starts at the castle grounds in Bennekom.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 55 km and one route of over 70 km
Natural areas: the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the Prattenburgsebos
Start at the Pallas '67 clubhouse, with Hoekelum Castle as the base
additional: The base is Hoekelum Castle, with luxury accommodation at 'de Schuur' for 4 nights. Participants can also take part for one or more days. People from Wageningen can stay at home overnight. The total cost for 5 days, including 4 nights' accommodation, is expected to be no more than 450 euros. Routes through the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the Prattenburgsebos; starts in Wageningen and Bennekom; 4 routes of approximately 55 km and 1 of over 70 km; 4 nights at Hoekelum Castle.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vårruset in Vänersborg is a spring-inspired fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances along Vassbottenleden, with the start and finish at Sanden. The event is open to everyone and welcomes both individual runners and teams of five. After the finish, teams are treated to a picnic, creating a wonderful sense of community and a springtime atmosphere. The event is family-friendly, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult. Timing is available for the 5 km course, but participants can also choose not to be timed. Race bibs are distributed in advance to avoid queues on race day.
course_highlights: 2.5 km and 5 km distances along Vassbottenleden
Start and finish at Sanden in Vänersborg
Certified 5 km course with timing
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Intersport Överby in Trollhättan in the days before the event. Teams that register receive a picnic after the finish, and the picnic voucher is on the team leader’s race bib. The event area is easily accessible on foot, by bike, bus and train. There is a facility for leaving warm-up clothing at the venue. Race information is emailed approximately two weeks before the event. Registration is binding and can be made up to one hour before the start. Teams of five are treated to a picnic after the finish. Information about the location and event format is based on details for 2026; details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

description: Bankvarvet is a popular fun run in Kullaparken, Kisa, focusing on the joy of being active rather than the fastest time or lap. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 900-metre Minivarvet for children born in 2016 or later. It’s a community celebration with entertainment, activities, and food, perfect for families, groups of friends, and companies looking to build team spirit. Bankvarvet attracts many participants and is known for its warm and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
A 900-metre Minivarvet for children
5 km and 10 km routes for adults and young people
additional: Kullaparken opens at 16:00, with activities including basketball, football, table tennis, and boules, as well as food and drink. Bankvarvet is a popular company activity for building team spirit. The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00, with the 5 km and 10 km races starting at 18:30. The official information currently available describes the 2026 edition: the race starts at 18:30, and activities in Kullaparken begin at 16:00. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Lauf um den Allendorfer Bahnhof – Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup
VR-Bank Abendlauf
location: Neuenkirchen bei Bramsche, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: Putten Power Run
description: The Putten Power Run is the annual running event that makes the vibrant heart of Putten beat. On the Friday after Ascension Day, the town centre turns into a sporting arena, with an atmospheric course through the centre and Putterbos. Participants can choose from various distances, from kids’ runs to a challenging 10 km, and enjoy a fun-filled day with music, food stalls and activities for the whole family. The event celebrates sporting spirit and togetherness, and supports local charities.
course_highlights: An atmospheric course through the town centre and Putterbos
Start and finish on the lively square in the heart of Putten
Water stations along the course and at the finish
additional: Race numbers are available for collection from 15:00 at the race office on Kerkplein. The IPICO timing tag must be attached to your shoelace and returned after the finish; otherwise, a €7.50 charge will apply. Free parking is available at the car park on Brinkstraat. Changing rooms with toilets are available, but there are no showers. Medical support is available along the course and at the finish. Enjoy a lively atmosphere with a DJ, food stalls, a business plaza and children’s activities. The event offers water stations, medical support and parking. Showers are not available in the changing rooms. Registration is available on the day at Kerkplein.

name: Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra
description: Gotaleden Relay & Ultra is a brand-new running and relay event taking place on 9 May 2026. Four races are offered along the scenic Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås: individual distances (35 km and 75 km) and team relays (35/75 km), with stages ranging from approximately 4.5 to 12 km. The races feature varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and the finish at Nolhaga Park will be celebrated with an awards ceremony, food trucks, showers and an After Run. The event is aimed at everyone from recreational runners to experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: The course follows the Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås, with beautiful scenery and historic industrial environments
Varied terrain: trails, gravel and asphalt
The ultramarathon has substantial total elevation gain (approx. 1,403 m) and reaches a high point of ~185 m above sea level
additional: Age limits: Relay (35/75) from age 14; Ultra 75 and Sprint 35 from age 17. Relay 75 consists of 9 stages (2–9 people per team), with stages of 4.5–12 km; Relay 35 has 4 stages (2–4 people). Ultra 75: 75 km, asphalt/gravel/trail terrain, 16 aid stations and a food station in Floda; Sprint 35: 35 km, 7 aid stations. Stage start points are located near public transport, and the organizer offers the option to book a bus to the start when registering. The finish at Nolhaga Park offers an awards ceremony, food, showers and an After Run. The races start in Gothenburg (Valhalla IP) and, for the sprint, in Floda (Garveriet), with different start points along the Gotaleden. After the finish, runners can enjoy a finish-line celebration and After Run, as well as a training weekend at Öijared Resort in March 2026 ahead of race weekend.

name: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun
description: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun is a trail race held in Gothenburg’s beautiful Änggårdsbergen nature reserve. The race offers two distances, 7.5 km and 12.5 km, where participants can experience technical trails, hilly terrain and magical viewpoints in the city’s wilderness. The course passes through varied environments such as Vitsippsdalen, Ljungheden and Västerberget, with coniferous forest, heaths and rocky outcrops. It’s an adventure for both beginners and experienced trail runners who want to enjoy nature and challenge themselves.
course_highlights: Technical trails and hilly terrain in Gothenburg’s nature reserve
Fantastic viewpoints overlooking the sea and central Gothenburg
The course passes through varied natural landscapes, including a wood anemone valley, heathland and coniferous forest
additional: Three start waves with friend seeding: the 12.5 km race starts at 11:00, 11:03 and 11:06. There is an aid station only on the 12.5 km course, after approximately 7.5 km. Start and finish at Karlsrofältet, near Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden. Race bibs can be collected at the venue from 09:30 or at Icebug in Gothenburg. Spiked shoes are prohibited. Everyone who completes the race receives an exclusive wooden medal inspired by Ljungheden. Public transport is recommended; parking is limited. Children aged 8 and up can run with a parent or guardian. Choose between 7.5 and 12.5 km. The organizer recommends trail shoes with a sturdy sole; spiked shoes are not permitted. Public transport is recommended.

name: Koster Trail
