description: Koster Trail is a challenging trail race through Kosterhavet National Park on Nordkoster. The race features a technically demanding course of approximately 15 kilometres, with stones, cliffs and many beautiful viewpoints along the coast. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy craft beer, homemade food and a refreshing saltwater swim. The race is organised by Kosterhavets Ekobod, with a focus on sustainability and care for nature.
course_highlights: Technically demanding course with stones and cliffs
Sections along the coast and sandy beaches
Many magical viewpoints on Nordkoster
additional: The start and finish are at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster. There are two aid stations with Koster water and U Sport sports drink from Umara. Race bibs can be collected on Friday from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00. After the race, pizza from Artisan Bread Karlstad and craft beer from Qvänum Brewery will be served. Bag storage is available at the start/finish. There are no shower facilities at the finish. Participants are advised to have personal accident and liability insurance. Travel to Koster can be planned via Västtrafik. A cable ferry runs between Nordkoster and Sydkoster. For 2026, food and a drink of choice were included in the standard entry fee; an option without food and drink cost 950 kr. The race information states a limit of 200 entries, two aid stations and an age limit of 18. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
description: Kolmårdstrailen is one of Sweden’s finest trail races, offering challenging, hilly courses in the scenic Kolmården terrain. Runners can choose between distances of 21 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 500-metre children’s course for the youngest participants. The courses run through forests, over rocky outcrops and along hiking trails, with beautiful views and sections of technical terrain. The focus is on the experience, with a course that combines the beauty of nature with a physical challenge.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with rocky-outcrop running and forest trails
Passage through Rödgölen Nature Reserve, with soft singletrack
Views from Kolmården’s highest peak, 171 metres above sea level
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place on race day between 9.00 and 11.00. Payment is by cash or Swish. All courses pass the race centre approximately 1 km before the finish, where the final kilometre is tough and partly off-trail through the forest. There are water stations along the course, including one at 7.5 km by the Scout Hut at Gransjön. Volunteers are needed for race bib collection, serving and water stations.

name: Hoby backyard Ultra 12H
description: The first edition of Hoby Backyard Ultra 12h! The course is 6,706 m, with approximately 50% trail/gravel road and 50% asphalt. 57 meters of elevation gain per lap.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Öland Church Relay is a classic long-distance relay, being held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on Öland as spring gets underway. The start and finish are in Färjestaden. The race comes in two formats: a longer course with eleven legs totaling 67.5 km and a shorter course with six legs totaling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs for all levels. Organizers Högby IF and Öland Sports Association aim to provide the best possible service, with course marshals, a race announcer and individual timing.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/olands-kyrkstafett/): 2027-05-08 — "Tid & datum 08 maj 2027 kl. 10:00" (was estimated 2027-04-08)

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a wonderful spring race that runs along the beautiful Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred. The race offers a fantastic nature experience and a great atmosphere, making it perfect for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a welcoming event that invites participants to enjoy exercise and camaraderie in a scenic setting.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://visithultsfred.se/evenemang/strandmilen/): 2027-05-08 — "Strandmilen — 8 maj, 2027 kl.10:00 - 13:00" (was estimated 2027-04-08)

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a family-friendly fun run starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometres through the city. There is also KyrkRundan, approximately three kilometres long, and a free children’s race. The event features music and activities along the course and is a local community celebration that welcomes walkers, joggers and runners alike. You are warmly welcome to a day of movement, togetherness and joy on Saturday, 9 May 2026.

name: SHE Silverlöpet
organizer: Sala-Heby Energi AB (i samarbete med IFK Sala)
description: SHE Silverlöpet is an annual running race in Sala, organised by IFK Sala. The race brings together runners of different ages and ability levels and is part of the club’s wide-ranging sports activities. Results from previous years are available, and the race is a popular event in the region. Registration is available through external platforms, and IFK Sala can be contacted for more information.

name: Vellinge Beer Run
description: Vellinge Beer Run is a 5-kilometer recreational race that starts and finishes at Vellinge Brewery in central Vellinge. The race is suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and offers a scenic course through the Vellinge area. After the race, participants can enjoy a beer tasting featuring the brewery’s craft beers, creating a unique combination of running and local beer culture in a welcoming setting.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer recreational race
Start and finish at Vellinge Brewery
Course through the scenic surroundings of the Vellinge area
additional: After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy a beer tasting at Vellinge Brewery, featuring its range of lagers, IPAs, and seasonal specialty beers. The race combines running with socializing and brewery culture at a popular local meeting place.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer
description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity race bringing participants together in Älmhult to support the fight against cancer. The race offers several distances and start times, selected during registration via RaceID. The event is marked by a sense of community and commitment, with inspiring talks and a festive after-run at Grillen after the finish. Participants can also enjoy affordable accommodation at the world’s only IKEA Hotel during race weekend.
course_highlights: Charity race with several distances and a choice of start time
After-run party with barbecue and music at Grillen after the race
Inspiring talks by well-known speakers before the race
additional: Online registration is open until Friday, May 9, at 20:00. On-site registration is also available on race day from 08:30, subject to availability. No refunds for cancellations, as this is a charity race. Group registration is available with a shared team name. The confirmation email will include the distance and start time. Hotel breakfast and accommodation are available at IKEA Hotel during race weekend.

name: Sommarro Snabbare
description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique, fast-paced running race in the Sommarro cultural reserve in Örebro. The race takes place on a 2.6 km loop through a forest park, with each lap having to be completed in progressively less time (the first lap in 25 minutes, the next in 24 minutes, the third in 23 minutes, and so on), making the race faster with every round. Everyone starts on equal terms, and the winner is the one who lasts the longest—making it suitable for both fast runners and those looking to challenge their endurance. There is also Lilla Sommarro Snabbare for children born in 2013 or later (one lap, untimed).

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race held in Bruksparken in Bromölla, starting and finishing at the same location. The race consists of six legs and is suitable for all runners, from recreational runners to more experienced athletes. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied surface of gravel and asphalt, making the race a day full of running joy and camaraderie. The anniversary year will be celebrated with a mini race for children and a raffle for a hot-air balloon ride for participating teams. The mass start is at 11:00, and race bibs can be collected from 09:00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://humlestafetten.se): 2026-05-09 — "den 9 maj 2026" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: Lundaloppet
description: Lundaloppet is a fun run held in central Lund, offering several distances for all ages and abilities, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the Little Lundaloppet for children. The race is known for its wonderful atmosphere and beautiful routes through parks and urban settings. It’s a community celebration where beginners and experienced runners alike come together to enjoy the joy of running in springtime Lund. The finish is inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen, the race’s beating heart since 1997.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://lundaloppet.se/information/): 2026-05-09 — "Lundaloppet 2026 8 maj -> 13:00-19:00 9 maj -> från 9:00" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: Hörster Waldlauf im Naturpark Teutoburger Wald
Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run to integracyjny bieg organizowany z myślą o osobach w spektrum autyzmu, ich rodzinach i przyjaciołach. Celem imprezy jest wsparcie integracji społecznej poprzez wspólne wydarzenie sportowe, które łączy uczestników i buduje świadomość na temat autyzmu. Bieg odbywa się na asfaltowej alejce przy Kąpielisku Arkonka w Szczecinie, a udział w nim to przede wszystkim satysfakcja i pokonanie samego siebie, niezależnie od zajętego miejsca. W ramach imprezy przewidziane są także wspólne zabawy koordynowane przez terapeutów i wolontariuszy, co dodatkowo sprzyja integracji.

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking w Wilkowie Nowowiejskim to malownicza i wymagająca trasa o długości 8,2 km, będąca pierwszym etapem XIV edycji Grand Prix Nordic Walking. Impreza odbędzie się 9 maja 2026 roku i stanowi doskonałą okazję do sportowej rywalizacji oraz poznania lokalnych atrakcji, takich jak największy chodak czy stół biesiadny. Uczestnicy mogą przygotowywać się korzystając z certyfikowanych tras Nordic Walking dostępnych w gminie Nowa Wieś Lęborska.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: IV Płużnicka Piątka to bieg na 5 kilometrów odbywający się w malowniczej miejscowości Płużnica. Trasa biegu jest zróżnicowana pod względem nawierzchni, co czyni ją atrakcyjną zarówno dla amatorów, jak i bardziej doświadczonych biegaczy. Zawodnicy startują w centrum miejscowości, a wydarzenie towarzyszą biegi dziecięce oraz uroczyste wręczenie nagród. Atmosfera biegu jest przyjazna i rodzinna, co potwierdzają pozytywne opinie uczestników z poprzednich edycji.

name: KaaienLoop
location: Stadspark en centrum van Oosterhout, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Kaaienloop is a lively running event in Oosterhout, starting and finishing at the Heuvel. The 24th edition takes place on Saturday, 8 May 2027, and offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the 550-metre Bambino Run to the challenging 10 kilometres through the city park and town centre. The varied routes are accompanied by live music from bands along the course, creating a festive atmosphere. The Kaaienloop is open to all ages and ability levels, with chip timing and a strong focus on sociability and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Course through the city park and the atmospheric centre of Oosterhout
Live music from various bands along the course
A range of distances, including a dedicated course for the Bambino Run in the city park
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 15:30 until 15 minutes before the start at the stand in front of Heuvel 7. The Bambino Run is 550 metres through the city park and can be run with a parent accompanying the child. The 5 km consists of 2 laps of 2.5 km, and the 10 km consists of 4 laps of 2.5 km. Timing is recorded via a chip in the race number and start and finish mats. Results will be published on uitslagen.nl. Participants can register for various distances, and the event also includes youth and company races. Photos and results from previous editions are available online.

name: Run van Gieten
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.05 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km

price_tiers.distance: Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe wedstrijdloop 10 kilometer
Magnesium halve marathon Run van Gieten

description: The Run van Gieten is a running and walking event held on the Hondsrug in Drenthe. The 19th edition takes place on Saturday, 8 May 2027, and offers a wide range of distances, from 250 metres for the youngest participants to a half marathon. The event includes various races, such as the Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe 10-kilometre race, the Magnesium half marathon and the Magnesium 5.3-kilometre race. There are also youth and wheelchair runs, walking tours and special races for children. Everyone is warmly welcome to join this sporty day full of challenge and fun.
course_highlights: Running and walking event on the Hondsrug in Drenthe
Distances ranging from 250 metres to a half marathon
Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe 10-kilometre race with chip timing
additional: Participants in the 10-kilometre race can use the changing and shower facilities at De Goorns sports hall. Valuables can be handed in at the Impuls office on Brink. There are plenty of parking spaces nearby. All participants run with a Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe chip. Cash prizes are awarded to the fastest men and women in various age categories, with an additional bonus for breaking the course record. Registration is via QR code and includes the youth and school championships, walks and special runs.

name: SilvercityRUN
description: SilvercityRUN is an annual running event in Schoonhoven, known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting challenge. The race passes through the historic streets of the Silver City and attracts both recreational runners and dedicated athletes. With 5- and 10-kilometer distances and a special Kidsrun, there is a suitable race for everyone. The event is marked by a festive atmosphere, with music and enthusiastic supporters along the course.
course_highlights: Historic streets of Schoonhoven
5- and 10-kilometer distances
Friendly, festive atmosphere with music
additional: SilvercityRUN 2026 sold out, with 1000 participants. A special training group and a running shirt are available. Each year, an amount is raised for the charity 'Het Huis van Noord'. The annual race celebrated its anniversary edition in 2026 and featured various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a kids’ run, with many volunteers and a lively atmosphere.

name: Springtime 2025
description: Springtime in Helsingborg is a traditional running event with several distances for all ages and abilities. The main event is the 10 km, which has been held since 1981 and is the most popular. There is also an intense 5 km race, the HD's MiniSpringtime children's race for children aged 5–10, and a race for participants with disabilities. The races start and finish at Stortorget in Helsingborg and offer a well-managed, scenic course featuring Pålsjöbacken and Kärnan.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stortorget in Helsingborg
The course includes the full climb up Pålsjöbacken and F.M Franzens gata to Pålsjögatan
Passes Kärnan and continues via Kärngränden and Nedre Långvinkelsgatan
additional: A race bib, medal, water and fruit are included in the price. Late registration is available until 3 May via the website, and after that on site at bib collection. Insurance can be purchased when registering. Team competitions are offered for both 5 km and 10 km, with mixed men's and women's teams whose times are recalculated. The 5 km and 10 km courses have been officially measured by Swedish Athletics course measurers. Sources list the next edition as taking place on 10 May 2026, with no details for 2027.

name: GVG Volkslauf Rund um den Otto-Maigler-See
Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: Wings for Life World Run to wyjątkowy, globalny bieg, który odbywa się jednocześnie na całym świecie. Zamiast tradycyjnej mety, uczestnicy ścigają się z wirtualnym Samochodem Pościgowym, który startuje 30 minut po biegaczach i stopniowo zwiększa prędkość, aż dogoni ostatniego zawodnika. W Gdańsku Południe bieg odbędzie się 10 maja 2026 roku, startując o godzinie 13:00 w okolicy mety Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie. Trasa to pętla około 3 km po utwardzonej nawierzchni, z minimalnym podbiegiem na łączniku. Cały dochód z wpisowego wspiera badania nad rdzeniem kręgowym.

name: Wings for life world run App
description: Wings for Life World Run App to wyjątkowy bieg, który odbywa się na całym świecie jednocześnie, 10 maja 2026 roku. Uczestnicy startują w tym samym czasie, gdziekolwiek chcą, a ich celem jest ucieczka przed wirtualnym samochodem pościgowym, który zaczyna ich ścigać 30 minut po starcie. Cały dochód z wpisowego przeznaczany jest na badania nad uszkodzeniami rdzenia kręgowego, a aplikacja mobilna zapewnia motywację i unikalne doświadczenie audio podczas biegu. To bieg dla każdego - od początkujących po zawodowców, biegaczy, osoby na wózkach i amatorów.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w Żninie, która w 2026 roku zaplanowana jest na 10 maja. Zawody obejmują biegi uliczne na dystansach 10 km, 5 km, 2,5 km oraz 5 km Nordic Walking, a start i meta zlokalizowane są na placu Wolności. Bieg na 10 km jest zaliczany do Grand Prix Pałuk. Uczestnicy otrzymują pakiet startowy zawierający pamiątkowy medal z cyklu „Wielcy Żninianie”, posiłek regeneracyjny oraz pamiątki z Pałuk. Biuro zawodów działa w dniu biegu od godziny 9:00 do 11:45 w Szkole Podstawowej nr 1 w Żninie.

name: Dikke Tien Runn

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inschrijfkosten voor 10 km is twaalf euro

description: De Dikke Tien Runn is a running race held in the beautiful Middag Humsterland nature area, starting and finishing at the sports park on Valgeweg in Feerwerd. The run is a spin-off of Sportpark De Dikke Tien, an initiative by local residents to make exercise fun, sociable and healthy. There are three routes: 10 kilometres, 5 kilometres and a special 1-kilometre kids’ run. The organisers work with Univé Verzekeringen and support the UMCG Beatrix Children’s Hospital with part of the entry fees.
course_highlights: Run through the Middag Humsterland nature area
Start and finish at Sportpark De Dikke Tien on Valgeweg
Three routes: 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km kids’ run
additional: €2.50 from each ticket sold goes to the UMCG Beatrix Children’s Hospital. The run is an initiative of local village associations and residents from Feerwerd and surrounding villages. The organisers work with Univé Verzekeringen. Routes of 1 km, 5 km and 10 km; start and finish at the Valgeweg sports park; support for the UMCG Beatrix Children’s Hospital.

name: Leiden Marathon
description: The Leiden Marathon is an atmospheric running event held in the historic city centre of Leiden and the surrounding area. The course passes the beautiful canals, cheering crowds, and the green polders and villages around the city. The start is on Koninginnelaan, and the finish is beneath the iconic finish arch at Vismarkt. Marathon weekend offers several distances, including 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, and a 5 km Nightrun, and is an experience for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Start on Koninginnelaan
Finish beneath the finish arch at Vismarkt
Course through the historic city centre, along the canals, and across green polders
additional: The 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km walking distances start on Saturday. The 5 km Nightrun takes place on Saturday evening. The 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km running distances start on Sunday. Race numbers can be collected on Saturday and Sunday at Johnson & Johnson Park (Garenmarktplein). There is a supervised bag drop and a tent village with a help desk. The finish is a festive place, with large crowds along the course. Registration opens on 1 October 2023; the event includes several distances and activities, with the start and finish at Garenmarktplein and Johnson & Johnson Park.

name: Rondehoeploop
location: Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Rondehoeploop is a friendly and popular running race in Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, celebrating its 40th anniversary edition in 2027. The race offers challenging courses of 17.2 km and 5 km, plus a 2 km children’s race, with a welcoming start and finish at De Bindelwijk sports hall. The event attracts many participants and spectators each year, thanks in part to the enthusiastic volunteers and the crowds along the course. Every participant receives a medal, and various prizes are awarded across different age categories.
course_highlights: 17.2 km Rondehoeploop course with challenging wind conditions
2 km children’s race, with a dedicated training schedule available
Start and finish at De Bindelwijk sports hall in Ouderkerk aan de Amstel
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 9:30 to 11:00 at De Bindelwijk sports hall. Same-day registration is no longer available for the running distances; it is available only for walking and the children’s race. Timing uses the MYLAPS Bibtag system, with the chip incorporated into the race number. Net time is recorded. The starting gun for the children’s race goes off at 11:42. All participants receive a medal, and various prizes and trophies are awarded across different age categories. The fastest Ouderkerkers receive a dinner/lunch voucher, and a perpetual trophy after three consecutive wins. Anniversary edition; advance registration required; includes route directions and refreshment stations along the course.

name: Schagen City Run
location: Het centrum van Schagen, Schagen, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Schagen City Run is an annual running event in the centre of Schagen, with the start and finish at the Markt. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a Business Run and a Kids Run, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The City Run is inclusive and accessible to athletes using handbikes or blades. Participants can collect their race numbers in advance at Sport2000 Sportshop Bouwes or on race day at Hotel Marktstad.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Markt in the centre of Schagen
Several distances: 5 km, 10 km, Business Run and Kids Run
Inclusive of athletes using handbikes and blades
additional: Race numbers can be collected in the week before the race at Sport2000 Sportshop Bouwes in Schagen. On race day, race numbers can also be collected at Hotel Marktstad. Participation with handbikes and blades is possible. A voluntary donation is requested for Stichting ALS, the event’s chosen charity. The race takes place on 9 May 2027 in the centre of Schagen. In addition to the main distances, there are other activities and a great atmosphere focused on inclusion and sportsmanship.

name: Kastelenloop
location: Diepenheim, Hof van Twente, Overijssel, Netherlands

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset in Växjö is a popular spring running event offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö, with the start and finish at Strandbjörket. The event is open to everyone and offers both individual and team registration. Teams consist of five people and receive a shared picnic after finishing. The event has a wonderful spring atmosphere, with a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and prizes for participants. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km course, but participants can choose to run without timing if they wish. Vårruset is organized by IFK Växjö in collaboration with Marathongruppen and several athletics clubs.
course_highlights: The course goes around Lake Växjö through beautiful natural surroundings
Start and finish at Strandbjörket, near Strandbjörkshallen
A water station and toilets are available at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in Växjö a few days before the event. Team leaders receive a picnic voucher on their race bib to collect the picnic after the event. The event area opens at 17:00 with a sponsor village, and light refreshments are served. Participants are encouraged to arrive dressed for the race and to travel to the event area in an environmentally friendly way. The race bib must be clearly visible throughout the race. Participants can run, jog or walk. Individual registration includes a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and race bib; team registration also includes a picnic. Timing is available for the 5 km distance and can be opted out of. Published local information applies to the 2026 event.

name: Blodomloppet (Uddevalla)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 2000kr fr.o.m. 28 april fram till och med 4:e maj

description: Blodomloppet in Uddevalla is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old. Participants can register individually or as a team, and the event ends with a picnic together. Blodomloppet is a popular workplace wellness activity that brings together companies and individuals in a social, healthy setting while supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km races start north of the grassy area in Museiparken and follow Kungsgatan eastward
Lilla Blodomloppet starts in the tree-lined avenue north of Museiparken and heads west
The course is suitable for both walking and running, with timing for the 5 km and 10 km races
additional: You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 participants. Team registration includes a picnic bag. Teams can fill vacant places until 1 May. Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on race day. You can pay using your workplace wellness allowance through Epassi, Wellnet, or Benify. T-shirt sizes may sell out, with priority given to those who registered in advance. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount, and the workplace wellness allowance can be used.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/uddevalla/): 2027-05-10 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! 10 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-10)

name: Vårruset Göteborg
organizer: Marathongruppen tillsammans med Hässelby SK, Spårvägens FK och lokala arrangören IK Vikingen
description: Vårruset Göteborg is a wonderful fitness festival for women, held in Slottsskogen, with the start and finish at Björngårdsvillan. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and 5 km on a course measured for accuracy. The event is all about the joy of movement, community and a fantastic atmosphere, with entertainment and encouragement along the course. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and a finisher’s bag, and teams that register also get a picnic after the finish. Vårruset is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and welcomes participants of all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult.
course_highlights: A 5 km course measured for accuracy
Start and finish at Björngårdsvillan in Slottsskogen
Entertainment and encouragement along the course and in the event area
additional: Registration is binding and can be completed online up to race day, no later than one hour before the start. Participants can opt out of timing when registering, which means their result will not be published in the results list. Teams consist of five people, and team members can run different distances. Teams that register get a picnic after the finish. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km (11 when accompanied by an adult) and 11 for the 2.5 km (7 when accompanied by an adult). Race bib information is sent out approximately two weeks before the event. Five-person teams get a picnic after the finish. Timing is available for the 5 km and can be opted out of. Information about the course and event format is from the 2026 edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Chalmersloppet 2026
description: Chalmersloppet is an annual running festival on the Johanneberg campus in Gothenburg, welcoming students, employees, alumni and companies to take part in a community focused on health and wellbeing. The event offers several distances and a walk, so everyone can participate on their own terms, from experienced runners to those who prefer walking. It is a meeting place for networking and exercise in a relaxed, inspiring atmosphere, with a focus on health for all. Students can participate for free, and company participation creates valuable opportunities for future employers and students to meet. Chalmersloppet is organized by Chalmers Student Union’s Teknologbolag and celebrates balance, wellbeing and community.
course_highlights: The race starts and takes place on the Johanneberg campus, with several distances: 9.82 km, 6.28 km, 3.14 km, and a 3.14 km walk
Start groups of runners and walking groups set off one after another from Chalmersplatsen
Runner Zone at Geniknölen features activities, networking and an awards ceremony
additional: Fysiken offers free changing rooms at Mossen. A bag drop is available for runners’ belongings. Bib numbers and T-shirts can be collected from a tent at Teknologgården the day before and on race day. Fysiken leads a group warm-up. The awards ceremony takes place at Chalmersplatsen. Runner Zone is a central meeting place featuring companies and activities. Students participate free of charge. The event includes activities in a Runner Zone.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.chalmersloppet.se/): 2027-05-11 — "See you on the 11th of May 2027!" (was estimated 2027-05-11)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: See you on the 11th of May 2027!

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami to wyjątkowa nocna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w Redzie, przy zbiorniku retencyjnym. Charakterystyczne dla tego biegu są czołówki biegaczy oraz świetlna oprawa trasy, które tworzą spektakularny efekt wizualny. Startują pary, co podkreśla integracyjny charakter wydarzenia i wyróżnia je na tle innych imprez sportowych w województwie pomorskim. Bieg odbywa się po zmroku, co dodaje mu niepowtarzalnej atmosfery i emocji.

name: Luilakpolderloop
location: Jisp, Wormer- en Jisperveld, North Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Luilakpolderloop is a friendly running race held annually in the beautiful polder landscape of the Wormer and Jisperveld. With distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), it offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. Children can take part in a special free 1.1 km youth race. The start and finish are at VV Jisp football club, with a welcoming atmosphere, medals for children, trophies for the winners and a raffle after the race.
course_highlights: Beautiful course through the Wormer and Jisperveld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 miles)
Free 1.1 km youth race for children
additional: Youth race bibs can be collected on 13 May 2027 from 14:00 to 14:30 at OBS De Harpoen, or on 14 May 2027 at 18:00 at Restaurant De Lepelaar. The youth race starts at 18:30 at Restaurant De Lepelaar and finishes at VV Jisp. Adult race bibs are available from 18:30 at VV Jisp; the adult fun runs start at 19:30. VV Jisp has 4 changing rooms with showers. Bag storage is at your own risk. Parking is limited, and a traffic marshal will be present. Live results are available during the race. The raffle and prize presentation take place after the race, at around 21:15. Registration for 2027 opens in early March, with 350 race bibs available. The event supports charities and offers digital timing with live results. Medals and trophies are available for participants, and registration is mandatory. No refunds are available in the event of cancellation.

price_range: Gratis enligt information om tidigare upplagor

description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, offering races for all ages, from a Mini Race for the youngest participants to a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over. The race is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works with young people in Sweden’s Million Programme suburbs. There is music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, uplifting fitness festival that encourages exercise and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over
Lilla Skärholmsloppet: approximately 1.6 km for children from preschool class to Year 6
Mini Skärholmsloppet: 500 metres for children aged 0–6
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Music and DJs along the course. A medal for everyone who completes the race. The entry fee includes a race bib, medal, fruit and drink. Lilla Skärholmsloppet has start times divided by school year, with colour-coded start groups. The Mini Race is 500 metres and can be run together with a parent. Late registration may be available at race-bib collection on 15 May and on race day, subject to availability. The race centre at SKHLM offers race-bib collection and bag storage; late registration may be available subject to availability. The recommended route is the red line 13 metro to Skärholmen. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the sources provided.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Kilsbergen Out & Back is a unique and friendly trail run in Ånnaboda, near Örebro, where participants choose their own distance by running one, two or all three out-and-back routes. The race offers hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and beautiful trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same place, creating a social and relaxed atmosphere throughout the day. After finishing, participants are served a simple hot meal, with a vegetarian option.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes of 10 km, 26 km and 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections
The Bergslagsleden Trail, with a turnaround point at the Rusakulan viewpoint
additional: The maximum number of participants is 100. Bibs can be collected from 08:00 at the race centre. The start, finish and race centre are at the warming hut by the artificial snow ski track in Ånnaboda. Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at the SM hut by the lower car park. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended. Runners must carry all their own equipment and fuel; there is no support along the course. The race centre will have an aid station with water, sports drink, bananas, sweets, crisps, buns and more. Runners may leave their own drop bags there. Parking is recommended at the lower car park, with signs directing you to the race centre. The organiser’s information lists the start time as 09:00, a maximum of 100 participants and the final registration date as 15 May. Runners are responsible for their own equipment and fuel; support is permitted only at the race centre. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended.

name: TIF Terrängen 2026
description: TIF-terrängen is a traditional cross-country race organized by Trollhättans IF Friidrott. The race has a long history and attracts runners who appreciate challenging terrain and the beautiful natural surroundings of Skidstugan in Trollhättan. After the 2026 race was cancelled, the event is planned to return in 2027, with more information to come later.
course_highlights: The courses start at Skidstugan in Trollhättan.
Distances are 800 metres, 2.3 kilometres, 5.2 kilometres and 10.4 kilometres.
The 10.4-kilometre distance consists of two laps of the 5.2-kilometre course.
additional: The 800-metre race is for children up to 9 years old.

name: 3 Mile Dwunastki
organizer: Klub Biegowy Dzik, Wojskowe Centrum Sportu DORSZ, 12 Brygada Zmechanizowana
description: 3 Mile Dwunastki to ekstremalny bieg terenowy organizowany przez Stowarzyszenie Klub Biegowy „Dzik” w Szczecinie, na Strzelnicy Krzekowo. Trasa o długości 3 mil (4 km i 828 metrów) prowadzi przez drogi polne, piasek, podbiegi i zbiegi, betonowe i piaszczyste odcinki oraz drogi leśne, oferując wymagające warunki biegowe. Bieg jest bezpłatny w 2026 roku i skierowany do osób powyżej 16 roku życia, z ograniczoną liczbą miejsc. Start i meta znajdują się na Strzelnicy Krzekowo, a wydarzenie ma charakter integracyjny i promuje aktywność fizyczną na świeżym powietrzu.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
description: 8. Okonińska Pętla to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana w malowniczej miejscowości Okoniny Nadjeziorne. Zawody odbędą się 16 maja 2026 roku o godzinie 16:00. Bieg przyciąga miłośników aktywności na świeżym powietrzu, oferując atrakcyjną trasę w otoczeniu borów tucholskich i jezior. Organizatorzy zapewniają przyjazną atmosferę i zapraszają do udziału zarówno zawodników, jak i kibiców.

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się nad jeziorem Rusałka w Poznaniu. Zawody zaplanowano na 16 maja 2026 roku i obejmują biegi na dystansach 10 km i 5 km, marsz Nordic Walking na 5 km oraz biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe na krótszych dystansach. Start głównych biegów i marszu zaplanowano na godzinę 12:00, a starty dziecięce rozpoczynają się od godziny 9:00. Uczestnicy mogą wybrać pakiet podstawowy lub rozszerzony z koszulką techniczną. Trasa biegu prowadzi malowniczym terenem nad jeziorem, co zapewnia atrakcyjne widoki i przyjemną atmosferę.

name: V Szczeciniecka 5-tka
description: V Szczeciniecka 5-tka to biegowa impreza odbywająca się w Szczecinku, w województwie zachodniopomorskim. Wydarzenie jest częścią duathlonu i zaplanowane jest na 16 maja 2026 roku o godzinie 11:30. Zawodnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację oraz pomiar czasu. Impreza jest otwarta dla różnych grup biegaczy i stanowi doskonałą okazję do sportowej rywalizacji i aktywnego spędzenia czasu.

name: Rundje um ut Hundje
description: Rundje um ut Hundje is an annual running event in Horst aan de Maas, celebrating its 11th edition in 2027. The event offers a wide range of distances for all ages, from the Parent/Child Run to the 10 km race. The routes pass through the centre of Horst, creating a sporty and sociable atmosphere, made possible in part by the local community and sponsors. The organisers aim to provide a well-organised and accessible event for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes ranging from 350 metres to 10 kilometres through the centre of Horst
Start and finish at Lambertusplein, near the statue of ’t Hundje van Hôrs
Various youth and adult races with age-specific distances
additional: Free parking around Lambertusplein. Public transport: the 'Horst Centrum' bus stop is a 2-minute walk away. Prize ceremonies take place at Wilhelminaplein after the youth and adult races. Shirts can be ordered optionally for an additional fee. Multiple race categories, including kids, urban, 5 km and 10 km; location at Lambertusplein; anniversary year with special festivities

name: Adelsö ultra
description: A new ultratrail race on Adelsö on 16 May 2027. Adelsö is one of the Mälaren islands on the outskirts of Stockholm. We have worked hard on the course and are proud to present a scenic marathon-distance XL that combines coastline and technical forest trails with 600 metres of climbing. Beyond the natural experience, the race offers a journey through historically significant landscapes, which we have made an effort to highlight along the route. One of the most exciting ultraraces in Stockholm in spring 2027 for those who love trail running.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice - edycja wiosenna to cykliczny bieg organizowany w malowniczym Ogrodzie Dendrologicznym w Przelewicach, idealnym miejscu dla miłośników przyrody i aktywnego wypoczynku. Impreza ma na celu popularyzację biegania i rekreacji ruchowej, a udział w niej nie jest ograniczony wiekowo. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na wyjątkową atmosferę i pamiątkowe medale, które otrzymują po ukończeniu biegu głównego oraz biegów dziecięcych. Wydarzenie współorganizowane jest przez Województwo Zachodniopomorskie i odbywa się pod honorowym patronatem Marszałka Województwa.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy to druga edycja biegu terenowego odbywającego się 17 maja 2026 roku w Modrzu, Polska. Uczestnicy mogą wybrać spośród biegu na 5 km, biegu na 10 km oraz marszu Nordic Walking na 5 km. Trasa prowadzi przez pola i lasy między miejscowościami Modrze i Drożdżyce, oferując kontakt z naturą i aktywny wypoczynek na świeżym powietrzu. Wydarzenie ma na celu promocję zdrowego stylu życia i integrację lokalnej społeczności.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka to coroczny bieg organizowany w Sierakowicach, będący częścią Festiwalu Biegów Polski Północnej. Impreza odbywa się na stadionie sportowym przy ulicy Kubusia Puchatka 7 i przyciąga biegaczy w różnym wieku, oferując zarówno bieg główny na 15 km, jak i liczne biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe. Zawody charakteryzują się elektronicznym pomiarem czasu, bogatą oprawą i nagrodami dla najlepszych zawodników. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację, w tym zabezpieczenie medyczne i policyjne oraz udogodnienia takie jak depozyt, prysznice i kawiarenka.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nobel Run
description: The Nobel Run is a friendly, accessible running event held in the beautiful Almere Hout. The various routes pass through the area’s green, sustainable natural surroundings, giving the event a unique feel. The event aims to make a sustainable and sporting contribution to Almere Hout and is intended as a festive occasion for participants, spectators, and residents of Nobelhorst. The Nobel Run promotes social cohesion and gives the city of Almere a sporting boost.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural surroundings of Almere Hout
The course has a green and sustainable character
Distances range from a Kids Run to a 15 km run
additional: Race number with a built-in MyLaps timing chip. First name printed on the race number for registrations made before 1 May 2027. Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 15 May 2027 between 10:00 and 14:00 at the Nobelhorst community hall. Participants may hand in one bag with a numbered label. Entertainment, post-run massage, refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, official results, and personal photos are included. The official Nobel Run shirt, limited-edition socks, and BibBits magnets can be ordered optionally during registration. The event offers merchandise and registration options and emphasizes an environmentally conscious, community-focused approach.

description: Blodomloppet is Sweden’s largest recreational running event, held in 24 locations across the country, including Malmö on 17 May 2027. The event aims to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 or 10 kilometres with friends and colleagues. The event is open to everyone and ends with a shared picnic for participants.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in an urban setting
Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old
A shared picnic bag for all registered teams
additional: Teams of 3–5 participants can register and receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a discount when registering. Late registration is available at the venue on the day of the event for an additional fee. The start and finish are in Museiparken in Malmö. The entry fee can be paid using a wellness allowance. The Munkedal edition held a free school race in 2025 for students in grades 4–9. Information about the 2027 entry fees is unavailable.

name: Gerstewitzer Mühlentaglauf
description: Der Gerstewitzer Mühlentag-Lauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die verschiedene Streckenlängen von 400 m für Kinder bis zu 10 km für Erwachsene anbietet. Nach einer Corona-bedingten Pause erfreut sich der Lauf großer Beliebtheit und verbindet sportliche Ambitionen mit regionalen Pfingsttraditionen. Die Veranstaltung wird vom SFG Nellschütz e.V. organisiert und bietet Läufern aller Altersklassen eine attraktive Wettkampfmöglichkeit in der Region Lützen.

name: Dortmunder Friedenslauf
description: Der Dortmunder Friedenslauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf, der am Pfingstmontag, dem 25. Mai 2026, in Dortmund-Kirchlinde stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Laufdistanzen durch den malerischen Rahmer Wald und zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre und sportliche Atmosphäre aus. Begleitet wird das Event von musikalischer Unterhaltung und motivierenden Trommlern entlang der Strecke. Der Friedenslauf ist Teil einer Laufserie der Arbeitsgemeinschaft Straßenlauf und zieht Läufer aller Altersklassen an.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: NYHET – Spring gratis! Sparbanken Skåne bjuder på startavgiften för de 250 första anmälda

description: Blodomloppet in Kristianstad is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km through scenic surroundings on a varied mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. Lilla Blodomloppet offers shorter distances for children up to 12 years old and takes place inside Tivoliparken. Whether you take part with colleagues or friends, or on your own, everyone is warmly welcome to join this race, which also promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Scenic route extending into Vattenriket
Surface varies between grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12 in Tivoliparken
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances/classes. The deadline to register a team is 12 May. Late registration is available on-site in Tivoliparken from 16:00 on 19 May. Lilla Blodomloppet distances are 100 m (ages 1–3), 550 m (ages 4–7) and 1,100 m (ages 8–12). The 5 km and 10 km courses have a varied mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. There are several cheer stations along the course. The event ends with a picnic, and dogs are welcome. Race numbers and T-shirts are handed out. Changing facilities and toilets are available on-site. Medical care is available during the event.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/kristianstad/): 2027-05-18 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 18 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-18)

name: Stafettvarvet
description: Stafettvarvet is an exciting relay race taking place on 19 May 2027 in Slottsskogen, Gothenburg. Each team consists of four runners, all of whom run the same 3.1-kilometre course through beautiful Slottsskogen, finishing at Slottsskogsvallen. The race is popular with companies and friends looking to do something fun and healthy together, with a lovely picnic included after the finish. The race starts at 18:00, with self-seeding to place runners according to pace. Stafettvarvet offers a magical atmosphere before, during and after the race.
course_highlights: 3.1-kilometre course through Slottsskogen
Start, relay exchange and finish at Slottsskogsvallen
A picnic box is included for each team after the finish
additional: The start uses buddy seeding, with runners lining up according to pace. Runners 1 and 2 can enter the start area between 17:00 and 18:00. At the relay exchange, the baton is handed over at exchange barriers divided into zones by race number. Each team receives a picnic box to enjoy after the finish. A corporate village, with tents available to book, is located in the entrance park outside Slottsskogsvallen. One picnic box is included per team. Women's, men's and mixed teams can register; mixed teams must include at least one participant of the opposite sex. It is free to watch the race along the course.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are classes with and without timing, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part completely free of charge, and there is special information for schools.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women—a fun and welcoming spring evening where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event tours 19 cities from 4 May to 4 June 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and a race bib, while teams of five are rewarded with a picnic after finishing. The race has been held since 1989 and is aimed at recreational runners of different ages, in line with the recommendations for each distance.

description: Blodomloppet in Karlskrona is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers an 800-metre children’s race and a dedicated 5 km walking course. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, and the event ends with a shared picnic for all participants. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity for both individual participants and teams, with special discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four different courses: 5 km run, 10 km run, 800 m children’s race and 5 km walk
The courses are measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Federation
Walkers have a separate course and start first to make it possible for everyone to enjoy a shared picnic afterwards
additional: The event offers special discounts of SEK 40 per person for blood donors and ICA members, for both individual entries and teams. You can register individually or in a team of up to 5 participants. Team members can take part in different distances/classes. There is an option to register many participants using an Excel template, and larger organisations can use customer pages to manage registrations. Walkers start first on a separate course to make it possible to enjoy a shared picnic after the event.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is a 5 km evening race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race follows a 2.5 km loop run twice, with a pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the course. You can participate individually or register a team (at least five people), with the five fastest results combined. Welcome to the running festival in Stadsparken on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 19:00.

name: Potmarge Run
description: The Potmarge Run is an evening race over 5 and 10 kilometres that has been part of the series of runs organised by Lionitas in Leeuwarden since 2012. The routes are measured precisely and offer a unique running experience along the Van Harinxmakanaal and the River Potmarge, where you can enjoy nature in the city. The start is at the MICA/Mediahuis building at Sixmastraat 15. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility, and you can optionally order a medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the Van Harinxmakanaal
Run along the River Potmarge
Precisely measured 5 and 10 km routes
additional: Online registration is available until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration. A medal can be ordered optionally for € 3,50. The start location is MICA/Mediahuis (Leeuwarder Courant building), Sixmastraat 15, Leeuwarden. Routes measured; online registration until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration; free parking after 18:00.

description: The Verkerkloop is an annual race through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet. The event includes a fast street course with 5 km and 10 km distances for individual runners, a school race for children in various age categories, and a business race for teams. The route passes through the Molenvliet industrial estate and surrounding streets, with a turnaround point halfway through. The Verkerkloop is a sporting event that contributes to a healthy, close-knit community and attracts thousands of participants each year.
course_highlights: Fast street course through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet
The 5 km distance consists of one lap; the 10 km distance consists of two laps
The route passes, among other places, along Molenvliet, Munnikensteeg, Klarinetsingel, Beethovenlaan and Develsingel
additional: Start and finish at Verkerk, Molenvliet 1, in the Molenvliet industrial estate in Zwijndrecht. The school race is for children aged 6 and up, with distances from 600 to 1,200 metres. Business race teams consist of 4 or 5 runners; the finish times of the first 4 runners are added together. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Race numbers can be transferred through a resale platform. A maximum of 3,500 participants are allowed. Registration opens on 1 February 2027. The event is held at Verkerk on Molenvliet and also includes youth and business activities.

organizer: Blodcentralen i Östergötland och IK Akele samt Blodtappen i Östergötland

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Sista dag för laganmälan är 14 maj, därefter är det individuell anmälan som gäller.

description: Blodomloppet in Linköping is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, and team members can choose different distances. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity that ends with a large picnic and has a strong focus on attracting new blood donors. Youth teams receive a discount, and blood donors are offered a special discount on the entry fee. Participants also have the opportunity to travel free of charge on public transport in Östergötland on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances for women and men
The race takes place in Linköping, with the start and finish in central areas
Water stations are available along the course
additional: All participants who register by 14 May and provide a mobile number will receive a ticket link by text message for six hours of free public transport in Östergötland on 21 May. Teams must have 3–5 people, and the entry fee is always charged for five people, even if the team is smaller. Bib collection and late registration are available at several locations in the days before the race. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person, both for individual entries and team entries.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and takes place on Thursday, May 21, 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable for both experienced runners and those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finish-line goody bag, and a race number; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km distance, but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, welcoming all age groups and runners, from children to adults, including a new dog category. The race offers distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km on a mix of paved roads, forest trails and residential streets. It is a popular recreational race that also features team competitions with a picnic after the race, bringing participants together. Since starting in 2012, the race has grown to become the largest in the Nyköping region and is known for its friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course on paved roads, forest trails and residential streets
Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill
Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish
additional: Start and finish at ICA Nära in Stigtomta. Participant bags with race bibs and timing chips must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. Team competitions have a mass start and include a picnic basket (no special diets). The dog category has its own start time and prize table. A refreshment tent serving fika and accepting card payments is available. Parking with guidance and bicycle parking are available. Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill. Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish.

name: VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf
description: The VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf takes place on May 29, 2026, and offers runners a well-reviewed and attractive route through the town of Ahaus. The race is organized by VfL Ahaus 1892 e.V., one of the leading recreational sports clubs in the Münsterland region. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a friendly atmosphere with a focus on health and community. The route has been carefully explored and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group, so participants can look forward to a great running experience.
course_highlights: Route reviewed and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group
Attractive town route in Ahaus
Event focused on health and community
additional: Registration opens on March 15, 2026. Places are still available. The race takes place as part of the town festival. In cooperation with AOK, VfL Ahaus also offers functional training classes. The routes are not officially measured; registration opens on March 15, 2026; places are still available; the event is part of the town festival, which features a varied accompanying program.

description: The Volksbank Run “Around Offlumer Lake” is a long-standing running event in Neuenkirchen, Lower Saxony, taking place on May 29, 2026. The course runs around Offlumer Lake, with the start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg. A range of races is offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run and student races to the 10 km main race. The event is organized by the SuS 09 Neuenkirchen running group and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-the-day registration available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg
Course around Offlumer Lake, measured by the DLV for the 10 km main race
Distances range from a 300 m Bambini run to a 10 km main race
additional: On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be picked up from 3:00 p.m. at the registration tent. Timing is provided by Teamsoft-Sportzeit. Races start at staggered times, from 4:00 p.m. (Bambini run) to 7:00 p.m. (main race). Course: around Offlumer Lake. On-the-day registration available. Parking at the outdoor swimming pool and Offlumer Lake.

name: Göteborgsvarvet
description: Göteborgsvarvet is a well-known 21.0975 km celebration of running in Gothenburg, bringing together tens of thousands of runners and hundreds of thousands of spectators along the course. The race passes through the festival atmosphere of Slottsskogen, continues along Hisingen’s quays and by the buzz of Avenyn. The course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer, and the event is complemented by Göteborgsvarvet Expo and numerous spectator and music stations along the route. Information about start groups and other details is sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race.
course_highlights: Start and festival area around Slottsskogen / Göteborgsvarvet Arena
The course passes Hisingen’s quays and Avenyn
More than 200,000 spectators and numerous music stations along the route
additional: The distance is a half marathon (21,097.5 m), and the course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer. There are water stations along the course, and an interactive course map/GPX is published closer to race day. Start groups are assigned according to seeding rules; detailed start times and the location of your start group are sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race. Göteborgsvarvet Expo and Runners Zone are located at Göteborgsvarvet Arena/Slottskogsvallen. Registration is closed for 2026; seeding rules and start groups are available; the 21 km course passes Slottsskogen, runs along Hisingen’s quays and goes by Avenyn; the race is part of Varvet Week.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika Stadslopp is organised by Ludvika FFI and is a family-friendly road race with several distances for both children and adults. The start and finish are at Charlie Normans torg, and the event includes a children’s race, the Lilla Stadsloppet, and 5 km and 10 km races (with or without timing). The event takes place on Saturday, 23 May 2026, and welcomes runners of all ages and levels. There is a bonus for the 10 km course linked to the course record.

name: Cityvarvet
description: Cityvarvet is a shorter 4.3 km version of Göteborgsvarvet. It starts at Götaplatsen and takes you along Avenyn to a spectacular finish at Slottsskogsvallen. The race is a lively celebration, with plenty of spectators, music and cheer stations along the course, and is suitable for beginners, fast runners and families. We recommend that children up to the age of 13 run with an adult. As a runner, you’ll have access to the Runner Zone at the finish for recovery, snacks and drinks.

name: Uka Pain
description: UKA PAIN is a trail and ultrarunning event in Älvdalen, Dalarna, held over the weekend of 22–23 May 2026. The event offers several distances—12 km, 28 km, 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles—with the 28 km race serving as the Trail-SM/VSM and the 12 km race as the JSM on 23 May. The start and finish are at Hotell Älvdalen, and the courses wind through forest terrain in the area, marked in orange. GPS trackers and drop bags are provided for the longer distances, and information about accommodation and registration is available on the official pages. Some distances require specific equipment, and participants are encouraged to bring their own cup for the aid stations.

name: VirsboRUN
description: Welcome to VirsboRUN—a family-friendly trail race at Skräddartorpet on Saturday, May 23, 2026. Choose to run 1–4 laps of the 5.3 km loop course (up to 21.2 km), or let the children take part in the free kids’ race of approximately 800 metres. The course passes through unspoiled nature and Hälleskogsbrännan, with varied trails and beautiful views. After crossing the finish line, participants can look forward to a medal and a freshly grilled hamburger.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-Varvet is a classic running race in Eskilstuna, offering a scenic and varied course along the water and through the city’s parks. The race is popular and appreciated by both elite runners and recreational runners, with a great atmosphere and crowd support along the entire route. It’s a perfect event for anyone looking to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings while enjoying Eskilstuna’s charm.
course_highlights: The course runs along Eskilstuna’s waterways and through its parks
Varied terrain featuring both asphalt and gravel
Crowd support along the entire course

name: Greifenstein Berglauf
organizer: Fussfit Petry GmbH, webconcept GbR, weitere lokale Sponsoren
description: The Greifenstein Mountain Run is a challenging 5.3 km road race from Ehringshausen-Katzenfurt to Greifenstein Castle, taking place for the 27th time on 30 May 2026. The route follows country roads and farm tracks, climbing a total of 260 metres to the finish at the castle, which offers a wonderful view of the region. The race is open to youth, men, women and seniors, with a combined ranking across all categories. Nordic walking is offered without age-category rankings, and a free children’s race for the youngest participants takes place separately in the afternoon. The event concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle.
course_highlights: 5.3 km road race with 260 metres of elevation gain
Start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle with panoramic views
Challenging section of the course above Edingen
additional: The entry fee includes a bus transfer to the start, transport of clothing to the finish, and drinks at the start and finish. Race numbers and finisher shirts will be distributed in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle from 14:00 on event day. Late registration is possible on event day until 30 minutes before the start. Parking is available at the outskirts of Greifenstein in the direction of Beilstein. A free children’s race will be held at around 16:50, accompanied by members of LG Dill. The awards ceremony and refreshments—including coffee, cake, cold drinks and bratwurst—will take place in the castle courtyard. In clear weather, the courtyard offers impressive views across the Dill Valley as far as the Feldberg in the Taunus. Register online by 28.05.2026; start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle; no relay or walking event; results available since 2008.

name: Internationaler Biesfelder Dorflauf

description: The International Biesfeld Village Run is a long-standing running event in the municipality of Kürten, taking place on 30 May 2026. The race is known for its hilly course, which challenges runners and carries the slogan “Flat is somewhere else.” Various distances, including races for toddlers and schoolchildren, offer suitable competitions for all age groups. The event is organized by Biesfeld Triathlon e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the Biesfeld Community Primary School.
course_highlights: Hilly race in the municipality of Kürten, with challenging climbs
Distances from 0.6 km (toddler race) to 9.2 km (main race)
Start and finish in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School
additional: Race packs will be handed out on race day in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School. No separate timing chip is required, as the chip is integrated into the race bib (RaceResult). A late registration fee of €3.00 applies from 23.05.2026; late registrations are possible on site on race day. Distances: 0.6 km, 2.1 km, 9.2 km; online registration until 28.05.2026; race bib with chip; event in Kürten-Biesfeld

name: Wälster Lauf
description: The Wälster Lauf is a traditional fun run and road race in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde, organised annually by Fortuna Walstedde. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and offers runners and walkers of all ages an appealing opportunity to get active. The event traditionally opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. Alongside competition, the focus is also on the enjoyment of exercise and community.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde
Fun run and road race with various distances
Traditional opening event of the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde
additional: The Wälster Lauf offers running and walking on a DLV-measured course. The event includes various age groups and distances, including a Bambini run, children’s races, a fun run, 5 km and 10 km road races, and walking. Start times are staggered from 15:30 to 17:15. The event opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. It is a well-established regional running tradition, with courses known for their accuracy and fairness. It is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia - edycja wiosenna 2026 to bieg przełajowy organizowany w malowniczym Leśnym Ogrodzie Botanicznym Marszewo w Gdyni. Impreza jest częścią cyklu biegów Botaniczna Piątka, które od 2014 roku promują bieganie i piękno naturalnych tras w Polsce. Bieg przyciąga pasjonatów biegania, którzy cenią sobie kontakt z przyrodą i estetykę otoczenia. To doskonała okazja, by aktywnie spędzić czas na świeżym powietrzu wśród zieleni i wyjątkowej atmosfery.

name: Bieg Lwa
description: Bieg Lwa to coroczny półmaraton odbywający się w Tarnowie Podgórnym, który przyciąga zarówno elity biegowe, jak i amatorów. Impreza jest znana z doskonałej organizacji, atrakcyjnej trasy oraz licznego dopingu kibiców. W ramach festiwalu odbywają się także biegi dla dzieci oraz różnorodne wydarzenia towarzyszące, takie jak konkursy kibicowania i koncerty. Bieg Lwa to doskonała okazja do sportowej rywalizacji i rodzinnej zabawy w pięknej scenerii.

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Edukacji Dzieci i Młodzieży z Autyzmem „Aperio”
description: Bieg Poznaniaka dla Przedszkolaka to rodzinna impreza biegowa odbywająca się 23 maja 2026 roku w malowniczym Wielkopolskim Parku Narodowym oraz na terenie Muzeum Rolnictwa w Szreniawie. W programie znajdują się biegi główne na dystansach 11 km i 5,5 km, marsz Nordic Walking oraz biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe na różnych dystansach. Impreza ma charakter charytatywny, a cały zysk przeznaczony jest na wsparcie dzieci z autyzmem. Organizatorzy zapewniają elektroniczny pomiar czasu, pamiątkowe medale oraz liczne atrakcje dla uczestników i ich rodzin, w tym bezpłatne zwiedzanie muzeum i gry terenowe dla dzieci.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
description: XXVIII Bieg Święców w Sławnie to coroczna impreza biegowa, która odbędzie się 23 maja 2026 roku. Główny bieg na dystansie 10 km prowadzi ulicami miasta, w tym asfaltowymi ulicami, kostką bazaltową oraz asfaltowymi ścieżkami rowerowymi. Trasa jest zabezpieczona i oznaczona, a na trasie rozmieszczone są punkty odświeżania z wodą. W ramach imprezy odbywają się także biegi dziecięco-młodzieżowe na stadionie lekkoatletycznym na dystansach od 50 do 600 metrów. Organizatorzy zapewniają integrację lokalnej społeczności oraz promocję zdrowego stylu życia.

Gerard Tebroke Memorialloop
