Distances: 12 km, 5 km, junior race (1 km and 2 km); activities include Nordic walking and walking; location: Schipluiden, Midden-Delfland.

name: 76e Stratenloop Tuitjenhorn
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrücker Staffelmarathon
location: Schloss- und Rosengarten, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrück Relay Marathon is a long-established relay marathon taking place on July 5, 2026, in the castle and rose gardens in Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The flat, well-maintained course follows a two-kilometre loop through the historic castle park, to be completed 21 times. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which has been hosting this relay marathon since 2013 and has built a dedicated running community. The relay marathon offers runners an attractive and varied route through beautiful parkland, with no disruptive road crossings.
course_highlights: Flat, well-maintained 2 km loop through the castle park
Start and finish in the rose garden, with a view of the historic castle
No disruptive road crossings on the course
additional: The relay marathon consists of 21 laps of 2 km each, run in Rheda Castle Park. The course is flat and has no road crossings. Registration is available online. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which also runs other races. Photos and videos of previous relays are available on the website. Registration is via my.raceresult.com; the race is held as a relay marathon, and results are available on the day of the event.

name: Dorflauf TSV Wiera
description: Der 6. Dorflauf TSV Wiera findet am 5. Juli 2026 in Schwalmstadt statt und ist offiziell beim Deutschen Leichtathletik-Verband angemeldet. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufen über 600 Meter und 10 Kilometer an. Die Ergebnisse werden in den offiziellen Bestenlisten der Leichtathletik aufgenommen, was den Wettkampf besonders attraktiv für ambitionierte Läufer macht. Das Rennen findet bei typischem Juliwetter mit angenehmen Temperaturen und meist sonnigen Bedingungen statt.

name: SVE-Steinwiesenlauf
description: Der Steinwiesenlauf des SV Eidelstedt Hamburg ist ein beliebtes Lauf-Event, das jährlich zahlreiche Teilnehmer anzieht. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Läufe für alle Altersgruppen, vom Bambinilauf über Schüler- bis hin zu 5 km und 10 km Hauptläufen. Die Strecke führt unter anderem über eine Autobahnbrücke und bietet spannende Wettbewerbe mit familiärer Atmosphäre. Der Lauf findet traditionell am Wochenende statt und erfreut sich wachsender Teilnehmerzahlen.

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event held in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The race attracts runners from various categories and offers the chance to compete on a route combining road and off-road sections. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: A route combining road and off-road sections
Scenic surroundings of Wilkowo near Świebodzin
Professional electronic timing
additional: The event is organized by Super Sport, a company from Zielona Góra, which provides timing, race bib printing, and technical support. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Registration will be available at super-sport.com.pl, and the event attracts local runners and sports enthusiasts.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie
description: 34. Bieg po Plaży w Jarosławcu to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie. Zawody odbywają się na malowniczej trasie wzdłuż plaży, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe doświadczenie biegu nad morzem. Bieg przyciąga zarówno amatorów, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy, tworząc sportową atmosferę i promując aktywny wypoczynek. Impreza ma długą tradycję i jest ważnym wydarzeniem sportowym w regionie.

name: Gütersloh Läuft - für den guten Zweck
description: Gütersloh Läuft ist eine vielfältige Charity-Laufveranstaltung, die am 8. Juli 2026 im Stadtpark Gütersloh zum 18. Mal stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufe für alle Altersklassen, von Bambini- und Schulklassenläufen bis hin zu Nordic Walking, Firmen- und Einzelläufen sowie einem 10-km-Sommerabendlauf. Alle Teilnehmer unterstützen mit ihrer Startgebühr die Stiftung Deutsche Schlaganfall-Hilfe, da von jeder Anmeldung 1 Euro gespendet wird. Die Laufstrecken führen durch den schönen Stadtpark und bieten eine sportliche und gemeinschaftliche Atmosphäre für Hobby- und ambitionierte Läufer.

name: City-Sport-Abendlauf
description: Der City-Sport-Abendlauf in Rostock ist ein beliebter Sommerlauf, der jährlich im Barnstorfer Wald stattfindet. Hunderte Läuferinnen und Läufer treffen sich zu einem abendlichen Lauf, bei dem der Spaß am Laufen mit dem guten Zweck verbunden wird. Die Erlöse des Laufs werden an gemeinnützige Organisationen gespendet, zuletzt zugunsten des Rostocker Hospizes am Klinikum Südstadt. Der Lauf hat sich als fester Termin in der Rostocker Laufszene etabliert und erfreut sich wachsender Teilnehmerzahlen.

name: 4. Dorstener 24-Stunden-Lauf
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr beträgt pro Person 12,00 Euro

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Dorsten 24-Hour Run is a charity fundraising event held in Dorsten, near the city center, in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof. The course is about 1 km long and runs through a scenic park between the Lippe and the Wesel-Datteln Canal. Participants can run, walk or stroll for any amount of time during the 24 hours and complete as many laps as they choose. 100% of the entry fee goes into the donation fund, which supports various social organizations. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, from a few short laps to a half marathon or marathon.
course_highlights: Loop course of approximately 1 km in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof
Scenic route between the Lippe and the Wesel-Datteln Canal
Central location near Dorsten city center
additional: The event is a charity run, with 100% of all entry fees going into the donation fund. Participants are not required to run for 24 hours straight; everyone can decide for themselves how many laps to run, walk or stroll. The event is organized by interevent GmbH and supported by numerous local sponsors. Functional shirts can be ordered for 27,00 EUR. Start and finish are in the park; registration is available online and on site. Parking is available on Kurt-Schumacher-Straße and in the VHS multi-storey car park. Results for performances of 50 km or more are included in the rankings.

name: Borener Meile
description: The Borener Meile is a traditional 1,609.34-meter road race, taking place for the 35th time on July 10, 2026, as part of the Borener Dorftage in Boren. The race is organized by Borener SV, an active sports club on the Schlei with a particular focus on running and triathlon. The event offers runners a short, fast course and is a popular competition in the region. Results and photos from previous races are available on the website.
course_highlights: Road race over exactly 1,609.34 meters (one mile)
Traditional event held as part of the Borener Dorftage
Organized by the regional sports club Borener SV
additional: Road race, registration available, results and photos from previous events available

name: Roruper Abendlauf
description: The Rorup Evening Run is a long-standing running event in Rorup, a district of Dülmen in North Rhine-Westphalia, which has attracted runners every summer for more than three decades. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon as its premier event, as well as 10 km, 3 km, a schoolchildren’s race and a Pampers Run for children. The course is flat and paved, with a ten-kilometre loop that is completed once or twice depending on the distance. The finish is in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium, where runners complete a lap of the stadium before crossing the finish line. In addition to certificates and trophies, cash prizes are awarded to the top runners in the half marathon and 10 km race.
course_highlights: Flat, paved course
Ten-kilometre loop, with a longer first lap for the half marathon
Stadium lap before the finish at the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium
additional: All races start at the Rorup sports ground. Certificates are awarded to all finishers, trophies to the winners, and special prizes to the top three runners in each age group. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three male and female finishers in the half marathon and 10 km race. Courses are officially measured; online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; parking is available; refreshments are provided on the course; finish in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium.

name: Musköloppet
description: Musköloppet is a popular running race held in the spectacular archipelago setting of Muskö. The race has a long tradition and celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022, after being paused during the pandemic. There are several different courses and categories, including children’s races, and the event offers a wonderful nature experience, with the start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård. Late registration is available on site up to one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the beautiful archipelago setting of Muskö
Start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård
Children’s races over 1.5 km and 2.5 km for different age groups
additional: Late registration is available on site at the start and finish area up to one hour before the race begins. There are water stations along the course, and runners may arrange their own drinks. Race management may decide to restart the race if needed. Pacing assistance from non-competitors is not permitted. The children’s races start at 10:00 for 1.5 km (ages 7–10) and at 10:30 for 2.5 km (ages 11–14). The countdown on the official website indicates 10 July 2027. However, the published times and distances on the website are for 2026. The relay costs 150 kr per team, and the children’s race for ages 4–6 is free, according to the published information.

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is a unique running adventure and a journey to explore your inner landscape. It is not a traditional race, but a self-supported run around the beautiful island of Gotland, including a loop around Fårö, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants have 10 days to complete the approximately 511 km course, with support from four Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides basic support, while runners are responsible for their own food and accommodation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Visby, Gotland’s medieval capital
Clockwise loop around the island, including Fårö
Mixed terrain with asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter trails
additional: Participants must check in twice daily using an online tool. Accommodation on the first night is at Visby Fängelse Hostel in shared rooms. A pre-race dinner and briefing are held the evening before the start. Angel Stations offer support, water, rest, and sometimes shower facilities. The ferry to Fårö runs every 30 minutes, but requires a call between 22:00 and 05:30. The run must be completed on foot within 10 days, averaging approximately 51 km per day. Luggage storage is available at the hostel. Parking is available near the ferry terminal, with cheaper options at Visby Airport. This is a self-supported event: participants are responsible for most of their food and logistics. The entire distance must be completed on foot within ten days, with regular position reports.

name: Sommerlauf des LSV Porz
location: Gut Leidenhausen, Köln-Porz, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 2 € am Veranstaltungstag, sonst keine expliziten Angaben
description: The LSV Porz Summer Run is a popular race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreation area in Cologne-Porz. Held as the Ingeborg Urbach Memorial Run, it offers distances from 1 km to 5 km for competitive runners and recreational joggers. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for official best lists, with the 5 km loop considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne. The entry fee also supports Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School.
course_highlights: Race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreation area
5 km and 10 km courses measured by the DLV and eligible for official best lists
The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
additional: The registration deadline is 23.06.2026. Late registration is possible on the event day for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the late registration fee. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Race numbers must be worn on the chest. €1 per participant is donated to Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School. Terrain in the Leidenhausen recreation area, registration by SEPA direct debit, race number worn on the chest, medals for all pre-registered participants, awards ceremonies for the top runners, certificates available online

name: Wybelsumer Polderlauf
description: The Wybelsumer Polder Run is a running event for children and adults held at the Wybelsum sports ground in Emden. Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V., the event offers a sporting opportunity for the whole family in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. It is part of Emden’s diverse events calendar and promotes the local community and sport.
course_highlights: Running event for children and adults
Venue: Wybelsum sports ground, Emden
Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V.
additional: The event includes various running distances for all age groups and is a popular regional event in the Krummhörn region.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: Der SCB Langendamm lädt zum 4. Bergheide-Cross 2026 ein. Die Strecke führt vom Zufahrtsweg des Schützenhauses des örtlichen Kleinkalibervereins über das Naherholungs- und Landschaftsschutzgebiet "Osterberg". Der Lauf bietet drei Streckenlängen für verschiedene Wertungs- und Altersklassen sowie Walking auf der kürzeren Strecke. Zusätzlich gibt es einen Schülerlauf über 1000 Meter für Kinder und Jugendliche. Die Veranstaltung ist vom DLV genehmigt und findet am 11. Juli 2026 ab 16:00 Uhr statt.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka to bieg na 10 km organizowany w Bukowcu, który przyciąga biegaczy pragnących zmierzyć się z trasą o umiarkowanym stopniu trudności. Każdy uczestnik, który przekroczy linię mety, otrzyma pamiątkowy medal. Biuro zawodów znajduje się w hali sportowej w Bukowcu, co zapewnia wygodę organizacyjną. Zapraszamy wszystkich miłośników biegania do udziału w tym wydarzeniu, które łączy sportową rywalizację z lokalną atmosferą.

name: Semesterhalvmaran
location: Torps herrgård, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Semesterhalvmaran is a recurring running event organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, inviting runners to experience the beautiful open landscapes of the Närke Plain. The race starts and finishes at Torps herrgård outside Kumla and offers a lovely running experience on gravel roads among rolling grain fields. After a two-year break, the race returns on July 11, 2027, welcoming runners of all levels to take part in a community filled with the joy of running. LK Gränslöst is an inclusive club that aims to bring runners from across the country together and build a strong community around running.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torps herrgård outside Kumla
Run on gravel roads among rolling grain fields on the Närke Plain
Beautiful, nature-rich surroundings on the Närke Plain
additional: Registration is planned to open in January. The race is organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, which also organizes other races and group training every Wednesday at 18:00 in Örebro. The club focuses on community and the joy of running for all levels.

description: The Dodenau Volkslauf is a recreational running event open to everyone, starting and finishing at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall in Battenberg-Dodenau. The event offers a range of distances from Bambini races to a half marathon, as well as Nordic walking. To be included in the rankings, participants must belong to an athletics club or an LG. Online registration is available until about one week before the race; late registration is possible at the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall
Distances for Bambini, short, middle and long races, as well as a half marathon
Nordic walking over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registration at the start is possible from 07:45 until 45 minutes before the respective start. To be included in the rankings, participants must provide their club or LG on the registration form. description: The 41st Pönitz Volkslauf takes place on 12 July 2026 in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers and Nordic walkers to a sporting and social event. The course runs through the scenic Holstein Switzerland, with romantic hedgerows, summer fields and peaceful meadows. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, show performances and an awards ceremony at the Pönitz Sports Park. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and attractive prizes are awarded to the winners.
course_highlights: Scenery of Holstein Switzerland, with hedgerows, fields and meadows
Start and finish at Pönitz Sports Park, with a summer atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the venue
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal. The awards ceremony begins at 11:15, with medals for the overall winners (places 1–3) and trophies and certificates for age-group winners and finishers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions and spectators. Runners can choose between the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and Nordic walking. Starts are from 8:30. A shared experience of community and nature.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: Der Barigauer Turmlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Oberhain bei Königsee, der am 12. Juli 2026 stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern eine attraktive Strecke mit landschaftlich reizvollen Abschnitten rund um den Barigauer Turm. Der Lauf richtet sich an ambitionierte Läufer und Laufbegeisterte, die eine sportliche Herausforderung in einer naturnahen Umgebung suchen. Die Organisation erfolgt durch den Laufverein Königsee, der für eine familiäre Atmosphäre und einen reibungslosen Ablauf sorgt.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a city race of approximately 6.3 km that takes place in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The race offers a scenic course along the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken, passing landmarks including the Stegeholm Castle ruins and Myntbryggan. After finishing, participants receive a medal as proof of their participation. The race is a popular summer tradition that welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A city race of approximately 6.3 km in central Västervik
The course follows the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken and passes the Stegeholm Castle ruins
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: A children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) of 800 m for children up to 10 years old, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. Participants receive medals after finishing. A separate Sparbanksloppet of approximately 700 metres is offered for children up to 10 years old. Registration for the 2027 race opens on 1 May.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!

name: Victorialoppet
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival held every year in Borgholm on Öland. The event offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including a 9 km main race, the 4 km Victoriajoggen, the 2 km Lilla Victorialoppet, and Mini, a 1.5 km race for the youngest participants. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful views along the shore and an enthusiastic crowd creating a wonderful atmosphere. The event is a popular celebration, with music along the course and a strong commitment to the Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run 9 km course with views along the shore
Music at several locations along the course
Courses adapted for all ages and abilities
additional: Bib pickup takes place on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholms Sporthall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholms Sporthall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive medals, commemorative plaques, ice cream, and drinks, depending on the race. Timing uses disposable chips for most races; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the parasport categories. There are also parasport and youth categories. Water is available along the 9 km course, and changing rooms and showers are provided at Borgholms Sporthall and Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Fees vary depending on the race and registration date; an administration fee applies.

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Die Altra Sunset Hamburg findet am Mittwoch, den 15. Juli 2026, im Wilhelmsburger Inselpark statt. Der Lauf bietet einen reizvollen ca. 5 km langen Rundkurs aus Asphalt und Wegen, der 1 bis 3 Mal gelaufen werden kann, sodass Distanzen von ca. 5 km, 10 km oder 15 km möglich sind. Die Teilnehmer können am Veranstaltungstag flexibel die gewünschte Rundenanzahl absolvieren, wobei ein Kontrollpunkt die Runden zählt. Zusätzlich gibt es einen Staffellauf, bei dem die Strecke viermal gelaufen wird, mit Teams von 2 bis 4 Läufer*innen. Die Veranstaltung ist offen für alle, die trainiert sind und keine ärztlichen Bedenken haben, eine Vereinszugehörigkeit ist nicht erforderlich.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
description: Der Lauf um und am Gartower See ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die am Nordufer des Gartower Sees in Gartow stattfindet. Die Strecke bietet eine naturnahe Kulisse mit Blick auf den See und die umliegenden Gartower Tannen, ideal für Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Altersklassen. Die Veranstaltung wird vom Sportverein SV Gartow organisiert, der seit 1946 für sportliches Engagement und Gemeinschaft in der Region steht. Start und Ziel liegen zentral im Ort, was eine familiäre und einladende Atmosphäre schafft.

name: Kraftprovet
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Trollhättans SOK
description: Kraftprovet is a classic city race in Trollhättan, offering a unique running experience along the canal area, with leafy paths, hilly terrain and beautiful views of the Göta älv, the locks and historic power stations. The race is a festival for everyone, with both elite runners and recreational runners taking part, while cheers from the crowd and music along the course add to the atmosphere. With more than 40 years of tradition, Kraftprovet brings the city, nature and people together during Fallens Dagar. There are several races to choose from, ranging from 800 metres to 11.6 kilometres, including a fun costume competition and an untimed Fun Run category.
course_highlights: The course follows the canal area, with varied and hilly terrain
Beautiful views of the Göta älv, the locks and historic power stations
Crowd support, music and a festive atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Start and finish at Hansenplatsen in Trollhättan. A race bib with your first name is available if you register by 30 June. A T-shirt can be ordered when registering by 15 May; it is included in some races and costs extra in others. Runners who finish in under 50 minutes (men) or 55 minutes (women) receive a silver medal. Pacers are available for finish times of 50, 55, 60 and 65 minutes. Costume competition with prizes before the start. Showers and changing facilities are available about 1 km from the finish at Arena Älvhögsborg. Water stations with Umara sports drink and water are available along the course.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://kraftprovet.se/deltagarinfo/): 2027-07-16 — "Datum 16 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-16)

name: Kölner Zoolauf
description: The Cologne Zoo Run is a unique running event at Cologne Zoo, taking place for the 13th time on July 17, 2026. It offers four different races for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to challenging 10 km races. The course runs through the zoo and past numerous animal enclosures, making the run a special experience. Official timing and certificates are included for most races, and the event places great emphasis on safety and family-friendliness.
course_highlights: A 1.62 km loop through Cologne Zoo, with views of numerous animal enclosures
Choose to run between 1 and 6 laps (1.6 km to 10.05 km)
Start and finish in front of the main entrance to Cologne Zoo
additional: Start times: BambiniLauf 18:15, KidsLauf 18:30, TopLauf 19:00, FunLauf 20:15. A requested bib number is available for an additional €3. On-site late registration is possible up to and including event day, with a €5 late-registration fee. Participation with dogs, strollers, walking poles, or music devices is not permitted. Official timing is provided for all races except the BambiniLauf. Certificates can be printed online. Safety and supervision of children in the start and finish areas are organized. Four race types (Bambini, Kids, Top, Fun); online registration; no refunds for non-participation; participation requires a bib number and timing chip; participation with dogs or headphones is not permitted.

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place on July 18, 2026, as part of Sports Promotion Week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, the race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners looking to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sports Promotion Week 2026
additional: The Oyler Berglauf is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026, which takes place from 18.07.2026 to 26.07.2026 at Sportplatz Oyle. The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details, start times, or wave information have been published on the website. The event is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026 and takes place at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 1. Stoppelfeld Ultra
description: Der Stoppelfeld Ultra 2026 ist ein klassischer Backyard-Ultra-Lauf, der am 18. und 19. Juli 2026 in Kerpen-Blatzheim stattfindet. Bei diesem besonderen Ausdauerformat geht es nicht um Geschwindigkeit, sondern um die Fähigkeit, jede Stunde eine 6,706 Kilometer lange Runde innerhalb von 60 Minuten zu absolvieren und pünktlich zur vollen Stunde wieder zu starten. Die Strecke führt überwiegend über Feld- und Wirtschaftswege rund um Blatzheim mit Start und Ziel am Bolzplatz Blatzheim. Das Event ist auf 50 Teilnehmer begrenzt und verspricht eine familiäre Atmosphäre sowie eine große mentale und körperliche Herausforderung.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: Der 22. Wiesenlauf am 18. Juli 2026 in Klein Meckelsen bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern die Möglichkeit, auf offiziell vermessenen und DLV-genehmigten Strecken über 5 und 10 Kilometer anzutreten. Die Veranstaltung umfasst Kreismeisterschaften über beide Distanzen sowie eine Bezirksmeisterschaft über 5 Kilometer, mit Wertung ab der Altersklasse M/W 14. Start und Ziel befinden sich am Sportplatz Klein Meckelsen, und die Veranstaltung ist sowohl für ambitionierte Wettkämpfer als auch für Volksläufer geeignet.

name: Spendenlauf Recke
description: Der Spendenlauf Recke am 18. Juli 2026 ist eine Benefizveranstaltung zugunsten der Kinderkrebshilfe Münster. Veranstaltet von Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG und der Firma Lewe aus Recke, bietet der Lauf zwei Streckenlängen: 5 Kilometer für Laufanfänger und entspannte Läufer sowie 10 Kilometer für erfahrene Läufer, die eine größere Herausforderung suchen. Der Fokus liegt auf dem gemeinsamen Einsatz für den guten Zweck, wobei die gesamte Startgebühr gespendet wird. Die Veranstaltung verbindet sportliches Engagement mit sozialem Verantwortungsbewusstsein und lädt alle ein, mitzumachen und zu unterstützen.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko to wyjątkowy bieg trailowy odbywający się 18 lipca 2026 roku na malowniczych terenach Wysoczyzny Elbląskiej nad Zalewem Wiślanym. Trasa prowadzi przez dzikie szlaki, zróżnicowane przewyższenia i cichą, naturalną scenerię, oferując biegaczom kontakt z przyrodą i historią regionu. Impreza jest częścią ogólnopolskiego cyklu biegów górskich, który promuje aktywność fizyczną w harmonii z naturą, skierowana zarówno do początkujących, jak i doświadczonych ultramaratończyków. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację, zabezpieczenie medyczne oraz bogaty pakiet startowy.

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn
distance_verbose: Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7.5 km
description: The Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn is a unique running event held on a summer evening through the shady forests of the Veluwe around Apeldoorn. The race offers five distances, ranging from 7.5 km to the full marathon of 42.195 km, with the start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos. The routes mostly follow wide Veluwe paths and forest trails across varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain, making for a challenging and atmospheric experience. Start times are scheduled so that you run into the evening and finish well before sunset, giving the race a special summer ambience.
course_highlights: Run through the shady forests of the Veluwe
Varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain and one-quarter unpaved
Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos, with the finish in daylight
additional: All five distances start later in the day so you can run into the summer evening. The marathon has a time limit of 5 hours, and participants may bring their own cycling companion to provide support along the course. Parking is free and within walking distance of the start location. Registration includes a finisher’s medal and a Midzomer shirt. On the day, you can switch your entry to a shorter distance free of charge at the event office. The event also relies on volunteers to help with various tasks. Five distances: 7.5 km, 14 km, half marathon, 28 km and marathon; cycling companions are allowed for the half and full marathons; facilities include water and fruit stations, free parking and public transport connections.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: Der Barther Flughafenlauf findet am 19. Juli 2026 am Ostseeflughafen Stralsund-Barth statt und bietet mit sieben Wettkämpfen ein vielfältiges Angebot für Läufer und Walker aller Altersklassen. Von kurzen Strecken für den Laufnachwuchs bis hin zur Halbmarathondistanz ist für jeden etwas dabei. Die Veranstaltung verspricht einen Vormittag voller Bewegung, Spaß und spannender Rennen in einer einzigartigen Atmosphäre direkt am Flughafen. Walker sind ebenfalls herzlich willkommen, und für das leibliche Wohl ist vor Ort gesorgt.

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy to wyjątkowe wydarzenie biegowe odbywające się 19 lipca 2026 roku na malowniczej trasie prowadzącej przez miejscowości Rozewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra i ponownie Rozewie. Festiwal oferuje różnorodne dystanse: maraton, półmaraton oraz biegi na 15 km, 10 km i 5 km, dzięki czemu każdy biegacz, niezależnie od poziomu zaawansowania, znajdzie odpowiednią trasę dla siebie. Start maratonu o godzinie 04:35 pozwala uczestnikom doświadczyć niezwykłego klimatu wschodu słońca nad Kaszubami. Po biegach organizatorzy zapewniają poczęstunek oraz losowanie nagród, co tworzy festynową i integracyjną atmosferę.

name: Amsterdam Pride Run
description: The Amsterdam Pride Run is a colorful and inclusive running event held during the Pride Amsterdam festivities. Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports, it offers a sporting celebration of diversity and equality. The run takes place in the city of Amsterdam and attracts a broad range of runners and supporters who come together to support the LGBTQ+ community. The atmosphere is festive and unifying, with an emphasis on sportsmanship and inclusion.
course_highlights: Running route through central Amsterdam
Inclusive and festive atmosphere during Pride Amsterdam
Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports
additional: The Amsterdam Pride Run takes place in the afternoon during Pride Amsterdam, with an entry fee ranging from €8 to €18. The event is part of a broader program of queer sports activities organized by Pride and Sports. It has a festive and safe atmosphere, with an emphasis on inclusion and sportsmanship. Route through Flevopark and along the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal; several race options, including a walk and a business run; a colorful and inclusive event during World Pride

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmühlenlauf takes place on 24 July 2026 in Bokel. This long-standing anniversary race is organised by ALG-VfL Bokel. The number of participants is limited to 300, and registration is via the RaceResult platform. The race offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for enthusiasts of endurance sports and athletics.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, children's race)
Local club atmosphere
Limited to 300 runners
additional: The number of places is limited to 300. The organisational fee covers provision costs and is non-refundable, including in cases of force majeure. Registration is via RaceResult; places are limited to 300. Date: 24.07.2026

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run “Through the Wewer Forest” in Paderborn is a community run with no timing and no entry fee, taking place on 24 July 2026. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and asks participants to donate instead. The races take place on flat loop courses with little elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. There are also races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Flat loop course (one lap)
Little elevation gain (30 to 40 metres uphill)
Distance options: 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run with no timing and no entry fee; donations are requested instead. There are races for children and young people. The finish location is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Runs on flat loop courses, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable causes.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: Der Heilwald-Marathon in Bad Lippspringe ist ein besonderer Lauf, der inmitten des 200 Hektar großen Heilwalds stattfindet, einem europaweit einzigartigen Erholungs- und Therapiewald mit einem beruhigenden Mittelgebirgsklima. Die Strecke besteht aus sechs großen Runden à 7,05 km, die insgesamt 42,3 km ergeben und wurde sorgfältig mit Messrad und GPS vermessen. Die Veranstaltung ist eine private Laufveranstaltung mit Selbstversorgung, bei der die Zeit per Hand gestoppt wird und ein Foto der Uhr als Nachweis eingereicht werden muss. Die Teilnahme erfolgt auf eigenes Risiko, und es gibt keine Startgebühr, stattdessen wird um eine freiwillige Spende für Baumpflanzungen gebeten.

name: 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf
description: Der 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf findet am 24. Juli 2026 statt und bietet Läufern ein besonderes Erlebnis mit Startzeiten am späten Abend. Die Hauptstrecke führt über 10 km durch die Stadt Heiligenhafen, entlang der Uferpromenade und rund um den Binnensee, mit viel Unterstützung an der Strecke. Zusätzlich gibt es weitere Wettbewerbe wie den Binnenseelauf (ca. 5,5 km), die Mitternachtslauf-Doppelmeile (ca. 3,2 km) für Jugendliche und den Mini-Mitternachtslauf (ca. 1 km) für Kinder. Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSV Heiligenhafen organisiert und ist eine beliebte Tradition mit elektronischer Zeitnahme und einem stimmungsvollen Programm am Veranstaltungstag.

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt is a traditional running race around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied Öland countryside. The race offers several distances for both young people and adults, including a walking class. Along the course, participants pass gravel roads with limestone surfaces, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each class.
course_highlights: The race goes around Öland’s only inland lake
Varied terrain including gravel roads, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes
Three water stations along the course, as well as at the start/finish
additional: A walking class is available for 5.5 km and 11 km, with start times between 13:00 and 16:00 and no timing. Showers and changing facilities are available at Högby Idrottsplats. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all classes. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön. Youth classes have different start times between 15:30 and 16:00, depending on age and distance. There are distances for children and young people, as well as an untimed walking class. Everyone who finishes receives a medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/hornsjon-runt/): 2027-07-24 — "Tid & datum 24 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Bjäre Trail
price_range: 195–425 kr (2026 års ordinarie tidiga anmälningsavgifter; priser för 2027 ej bekräftade)
description: Bjäre Trail is a challenging trail race featuring varied terrain through grazing pastures, old railway embankments and dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls. Runners face steep hills, including an old ski slope, and are rewarded with spectacular views of Laholmsbukten, the northern side of the Bjäre Peninsula and the Halland coastline. The race is held at Båstad Företagsby and welcomes both experienced trail runners and nature lovers looking for a tough, scenic course.
course_highlights: Highly varied terrain with grazing pastures and an old railway embankment
Dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls
Steep hills with views of Laholmsbukten and the Bjäre Peninsula
additional: Maximum 300 starters. Late entries are accepted on site on race day for an additional fee of 100 kr, payable only in even-numbered cash amounts or by SWISH. Bibs must be collected no later than one hour before the start at the start/finish area, or at Bjäre bär’s farm shop on Friday. Toilets are available at Företagsbyn, but there are no changing rooms or showers. Everyone who finishes receives a wooden plaque; winners in each class receive raspberries sponsored by Bjäre bär. Distances are 12, 17, 34 and 51 km. The 34 km and 51 km races consist of two and three laps respectively of the 17 km loop. The race information states a maximum of 300 participants.

name: ÖTILLÖ Gothenburg
description: ÖTILLÖ Swimrun Gothenburg is a unique swimrun race held at the height of summer in Gothenburg’s beautiful archipelago. The race is rooted in a strong local swimrun tradition and features a spectacular course with numerous swims and varied running terrain across islands and rocks. The event is easy to reach by ferry from the mainland and offers a fantastic combination of nature experiences and spectator support. It is a perfect race for both experienced swimrunners and curious participants who want to experience the sport in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: A combination of fast running sections and intense swims
A course through the West Coast archipelago of Gothenburg, with many islands and islets
Magnificent coastal and archipelago scenery, with plenty of spectators along the course
additional: The race offers three distances: World Series (approx. 39.7 km with 29 running sections and 28 swims), Sprint (approx. 22.8 km with 18 running sections and 17 swims), and Experience. The start and finish are at Styrsö Bratten. Ferries run regularly from Saltholmen and Stenpiren to the event area. Mandatory equipment is available to buy at the start/finish area. A large team of volunteers helps out along the course and at the event. The awards ceremony takes place after the race. Check-in is at Styrsöskolan. The event offers the Experience, Sprint, and World Series distances.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://otilloswimrun.com/races/gothenburg-sweden/gothenburg-world-series/): 2027-07-24 — "saturday, July 24th, 2027 ... 08:11 Start World Series" (was estimated 2027-07-31)

name: 10. NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf
price_range: 25 EUR für Erwachsene, 20 EUR für Kids
description: The NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf is a maritime race held annually on the North Sea island of Norderney since 2016. The event offers a unique running experience amid the island’s natural surroundings and special atmosphere. The routes pass through the historic Kurplatz and by landmarks such as Napoleonschanze, Schwanenteich and the island windmill. The race is suitable for all age groups and includes distances from the Bambini Run to the half marathon.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kurplatz, beside the Conversationshaus and Badehaus
Past Napoleonschanze, the oldest monument on Norderney
Through the lively shopping streets, with spectators cheering runners on
additional: The official technical T-shirt can be ordered during registration and is distributed with the race pack. It costs EUR 25 for adults and EUR 20 for children. Late entries are possible online until 22.07.2026 for a fee, and in person on 24 and 25.07.2026. Timing is by ChampionChip; chip rental costs between EUR 3 and EUR 5, depending on the race. A preferred race number is available for an additional EUR 3. Cut-off times: 1:15h for 10 km and 2:30h for the half marathon. Island and maritime theme, sustainable technical T-shirt, in-person registration, online results, ferry connections for participants, test run on the day before the race, certificates and medals for children

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: Der GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon ist ein 50 km langer Trail-Lauf, der in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Deutschland startet. Die Strecke weist eine geringe Höhendifferenz von etwa 350 Metern auf und muss innerhalb von 8 Stunden bewältigt werden. Der Kurs führt durch Wald- und Pfadabschnitte, vorbei am Brelinger Berg mit seinem geologischen Naturlehrpfad und zurück entlang des Bissendorfer Moors. Die Veranstaltung ist beim Deutschen Ultramarathonverband registriert und bietet Online-Ergebnisse, Urkunden sowie Finisher-Medaillen.

name: FriesenCross
description: Der Friesencross in Schillig ist eines der außergewöhnlichsten Crosslauf-Events Deutschlands und findet am 25. Juli 2026 statt. Die Strecke führt direkt am Strand entlang und bietet ein einzigartiges Naturerlebnis entlang des UNESCO-Weltnaturerbes Wattenmeer. Die Läufer:innen durchqueren weichen Sandstrand, grüne Wiesen und sogar den schlickigen Meeresboden, was sportliche Herausforderung und Nordseefeeling perfekt verbindet. Begleitet wird das Event von Lauf-Sport-Moderator Heino Krüger, der mit viel Erfahrung durch den Tag führt. Parallel zum Lauf findet das Friesenfestival statt, das für Stimmung, Musik und kulinarische Highlights sorgt.

name: Mulsumer Speckenlauf
description: Der Mulsumer Speckenlauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die jährlich vom TSV Mulsum ausgerichtet wird. Die Veranstaltung findet auf dem Sportplatz Mulsum in der Wurster Nordseeküste statt und zieht zahlreiche Läuferinnen und Läufer an. Die Strecke bietet eine sportliche Herausforderung und wird von einer freundlichen Atmosphäre begleitet. Neben dem Hauptlauf gibt es auch ein Kinder-Sportfest mit klassischen Disziplinen, das den familiären Charakter der Veranstaltung unterstreicht.

name: 26. Bieg Dookoła Morynia i Jeziora Morzycko
description: Zapraszamy na 26. edycję Biegu Dookoła Morynia i Jeziora Morzycko, wyjątkowego wydarzenia łączącego sportową rywalizację z pięknem Pomorza Zachodniego. Trasa biegu prowadzi malowniczym szlakiem wokół Jeziora Morzycko, oferując uczestnikom niezapomniane widoki i atmosferę sportowej wspólnoty. To doskonała okazja dla biegaczy i miłośników aktywnego stylu życia, aby spotkać się w Moryniu i cieszyć się ruchem na świeżym powietrzu. Niezależnie od doświadczenia, każdy znajdzie tu coś dla siebie.

name: 24 Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba
description: 24. Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba to coroczna impreza sportowa organizowana w Lęborku, mająca na celu uczczenie patrona miasta. Bieg odbywa się na atestowanej trasie o długości 10 km, prowadzącej ulicami miasta i odpowiednio zabezpieczonej przez służby porządkowe. Start honorowy odbywa się na placu Pokoju, a start ostry na ulicy Armii Krajowej. Meta znajduje się na placu Pokoju przed sceną. Zawodnicy muszą mieć ukończone 16 lat i przestrzegać zasad ruchu drogowego.

location: Hel, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Moore DRV Run Maasdijk

description: The Moore DRV Run Maasdijk is a friendly running race in the Westland, held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk. The main distance is 10 kilometres on a traffic-free, fast asphalt course through the polder and along iconic dikes. There is also a 5 km race, the 5 van DAEL, and a youth run for children up to 12 years old. After the finish, participants receive an original running shirt and excellent refreshments at the atmospheric finish field.
course_highlights: Traffic-free course through the polder and along dikes
Entirely paved, fast asphalt course with water stations
Iconic finish location in the village of Maasdijk
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 10:30 at the canteen of korfbalvereniging Dijkvogels, Lange Kruisweg 44F in Maasdijk. The 5 km starts at 14:00, followed by the 10 km at 14:10. Changing and shower facilities are available at the korfbalvereniging. Results are recorded using a SAW chip, which costs €4.50 as a one-time fee and is not included in the entry fee. The youth run takes place without a chip. The race is held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk and offers a friendly atmosphere for all ages, including youth activities and special keepsakes for participants.

name: Volkswandertag
description: Der Volkswandertag in Bollensen ist eine jährlich am letzten Sonntag im Juli stattfindende Veranstaltung, die Wanderfreunden aller Altersgruppen offensteht. Angeboten werden verschiedene familienfreundliche Strecken, die über Waldwege durch das schöne Solling-Gebiet führen. Die Marathon- und Halbmarathonwanderungen sind Rundkurse mit Start und Ziel am Sportheim des TSV Bollensen, alle Strecken sind markiert und bieten Verpflegungsstationen. Die Veranstaltung ist geprägt von einer gemütlichen Atmosphäre mit Essen und Trinken im Zielbereich und einem starken Gemeinschaftsgefühl.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy to coroczna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w malowniczej miejscowości Dąbki w województwie zachodniopomorskim. Wydarzenie promuje aktywność fizyczną i zdrowy styl życia, a także walory Uzdrowiska Dąbki i Gminy Darłowo. W ramach imprezy odbywają się biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży, bieg na 10 km oraz specjalne biegi towarzyszące, takie jak Uzdrowiskowa Mila Morska. Organizatorzy zapewniają bogaty program i atrakcyjne nagrody, a trasa biegu prowadzi przez urokliwe tereny uzdrowiskowe.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia to bieg na dystansie 5 km organizowany w malowniczym Ogrodzie Dendrologicznym w Przelewicach. To doskonała okazja, aby połączyć aktywność fizyczną z relaksem w otoczeniu zieleni i przyrody. Wydarzenie odbywa się w ramach cyklu Botaniczna Piątka i jest współorganizowane przez Województwo Zachodniopomorskie. Uczestnicy otrzymują pamiątkowy medal w kształcie Lilii Wodnej, a start głównego biegu zaplanowano na godzinę 10:00.

location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 39e Kooyman Polderloop
description: The Kooyman Polderloop is an annual running race in De Kwakel, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer. This popular race takes place during a beautiful summer of sport and attracts many participants, including many AVA members. The event offers an enjoyable, sporty evening with a challenging course through the polder landscape. It is a fixture in the region and is known for its friendly, accessible atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the distinctive polder landscape
Evening race with a sporty, welcoming atmosphere
Organized by the local athletics club, AVA Aalsmeer
additional: The start is usually at AVA, Sportlaan 43, Aalsmeer. There is a sociable post-race gathering with coffee or tea in the clubhouse. The club also organizes walking groups and running courses, strengthening the sporting community. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the event is part of the Polderfeest, which features activities such as food festivals, performances, and family activities over several days.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: Der Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf am 31. Juli 2026 bietet einen vermessenen 5 km-Rundkurs am Fuße des Kleinen Deisters. Die Strecke ist vom Deutschen Leichtathletik-Verband (DLV) genehmigt, sodass die Ergebnisse in Bestenlisten aufgenommen werden können. Die Kilometrierung ist gut ausgeschildert, und das Streckenprofil ist leicht hügelig mit einer Höhendifferenz von etwa 20 Metern. Der Lauf startet um 17:45 Uhr am Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe und richtet sich an Läufer, die eine attraktive und offizielle Laufveranstaltung in der Region suchen.

name: Falkenbergs Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 450 kr fram till och med 20:e juli 2027

description: Falkenbergs Stadslopp is a 10 km city race that passes through central Falkenberg and beautiful summer scenery. The race is a community celebration and a running highlight in Halland, welcoming both beginners and experienced runners. The course is fast and easy to run, with fantastic crowd support along the way. The start and finish are both at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats, creating a smooth and enjoyable overall experience for participants.
course_highlights: 10 km through central Falkenberg and beautiful summer scenery
Fast, easy-to-run course with two water stations along the route
Start and finish at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats, with good facilities and crowd support
additional: The start and finish are both at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats. A warm-up with Nordic Wellness takes place at 11:40 in the start area. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:00 in the finish area. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia on the Thursday and Friday before the race, and on race day from 9:00. Changing rooms and bag drop are available on race day. Massage is offered in the finish area after the race. Falkenbergs Stadslopp is the 2027 district championship and is part of Tour de Falkenberg. Start groups are marked with flags according to runners’ estimated pace per kilometre, for safety. The kiosk is open 10:00–14:00. There are two water stations on the course, at 3 km and 8 km, as well as one at the finish.

description: Bruksleden Trail Marathon is a trail race organised by Fagersta OK, offering two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan). The race follows the beautiful Bruksleden trail through forests, winding paths and past lakes, with varied and technically challenging terrain. With a limited number of 200 places, the event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers, and after the finish, showers and a light meal are available. This is an ideal race for experienced trail runners and curious recreational runners alike who want to enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful forests and along winding woodland trails
Pass sparkling lakes
Varied and technically challenging terrain with steep climbs and descents
additional: Places are limited to 200 to preserve a friendly atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers. Showers and a light meal are available after the finish. Previous editions have started and finished in the area around Fageråsen/Fagersta; the arrangements, distances and practical information for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: PRB (Växjö)
description: PRB is a challenging and tactical running race where participants run a 6,706-metre course, with a start every hour on the hour. To continue in the race, runners must start each lap, in accordance with last-man-standing rules and Backyard Ultra standards. The course is easy to run and varied, with asphalt and gravel/trail sections. It is located on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö, with good opportunities to rest and access services in the lap area. Participants can enjoy a scenic setting close to a playground, skatepark, swimming area and café. After completing at least one lap, runners receive a medal and a finisher beer as a reward.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre course with approximately 35 metres of elevation gain
Each lap has approximately 3 km of asphalt, with the rest on gravel/trail
Starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting together
additional: The lap area offers an energy table with sports drink, water, Coca-Cola, coffee, sweets, crisps and fruit. A cooked meal is served every six hours, starting after four hours. There is space to set up a reclining chair and a small tent. Recommended parking costs 10 kr/day and is located at ICA Kvantum Teleborg. Littering results in immediate disqualification. The nearest bus stop is Trummenvägen by ICA, served by route 3. Backyard Ultra format, with a start every hour on the hour and last-man-standing rules. A previous edition was described as a Silver Ticket event.

name: HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf, 46. Int. Volkslauf mit HM
description: The HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf in Duisburg is a traditional road race with a flat course along the Rhine. On 25 July 2026, events will be held over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The flat course makes the race appealing to runners of all abilities. All events share the same finish line, and the event offers a pleasant atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Rhine
Events over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon
All events finish at the same location
additional: Start times: 7.5 km walking at 15:00, 5 km run at 16:50, 10 km run at 17:40, half marathon at 17:30. All events take place on a flat course. Results will be published on the RUNME results page. The event takes place on 25 July 2026 and offers start times for various events. Results will be available shortly after the races finish. The event is particularly appealing in good weather.

name: Sechs-Std.-Lauf am Förderturm Bönen
location: Ehemaliges Zechengelände, Bönen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Run at the Bönen Headframe is a unique ultrarunning event held on an officially measured loop course at a former colliery site. The course is traffic-free, gently undulating, and consists of asphalt and compact gravel. The event offers comprehensive refreshments, including vegan options, and professional lap counting via race result. With a minimum age of 20, the run is aimed at experienced ultrarunners who want to test their endurance in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop course at a former colliery site, traffic-free
Lap length: 1,340 m; surface: asphalt and compact gravel
Officially measured course with gentle undulations
additional: Race bib pickup on event day from 07:00 to 08:30. Showers and changing facilities are available at the nearby Goethe Sports Hall and in the Förderturm Shaft Hall (not supervised; no liability is accepted). A variety of food and drinks, including vegan options, will be provided before and during the run. Laps are counted electronically via race result, with measurement of the remaining distance. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross local branch in Bönen (DRK-Ortsverein Bönen e.V.). Awards ceremony at approximately 16:00. Minimum age: 20. Maximum 200 participants; on-site registration is possible for a €10 fee. Loop course at a former colliery site, vegan refreshments, race bib pickup 07:00–08:30, minimum age 20.

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international charity run, with entry fees donated to a good cause. There are different distances for children, beginners and experienced runners, taking them through Bredstedt’s town centre. The event fosters community spirit and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is online, and the entry fees are moderate to make it accessible to as many people as possible.
course_highlights: Different routes for children, beginners and experienced runners
Run through Bredstedt’s town centre
International charity run
additional: Registration is online only, until 30.07., at www.my.raceresult.com. Entry fees are donated. Note: The event information PDF is currently not accessible. Several distances for different ability levels; event in August 2026; children participate for free, adults pay up to 5 euros.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: Der Ottonenlauf ist ein Landschaftslauf im Harz, der Läufer aus drei verschiedenen Dörfern zu einem gemeinsamen Ziel in der UNESCO-Weltkulturerbestadt Quedlinburg führt. Die Streckenlängen von 21,1 km, 42,2 km und 69 km starten jeweils in Stiege, Alexisbad und Meisdorf. Die Route verläuft überwiegend auf Wald- und Forstwegen durch das Selketal mit schattigen Wäldern, ländlichen Abschnitten und moderaten Steigungen, die ein gutes Tempo erfordern. Neben dem Lauf gibt es auch Walking- und Nordic-Walking-Optionen, sodass das Event für eine breite Läuferschaft offen ist. Elektronische Zeitmessung und Medaillen für Finisher runden das Angebot ab.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: Die hella marathon nacht rostock ist ein stimmungsvoller Sonnenuntergangslauf vor malerischer Kulisse an der Haedgehalbinsel im Rostocker Stadthafen. Die Veranstaltung bietet Wettbewerbe über Marathon, Halbmarathon, Rostocker 7 km und einen Schülerlauf, die alle in der Dämmerung starten und im hell erleuchteten Ziel enden. Die Strecke führt unter anderem durch den Warnowtunnel und den IGA-Park und wird verkehrsfrei gehalten. Die Veranstaltung verbindet sportliche Herausforderung mit norddeutscher Gastlichkeit und Urlaubslaune.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: Die hella marathon nacht rostock ist ein stimmungsvoller Sonnenuntergangslauf entlang der Warnow mit maritimem Flair und hanseatischer Gastlichkeit. Die Veranstaltung findet im August in Rostock statt und bietet Wettbewerbe über Marathon, Halbmarathon, Rostocker 7 und einen Schülerlauf. Start und Ziel befinden sich im Rostocker Stadthafen, wo die Läufer:innen in der Dämmerung starten und im hell erleuchteten Ziel finishen. Die Strecke führt unter anderem durch den Warnowtunnel und den IGA Park, was für ein einzigartiges Lauferlebnis sorgt.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: Der Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf ist ein traditioneller Lauf im Spätsommer, der Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Altersklassen in der schönen Umgebung von Edertal-Hemfurth zusammenbringt. Bei angenehmen Temperaturen und untergehender Sonne steht die Freude an der Bewegung und das Gemeinschaftsgefühl im Vordergrund. Im Ziel erwarten die Teilnehmer Erfrischungen, gute Musik und ein geselliges Beisammensein in entspannter Atmosphäre. Der Lauf wird vom TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. ehrenamtlich organisiert und ist ein beliebtes Event für ambitionierte Läufer, Freizeitjogger und Familien.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: ARM Race Kamień to ekstremalny bieg z przeszkodami OCR, który zaprasza zarówno profesjonalistów, jak i amatorów szukających mocnych wrażeń. To wyzwanie dla całych rodzin, w tym dzieci, oferujące nietypową rozrywkę i możliwość zmierzenia się z własnymi słabościami. Bieg należy do elitarnego grona tego typu imprez w Polsce i stale się rozwija, zapewniając uczestnikom niezapomniane emocje.

name: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne
description: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne is a trail race offering several distances, with the start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala, Hässleholm. The races follow beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves, with a focus on minimizing asphalt and traffic exposure for a more immersive and technical running experience. TGS 60 consists of two laps (35+25 km), while TGS 35 and TGS 25 correspond to the first and second laps of the 60 km race, respectively. TGS 10 is a shorter distance that follows approximately the final 10 km of the longer races. Runners of all levels are welcome to enjoy the forest and the challenges of trail running.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves
Less than 3 km on asphalt and only one major road crossing
Technical, nature-focused course with varied terrain
additional: TGS 60 has a lap point at 35.1 km, with a cutoff time of 13:30. Aid stations with food, water, cola and sports drink are located at several points along the course. The maximum time limit for TGS 60 is 9 hours and 15 minutes. The finish closes at 17:00 for TGS 35 and TGS 25. TGS 10 starts at 13:45. All distances start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala. The race offers a technical, nature-focused experience with minimal asphalt and traffic exposure. The distances are approximately 10.2 km, 26.6 km, 35.1 km and 61.7 km. For the 2026 edition, free parking near the start and finish is listed, and a post-race meal is included in the entry fee.

name: Nordkirchener Halbmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 EUR bei Anmeldungen bis zum 15. Juni

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 17 EUR bei Anmeldung vom 16. Juni bis 27. Juli

description: The Nordkirchen Half Marathon takes place on August 2, 2026, and offers a scenic course through Nordkirchen Castle Park and the Obsen farming community. Runners start at the stadium in Castle Park, complete two laps of the stadium, and then run a nearly 10-kilometer loop through picturesque parkland and villages. Several aid stations along the route provide refreshments for participants. The finish is back at the stadium, where spectators can cheer on the runners and enjoy a lovely time together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium in Nordkirchen Castle Park
Run through the expansive castle park with views of the castle
Loop through the Obsen farming community, where enthusiastic neighbors cheer runners on
additional: Personal refreshments can be dropped off before the start (8:00–8:45 a.m.). Water stations are located at km 4.5, 7, 9, 10.5, 14, 16.5, and 18.5. On-site late registration is available until 8:00 a.m. for an additional fee of EUR 3. Bibs with timing chips for electronic timekeeping will be issued and collected after the race, but participants may keep them as souvenirs. The course goes through Castle Park and Obsen, with the start and finish at the stadium in Castle Park. Registration is available online and on race day. Live results are available. Parking is available at the stadium, Nordkirchen Comprehensive School, and the Sundern car park.

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
description: Der Charity-Lauf Koldingen ist Teil des Sparkassen-Laufpasses der Region Hannover, einer der größten Laufserien Deutschlands mit 43 Veranstaltungen im Jahr 2026. Die Läuferinnen und Läufer haben die Möglichkeit, die Region Hannover laufend zu entdecken und bei jeder Teilnahme Stempel für ihren Laufpass zu sammeln. Der Lauf bietet eine abwechslungsreiche Strecke in der schönen Umgebung von Pattensen und fördert den Breitensport in der Region. Die Veranstaltung ist offen für alle, die aktiv sein und gleichzeitig Gutes tun möchten.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: Der 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen findet am 2. August 2026 in Beverstedt-Wellen statt und ist einer der ältesten Marathonläufe Deutschlands mit familiärem Charakter. Die Veranstaltung bietet anspruchsvolle Strecken auf vier Distanzen, darunter Marathon, Halbmarathon, 11 km und 5 km, die teilweise DLV-vermessen sind. Die Strecke führt durch abwechslungsreiche Landschaften mit Waldwegen und verschiedenen Belägen. Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSV Wellen organisiert und lebt von der Unterstützung vieler freiwilliger Helfer aus dem Dorf.

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esens City Run, held as the 6th Esenser Volksbank Run, takes place on Friday, July 31, 2026, in Esens. The traditional “Around St. Magnus” run offers exciting races in the city center for runners of all ages. The event begins with the 670-meter Bambini run, followed by student races over 1,340 meters. Adults can compete over five and ten kilometers, with both races starting at the same time. The awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: “Around St. Magnus” run in Esens city center
670-meter Bambini run
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 18:10, student race at 18:30, and adult 5 km and 10 km races at 19:30. Awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races. Online registration is available. Start and finish at Esens Market Square; online registration available; July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
description: Der Gifhorner Friedhofslauf ist ein besonderer Lauf, der auf dem Ev.-luth. Friedhof St. Nicolai in Gifhorn stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern die Möglichkeit, Strecken von 4 oder 8 Kilometern zu absolvieren. Nach dem Lauf gibt es ein gemütliches Beisammensein mit Grillen und Getränken unter den Apfelbäumen. Der Lauf findet traditionell am Abend statt und verbindet sportliche Aktivität mit einer entspannten Atmosphäre in historischer Umgebung.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the heart of the Falun Mine World Heritage Site, offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses, following old routes known as Vattnets Väg till Gruvan (The Water’s Way to the Mine). The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km) and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants, with the option to run timed or untimed. The event is organised by the orienteering club OK Kåre, which welcomes participants to the start and finish at Falun Mine.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km, starting and finishing at Falun Mine
The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail tracks, nature paths and short paved sections; an initial climb and clearly marked downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falun Mine; warm-up begins at 12:10 on Falu Rödfärg’s paved area (approximately 7 minutes), led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start at the same time, and runners are divided into two optional groups based on target pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Runners can choose to run with or without timing; prizes go to the first three finishers on each course, with raffle prizes for other participants; teams can be registered (teams of 3), and registrations can be transferred free of charge through the registration system. The race information mentions aid stations/water stops, parking, race office, showers/changing facilities and course markings. All three courses start and finish at Falun Mine; results from previous years are available.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.

name: Svartåloppet
location: Svartå Folkets hus, Svartå, Degerfors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Svartåloppet is a fun run held on the second Saturday in August, starting and finishing at Svartå Folkets hus. The race offers three distances: 2.5 km on flat roads, and 5.5 km and 14 km on hilly forest roads and trails. Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable system. The race is open to all ages and has a long tradition in Svartå, dating back to the 20th century.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km and 14 km courses are hilly forest routes on forest roads and trails
The 2.5 km course is a flatter road route
Start and finish at Svartå Folkets hus
additional: Timing is handled by Racetimer using a modern and reliable timing system. Svartå IF is the organizer and has its own facilities, including a floodlit trail and club cabin at Hyttvallen. Results from several past years are available via Racetimer. The start and finish are at Svartå Folkets hus. Timing is handled by Racetimer.

name: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail
description: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail is a challenging last-person-standing competition held in scenic Bunketorp in Lindome, south of Gothenburg. Participants run a 6,706-metre course on pleasant, well-trodden forest trails and exercise tracks, with a start every hour on the hour. Each lap must be completed within the hour to continue, and the runner who completes the most laps wins. The course is hilly, with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap, and offers beautiful forest scenery and varied terrain. The event provides a welcoming atmosphere with good service and support for both runners and their companions.
course_highlights: A 6,706-metre course on soft forest exercise tracks and trails
A hilly course with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap and three major climbs
Beautiful, varied terrain with no asphalt or gravel roads
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting at the same time. Participants must be in the starting pen at the start and may not cross the start line and then go back. The venue has changing rooms with showers and a sauna, toilets, a participant tent for storage and rest, an aid station, refreshments for companions, secure storage for valuables, and first aid. There is no age limit; participation is at your own risk. Prizes are awarded to the top three women, the top three men, and the best team (3 runners).

name: Istrun - Skaras snabba halvmara
description: Istrun is a fast, flat half marathon in Skara with approximately 70 metres of elevation gain, making it a perfect course for setting personal records. The race is organised by Istrums SK - Friidrott and welcomes both recreational and competitive runners. The distance is 21.1 km, and the course is designed to be fast and easy to run. Runners who are not members of a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Association can register through M Motion or K Motion.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Approximately 70 metres of elevation gain
Suitable for personal records
additional: The race is listed as fully booked. For questions or to join the waiting list: istrun@istrumssk.se.

location: Vikbolandet, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

location: Guldsmedshyttan, Lindesberg Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description:
Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail-running adventure for anyone looking to combine the joy of running, a challenge and spectacular scenery. Choose between 42 km, 21 km or 10 km—and bring the whole family! Children up to 12 years old can run for free in Barnens Fjällmaraton.
The course takes you over rugged mountain trails, boardwalks and winding paths all the way to the finish and the lively After Run party at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen is a deluxe running experience. Secure your place and experience the mountains with us!
