description: The MHB Overbetuweloop is the Betuwe’s running event, held in Elst on Sunday, October 11, 2026. The event offers five distances, including the challenging MHB 5 km and Rabobank 10 km, both certified by the Atletiekunie. There are special KidsRuns for children over 400 m and 800 m, as well as a new 1300 m teen run. The course passes through Elst’s picturesque centre and the beautiful countryside along the Linge, making it suitable for the whole family. Start times have been moved earlier to avoid running during the hottest hours of the day.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Elst’s centre and the countryside along the Linge
5 km and 10 km certified by the Atletiekunie
Safe, fast KidsRun course named after Olympic athlete Femke Bol
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Sunday, June 21, 2026, from 09:00 at the Town Hall, Dorpsstraat 67. First aid is available, and there are water stations along the course. After the finish, participants receive water and something to eat. Physiotherapists/sports massage therapists will be present. The 5 km and 10 km start together, with an extra-wide start area and space at the front for competitive runners. Electronic timing is used. Children aged 4–7 may run the 400 m KidsRun with a parent/guardian. Medals are included for children; adults can order a medal when registering for €2.50. Dansstudio Kerima will lead a KidsRun warm-up. Extra cooling will be provided in extremely hot weather. The course is certified by the Atletiekunie; medals and prizes for top finishers; sustainable medal options; start and finish in Elst; registration until June 20; volunteers wanted; sports clinics and facilities such as first aid and physiotherapy.

name: Loopavond Gemzen
description: Loopavond Gemzen is een hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt op 13 oktober 2026 in Heerde, Nederland. De wedstrijd wordt gehouden op de Lambert Dijkslag Atletiekbaan en biedt deelnemers de keuze uit afstanden van 3 km en 5 km. Het evenement vindt plaats bij typisch koel en helder herfstweer, ideaal om te presteren. De organisatie nodigt lopers van alle niveaus uit om deel te nemen en te genieten van een sportieve avond.

name: 5e Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse
description: De Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse is een gezellige wandeltocht in de herfst door de prachtige landschappen van Zuid-Holland. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit vijf wandelafstanden en lopen 1 tot 4 dagen door kleurrijke bossen, duinen, dorpen en langs de Hollandse kust. Onderweg worden wandelaars verrast door muziek, theater, sfeervolle chillplekken en gezellige tussenstops met lekkernijen. De routes voeren langs iconische plekken zoals Keukenhof, de Amsterdamse waterleidingduinen en historische dorpen, waardoor het een sfeervol en afwisselend wandelavontuur is voor iedereen.

name: Geopark Hondsrug Crosscircuit
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: Het Geopark Hondsrug Crosscircuit is een uitdagend crosscircuit dat plaatsvindt in het prachtige Hondsruggebied, een uniek ijstijdenlandschap en UNESCO Global Geopark. Het circuit bestaat uit meerdere crosslopen georganiseerd door verschillende lokale loopgroepen, waarbij deelnemers actief kunnen bewegen in een natuurlijke en afwisselende omgeving. Deelnemers van verschillende leeftijden en niveaus kunnen meedoen, met speciale regels voor junioren. Het circuit stimuleert sportiviteit en verbondenheid met het landschap.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun is a trail race through the coastal woodlands and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne, organised by Pan-Kristianstad. The event offers distances of 17 km, 11 km, 6 km and 2.5 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 350 m with a medal and no timing. The gently undulating courses combine trails, sand dunes, varied terrain and running on sand along the coast—guaranteeing participants an exceptional running experience. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, and also features team competitions. The maximum number of participants is 1,000.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a fun race in central Jönköping, suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners. Starting at Lillsjöplan, the races follow a completely flat, officially measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seeding. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) options are available, and the organizers emphasize a great atmosphere, with pacers for 40, 45, and 50 minutes in the 10K. Team registration gives a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and group registration is available for larger parties.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal where each lap is 6.706 metres. The format features hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start every full hour, for a total of up to 12 laps. Participants must complete a lap in under an hour to start the next one. The winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories is the participant who completes the most laps, with the fastest time on the final lap breaking a tie. The race suits both competitive runners and those looking to test their endurance on a technical yet runnable course through scenic Garnudden. A shorter MiniBackyard is offered for children and beginners, with on-site registration and a separate start time in the afternoon.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on the experience of nature as on performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Viersener Herbstwaldlauf Rund um den Bismarckturm
description: The 79th Viersen Autumn Forest Run Around the Bismarck Tower takes place on 10 October 2026 in Viersen. The event offers a 5 km run for adults on a hilly course, with a time limit of one hour. There is also a 7.25 km Walking & Nordic Walking event. The age limits are 14 to 99 for the run and 10 to 99 for walking. This traditional event is aimed at runners and walkers looking for a challenging course through autumn woodland.
course_highlights: Hilly course
Around the Bismarck Tower
One-hour time limit for the 5 km run
additional: There are events for children and young people; further information is available in the organiser’s official race announcement. All events share the same start and finish, but the exact locations are only shown with RUNME Premium. Results are listed by age category, with categories assigned according to year of birth. There are several events with different distances, age categories and start times; young people aged 14 and over may participate. Results will be published on the website.

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig Marathon takes place on 17 October 2026 in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course passes through the scenic Rothaar Mountains and is recognised by the DLV as an officially authorised popular race. More than 1,000 runners take part each year, enjoying the varied trails and forest scenery.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaar Mountains
DLV-recognised, officially authorised popular race
A range of events: marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Registration opens on 01.05.2026. Late registration is available until half an hour before the start of the respective event. Start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00, half-marathon at 12:00, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15, and the AOK run at 11:45. The event venue is Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. Registration opens on 01.05.2026; no dog runs. A detailed course description is available, along with start times and organisational information on the website.

name: Hachenburger Löwenlauf
description: The Hachenburg Löwenlauf is a long-standing race with a family-friendly atmosphere, taking place on October 17, 2026, in Hachenburg. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon, a 10.5 km race, a 6.3 km fun run/team race, and children’s races. The courses pass through the varied landscapes of the Westerwald, with challenging climbs and wonderful views. Since 1989, proceeds from the race have been donated to social projects, giving the event special social significance.
course_highlights: The half marathon reaches its highest point at Gräbersberg (513 m) and features varied climbs and descents.
The 10.5 km race runs mostly along forest paths, with its highest point at 439 m above sea level.
The start and finish area is at the Rundsporthalle in Hachenburg, which has changing rooms and showers.
additional: Electronic timing without a chip; certificates for all finishers; prizes for category winners; special prize for the largest team in the team race. Late registration is available on October 16 from 17:00 and on race day from 09:00. Refreshments including electrolyte drinks, water, tea, cola, and fruit are available on the course and at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Rundsporthalle. Distances include a half marathon, 10.5 km, a 6.3 km team and fun run, and children’s races. The start and finish area is at Lohmühle, Hachenburg. Electronic timing without a chip; certificates for all finishers; prizes for category winners; refreshments on the course and at the finish. Registration is online only.

name: Herbstlauf des LSV Porz
organizer: LSV Porz / Kölner Lauf- und Nordic-Walkingteam
description: The LSV Porz Autumn Run is Cologne’s oldest road race and takes place in the picturesque Leidenhausen recreation area. The event offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, measured in accordance with the German Athletics Association (DLV) regulations and eligible for rankings. Both competitive runners and recreational joggers can enjoy the autumn scenery as they run. The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne and the surrounding area, and is often used by top runners to assess their form.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Leidenhausen recreation area amid autumn scenery
The 5 km loop is one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
Routes measured in accordance with DLV regulations and eligible for rankings
additional: Race numbers must be worn on the chest. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Late registration is possible on the day of the event for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the fee. No liability is accepted for theft, accidents or other damage. Payment is by SEPA direct debit a few days before the event. No entry fee will be debited if the event is cancelled. Courses measured, registration until 14.10.2025, start times from 11:00, parking nearby, participation in running and Nordic walking events

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area. Organized by Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to delight participants. The event is very popular, and starting places fill up quickly. The exact route is still being finalized, but promises to be a fantastic and unique course. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: A unique route through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
A nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the 2026 Teutomarsch sold out within 30 minutes, with 500 starting places. There is a waiting list. Participants consent to being photographed and filmed and to the publication of the resulting images and footage. Entry fees are non-refundable. Minimum age: 16. Dogs are allowed on a leash. The organizer accepts no liability for personal injury, property damage, or loss or theft. Trail running, no timekeeping, refreshment stations along the route, start and finish at Grundschule Hohne, participant limit: 500.

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: Der 24. Niedensteiner Panoramalauf findet am 17. Oktober 2026 in Niedenstein statt. Die Veranstaltung wird vom SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. und dem Lauftreff Niedenstein organisiert. Der Lauf bietet eine attraktive Strecke rund um das Hessenturm-Stadion und das Vereinsheim, eingebettet in die schöne Landschaft der Region. Teilnehmer können sich auf eine gut organisierte Laufveranstaltung im Rahmen des Schwalm-Eder-Laufcups freuen.

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: Die Prignitzer Moormeile in Bad Wilsnack ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf, der am 17. Oktober 2026 zum 26. Mal stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen von 1 km bis 12,4 km, die durch Wilsnacker Wälder, den Kurpark und rund um die Karthanehalle führen. Die Läufe sind sowohl für Kinder, Jugendliche als auch für Erwachsene geeignet und Teil des Prignitz-Cups sowie des Brandenburg-Cups. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre, gute Versorgung an der Strecke und eine professionelle Zeitnahme aus.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail to cykl biegów trailowych odbywających się na pagórkowatych szlakach Pomorza i Kaszub z bazą zawodów w KJ Barłomino. W ramach imprezy dostępnych jest pięć dystansów: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km oraz 11 km, oferujących różnorodne wyzwania dla biegaczy terenowych. Zawody promują piękno kaszubskich terenów oraz regionalne atrakcje, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na doskonałe bufety na trasie. Impreza jest wspierana przez program #AktywnaWieś i organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Pomerania Sports.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® to cykl biegów trailowych odbywających się na pagórkowatych szlakach Pomorza i Kaszub, z bazą zawodów w KJ Barłomino. W ramach imprezy dostępnych jest pięć dystansów: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km oraz 11 km, oferujących różnorodne wyzwania dla biegaczy terenowych. Zawody promują piękno kaszubskich terenów oraz regionalne atrakcje, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na dobrze przygotowane bufety na trasie. Impreza jest wspierana przez program #AktywnaWieś i organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Pomerania Sports.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
50e Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop - Halve Marathon Schoonhoven
description: De 50e Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop in Schoonhoven is een hardloopevenement met meerdere afstanden, waaronder 1,5 km, 6 km, 10 km en de halve marathon van 21,1 km. De wedstrijd is aangesloten bij de Atletiekunie en biedt een gevarieerd parcours voor zowel recreatieve als meer ervaren lopers. Het evenement staat bekend om zijn gezellige sfeer en de mooie omgeving van Schoonhoven. De prijzen variëren van €3,00 tot €15,00, afhankelijk van de afstand.

name: A. Vogelloop
description: De A.Vogelloop is een sfeervolle hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op 17 oktober 2026 in 't Harde. De wedstrijd wordt georganiseerd door de Wallenloop en Havenloop samen met A.Vogel, waarbij het goede doel stichting Opkikker wordt ondersteund. De route loopt over het prachtige landgoed Zwaluwenburg met een onverharde ronde van 5 kilometer door bosrijke omgeving, start en finish in de fraaie A.Vogeltuinen. Er is aandacht voor zowel recreatieve als professionele lopers en voor kinderen zijn er speciale jeugdafstanden met medailles voor alle deelnemers.

name: Boerbos cross
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: De Boerbos Cross in Rolde is een uitdagende crossloop door het unieke landschap van het Boerbos, onderdeel van het UNESCO Global Geopark De Hondsrug. De route voert over onverharde paden, heuvels, heide en zandverstuivingen, met afstanden voor junioren, senioren en masters. De cross wordt georganiseerd door Loopgroep SGO, Gieten en Vomos en maakt deel uit van het Hondsrug crosscircuit. De tijdwaarneming gebeurt zonder chip, en er is een beperkt aantal deelnemers toegelaten.

name: Dutch Backyard Ultra Zeewolde
description: De Dutch Backyard Ultra is een unieke ultraloop waarbij deelnemers elk uur starten aan dezelfde ronde van 6,706 km. Er is geen vaste finish; wie binnen het uur de ronde voltooit, start precies een uur later opnieuw. Het evenement duurt zo lang als de deelnemers volhouden, met slechts één winnaar: de laatste loper die een ronde voltooit, de 'last man standing'. De route in Zeewolde loopt over het Scoutinglandgoed en voert voornamelijk door de natuur met weinig hoogtemeters.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet makes a comeback in 2026 with a new, city-adjacent course that mainly follows walking and cycling paths through several of Skövde’s residential areas. Race day is October 18, and the races are designed as easy-to-run urban courses suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Three distances are offered (21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km), with a shared start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.

name: Burscheider Stadtlauf
location: Burscheid, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Burscheid City Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in the town center of Burscheid and offers an ideal setting for runners of all ability levels. There are several distances: the 10-kilometer main race, a 3-kilometer run, and an 800-meter run that serves as a qualification for the Sports Badge. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational athletes. All finishers receive the traditional Kretzer City Run bread, and the top finishers are awarded special trophies.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer main race through the town center
3-kilometer run for recreational athletes
800-meter youth run as a qualification for the Sports Badge
additional: Late entries are possible at the registration office on race day for an additional fee of €5.00, but late registrants will not receive Kretzer City Run bread. Race packets will be distributed from 10:30 a.m. at the Protestant church. Changing rooms and showers are available at the “Auf dem Schulberg” sports hall. Free drinks are available along the course and at the finish. Age-group rankings follow DLO regulations. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross, Burscheid branch. Bib numbers must be worn on the chest. The event also includes children’s races, race-packet distribution from 10:30 a.m., online results, age-group rankings, medals, and trophies. October weather is usually mild, making participation comfortable.

name: Laubacher Ramsberglauf
price_range: bis 20. September vergünstigtes Startgeld, danach zzgl. Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Laubach Ramsberg Run is a traditional running event that starts and finishes in the picturesque castle park in Laubach. The event offers various distances for different age and ability groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and Bambini. The races feature a varied course through the beautiful countryside around Laubach. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere, with refreshments, changing facilities, and an awards ceremony right in the castle park.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Laubach Castle Park
A varied course through the countryside around Laubach
Refreshments and changing facilities at the Sports and Cultural Hall
additional: Registration is via RACERESULT, with a reduced entry fee available until 20 September; a late registration fee applies thereafter. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Sports and Cultural Hall. The awards ceremony takes place right in the castle park. Distances: 10 km main race, 5 km fun run, children’s races over 1500 m and 300 m; registration via Raceresult; start and finish in the castle park; refreshments, changing and shower facilities on site; October weather: approx. 14°C, cloudy

name: Styrumer Straßenlauf "Rund um die Neustadtstraße"
location: Neustadtstraße, Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 25 km, Halbmarathon, Halbmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Styrum Road Race “Around Neustadtstraße” is a traditional road race in Mülheim an der Ruhr, centered on Neustadtstraße in Styrum. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km, 25 km, a half marathon and 50 km. The courses are officially measured and listed in the laufen.de race calendar, making participation in the German rankings possible. The race is held in accordance with the rules and safety standards of the German Athletics Association (DLV).
course_highlights: Officially measured road race courses
A range of distances from 1 km to 100 km
Event on Neustadtstraße in Styrum
additional: Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C, low of 6 °C, average precipitation of 40 mm, mostly cloudy. The event also includes shorter distances such as 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km and 25 km, as well as special races for children and young people. The course runs along Neustadtstraße and through Sportpark Styrum, in cool October weather averaging 14°C. The event is listed in the official race calendar and meets the standards of the German Athletics Association.

name: Hambacher Herbstwaldlauf
description: The Hambach Autumn Forest Run is a traditional race in Niederzier-Hambach, held every year in autumn. In autumnal weather, runners enjoy the beautiful atmosphere and the forest’s vibrant colors. Around 200 participants take part across various age groups and distances. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. and offers a friendly, community-minded and athletic atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Run through the autumn forest amid colorful foliage
A range of distances for children, young people and adults
A traditional event with a friendly club atmosphere
additional: The event attracts around 200 runners. Results from the previous year are available online, with certificates available to print. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. The website provides no explicit information about start times, pricing tiers or registration options. Forest trail; online registration possible; start and finish at the Sophienhöhe parking lot; event in October 2026

name: Traditioneller Sparkassen-Herbstwaldlauf
location: Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum, Beckum, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Traditional Sparkasse Autumn Forest Run in Beckum is a popular running event taking place on October 18, 2026, at the Harberstadion Neubeckum Sports Center. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a schoolchildren’s run, a 5 km everyone’s race, 5 km walking, and the 10 km main race. Participants receive medals, certificates, and trophies, making the run a motivating experience for recreational and competitive runners. Late registration is possible until approximately 30 minutes before the start, offering flexibility for last-minute entrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Harberstadion Neubeckum Sports Center
Races for all age groups, from Bambini to the main race
Trophies for the fastest runners and certificates for all participants
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event until approximately 30 minutes before the start, for an additional fee of €2. All participants in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races receive medals; certificates are awarded for the 5 km everyone’s race and 5 km walking, and trophies for the three fastest runners in the 10 km main race, as well as certificates for all participants. Forest running event; registration and results on the website.

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on October 25, 2026, offers runners a varied programme featuring a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km city run, 5 km run and children’s mile run. The course goes through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its good refreshments and friendly atmosphere. The event welcomes runners of all abilities and also offers a public race series with additional competitions during the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeved shirts, and extensive services are available on site.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km on courses of 10 km or longer, with water, sports drinks and fruit
Showers in the sports hall at Graf Anton Günther School, approximately 300 m from the start/finish area
Changing facilities and baggage drop-off on Level 1 of the Schlosshöfe car park
additional: Race packs will be handed out on October 11 from 11 a.m. at the Schlosshöfe. On race day, collection opens at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for everyone else. Group registration is available. After the race, extensive refreshments will be provided, including drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries and non-alcoholic wheat beer. Physiotherapy students will offer free massages. Portable toilets and changing facilities are available. Multiple race distances, start in Wardenburg, road closures in the city centre, finisher medals, online registration available

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
description: Der Müggelsee-Halbmarathon ist ein landschaftlich reizvoller Lauf im Südosten Berlins, der komplett um den Großen Müggelsee führt. Die Veranstaltung bietet drei Streckenlängen: Halbmarathon, 10 Kilometer und 5 Kilometer, die jeweils als Pendelstrecken oder Rundkurs gestaltet sind. Die Strecke verläuft unter anderem durch den historischen Spreetunnel und bietet eine idyllische Kulisse mit Blick auf den größten Berliner See und die umliegenden Müggelberge. Der Lauf ist für alle Läufer geeignet, die Bestzeiten anstreben oder einfach die Gemeinschaft und Natur genießen möchten. Start und Ziel befinden sich an der Müggelseeperle, und der Lauf findet am 18. Oktober 2026 statt.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: Der Almetal-Marathon 2026 findet am 18. Oktober statt und bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern eine landschaftlich reizvolle Strecke von Büren-Ringelstein bis zum Ahorn-Sportpark in Paderborn. Neben der klassischen Marathondistanz gibt es zwei Halbmarathon-Varianten sowie einen Staffelwettbewerb über vier Teilstrecken. Die Veranstaltung ist geprägt von ehrenamtlichem Engagement zahlreicher Sportvereine und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre sowie ein beeindruckendes Naturerlebnis im Almetal.

name: Müngstener Brückenlauf
description: Der Müngstener Brückenlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Solingen, der durch malerische Landschaften führt. Die Strecke beginnt auf dem schmalen Schäfchenweg und bietet einen letzten Anstieg vor dem Ziel, vorbei an Wiesen und Feldern. Der Lauf wird vom Solinger Leichtathletik-Club 1951 e.V. organisiert und zieht Läufer aus der Region an.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: 52. Maraton Dębno to najstarszy i jeden z najszybszych maratonów w Polsce, odbywający się 18 października 2026 roku. Trasa o długości 42,195 km, atestowana przez PZLA, prowadzi ulicami Dębna i okolic, sprzyjając uzyskiwaniu życiówek. Impreza ma bogatą tradycję sięgającą 1966 roku i przyciąga zarówno amatorów, jak i profesjonalnych biegaczy z kraju i zagranicy. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację, liczne punkty odżywcze oraz gorący doping kibiców. Maraton jest także okazją do integracji środowiska biegowego i świętem sportu dla całych rodzin.

name: TCS Amsterdam Marathon 2026
location: Olympisch Stadion, Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The TCS Amsterdam Marathon takes place on Sunday, 18 October 2026, and is known for its fast, flat course and rich historical background. The start and finish are at the iconic Olympic Stadium, with a route along the Amstel, past stately townhouses and windmills, and through the green Vondelpark. The event attracts thousands of runners every year and offers an unforgettable experience, with enthusiastic supporters lining the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Olympic Stadium
Course along the Amstel with beautiful views of townhouses and windmills
Through the city’s green heart: Vondelpark
additional: The marathon is a World Athletics Platinum Label race with a fast course. An official Mizuno race shirt can be ordered, and an international pasta party is held for participants. The 7.5K run takes place on Saturday, finishing at the Olympic Stadium. There are also special business runs and kids’ runs. Globalrunning.com offers travel packages including an entry place, accommodation, and transport. The event also includes a Kids Run, Heroes Run, and charity runs; travel packages are available; registrations and ticket resales are handled through the official websites.

name: Turfveld Wintercross 5, 10, en 15 km, Texel
location: De Dennen, Den Burg, Texel, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Turfveld Winter Cross in Den Burg on Texel is a challenging cross-country running series in the wooded De Dennen area near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld. The first race, on 18 October 2026, offers several distances, including 14.9 km, 9.8 km, 4.91 km and 0.75 km, with the start at Nattevlakweg. The route follows scenic, winding forest paths and is suitable for both young runners and adults. The race is part of a five-race competition; taking part in at least three races is required to qualify for the standings. The start times are 10:30 for children aged 12 and under and 10:50 for all other participants.
course_highlights: Wooded De Dennen area with winding paths
The longest distance on 18 October is approximately 14.7 km, divided into 3 laps
Sheltered start location near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld
additional: Registration opens at 9:45 at 't Bospaviljoen Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2. Cash payment, preferably with the exact amount, is appreciated; otherwise, a payment request will be sent. Children aged 12 and under run 750 metres and start at 10:30; all other distances start at 10:50. The cross is part of a five-race competition; taking part in at least three races is required to qualify for the standings. 2026–2027 season, several distances, courses from 2 km to 14.7 km, registration from 9:45, location: 't Turfveld, Den Burg.

name: Bunkercross
description: De Bunkercross in Olst is een unieke en pittige crossloop die de 17e editie viert als sportieve opening van het Sallands Cross Circuit. Het volledig onverharde parcours voert je over historische commandobunkers en door de bossen van landgoed De Haere, een gebied vol natuur en geschiedenis. De loop trekt een breed deelnemersveld, van regionale toppers tot fanatieke recreanten, en biedt een uitdagende en sfeervolle start van het crossseizoen. Startnummers worden uitgereikt in het imposante Kasteel De Haere, waar na afloop ook gezellig nagepraat kan worden.

name: Zeezichtloop Petten
description: De Zeezichtloop Petten vindt plaats op 18 oktober 2026 met start en finish op Plein 1945 in het hart van Petten. De loop biedt diverse afstanden voor hardlopers en wandelaars, waaronder een ontspannen wandeling van 10 of 15 kilometer, een uitdagende 5 km hardlooproute die tweemaal wordt gelopen, en een feestelijke Kidsrun voor de jongste deelnemers. Het parcours voert langs de dorpskern, de dijk met prachtig zeezicht, duin en bos, waarbij pittige klimmetjes en mul zand zijn vermeden voor een toegankelijker parcours. De dag wordt afgesloten met prijsuitreikingen en de uitreiking van de Erik ten Velden bokaal aan de snelste Pettemer op de 10 km.

name: Mjitte Run
description: De Mjitte Run in Boazum is een hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt op 18 oktober 2026. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit afstanden van 5 km, 10 km en 15 km, deels over mooie landelijke wegen en paden. Het evenement biedt een gezellige sfeer voor zowel recreatieve als fanatieke lopers en vindt plaats tussen 11:30 en 18:00 uur. De Mjitte Run is een jaarlijks terugkerend evenement dat de lokale gemeenschap samenbrengt.

name: MOLENHOEKS MAKKIE running the hills
location: Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: Molenhoeks Makkie is a trail run in October starting in Molenhoek, located in the Rijk van Nijmegen. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with all routes offering a hilly course rather than a flat road race. With a maximum of 1,400 participants, it offers a more intimate running experience than large city events. The organiser, Stichting Molenhoeks Makkie, provides extensive facilities such as public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, AEDs, a supervised cloakroom and massage services.
course_highlights: Hilly course instead of a flat road
Start and finish in Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen
Distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Maximum of 1,400 participants. No on-the-day registration is available. Facilities include public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, an AED, a supervised cloakroom and massage. Typical October weather is cool and crisp, with an average temperature of 14°C, a minimum of 6°C and 40mm of rainfall. Make sure to register in advance; late registrations are not possible. Facilities such as parking, changing rooms, first aid and massage are available. The event is easily accessible by public transport and offers a friendly, local atmosphere.

name: Herfstloop Twente
location: Atletiek Club TION, Enschede, Overijssel, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 8 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Herfstloop Twente is one of the oldest running events in the east of the Netherlands, organised since 1976 by Atletiek Club TION in Enschede. The race takes runners through the beautiful countryside near Rutbeek and offers a suitable distance for every runner. In 2026, the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon routes return to their original courses. The 2-mile race, introduced in 2024, is a popular distance for beginner runners and young people. The atmosphere is professional yet informal, with strong involvement from volunteers and sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural area near Rutbeek
Original courses for the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon races
The 2-mile distance is suitable for beginner and returning runners, as well as young people
additional: The start and finish are on the track at AC TION. Participation in the 2-mile race is open from age 11. The organising committee consists of 7 people, with more than 50 volunteers on the day. Participants give the Herfstloop an average score of 8. Registration is via the website. Facilities include free parking, with a medal available for €1.50. The event takes place in the natural surroundings of Enschede.

name: KNÆK CANCER LØBET AABYBRO 2026 & ØLAND AFD.
location: Aabybro, Jammerbugt Municipality, North Jutland, Denmark

name: Sydvest Crossløb 2026/27 - afd. 1 - Brørup ved Aquagain
Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held at Norrköping’s own ski slope. The race is described as challenging—in 2024, participants completed five tough laps of the hill—and is aimed at both competitive runners and families, with a separate children’s race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children’s activities, and award and photo ceremonies afterwards.
course_highlights: Held at Norrköping’s ski slope (Yxbacken)
In 2024, consisted of five challenging laps of the hill
The children’s race “Lilla Yxbackenloppet” was introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race took place on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. Around 50 children took part in the 2024 children’s race and received medals at the finish; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Magnus Media took photos, which were published on the race’s Facebook page. Around 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children’s race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: VSM terräng
description: The 2026 Swedish Cross Country Championships are organized by Västerås Friidrott and will be held at Rocklunda IP in Västerås on October 24–25. The course is an easy-to-run cross-country course over a flat grassy area, with a 2–3-meter-wide gravel path that is crossed several times per lap. Hay bales are used as obstacles on parts of the course. The event welcomes runners of different ages and abilities and offers ample parking, as well as nearby accommodation and lunch service at Good Morning Hotels.
course_highlights: Flat grassy area with less than 0.5 meters of elevation difference
2–3-meter-wide gravel path crossed four times per lap
Hay bale obstacles on parts of the course
additional: Pre-booked lunch is served at Good Morning Hotels, 700 meters from the venue, on Saturday and Sunday for 130 SEK. Book lunch by emailing henrik@vasterasfriidrott.se no later than October 16. Plenty of free parking is available next to the competition area. The VSM categories start on Saturday, October 24; the first start is at 10:30 a.m. Free parking is available next to the competition area. Pre-booked lunch is available for 130 SEK.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Welcome to the second edition of Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, a unique and exciting running event in the autumn darkness of Kråksångsskogen. The race consists of 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with each lap to be completed in no more than 30 minutes. After the sixth lap, runners change direction, adding an extra dimension to the competition. A headlamp is mandatory, as almost the entire race takes place in darkness. This is a small-scale race with a limited number of places, offering a challenge for anyone looking to test their limits in ultrarunning.
course_highlights: 13 laps of a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes per lap
Change of running direction after the sixth lap
The course is marked with reflectors and trail markers, and consists mostly of trails with around 700 metres of gravel
additional: Food and energy are provided during laps 7 and 8 (pizza from a local pizzeria), as well as sweets, bananas, crisps, coffee, hot broth, sports drink and water. Facilities are limited, with self-service energy, a warm fire and shelter from the elements. Toilets are in the woods. Maximum 70 places. Each lap starts every 30 minutes, and if you complete a lap faster, you can rest for the remaining time before the next lap starts. The race starts at the Linghemsskogen barbecue area. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes. A headlamp and mobile phone are mandatory items of equipment. Limited to 70 places; registration closes on 13 October. Participants who complete at least one lap receive a wooden medal.

name: Halloween Night Trail
description: Halloween Night Trail is an exciting and atmospheric trail race in the dark at the Karlsnäs area north of Ronneby. The race offers three distances: 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The courses are marked with reflectors and torches to guide runners through the darkness. After crossing the finish line, all participants are served a grilled hamburger and a drink, making for a pleasant end to the evening. The event has a Halloween theme, with decorations along the course, and encourages participants to dress up for an extra festive atmosphere. Ronneby Orienteering Club is the experienced race organiser.
course_highlights: Run on narrow trails and through terrain, with reflectors showing the way in the dark
Halloween-themed features such as Zombie Hill, Count Dracula’s lair and the Bat Cave
The finish area is indoors, and grilled hamburgers and drinks are served after the race
additional: Electronic timing for the 5 km and 10 km distances; no timing for the 2 km. Race bibs and chips can be collected at the venue from 17:00. A headlamp is recommended to help you follow the reflectors in the dark. The prize ceremony is tentatively scheduled for 20:45. Changing rooms and showers are available in limited numbers. Extra hamburgers can be purchased after the race. Parents may run with children in the 2 km without registering. Shoes with good grip are recommended because the surfaces may be wet and slippery. Electronic timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km, but not the 2 km. A hamburger and a small drink are included in the entry fee. The venue and finish are at Friluftscentrum Karlsnäsgården.

name: Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf
description: The Helberhäuser HauBerg Run is a long-standing event taking place for the 29th time on October 24, 2026. Organized by TSG Helberhausen, it features a revised course that follows two laps of the well-known route. The race is part of the Rothaar Running Series and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in the Hilchenbach region. TSG Helberhausen is a multi-sport club with a wide range of activities, and organizes the race as one of its many popular events.
course_highlights: Two laps of the well-known HauBerg Run course
Part of the Rothaar Running Series
A long-standing race in the Hilchenbach region
additional: The course was revised for 2025. The event is part of TSG Helberhausen’s diverse sports program; the club has more than 20 departments and offers a wide range of sports. The 2026 anniversary edition features a special course layout, with all runners completing the routes in reverse. The event offers a range of competitions, including children’s races and Nordic walking, on a challenging, hilly course.

name: Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as children’s races. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation. It offers suitable running options for competitive runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children’s races over 1 km and 2 km
Participant and course records for the 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers children’s races alongside the main distances. It combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. The event takes place in Nordwalde, with more than 800 participants at the last edition, including record-breaking times and food and drink.

name: KRC Van Elderen Stadshagenrun 2026
distance_verbose: 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1.6 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km, 0.7 km

name: Veluwse Winter Competitie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Stuurbordje nodig à € 5,00 voor de hele competitie

description: The Veluwe Winter Competition 2026-2027 is an accessible mountain bike competition held on a variety of challenging and varied courses in the Veluwe region, including Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede/Lunteren and Zutphen. Races are timed and consist of multiple laps, making them suitable for experienced recreational mountain bikers. The competition comprises up to 9 races and is open to participants with a KNWU or NTFU licence, with enjoyment and sportsmanship at its heart.
course_highlights: Varied courses in and around the Veluwe
Timed races with 5 to 10 laps
An easier B-line is available on difficult sections
additional: The races begin with a draw to determine the first starting rows at Nunspeet and Soest; from Oldebroek onwards, riders are lined up according to the current standings. The starting order of categories 8 & 9 and 10 & 11 alternates from race to race. A transponder is required and is attached to the handlebar plate. Races are timed rather than distance-based and last 5 to 10 laps. The best 5 results count towards the overall standings. A day licence is no longer required; participation without a licence is at your own risk. Registration is via inschrijven.nl and is also possible on-site, with mobile payment or cash. The competition includes several events in autumn and winter at locations such as Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede / Lunteren and Zutphen. Registration is handled via email, and detailed route information is available. Live results are displayed on the website.

name: All4running Crosscircuit
description: The All4running Crosscircuit is a series of five challenging cross-country races held in North Holland at various locations, including Hoorn, Wieringerwerf, Den Helder and Spierdijk. The races vary in distance and are suitable for a range of age categories, from juniors to seniors. Participants can register for the entire circuit or for individual races. The circuit offers a sporty and friendly atmosphere, with a ranking and attractive prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Varied courses in wooded areas and sports park settings
A range of distances for juniors and adults, from 1,000 metres to 10,000 metres
Races at various locations in North Holland, including Risdammerhout and Dijkgatbos
additional: You can register for the entire circuit or for an individual race. Participants must return their chip after the race to avoid additional costs. A points system determines the final ranking, with the best four results counting and bonus points awarded for taking part in all five races. Found items are kept for 14 days by the organising club. Final prize categories are divided by age and gender. Cross-country races in Hoorn, Wieringermeer and Spierdijk; registration available on race day; return your chip and prizes awarded to top finishers.

name: Battle of the Zekskes
description: The Battle of the Zekskes is the very first Cornhole tournament in Velden, an accessible and sociable game in which teams of at least four people throw beanbags at a wooden board to score points. The event takes place on 18 October 2025 and is organized by Sportvereniging Velden. Alongside the sporting competition, an evening celebration is also planned, making it a fun combination of competition and socializing for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Accessible cornhole game with beanbags and wooden boards
Teams of at least 4 people
Held at Theo Lommen Sportpark in Velden
additional: The minimum age to participate is 16. An evening celebration is planned after the tournament. Teams consist of at least 4 people. Cornhole game, teams of at least 4 people, evening celebration after the tournament

name: Nacht van de Nacht wandeling
description: The Night of the Night walk in Breda is a special experience where you walk in silence through the darkness and enjoy the natural nighttime surroundings. During the walk, you can experience the peace and quiet and, weather permitting, a beautiful starry sky. The activity highlights the importance of darkness and combating light pollution, and is suitable for a broad audience who enjoy nature and quiet.
course_highlights: Walk in complete darkness
Experience silence and nature at night
Possibility of seeing stars in clear skies
additional: The Night of the Night includes various activities such as walks, boat trips, stargazing and lectures. Some activities are wheelchair-friendly and suitable for children. Participants can sign up via an online form. The campaign aims to raise awareness of light pollution and the importance of darkness for nature and health. Various activities include stargazing, walks, boat trips and lectures, focusing on darkness and the nighttime experience.

name: Sønderjysk Crossløb 2026/27 - Cup tilmelding alle løb
Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne’s largest cross-country races, organised by Heleneholms IF in the autumn-coloured Bokskogen forest in Torup. The race starts and finishes at Torups Friluftsgård and traditionally takes place on the last Sunday in October (2026-10-25). The course runs through forest terrain and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to experience nature in autumn. All practical information and the race invitation are available on the event’s information pages.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Bokskogen (Torup)
Start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård
Autumn scenery and trails — traditionally held on the last Sunday in October
additional: Registration is via AnmälMigNu (see the registration page). The invitation, race categories, entry fees, course description, race information, start list and practical information are available in the tabs on the left-hand side of the event page. Race contact: tavling@heleneholmsif.se. Heleneholms IF office: kansli@heleneholmsif.se, tel. 040-19 42 20. Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup; two distances (12 km and 6 km); start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård; course map available; registration via AnmälMigNu; contact tavling@heleneholmsif.se.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is an annual running event celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. It takes place on Sunday, 25 October 2026. The event website shows that the race has offered several distances (2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km, according to a previous registration form), and that the organiser publishes the invitation, race information, start list, map and results on the website. The website describes the course as scenic and the 14 km route as challenging. More information and course details are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Scenic course (linked from the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km (according to a previous registration form)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website includes links to the map and course profile, as well as race information, invitations, start lists and provisional results from previous years. A previous registration form (2020) offered a choice of distance and a choice of which day to run (23/10, 24/10 or 25/10). Content includes the invitation, race information, start lists, course map, results and course profile; 14 km course. The race traditionally takes place during the last weekend of October and celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Hindås Trail
description: Hindås Trail is a running festival held on the beautiful fitness trails in Hindås on 25 October 2026. Participants can choose between a 1 km race for children, 5 km and 15 km. The event is suitable both for competitive runners and for those who want to enjoy a scenic run. After the finish, coffee and chocolate wafers are served, and hot dogs and a more substantial fika are available to buy at a good price. All proceeds go directly to the popular skiing activities in Hindås.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful fitness trails in Hindås
A children’s race on an easier 1 km course
Choose between 5 km and 15 km distances
additional: At the finish, participants are offered coffee and chocolate wafers. Hot dogs and a more substantial fika are also available to buy at a good price. All proceeds from the event go to the skiing activities in Hindås. All proceeds go to Hindås Ski Club’s skiing activities.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Slott Trail is an atmospheric trail race held in the autumn darkness around historic Löfstad Castle in Norrköping. The event offers two distances: Lilla Skymningsloppet, a 1,000-metre children’s race in the park, and Löfstads Mörkaste, a 7-kilometre night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain, where a headlamp is mandatory. The course winds through the beautiful castle park and forest and is marked with reflectors and tape for a safe and memorable running experience. Löfstad Slott Trail is a perfect start to the autumn holiday week and is organised by Orienteringsklubben Denseln, with a focus on community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: 7 km night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain
The course is marked with reflectors and tape
1,000-metre children’s race in the park, with no timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 15:00 in the castle courtyard. On-site registration is available. Parking is available up to 500 metres from the castle; allow extra time to walk. Löfstads Mörkaste starts at 17:00 and a headlamp is mandatory. Trail shoes are recommended. Lilla Skymningsloppet is not timed, and children may run with an adult without registering separately. All participants receive a prize at the finish, and special prizes are awarded after the race. Löfstads Mörkaste starts at 17:00 and requires a headlamp; trail shoes are recommended. Lilla Skymningsloppet starts at 16:00 and is not timed. Participants under 15 in the 7 km race must run with a registered responsible adult.

name: Glauchauer Herbstlauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinschaft Glauchau e.V. und Kreissportbund Zwickau
description: The Glauchau Autumn Run is a long-standing running event in Glauchau, held annually in autumn since 1986. The event offers courses for runners of all ages and ability levels, including a half marathon, 10 km, 3.2 km and 1.1 km races, as well as walking and Nordic walking. The routes pass through the scenic surrounding area on asphalt and paved paths, including sections alongside the reservoir and the castle pond. The event is a sporting highlight for the region and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running to experience autumn actively.
course_highlights: 21.1 km flat scenic run with 75% asphalt and 25% paved paths
10 km course with 25% asphalt and 75% paved paths around the reservoir and castle pond
3.2 km and 1.1 km loops around the grounds of the Sachsenlandhalle Glauchau
additional: Half-marathon time limit: 2:45 h. Intermediate checkpoint at km 14.3 (reservoir pavilion) must be passed by 12:00; otherwise, disqualification with a shortened course to the finish. Race number includes a baggage tag and a raffle ticket. Recommended parking: Kaufland, Grenayer Straße. Late registration/changes possible on 24.10.2026 from 13:00 to 14:30, with a late registration fee of 5 euros. Registration opens on 01.08.2026. Race numbers include chips; age-group rankings, team and special rankings. No refunds. Limits apply to the company and family runs and Special Olympics. Participation includes shipping of the entry fee.

name: Ottensteiner Wottellauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: U7 Bambinis, Schüler und Schülerinnen € 3,00; Voranmeldung möglich bis zum 23.10.2025

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 Km und 10 Km € 7,00 (Voranmeldung möglich bis zum 24.10.2024)

description: The Ottenstein Wottellauf is a long-standing running event held annually in Ottenstein near Ahaus. The event offers various races for children and adults, including 10 km, 5 km, and several shorter children’s races. The races start at Sportplatz 1, 48683 Ahaus-Ottenstein, and are known for their friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. All participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies, making the race especially appealing to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportplatz 1 in Ahaus-Ottenstein
A range of distances from 200 m to 10 km
Friendly atmosphere with awards for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective start. Showers and changing rooms are available at the venue. An unattended bag drop is available. Certificates are provided online. Trophies are awarded to places 1–3 in the 5 km and 10 km races. Every child receives a medal. Prizes are awarded to the largest group. Photos and videos are taken during the event and used for press and social media. Registration until 23.10.2025, start times from 11:05, showers and changing rooms available, photos and videos during the event

name: Volkswaldlauf des MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt
description: The MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt Volkswaldlauf takes place on 25 October 2026 in Winsen-Borstel. The event offers distances ranging from short children’s races to a challenging 20.3 km course, making it ideal for families as well as runners looking for a longer distance. The start and finish are at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground on Heidlandsweg, which serves as the central meeting point. The race is part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup and promises a varied route through natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 20.3 km
Start and finish at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground
Event as part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup
additional: The event is aimed at families and runners of all ages. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The Am Habichtshorst sports ground is the central meeting point for runners. Distances: 0.5 km to 20.3 km, including children’s races; central meeting point at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground; October weather: approx. 14°C, 6°C low, 40mm of precipitation, cloudy

name: 35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklingen Volkslauf is a local race day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat races for adults over approximately 5.5 to 5.7 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main race is the 10 km Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. There is also a 400 m Bambini race for the youngest participants and a 1 km students’ race, allowing families and club runners to take part together, with participants grouped by age category.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Races for adults and children, plus walking and Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking events are grouped by distance and age category. There is a 400 m Bambini race and a 1 km students’ race. All races finish at the same location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with the start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of events, including walking and children’s races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbst Roland Run is a traditional fun run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, starting and finishing at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children’s races to 10 kilometers for adults. The course is a flat 5-kilometer loop on paved and mixed surfaces that also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on paved and mixed surfaces
Course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, teenagers, adults, and seniors. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 40 mm of precipitation. The race also supports Anhalt Hospice Zerbst and is organized as a community fun run with medals and certificates.

name: Oldenburg Marathon / Oldenburg Marathon 2026
price_range: 35 Euro für das Sportshirt (zusätzliche Startgebühren nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on 25 October 2026 offers a wide range of races: the EWE Marathon, public half marathon, AZO Half Marathon Relay, 10 km Volksbank City Run, 5 km Müller & Egerer Run, and Decathlon Children’s Mile Run. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to take part in different disciplines. The course runs through the city of Oldenburg and offers a great running experience for participants of all abilities. Registered participants can also purchase a high-quality, sustainable long-sleeved shirt.
course_highlights: A wide range of distances, from the marathon to the children’s run
Course through the city of Oldenburg
10:00 a.m. start time for the shorter races
additional: Race packets can be collected on 11 October from 11 a.m. at the Schlosshöfe. Saturday’s pre-race check-in, from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., is recommended. Group registration is available. A high-quality, sustainable long-sleeved shirt by Wijld is available for €35 only when registering. Race numbers may also be collected by family members. Multiple race distances, start locations in Oldenburg, special medals, event merchandise, and information about race numbers and registration.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: The Gütersloh DJK Half Marathon is an established running event in Gütersloh, taking place on 25 October 2026. The event offers a half marathon as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The courses are officially measured by the DLV and are therefore eligible for rankings. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with awards for the fastest runners in various age categories and overall standings.
course_highlights: DLV-measured half-marathon course to IAAF/AIMS standards
5 km and 10 km road races as additional events
Awards for places 1–6 in the overall standings
additional: Certificates can be downloaded from the timekeeper’s website, www.timeteam-jung.de. Awards ceremonies will take place in the tent as soon as possible after the races. Parking is available at Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee. DJK Gütersloh accepts no liability for accidents, theft or other damage. Measurement to DLV/IAAF/AIMS standards, online registration, parking at Hauptschule Nord, disclaimer of liability, certificates via www.timeteam-jung.de

name: Porzellinerlauf
location: Sportplatz Am Dohlenstein, Kahla, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Porzellinerlauf Kahla is a traditional autumn road race starting and finishing at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground in Kahla, Thuringia. The 13 km race is the main event, alongside shorter children’s and youth races, making the day appealing to both families and regular runners. Organised by SV 1910 Kahla e.V. since 1971, the race combines a sporting challenge with the local porcelain tradition. Regional timekeepers oversee the course, which receives particularly positive feedback for its route.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground
13 km main race, with shorter children’s and youth races
Route through Kahla with a connection to its porcelain tradition
additional: The field is modest, with around 101 to 300 runners and more than one hundred finishers in recent editions. Typical November weather in Kahla is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. Timing is provided by regional timekeepers. The race has been established since 1971 and regularly attracts between 101 and 300 participants. The course is known for its good condition and attractive surroundings. The event also includes refreshments, showers and an awards ceremony.

name: VR Bank Westküsten Herbstlauf Schafstedt
description: The VR Bank Westküsten Autumn Run Schafstedt is an autumn running event in Schafstedt, Schleswig-Holstein, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event welcomes adults and younger participants and fosters a family-friendly atmosphere with children’s and youth races. The routes pass through the autumn landscape in the fresh air and offer an alternative to city runs.
course_highlights: The 3 km route is flat
The 5 km run and 5 km walk include some hills
All races finish at the same finish line
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Typical October weather in Schafstedt is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event also includes walking options and is aimed at families and young people. October weather is generally mild, with temperatures around 6–14 °C, creating ideal conditions for an autumn run.

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night marathon and half marathon held in Koszalin, known for its excellent atmosphere and distinctive nighttime ambience. The course consists of laps of approximately 7 kilometres, completed multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The race has official PZLA certification, which verifies the course distance and makes it possible to set world records. This is the sixteenth edition of the event, attracting runners who want to improve their personal bests in the one-of-a-kind conditions of a night race.
course_highlights: The course consists of laps of approximately 7 km, completed 3 or 6 times
Official PZLA certification confirms the course distance
Views of the stadium along the course and Koszalin’s undulating terrain
additional: The race office for children and young people opens at around 19:00, with a limited number of places (20). The race office for adults is located in the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall at ul. Racławicka, about 300 m from the stadium, and remains open until 30 minutes before the start. Participants must show a photo ID when collecting their race number. The course runs along the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. The medal and merchandise are updated each year and are an important part of the event. The event offers different distances, including a marathon and half marathon, with reports, photo and video galleries, and options to register online or at the race office. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and the chance to compete in various themed categories.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual half-marathon held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants can run a route through charming parts of the city, finishing at ERGO Arena, which offers a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive race packs. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of sport in the Pearl of the Baltic and earn a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades
The finish is located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and Sopot’s iconic pier
additional: The race pack includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half-marathon route is certified and passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades. The finish is inside ERGO Arena, providing comfortable conditions for runners after the race. Race packs available from 10 February 2026; participant limit: 3,500; discounts for holders of the Sopot Card; the event is part of the Korona Półmaratonów Pomorza 2026–2030 series.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
price_range: Półmaraton: od 50 PLN do 180 PLN, Maraton: od 60 PLN do 220 PLN
description: The 14th Vistula River Run along the Lower Vistula Valley Trail is an annual race held in Tczew County. Participants can choose between two distances: a certified 42.195 km marathon and an uncertified 21.097 km half marathon. The routes pass through the scenic Lower Vistula Valley and feature a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. The marathon starts in Tczew at 9:00, and the half marathon starts in Małe Walichnowy at 11:00. Both finish in Tczew.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The route is marked every 1 km with painted markings and yellow signs
additional: The limit is 400 paid participants. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon route is PZLA-certified; the half marathon is not. The finish is at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew, ul. Bałdowska 19. The routes have varied surfaces. The participant limit is 400, registration is online, and the event includes a half marathon and a marathon.

name: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE
description: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE is a social running clinic held on the last Sunday of October, starting and finishing at Out Of Office Coffee in Westergas, Amsterdam. The event begins at 11:00 with running drills focusing on technique and speed, followed by a group run accompanied by music. This event celebrates the final day of 30 years of the Amsterdam Dance Event, combining sport and music in a unique and enjoyable way.
course_highlights: Starts and finishes at Out Of Office Coffee, Westergas
Includes running drills focusing on technique and speed
Group run with music accompaniment
additional: The event is a running clinic open to everyone, emphasizing social participation and enjoyment. It is part of the Amsterdam Dance Event festival program and celebrates the event's 30th anniversary. The venue Out Of Office Coffee is open Fri - Sun 10 - 17 and Tue - Thu 09 - 16. Participants can enjoy a relaxed run combined with music and a convivial atmosphere, perfect for both recreational runners and fans of the dance festival.

name: Duinentrail Schoorl
description: The DYNAFIT Duinentrail Schoorl 2026 is a challenging trail run through the beautiful dune area around Schoorl, Bergen, Hargen and Camperduin, featuring the highest dune peaks in the Netherlands. The trails range from 12 km to 50 km and include a swim trail and various kids’ trails. All routes start and finish at Laguna Beach. The combination of dunes and coast makes for a unique and varied running experience, with October weather conditions adding an extra challenge. This 14th edition offers a perfect location for both runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Trail through the highest dune area in the Netherlands
Varied terrain with hills, narrow paths and mud
Start and finish at Laguna Beach, right on the beach
additional: There is a test run/course preview on 17 September. The start and finish location is ideal for runners and supporters. Participants should have experience with off-road terrain and be in good physical condition. Participation is at your own risk. Trail, Swim Trail, beach activities, two-day programme, various distances, start and finish at Laguna Beach Schoorl

name: Parkcross Hoorn
location: De Blauwe Berg, Hoorn, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Parkcross in Hoorn, organized by A.V. Hollandia, is an annual cross-country race held at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex. The race is part of the All4running Crosscircuit and attracts both youth and senior runners. The Parkcross offers a challenging course in a park-like setting, suitable for runners of different levels. The organizers are known for their hospitality and good facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in a park-like setting
Challenging terrain with natural features
Suitable for youth, juniors, seniors, and masters
additional: Registration is via Atletiek.nu. The race is part of the All4running Crosscircuit. The event takes place at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex in Hoorn. The cross-country race is held in Risdammerhout neighborhood park; registration is available on the day. The course features mud and hills, and the location is near Sportpark de Blauwe Berg.

name: Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl
description: The Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl is a unique running event held annually in October, and in 2026 it will celebrate its fourteenth edition. The main distance is 4 nautical miles (7.408 km), taking runners past green spaces, the sea, the harbour, the beach and historic sites in Delfzijl. The race starts at the athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in the town centre. In addition to the individual 4 Zeemijlenloop, there is a corporate run and a kids’ run, making the event suitable for a range of participants. The race has a strong regional character but attracts participants from across the Netherlands. The course is wide, varied and distinctive because its distance is measured in nautical miles.
course_highlights: 7.408 km route past the sea, harbour, beach and green spaces
Starts at the Burgemeester Boeremalaan athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in central Delfzijl
Passes historic sites such as the statue of Maigret and the Damsterdiep
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday evening and Sunday morning at the AV Fivelstreek clubhouse and in central Delfzijl. Late registration is not available for the 4 Zeemijlenloop. The prize-giving takes place after the races. There is a party tent and a post-race gathering after the corporate run. The event takes place in October, with start and registration points at the athletics track and in central Delfzijl, and includes various race categories.

name: Jan de Vos Najaarscross
location: Kralingse Bos, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Jan de Vos Autumn Cross is a challenging cross-country race held in Kralingse Bos in Rotterdam. It is organised by PAC Rotterdam, the oldest athletics club in the Netherlands. The course runs along natural paths with hills, bushes and tree trunks, making for a varied and demanding running experience. The cross is suitable for participants of all ages and attracts many enthusiastic runners each year.
course_highlights: Start at the Beachhouse by the beach in Kralingse Bos
Includes a hill behind the petting zoo
Natural obstacles such as bushes, tree trunks and slippery paths
additional: The cross consists of two laps of approximately 4 kilometres. The race is suitable for participants aged 17 to 70 and over. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and an opportunity to chat over a drink. The aim for next year is to also offer a shorter distance of approximately 4 km for younger athletes. The event takes place in the Kralingse Bos area, a popular location for running races in Rotterdam.

name: Het Achtje van Atledo
description: The Achtje van Atledo is a running event organised by Atletiek- en Trimvereniging Atledo in Dongen. Atledo is a large and active club with a modern athletics track and a wide range of training sessions for all ages and levels. The event takes place in a green sports area alongside the canal and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere for both competitive and recreational runners. The club is known for its expert guidance and focus on injury prevention.
course_highlights: Modern athletics track with good grip and cushioning
Located in a green sports area alongside the canal
Facilities for various athletics disciplines in addition to running
additional: Atledo offers training for all levels and ages, including a 'Run for Fun' programme for beginner runners and an 'Older Adults in Motion' programme. The club has a clubhouse with a sports café and extensive facilities for technical athletics events. Running or walking, date 25 October 2026, starts from 10:00.

name: Strand TIEN cross
description: The Strand TIEN Cross on Sunday, October 25, 2026, is the first race in the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition 2026–2027, a series of six small-scale, accessible running races on unpaved courses in and around Oss. The cross offers both a long distance of approximately 10 km and a short distance of approximately 5 km, as well as special youth cross races over shorter distances. The races are suitable for runners of all levels and ages, giving participants the chance to measure themselves against others, pursue personal goals, and enjoy running in nature. Anyone who takes part in at least four races has a chance to place in the overall standings.
course_highlights: Unpaved courses in and around Oss
Distances of approximately 5 km and 10 km
Special youth cross races over shorter distances
additional: The cross competition consists of six races. Taking part in at least four races in the same category qualifies participants for a place in the overall standings. The races take place on Sunday mornings and are small-scale and accessible. There is a youth race for younger runners. You can get in touch via WhatsApp or SMS at 06 37 30 12 02. The race is part of a series of six small-scale, accessible running races in Oss, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl.

name: Craft x Luyckx Sport Oercross
location: Former US Military Terrain, Havelterberg, Netherlands
description: The Craft x Luyckx Sport OER Cross is a challenging cross-country race, organised for the seventh time by AV De Sprinter on 25 October 2026. The race takes place on the wooded, hilly training grounds of the former American base in Havelterberg. The OER Cross is part of the prestigious Athletics Union Cross Country Series and serves as a qualifying race for the European Cross Country Championships. There are various distances for youth and adults, divided by age category.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly training grounds of the Ministry of Defence’s Havelte-West site
Located at the former American base in Havelterberg
Part of the Cross Country Series and a European Cross Country Championships qualifying race
additional: Parking is permitted only at the car park of Darper Football and Sports Association; parking on the Ministry of Defence training grounds is prohibited. Flying a drone during the event is strictly prohibited. Test runs are organised in collaboration with Craft and Luyckx Sport to try out the course and new shoes. The OER Cross is one of four top races that count towards the national cross-country ranking. The event takes place at the former American base in Havelterberg, with registration via Inschrijven.nl. The site is known for its challenging, hilly and wooded setting. Parking is available at the grounds of Darper Football and Sports Association. Drone use is not permitted during the event.
