name: Bergensløpet Vår
description: Welcome to the Fjordkraft Bergen City Marathon (FBCM) on Saturday, April 25, 2026. This will be the 15th edition of the race, and we look forward to another day filled with the joy of running, community, and urban life at its best. The start and finish line, as usual, will be at Bryggen, where the atmosphere sets the tone for a memorable experience. The course will take you through some of Bergen's most characteristic areas – from Old Bergen and the views along Fjellveien to the new walkway around Store Lungegårdsvann. The Bergen City Marathon 2026 offers a course filled with life, views, and the city's unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: The start and finish are, as usual, at Bryggen, where the atmosphere sets the tone for a memorable experience.
The course takes you through some of Bergen's most characteristic areas – from Old Bergen and the view along Fjellveien.
Bergen City Marathon 2026 offers a course filled with life, views, and the city's very unique atmosphere.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival
description: Oslo Running Festival consists of eight races along the capital's beautiful trails and scenic roads. You can run whenever you want – alone or with others. You can participate individually in the SOLO category, or in the team competition as a DUO or TRIO. In DUO and TRIO, you can compete in the women's, men's, and mixed categories. Each race is announced on a Friday at 12:00, and the course is open until Sunday at 11:00 the following weekend.
course_highlights: Oslo Running Festival offers both individual and team competitions.
The routes run along beautiful trails and roads in Oslo.
The race has an opening period of just over a week to complete the distance.

name: Perseløpet 5 & 10 km
description: The Perseløpet 5 & 10 km is an exciting running event set in picturesque surroundings. The courses are designed to provide both beginners and experienced runners with a challenging yet rewarding experience. Participants can choose between two distances: 5 km and 10 km, both offering a fast and flat AIMS-certified course designed for records. There is a strong emphasis on community and the joy of running, with results available immediately after finishing and free parking.
course_highlights: Fast and flat course, designed for records. AIMS-certified course.
Results available immediately after finishing.
Free parking.

name: Rundt Torghatten
description: TORGHATTEN RUNDT is part of the "Race Carousel" and takes place every year on the second day of Pentecost. Distance: From the community house at Torget, around the legendary Torghatten, and back to the community house. The surface consists of asphalt, gravel, and natural terrain, making the race accessible for all categories.
course_highlights: The race takes place every year on the second day of Pentecost.
Distance: From the community house at the square, around the legendary Torghatten, and back to the community house.
The surface is asphalt, gravel, and natural terrain.

name: OBOS Fornebuløpet
description: The OBOS Fornebuløpet is perhaps Norway's largest midweek race, taking place on May 21 in Fornebu. The 5 km course starts at UNITY Arena, goes past the Equinor building along the water before turning into Nansenparken. The entire route is on asphalt, primarily on walking/cycling paths, and there will be a water station at Storøya School after about 3.4 km and at the finish line. Participants will have their own area in UNITY Arena for changing clothes and for food/drink between distances.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, primarily a pedestrian/bicycle path.
There is a water station at Storøya School after about 3.4 km and at the finish line.
Participants will have their own area in the UNITY Arena for changing clothes and food/drinks between the distances.

name: Land Løpskarusell
description: The Land Running Carousel is an annual running series that takes place from May to September, featuring 11 events in Søndre and Nordre Land. The races include cross-country running at distances of 400m, 1800m, and 3600m, as well as track events with distances of 300m, 600m, and 1500m. It is a great opportunity for both experienced runners and beginners to participate in varied races and enjoy the beautiful nature of the area.
course_highlights: RACE 1: Wednesday, April 30 at 6:30 PM: Lyngstrand Camping. Cross-country run 400, 1800, and 3600 m.
RACE 2: Wednesday, May 7 at 6:30 PM: Dokka Stadium. Track events 300m, 600m, and 1500m, combined events with 60m, long jump, and small ball for children.
3rd race in the Land Carousel: 3.2 km trail run at the Land Museum.

course_highlights: The race was held in Flora, Norway.
Distances available were 10 km and 5 km.
The race took place on October 20, 2018, at 12:00 PM (GMT+2).

name: Helse Førde-stafetten
description: We are excited to welcome you to the 18th edition of the Helse Førde Relay. Experience the great atmosphere at the start and finish at the hospital in Førde, and join the fun run, the rocket course, one of the children's races, or a team in the relay. The main course consists of 6 legs and is 5.5 kilometers long, and there will also be children's races and a variety of activities for the audience. The relay starts at 6:30 PM, and everyone can participate, either as runners or supporters.
course_highlights: The main course consists of 6 stages and is 5.5 kilometers long, which includes various surfaces such as asphalt and gravel.
There was a strong turnout and beautiful weather for running, with many participating in costumes and children's races as part of the event.
Over 400 children participated, and more than 80 teams were registered in the relay, creating a true community celebration.

name: Ulriken Opp
description: Ulriken Opp 2026 takes place on Saturday, May 30, and is a hill climb race that goes from the lower station to the upper station on Ulriken, the highest of the 7 mountains surrounding Bergen. The course has an elevation difference of about 405 meters from the starting area at 200 meters above sea level to the summit at 605 meters above sea level, and the distance is measured at approximately 1730 meters for the TRIM and MOSJON classes, while the COMPETITION CLASS has a distance of 3.6 km. The course offers varied terrain, from gravel to steep stairs, and provides a spectacular view of Bergen and the North Sea.
course_highlights: Ulriken Opp consists of 3 different trails; “Grieg Oppstemten Uphill”, “Drevelin Montana Classic”, and Cani Cross (handler with dog).
The start is from Montana (the gravel track) and the finish is at the top of Ulriken at 605 meters above sea level.
There are recorded course records for both men and women in the competitive class.

name: Sømnamile
description: Welcome to a measured and fast mile along our beautiful coast in the far south of Helgeland! The event is organized by Sømna Sports Club in collaboration with Sparebank 1 Helgeland and HEV. We hope that YOU will come, regardless of your level, as there is room for both the competitive runner who wants to race against the clock and the recreational runner who just wants to finish. The start and finish line is at the athletics stadium in the municipal center of Vik, and you can choose between 10 km and 5 km with or without timing. Runners under 10 years old can participate in the children's race of 600 meters around the stadium.
course_highlights: Sømnamile - Norway's most beautiful mile!
The start and finish are at the athletics stadium in the municipal center of Vik.
Both distances will be officially measured.

description: The Schjongs5er'n was held in Schjongslunden, where children and adults had a great time with the race. On Saturday, races are organized for over 500 participants, but some are trying to stop them. Håkon (19) broke the course record at Schjongs5er'n, which offers a completely unique running experience. A large turnout is expected at the Schjongtest.
course_highlights: Children and adults had a great time when the Schjongs5er'n was held in Schjongslunden.
On Saturday, they are organizing a race for over 500 - but some are trying to stop them.

name: Farsund Maraton
description: Farsund Marathon is one of Norway's most beautiful races, taking place through a spectacular natural and cultural landscape. The marathon is held in Farsund and offers various distances, including full marathon, half marathon, children's marathon, and relays. In 2025, the race gathered 985 participants, and the weather was ideal with a light breeze and full sun, contributing to a positive experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Farsund Marathon is one of Norway's most beautiful races, taking place through a spectacular natural and cultural landscape.
The marathon runners were given the opportunity for an early start on the marathon distance, starting one hour before the main race.
In 2025, 86 runners participated in the half marathon, with a total of 985 participants across various distances.

name: Glommaløpet
description: In the Glommaløpet, you run on a gravel path along the last kilometer of the Glomma River from Sarpefossen to the river's mouth at the sea near Gamlebyen in Fredrikstad. The race starts at the square in Sarpsborg, and the route goes through Kulåsparken, over Sannesundsbrua, along the Glommastien (the eastern side of the Glomma), under the Fredrikstad Bridge, finishing in the best-preserved fortress town in the Nordics – Gamlebyen. The race takes place on May 30, 2026, and offers several distances, including a relay for teams of up to ten participants and an individual 10-mile race.
course_highlights: The Glommaløpet offers beautiful nature experiences along the Glomma River and is open to everyone, regardless of level.
The course is flat and easy to run, with water stations at 4.5, 9.5, and 14.5 km.
A portion of the profits goes to the Cancer Society.

name: Ecotrail Oslo
description: Ecotrail Oslo is an exciting running experience that takes place in Oslo. Participants can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 21 km, 31 km, 50 km, and 80 km. The courses take you through beautiful nature with elevation gains that vary depending on the distance, providing a unique opportunity to experience Oslo's scenic beauty. The tenth edition of Ecotrail Oslo will be held on May 24, 2025, and this is a race for all age groups and levels.
course_highlights: The course runs on urban trails and technical paths through Nordmarka and Bærumsmarka.
The last five kilometers are on asphalt along the fjord and into the shared finish line at Vippa.
Registration opens on September 10th at 00:00.

name: Energistafetten
description: On Saturday, May 24, 2025, the Energistafetten will be held in Stavanger, where more than 11,000 participants are expected. The relay is inspired by the Holmenkollstafetten and the festive atmosphere of the Tour de France, and it is a community event for both runners and non-runners. Teams can be formed by companies, organizations, friends, neighborhoods, or others, and with effort, camaraderie, and joy, we will create positive energy!
course_highlights: We are inspired by the Holmenkollen Relay and the GO CRAZY atmosphere in the Tour de France.
The relay is a community event for both runners and non-runners.
Teams can be formed by companies, organizations, friends, neighborhoods, or others.

name: Soria Moria til Ende
description: Welcome to the Soria Moria Trail Ultra to the World's End, May 25-26, 2024! This ultra-trail race of the 100 miles+ category starts at Soria Moria in Voksenkollen, Oslo, and finishes at the World's End on the island of Tjøme in Vestfold. The event also includes two shorter distances: 50 miles+ from Sande to the World's End and 27 km (17 miles) from Teie to the World's End.
course_highlights: 100-miles+, total elevation gain 4200m, starting at Soria Moria, Voksenkollen in Oslo, Saturday, May 25 at 10:00 AM.
50-miles+, total elevation gain 1700m, starting from Sande Sports Club, Saturday, May 25 at 11:59 PM.
27 km (17 miles) with a total elevation gain of 400m, starting from Teigar Youth School, Nøtterøy, on Sunday, May 26 at 11:00 AM.

name: Stomperudløpet
description: The Stomperud Race is the big running celebration in Sørum, featuring four distances suitable for everyone. The event has received positive feedback on the courses, which are a mix of gravel paths and terrain, as well as some asphalt. The shortest distances take place on the athletics track. Bring your running shoes and join the Stomperud Race, starting and finishing at Stomperud Stadium in Lørenfallet.
course_highlights: The Stomperudløpet has four distances, making the event suitable for everyone.
We have received positive feedback on the routes, which are a mix of gravel paths and terrain - as well as some asphalt.
The shortest distances take place on the track.

name: Konnerudløpet Turløp
description: Are you ready for a rare adrenaline kick? Become Konnerudrennet's ultimate Climbing King or Challenge Queen in 2025! This year, at the most explosive Konnerudrennet ever, we challenge ski gravity and give you the chance to claim the throne as Climbing King or Challenge Queen in breathtaking climbing and downhill competitions for age classes 13 years and older. With a spectacular Tour de France-inspired atmosphere, you as the leader of the competition in your class will have the honor of donning the coveted climbing or downhill jersey already after the first day.
course_highlights: The prizes are to die for, and the title of Climbing Queen or Downhill King at the Konnerud Race 2024 will be yours forever!
The weather gods are on our side, providing us with freezing temperatures and the perfect snow is being produced, so there’s no reason to miss out on this.
Konnerudrennet is not just an ordinary ski race – it is a ski festival.

name: Kragerø Sommerløp
description: Kragerø Summer Run is a spectator-friendly and fun street race that takes place in the heart of Kragerø. Experience a fantastic community celebration with 5km, 10km, and a free kids' race of 700m, where children can experience achievement and joy. The race starts at Jernbanetorget and features a fast and pleasant loop through the city center, with entertainment and a great atmosphere along the route. Participate alone or together with family, friends, and colleagues, and have fun together!
course_highlights: Kragerø Summer Run is a community festival in the heart of the city featuring a 5km, 10km, and a free children's race.
The children's race is free and in collaboration with Kragerø Sports Association Athletics, where all children receive a medal.
The race will be a low-threshold event for everyone at all levels, and there will be entertainment and extra fun for the kids.

name: Totenvikaløpet
description: The Totenvikaløpet has received the stamp "World Ranking Competition 2024" from World Athletics and is thus included in the World Athletics race calendar. The race features an easy asphalt course with a view of Lake Mjøsa, starting at 10:00 AM. There is no time limit - the organizers will wait for the "last warrior," but after 12:00 PM, there will be limited safety along the course due to an agreement with the county municipality.
course_highlights: The Totenvika Race is part of the World Athletics running calendar.
The race has an easy asphalt course with a view of Lake Mjøsa.
There is no cutoff time - we wait for the "last warrior."

name: Brunkollen Rundt POP–UP–RUN
description: Get ready for an experience in the heart of beautiful Bærumsmarka. Welcome to Brunkollen Rundt, our westernmost race – in perfect technical terrain! Start from the parking lot at Solemskogen, and run a varied route down to the water at Store Gryta, then further up to Barlindåsen and back to the finish line at Solemskogen Parking Lot. The route is technical, especially from Øyervann to Pilegrimsleden, but concludes with an easily runnable section that invites a strong finish.
course_highlights: We continue running along the water towards the top of Grytlihøgda and up to Barlindåsen.
The route is technical, especially from Øyervann to the Pilgrim Trail.
Ends with an easily runnable section that invites a strong finish.

name: Barskingen OCR Hinderløp
description: Barskingen OCR is an exciting obstacle course race that takes place at Rakkestad Airport, with distances of 5 km and 8 km. The age limit is 12 years for the 5 km and 14 years for the 8 km, and the race promises an experience filled with sweat, mud, and laughter, as well as a fantastic sense of achievement. The event has grown significantly since 2016, and participants of all ages come together to experience what many describe as the best race of the year.
course_highlights: Get sweaty, dirty, cheerful, and experience an incredible sense of achievement!
The Barskingen has grown in every way in 2016, and I both believe and know that all of us who participated today wholeheartedly agree on one thing – Barskingen is the best race of the year!
The event area has excellent facilities, including plenty of restrooms and changing rooms with comfortable locker rooms.

The race is organized by Sædalen IL around Store Lungegårdsvannet, starting from Amalie Skram Vgs. The course follows a safe walking and cycling path and is suitable for all age groups; big and small, young and old. The course route follows a safe walking and cycling path all the way around the lake, and is suitable for all age groups.
There is no requirement to run; you can roll, walk, jog, or run.

name: Trondheimstafetten
description: The Trondheim Relay is public health at its best, movement in a fantastic setting. On May 30, 2026, the Trondheim Relay will be held for the first time, starting at Skansen and featuring a route that goes from park to park, ending at Trondheim Stadium. The relay consists of 10 stages and 20 runner-friendly kilometers along new walking and cycling paths, allowing participants to experience the city's culture and history. The Trondheim Relay is suitable for all ages and levels, and is a great sporting event that promotes community and activity.
course_highlights: The first leg of the Trondheim relay is 1609 meters and runs through the city's new "dream mile."
Each stage has its own character, ranging from flat and fast stretches to more hilly and technically challenging sections.
The Trondheim Relay is suitable for all ages and levels, and encourages team formation in workplaces, associations, residential communities, friend groups, or families.

name: Oppdalskarusellen 2. løp
description: The second race in the Oppdal Carousel 2025 was held on Sunday, May 25, at 2:00 PM from the NOIL area in windy and wet weather. Despite the conditions, many runners lined up at the start for the 3.18 km course with an elevation gain of 47 meters. In the women's category, Bente Lien Hæhre from NOIL took the victory with a time of 13:35.5, just under six seconds ahead of Solveig Egge Greftegreff from Brandbu IF. In the men's category, Mads Berge from NOIL was the fastest to finish with a time of 10:26.8.

Mads Berge from NOIL was the fastest in the men's class with a time of 10:26.8.
The course was 3.18 km long with an elevation gain of 47 meters.

description: Skaubygdaløpet is a tough half marathon in somewhat very hilly terrain on Nesodden, organized on hiking trails in Nordre Frogn. The race distances with timing are 21.1 km and 7.1 km, with a separate category "Open Course" at 3.7 or 6.4 km without timing. The courses have a challenging profile, where one does not set personal records, but must calculate their own pace and finish with style. For the children, there are 200m and 600m races.
course_highlights: Course lengths with timing are 21.1 km and 7.1 km.
We also have a separate category "Open Course" at 3.7 or 6.4 km without timing.
For the children, we are organizing 200m and 600m races.

description: The Straumemila running festival offers several distances for runners of all ages and skill levels, including 10 km, 5 km, and the Children's Mile. The race takes place in scenic surroundings and has a friendly atmosphere that promotes community and enjoyment for all participants. There are also prizes for the best performances and opportunities to set new course records. Organized by Sotra Sports Club, Straumemila aims to facilitate increased activity in the region through play, competition, and community.

The traditional Vettisløpet takes place in Utladalen on Sunday, May 25, 2025, with the option to register in both recreational and active categories.

The race has a fantastic backdrop with Hjellefossen, Avdalsfossen, and Vettisfossen.

The course is incredibly fast and easy to run, and both the marathon and half marathon will converge at the entrance to Myrvegen, where there will be a merging area of over 1 km to ensure ample space for all participants. Come and try our renowned course, and kick off the summer with a quality race!
course_highlights: Jessheim Half Marathon and 5 km, an incredibly fast and easy-to-run course in Jessheim.
The marathon and half marathon will meet at the entrance to Myrvegen.

description: The Risør Run 2023 takes place on Saturday, August 12, featuring 5 and 10 kilometer distances, as well as a free children's race. The start and finish are on Måkeveien in Risør, where the 10 km course takes participants through the beautiful hiking terrain of Åmlandskauen, while the 5 km course follows gravel roads towards Tronndalen. Both routes have a challenging ascent towards the end, and timing is carried out using RFID technology.

The 10 km course runs through beautiful hiking terrain in Åmlandskauen, up to Kvernsmyr and Vemmelstjenn.

name: Elverumtrimmen - løp
description: Elverumtrimmen is a running series that has become part of my regular routine, and I have tested myself on the course the last two Mondays. There is a steady positive development, even though my time on the 5.3 km isn't impressive. I have over 170 test runs on this course since it was opened in 2000, and the course started on asphalt before transitioning to more challenging terrain with rocks. There was a new record and nearly 100 active participants gathered and ready to start, and the weather was ideal.
course_highlights: Elverumtrimmen is a running carousel for everyone, regardless of age, pace, and level, on Mondays.
The course has been in use since 2000, and I have found that it's faster to run with a steady pace instead of walking.

description: Voss Running Carousel 3 is an exciting sports event that takes place in Voss, Norway. This event is part of a larger running carousel that attracts both local and visiting runners. The courses are scenic and varied, providing participants with a unique experience of Voss' beautiful landscape. The races are held on Mondays starting at 7 PM and include a 5 km and a half marathon, catering to both children and adults.

name: Borredalen Rundt
description: Borredalen Rundt is a race that has been organized since 1962 and continues to attract participants. On April 29, 2025, at 6:30 PM, the next race will take place, which is the fourth race in the series for the year. The race has a long tradition and gathers both newcomers and experienced runners, and the route is 5.59 km long in Fredrikstad, ideal for enjoying nature while training.
course_highlights: Finn Markus Johansen was the fastest in one of the earlier races with a time of 20:43, and he now has a total of 35 victories.
Debutant Benedicte Solvin was the fastest woman with a time of 23:45, which is also the year's best for the women's category.
The race has seen participation from both local and foreign runners and brings new highlights and records each season.

The routes primarily follow gravel roads and paths in Bragernesåsen and Hamborgstrømskogen, with several distances available, ranging from 3 km to 12 km. Race leader Svein O. Halvorsen emphasizes that this is a running carousel for everyone.
course_highlights: This spring, Wednesday's silver medalist in orienteering won the 3-kilometer, so there are obviously significant differences in levels.
The best woman in the 3-kilometer race was Ane N. Høverstad from DBK with a time of 13:41, while Jon G. Løvendal from Hellas was the fastest man with a time of 11:10.
Now the 5-kilometer race awaits, starting from Sturlahuset at Neperudjordet, followed by the 7-, 9-, and 12-kilometer races, all starting from Sturlahuset.

There are basic indoor facilities (toilet) available in Prestrudhallen, but we recommend arriving changed, and the shower should be taken at home.

description: VHUT is a trail ultramarathon that traverses the best terrain in northern Vestfold, with only 6% asphalt on the long course! Our goal is to provide runners with a true trail experience, with the motto "challenging but fair." The course stretches across 2 counties and 5 municipalities, and participants pass many locations of local historical significance. The race is unmarked, and participants must navigate using GPS, map, and compass.
course_highlights: We continue to offer accommodation before the race, as well as transport from Hengsrød to the start for the 50 and 87 km distances, making it easier to participate.
There are 2 drop bag stations offered for the 147 km, and 1 for the 87 km, where food will also be served.
The course takes participants on a journey along the finest trails and over the most beautiful peaks in northern Vestfold.

Crazy Race is Norway's first inflatable 5k run, where participants can expect 5 crazy kilometers with 14 enormous inflatable obstacles. Guaranteed fun for the whole family!

name: Bergsdalen Opp
description: Bergsdalen UL, Voss Cycling Club, and Dale IL are organizing the BERGSDALEN OPP for the 12th time this year, a hill climb race, ride, and run. The event includes cycling, roller skiing, and running. The distance is from Dale to Storefossen, approximately 4 km with a consistent 10% gradient on paved road. Hikers who want to support the event can register in the Fitness and Hiking Class, which is not timed.

The roller ski race Bergsdalen Opp has a free style, with a shorter course for 11-12 years old and a mass start for 13 years and older.
Participants will be served beet soup after the roller ski race, and there will be an awards ceremony at the old Bergsdalen elementary school.

name: Anton Sport Sommerløpet
description: Join us for Southern Norway's biggest running festival – the Summer Run in Kristiansand, Saturday, June 7, 2025! Experience the best of Kristiansand and Southern Norway, with fantastic surroundings and an inclusive atmosphere. The Summer Run offers a variety of activities and distances for everyone, from the children's race Happy Mile to the half marathon. There will be thousands of participants, and this is an experience you won't want to miss!
course_highlights: The Summer Race offers a variety of activities and distances for everyone, from the children's race Happy Mile to the half marathon.

name: Lysefjorden Inn Ultra
description: The Lysefjorden Inn ultramarathon was first held in 2013 and, with a distance of 62 km and 2500 meters of elevation gain, is known as Rogaland's toughest ultramarathon. The race offers a challenging trail course with beautiful scenery and varying weather conditions, so participants must be prepared for everything from sun to rain. The course also includes elements such as ice bathing and bouldering, making it a unique experience for all participants.
course_highlights: The Lysefjorden Inn ultramarathon is known as Rogaland's toughest race.
The race offers a challenging trail course with beautiful nature and varying weather conditions.
The course includes elements such as ice bathing and bouldering.

name: Hovlandsnuten Opp
description: Hovlandsnuten Opp is a mountain race suitable for both young and old, trained or untrained. Meet the challenge and reach the summit with a fantastic fjord view waiting 931 meters above sea level. The race is being held for the seventeenth time and is specially designed for families with children. The route from Risvoll school up to Hovlandsnuten, known as Sagastien, is approximately 6.7 kilometers long.
course_highlights: We especially welcome families with children.
The course is approximately 6.7 kilometers long.
This year, there will be a hydration station at the top and Hovlandsstølen.

name: Pinåsløpet
description: The Pinåsløpet is a Norwegian uphill race that was started by Ole Wiik in 2002. The organizing clubs are Svarstad IL and Lardal o-lag. The race covers a distance of six kilometers from Dalen, up to Pinås and back, with an elevation gain of 300 meters to the summit at 367 meters above sea level.

The race is six kilometers long from Dalen over Pinås and back.
There is an ascent of 300 meters where the summit is at Pinås, 367 meters above sea level.

name: Byløpet
description: The city race features courses from 5 km to 21 km suitable for everyone, from professional runners to school classes and families. The race route takes place in scenic surroundings around Hjellevannet, with the venue located in the square outside Arkaden in Skien. The city race aims to be an experience for all senses and showcase Skien city center and Hjellevannet at its best, starting from various locations near the waterfront.
course_highlights: The city run is an arena in Grenland that aims to promote sports joy and maintain the joy of running.
The course continues along the waterfront at Bakkestranda, where you can enjoy the view of the city of Skien and Bakkestranda.
The last meters are on a gentle uphill towards the square, where you can raise your arms in the air and receive a well-deserved applause.

name: Solnedgangen
description: Saturday, June 28, 2025, Kondis, Stavanger 5k, Sunset 5 km. The start/finish is at Sola Strand Hotel (on the sidewalk outside the employee parking). It is important to keep to the right on the course to avoid collisions, as the course involves encountering other runners. There will be no aid station along the way, but water and sports drinks will be available at the finish line, where medals will also be awarded. Results will be sent via SMS, and there are no changing facilities, so remember to bring a change of dry clothes.

name: Sognefjord Trail Run 2026
description:
Sognefjord Trail Run – Experience fjord and mountain from the trail!

Join us for a spectacular trail race in Kaupanger with the Sognefjord as the backdrop. The race offers a unique mix of technical sections, steep ascents, and beautiful flow trails with fjord views. With distances ranging from 17 km to 50 km, the race is suitable for both novice trail runners and experienced ultrarunners.

Welcome!
course_highlights: The best thing about the Sognefjord Trail Run is the view and the variety of the course!
The course features everything from high mountain terrain, forests, flowing trails, and technical sections, all set in a beautiful environment.
The atmosphere at the start and finish was fantastic, with enthusiastic and helpful volunteers at the aid stations.

description: The Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses, which runs on wide pathways and is well-used by runners and joggers in the Drammen area. The race takes place on three dates: May 25 and June 8, attracting runners of all ages and skill levels. The routes are varied and provide a great opportunity to experience the beautiful nature of the area.
course_highlights: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses.
The race takes place on a wide pathway and is well-used by runners and joggers in the Drammen area.

name: Trimkarusellen Grenland
description: The Trimkarusellen Grenland features races that take place on asphalt, trails, and gravel, something for every taste, but each time you experience the same sense of achievement and community with others. There are 5 different routes set up in Grenland, each approximately 5 km, which are run twice during the season. Participants can join without timing from 5:00 PM or in a mass start with timing at 6:00 PM. The Trimkarusellen primarily holds races every other Tuesday, and the routes are only marked on race day, but maps and descriptions will be provided well in advance of the start.
course_highlights: It gives you the opportunity to focus on your own mastery and execution.
The races are free, and late registration is possible on-site until 15 minutes before the start.
Everyone will receive a reusable bib number, which must be returned after crossing the finish line.

name: Romerike Løpskarusell Løp
description: Romerike Running Carousel is a running series with eight races taking place at various locations in Romerike. The races feature different distances, surfaces, and elevation profiles, and are open to anyone who wishes to participate. You can choose to walk, jog, or run, with or without timing, and compete against yourself or others. The races are held on Tuesdays and Thursdays from the end of April to mid-September, and you can sign up for the entire series or individual races.
course_highlights: The races have different distances, surfaces, and elevation profiles.
You can choose to participate for time or just complete the distances.
The event is open to everyone, and running is a social and enjoyable activity.

description: The Terrain Carousel in Kvinesdal/Flekkefjord is suitable for everyone, whether you want to walk, jog, or run at your own pace through the trails. It is an inclusive and social meeting place where friends, colleagues, and acquaintances come together for shared exercise – regardless of ambitions or abilities. In 2024, the carousel consists of 7 races held on Tuesdays from April 30 to September 17, with distances ranging from 4 to 12 km.
course_highlights: The Terrain Carousel offers eight fantastic courses.
In 5 of the races, you can choose whether you want to run the regular distance or the double distance (Milsluker).

description: The Follotrimmen is a running series consisting of 8 races at different locations in Follo, featuring various distances, surfaces, and course profiles. On average, about 130 people show up every Wednesday to exercise or test their fitness in the scenic course. The course runs around Holavatnet on asphalt and gravel roads, and it is easy to bring a stroller along for the 3.1 km round.

description: The Ekholt Race is organized on Wednesday, June 11, at 18:30 from Rygge Youth School, with distances of 7 km and 3.8 km. The race features a mass start for the timed category, while the recreational category starts two minutes later. Participants will experience varied terrain and a challenge after 1.5 km due to railway construction that makes the route a slight detour. The Ekholt Race is part of the Mossekarusellen 2025 running series and attracts many participants each year.

name: Sommernattsløpet Bergen
description: The Summer Night Run Bergen 2026 is a running festival where participants can choose between 5 km or 10 km. The race takes place in Nygårdsparken, which is centrally located in downtown Bergen, and it is easy to get there by public transport. All participants receive a great medal and refreshments at the finish line, and there is also a chance to win prizes from partners. This race is a fantastic opportunity to test your fitness or just have fun together with hundreds of other runners.
course_highlights: The Summer Night Run is the summer's most fun street race where you run on fast courses in beautiful surroundings.
Regardless of whether you run 5 kilometers or 10 kilometers, we guarantee minimal elevation gain and the maximum chance for a new personal best in the Summer Night Run.
Runner’s World will have pacers in both Bergen, Trondheim, and Oslo – here you have every opportunity to set a new personal best.

name: Austevollsløpet
description: Welcome to the 41st Austevollsløpet on Sunday, September 29, 2024, at Austevoll Sports Facility. At 12:45, the Mini-Mini marathon for the youngest participants (870 m) will start, and at 13:10, the 5 km race for participants aged 11 and up will take place. Austevollsløpet has been held since the early '80s, featuring a new course that is flat and officially measured, with a total elevation difference of 41 m. We hope to see many recreational runners and families, and we encourage everyone to bring the whole family, as strollers are allowed.
course_highlights: The Mini-Mini marathon is 870 m long for participants aged 0-10 years, starting at 12:45 PM.
The course for the 5 km is as flat as possible, with a total elevation difference of only 41m.
Family discounts are available, and it's a great activity for both family and friends.

name: Birkebeinerløpet
description: The Birkebeinerløpet is a trail race of 21 km, known as Norway's largest trail race, and takes place in beautiful nature. The race, which has been held every year since 1999, starts at the Sjusjøen cross-country skiing arena and finishes in Lillehammer between Kristins Hall and Håkons Hall. With an elevation difference of 600 meters, the Birkebeinerløpet offers a varied and motivating training experience for both cross-country skiers, orienteers, and long-distance runners. In addition to the main race, the Halvbirkensom is also organized, which starts approximately halfway through the main course.
course_highlights: The Birkebeiner Race is inspired by the ski race Birkebeinerrennet and is organized by the same organizer.
The race has an elevation difference of 600 meters between the start and finish.
Participants can also choose the Half Birkebeiner, which starts at Sjøsætra approximately halfway through the main course.

name: 3 Toppsløpet Jeløya
description: The 3toppsløpet on Jeløy was held for the first time in 2014 and is a trail run that takes you through some of the most beautiful places on Jeløy. You can run four different distances: 1 km, 10 km, 20 km, or 30 km. The race is a true test of strength and a relatively challenging and technically demanding trail run, where runners alternate between running along the beaches and on forest paths. The goal of the race is to create as nice a route as possible around the entire Jeløy, passing over the three well-known peaks: Rødsåsen, Bjørnåsen, and Rambergtoppen.
course_highlights: The runners alternate between running along the beaches and on trails in the forest on beautiful Jeløy.
Every year, the organizers donate the profits from the trail race to charity and aid work.
The race is a true test of strength and a relatively demanding and technically challenging trail run.

This year, we will be part of Tanangerdagene, a festival over 4 days where Tananger showcases its very best for both children and adults, with activities such as Children's Day at Tananger Stadium, dock dancing, stalls, and sales of sausages, soda, and cakes.
course_highlights: Low-threshold recreational race around Tananger Ring.

name: Besseggløpet
description: Besseggen is one of Norway's most beautiful hiking destinations. The Besseggen Race follows the regular T-marked route over the ridge. Start at Memurubu and finish at the Gjendeosen parking area. The terrain is rugged, mainly gravel and stone. There will typically also be some snow in parts of the trail. The start and finish are at about 1000 meters above sea level, with the highest point at approximately 1743 meters above sea level. The course is about 14 km long.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 14 km long, with an elevation difference of 1000 m.
The terrain is uneven, primarily gravel and stone, and there will usually be some snow in parts of the trail.
The Besseggløpet is held every last Saturday in June, offering opportunities for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.

name: Bislettmila
description: The Bislett Mile is a low-threshold athletics event where both elite athletes and recreational runners have the opportunity to run at Bislett Stadium. Elite heats are organized for senior men and women in the 5,000m and 10,000m, as well as 5 km and 10 km for recreational runners, with both genders competing in the same heat. This event provides an excellent opportunity to meet the national championship standard for the 10,000m, with good pacers present.
course_highlights: The Bislett Mile offers both elite athletes and recreational runners the opportunity to compete at Bislett Stadium.
Elite heats will be organized for senior men and women in the 5,000m and 10,000m events.
It will be an excellent opportunity to meet the national championship requirement for the 10,000m.

Bislett Mile race. Many runners in action at Bislett Stadium.

name: Odden Stafetten
description: Welcome to the Odden Relay 2025! This is a fun, informal, and social relay taking place on June 16, 2025, at Martodden/Norwegian Railway Museum in Hamar. The race features a varied and scenic course, where 4 people per team compete in both a long route (approximately 1.5 km) and a short route (just under 1 km). Participants will receive a bun and juice at the finish line, and there will be a prize draw after all teams have crossed the finish.
course_highlights: The stages run from the campsite towards the Railway Museum and the climbing park, with marked trails and marshals ensuring that you run the right way.
It’s a perfect opportunity to gather colleagues or friends for an active and fun afternoon.
Both corporate teams and friend teams are welcome, and the first leg is long, then short, then long again, and finally short.

name: Holavatnet Rundt 10
description: The Summer Carousel Holavatnet Round was first organized in 1983 and is now in its 41st season. On average, about 130 people show up every Wednesday to exercise or test their fitness in the scenic course. The route goes around Holavatnet on asphalt and gravel paths, and it's easy to bring a stroller along for the round.
course_highlights: The course is 3.1 km long, consisting of 1.1 km of asphalt, 1.8 km of gravel road, and 0.2 km of asphalt.
There is a nature trail for children in the hiking class, with a prize located at the "cabin" (about 450 meters above sea level).
The race starts at about 40 meters above sea level, and the summit/finish is at 553 meters above sea level.

name: Skagerrakmila
description: On Friday, June 20, IK Grane Arendal Athletics invites you to a running festival in Arendal with the Skagerrakmila starting at 7 PM. For the 33rd time, the race is organized with the start and finish in the center of Arendal, taking you through the city center and nearby areas to the east. A June evening in Arendal often offers good weather, and together with the audience in the streets and on the outdoor terraces along the route, this creates a fantastic setting for the race. The Skagerrakmila is an annual 10 km race, and there will also be a 500-meter children's race held in conjunction with the event.
course_highlights: The Skagerrak Mile is an annual 10 km race in Arendal that was first held in 1990.
The race is certified as a quality event in the training magazine Kondis, and it holds a record for the number of participants from 1992 with 464 runners.
The fastest time is held by Urige Butas from Ethiopia, with 30:01 from 2005.

images.alt_text: Skagerrakmila winners on the podium in Arendal. Congratulations!

name: St. Hansgaloppen
description: The St. Hansgaloppen is a race that takes place in beautiful surroundings by Maridalsvannet. The course is relatively flat, with small elevation changes and a slight downhill at the turnaround point. Overall, it is an easy-to-run route that is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. Øystein won the race with an impressive time of 50:00, thereby defending his title from the previous year.
course_highlights: The course is relatively flat, with small elevation changes and a slight downhill at the turnaround point.
Øystein defended his victory from last year and won the St. Hansgaloppen in a very good time.
The race includes a rerouted course that is approximately 175 meters longer than before.

name: Bèrghem Ultra Trail
description: Bèrghem Ultra Trail is an exciting ultramarathon that changes its route from year to year, but always takes place on the Hedmark plateau (Hedmarksvidda). This event, located in Brumunddal, celebrates and highlights the unique wilderness of Norway.
course_highlights: The Bèrghem Ultra Trail route changes from year to year.
The event always takes place on the Hedmark Plateau (Hedmarksvidda).
Our other ultra events celebrate and showcase the unique wilderness of Norway.

images.alt_text: Runners at the Bèrghem Ultra Trail event.

name: Norefjell Trail
description: Norefjell Trail is a true endurance test with a 42 km marathon that covers varied terrain, including mountain views, lakes, beautiful runnable trails, and gravel roads. The route passes Tempelseter and Istjenn, and reaches Høgevarde before descending to the finish line. This race is perfect for runners looking for a great challenge in Norway's beautiful mountain landscape.
course_highlights: 42 km | 1,550m elevation gain | ~80% trail | ~20% gravel.
The race starts and ends at Norefjell Ski & Spa, with a great warm-up during the first 3 km on gravel road up towards Leppejuvet.
The final stretch is more runnable, with open mountain trails towards Augunshaug along the ridge, before a technically challenging descent on rocky paths.

name: Fjord til Helvete
description: The mountain race From Fjord to Hell is organized by Søndre Land IL Athletics in collaboration with Søndre Land IL Ski. The race first took place in 2015 and will be held for the tenth time on Saturday, June 20, 2026. You can find more information about registration, class divisions, entry fees, and other event details on the race's Facebook page.
course_highlights: Organized by Søndre Land IL Athletics in collaboration with Søndre Land IL Ski.
The race saw the light of day in 2015.
Held for the tenth time on Saturday, June 20, 2026.

name: Chicken Bootcamp Race
description: Chicken Race is Norway's largest obstacle course for the whole family, held at a former military camp in Helgelandsmoen near Hønefoss, about 45 minutes from Oslo. Here, you can bring the whole family to courses filled with exciting challenges where you will run, climb, crawl, balance, carry heavy loads, and get both wet and dirty. The courses have just the right level of tough obstacles, and all of them are optional.
course_highlights: 2 km family run on Saturday, June 21, 2025, as well as 5 km and 8 km obstacle races.
Get wet, dirty, and infinitely tougher with us.
Norway's toughest running experience with mud, burpees, flames, bruises, and a sense of accomplishment.

name: Sommerskogsløpet
description: Welcome to the Sommerskogsløpet 2024. For the 29th time, the Sommerskogsløpet is being organized in beautiful natural terrain near Kristiansand city center. There are three different race distances that largely follow the Main Trail, and all routes converge at Dalane just north of the city center. This trail run offers a varied and scenic route that takes participants through forest paths and past stunning viewpoints, making it suitable for both experienced runners and beginners.
course_highlights: The Sommerskog Race takes place in beautiful natural terrain near the center of Kristiansand.
There are three different race distances that largely follow the Main Trail.
The race offers a varied and scenic route that takes participants through forest trails and past beautiful viewpoints.

name: Knarvik Maraton 5 km
description: Knarvik Marathon will be held on Saturday, June 21, 2025, featuring races for the marathon, half marathon, and 5 km. As part of the event, the Norwegian Championships in Half Marathon and NM 5 km road race will be organized. The start and finish for the 5 km is at Knarvik Stadium, and the course is relatively flat, with asphalt and gravel, winding around the stadium and through Brekkeløypa.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is easy to run and has its start and finish at Knarvik Stadium.
There is 1 aid station on the course, after approximately 3 km, and at the finish line, participants receive water and bananas.
The course is well marked with about 20 course marshals present, and the Red Cross will also be on site.

name: IDYLL Craft Run
description: IDYLL Festival and Craft Sportswear invite you to IDYLL x Craft Run 2024 at Dampskipsbrygga on June 22. Do you want to race against skiing stars? Now you have the opportunity! During IDYLL x Craft Run, you will have the chance to test your running skills against ski stars like Johannes Klæbo, Tiril Weng, and Even Northug, as well as other well-known figures from the national ski team. The race starts on Saturday, June 22, at 10:00 AM at Dampskipsbrygga.
course_highlights: Run towards the skiing stars like Johannes Klæbo, Tiril Weng, and Even Northug.
Test your running skills alongside well-known profiles from the national ski team.
The event takes place on Saturday, June 22, starting at 10:00 AM.

name: Lundehøgda Opp
description: Welcome to Lundehøgda Opp on Saturday, July 1, 2023, at 11:00 AM, starting at Garveriet in Moelv town center. The course is marked from the finish line at Lundehøgda to the clubhouse in Amblisberget, where there are shower facilities and award distribution after the finish, around 1:30 PM. We will transport you to the top, and there will be a kiosk selling refreshments while you wait for the award ceremony. Course record holder and newly crowned Norwegian champion Geir Steig is registered!
course_highlights: There is a marked route from the finish line at Lundehøgda to the clubhouse in Amblisberget, where there are shower facilities and prize distribution as soon as possible after the finish.
Course record holder and recent Norwegian champion Geir Steig is registered!
Kiosk sales with refreshments while waiting for the awards ceremony in the clubhouse.

name: Bankmila
description: On Saturday, June 22, Surnadal IL and partner SpareBank 1 Nordmøre invite you to the fourth edition of Bankmila. The course, which starts at Skei and goes via Røtet and back to the finish line at Skei, is approximately 10 kilometers long. Bankmila is divided into Minibankmila for children, a recreational class, and a timed class, with start times from 11 AM. The organizers have a clear ambition to reach a three-digit number of participants this year, so mark Saturday, June 22, and join us for Bankmila!
course_highlights: The Minibank Mile starts at 11 AM, and participants are encouraged to arrive in good time for registration.
The recreational class starts at 11:30 AM, and the timed class starts at 12:00 PM.
The course is fast and easy to run, and it also promotes really good public health!

name: Knarvik Halvmaraton
description: Knarvik Half Marathon starts and finishes in the same place inside Knarvik Stadium. The course runs on roads in Knarvik and into the Brekkeløypa, where there is gravel, while the rest of the course is on asphalt. There are 8 aid stations along the route, and after crossing the finish line inside the stadium, water and bananas will be served. The course is well marked with approximately 20 course marshals present, and the Red Cross will also be on-site. The half marathon consists of 4 laps of the 5 km course, with an additional distance of 1097 meters onto the walkway towards Gjervik.
course_highlights: The course is car-free, and you can look forward to enjoying beautiful nature in your sight along the way.
There are 8 aid stations along the course, and after crossing the finish line inside the stadium, water and bananas will be served.
The age limit for participation is 15 years.

name: Nordmarka Skogsmaraton
description: We are looking forward to this year's most beautiful trail race, the Nordmarka Forest Marathon, which will be held for the 33rd time in 2026. It was a great day, and we hope that all runners had a wonderful racing experience. The course is challenging, and all honor and glory to everyone who lines up at the start! A big thank you to all our helpers, volunteers, and supporters – nothing happens by itself.
course_highlights: The race has tough courses, and we hope that all runners had a great racing experience.
We want to give honor and recognition to everyone who lines up at the start!
A big thank you to all our helpers, volunteers, and supporters – nothing happens by itself.

name: Sentrumsgateløpet
description: The City Center Run is a collaboration between Our City and the Kongsvinger Local Committee, offering a sporting street festival where everyone can participate. The race features officially measured distances of 5 km and 10 km, running on both sides of the Glomma River, with the 10 km race consisting of two laps on the same course. It is a beautiful route suitable for active individuals, recreational runners, city enthusiasts, and children, with a special children's race covering various distances (maximum 500 meters). The event also includes a market square, lively shops, and various children's activities.
course_highlights: The city center race features a beautiful course along the Glomma River and over both city bridges.
The race is for everyone: Both active runners, recreational joggers, city enthusiasts, and children.
Children's race with various distances (max 500 meters).

name: Sommernattsløpet Oslo
description: The Summer Night Run is the summer's most fun street race where you run on fast courses in beautiful surroundings. Swap your dress shoes for running shoes and join the summer's big running celebration at sunset! Whether you run 5 kilometers or 10 kilometers, we guarantee minimal elevation gain and maximum chance for a new personal best in the Summer Night Run. The course consists of a well-measured route of 5 kilometers and is Oslo's fastest course!
course_highlights: 5-kilometer course – full throttle in one lap!
The 10-kilometer course passes Filipstadkaia halfway and takes an extra loop in the route before the finish – twice the fun!

images.alt_text: Runners ready for the start of the Summer Night Race.

name: Kristinaløpet
description: The Kristina Run is a recreational race in the center of Tønsberg, organized by Tønsberg Athletics Club. In 2025, the race will take place on a new route starting and finishing at Kaldnes, an area well-suited for the event. The new course is flat and easy to run, encouraging fast times and records. The Kristina Run includes distances of 10 km, 5 km, and the Children's Kristina Run at 500 m.
course_highlights: The Kristinaløpet has been organized since 1981 and is named after Princess Kristina of Tunsberg.
The 10 km course consists of two laps of 5 km, with a separate recreational class for 5 km.
It is important to stay within the designated markers in the start and finish area, otherwise the time will not be recorded!

name: KRS Last One Standing
location: Spicheren Treningssenter, Jegersbergveien 1B, 4630 Kristiansand S, Norge
description: KRS Last Man Standing is a unique "Last Man Standing" race at Gimle/Lund in Kristiansand. Participants run 6.7 km every hour, and the competition continues until only one runner remains. How many laps can you manage?
course_highlights: The race takes place at Gimle/Lund in Kristiansand.
The participants run 6.7 km every hour.
The competition continues until only one runner remains.

name: Skeikampen Dogrun
description: We are pleased to announce that the VOM Dogrun will be held at Skeikampen for the third time on June 8, 2025, starting at 7:00 PM. The VOM Dogrun is an event for all dogs, where participants can choose a class according to their own level, either with or without timing. A veterinarian will be present for animal welfare, and all participants will receive a VOM DOGRUN DOG LEASH, a bib number, and a medal. Prizes will be awarded to the fastest participants, and there will also be a raffle for prizes based on bib numbers for all classes.
course_highlights: VOM Dogrun is for everyone who wants to participate in a pleasant activity with their dog.
There is always a veterinarian and a responsible person for animal welfare present at VOM DOGRUN.
Participants will receive a medal, and there will be prizes for the fastest women and men.

name: Oppdalskarusellen 3. løp
description: Ready for the Oppdal Carousel 3rd race: A challenging stage and a festival atmosphere ahead! The third stage, "Oppdal's toughest - Koperud up," takes place on June 15 in Nordre Oppdalen. The Oppdal Carousel is an annual race series organized by SenIL in collaboration with NOIL, now entering its 8th edition with five races spread throughout the season. Each stage has its own distance and unique route, attracting both local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: The Oppdal Carousel 2026 is set with five races spread throughout the season.
The popular race series starts with the first race of spring on April 19 and concludes with the final on September 6.
Each stage has its own distance and unique route, attracting both local and visiting runners.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, Halvmaraton
description: The Perseløpet 2025 is a fast and flat race, designed for records, with an AIMS-certified course. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, or 50 km, all within the same event. This is a low-threshold and inclusive race suitable for both recreational runners and those chasing a new personal best. There is a mass start for all distances, but with a mat start, you will receive your own start time when you cross the starting line. The course is known for a high percentage of personal records – maybe you'll set a new one?
course_highlights: Fast and flat course, designed for records.
Results available immediately after finishing.
Free parking.

The race takes place on a varied and scenic route in Jessheim, allowing participants to experience the beautiful surroundings. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and includes awards for the top runners, as well as finisher medals for all participants.

The event is known for its friendly atmosphere.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 4
description: Voss Running Carousel 4 is an exciting sports event taking place in Voss, Norway, welcoming participants and runners from the age of 9. The races occur on Mondays starting at 7 PM, with dates in 2026 including April 13, May 4, June 1, June 22, August 3, and September 21. The course is 5 km, with the start and finish at the sports field, and it goes through scenic areas such as Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. There is a discount for those who register for all six races before the second race.
course_highlights: The course is 5 km, with the start and finish at the sports field.
The race goes through scenic areas such as Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade.
There is a discount for those who register for all six races before the second race.

name: Bamford Frontyard
description: Bamford Frontyard consists of a relatively flat 3 km loop, where the first lap must be completed in 30 minutes. The next lap must be run 1 minute faster, and you must have completed all previous laps to continue. The competition ends when only one person finishes the final lap, and if multiple participants start, the fastest to finish will win. Completing 15 laps or more qualifies for the Ultra distance, and a medal is awarded to everyone who completes the first lap.
course_highlights: The first lap must be run in 30 minutes, and for each subsequent lap, the time is reduced by 1 minute.
The ranking is based on the number of completed laps within the time limit, and within each lap, the ranking is determined by the runner's time for that specific lap.
15 laps or more qualify for the Ultra distance.

name: Baneløpet 5. løp
description: The Track Race 5th event is part of the Running Carousel 2023, where all participants can compete and earn points based on a WMA table. The race will be held on October 7th at 3:00 PM in Sandefjord, with a distance of 10 km. There is open participation for both members and non-members of STIF Dammen1182, with the option for timing and a race number for those who wish to compete. There will also be an opportunity to participate without timing in the fitness class.
course_highlights: The track race, event 5, gives all participants the opportunity to compete and earn points based on a WMA table.
The race has open participation for both members and non-members of STIF Dammen1182.

name: Oddvar Helleruds Minneløp
description: Welcome to the traditional cross-country race Oddvar Hellerud's Memorial Run. The race takes place on Wednesday, June 19, 2024, featuring a distance of 9.7 km suitable for both recreational runners and active competitors. The event will be held at Vestre Spone Sports Ground and also includes a children's race. Registration takes place at the start, and ice cream will be served after the finish.
course_highlights: Recreational exercise starts at 6:00 PM, and the children's race begins at 6:30 PM.
The competition starts at 7:00 PM, with an entry fee of 150.
No prizes, but ice cream will be served after the finish.

name: Kongsberg Mosjonskarusellen
description: The Kongsberg Motion Carousel is the final carousel event of the year, and the Lurdalsrunden was held in beautiful autumn weather. As usual, there were some challenges, possibly due to insufficient marking and eager youth, but all participants crossed the finish line. Kasper Lekve was the fastest in the short course with a time of 32:16, while Sofie Spiten and Kristian Qvenild were the fastest woman and man, respectively, with times of 1:00:16 and 55:40. The results can, as usual, be found on EQ Timing's pages.

description: Valestrandsmarka Rundt 5th race takes place on June 26 in Vestland. This race is part of a series of trail runs and offers a unique opportunity to experience the beautiful nature of the area. The course is varied and challenging, with both flat sections and steep hills that provide participants with a good workout. The fun run/march is 4400 m long, starting and finishing at Furubakken sports ground, Valestrandsfossen.

name: Ottaløpet
description: Welcome to the Ottaløpet 2024, taking place on Saturday, June 29 in Otta, Gudbrandsdalen! The first edition was held in 1993, and the race includes 10 km and 5 km distances, as well as a non-timed fun run and a relay. The event focuses on involving the local community in an active day, with children's activities, music, and a pleasant atmosphere in the Park at the finish line. After a successful restart in 2022, we look forward to another exciting day with good weather and lively participation.
course_highlights: The Ottaløpet features both 10 km and 5 km distances, as well as a non-timed fitness class and a relay, and is open to both children and adults.

name: Ålgård-Sirdal 100K
description: Ålgård-Sirdal 100K is a challenging course of 100 kilometers that takes participants from Ålgård to Sirdal. The route is varied, featuring both mountains and roads, and the last aid station is at Lortabu (86 km). After this, the course follows the road to Gravassryggen, before ascending the steep trail to Storeknut. Towards the end of the race, participants will experience a fantastic view over Sirdal from the finish line at Slottet.
course_highlights: The last aid station is at Lortabu (86 km), where the route then follows the road to Gravassryggen.
After 90 km, the participants will understand why the trail gets its name from the 1800s, when shepherds had to herd their sheep from the coast to the mountain pastures in Sirdal.
About 1 km before the finish, there is a steep gravel path leading to the finish at the Castle, where you get a fantastic view of the entire Sirdal.

name: Preikestolen Trailrun
description: The Preikestolen Trailrun is an epic running journey where you follow in the footsteps of Rockman, the legendary figure who braved the rugged trails every weekend in pursuit of winning his beloved's heart, but without swimming. This race is not just a run – it is a mythical adventure where you battle against the forces of nature on some of the world's most spectacular trails. Prepare for a mix of skyrunning, technical trail running, and exhilarating climbing, as you run through mystical forests, cross boulder fields, and ascend to the mountain peaks above the Lysefjord. The route takes you on a secret path to the iconic Preikestolen, before descending into a playground of ancient, rugged terrain.
course_highlights: You will run through mystical forests, cross moors, and ascend to the mountain peaks above the Lysefjord, where the shimmering water is framed by majestic cliffs.
The route takes you along a secret outer trail to the iconic Preikestolen, before descending into a playground of ancient, rugged terrain – shaped by the gods themselves.
This race is extremely technical with an elevation gain of 1200 meters and a distance of 20 km.

name: Kvitfjell Stuttlaup
description: Stuttlaupet is a 13 km long race in varied terrain, taking place during the Kvitfjell Running Festival. The festival, which was established in 2022, also includes other races such as Kvitfjell Opp and Langlaupet. In 2024, the festival will expand with Stuttlaupet, which will provide participants with a fantastic experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Stuttlaupet is a 13 km long race in varied terrain.
Kvitfjell Running Festival will be held on July 26 and 27, with the Short Run at 10:00 AM on July 27.
The festival also includes a banquet dinner and an afterparty following the race.

name: Kvitfjell Langlaup
description: The long run is a 25 km race in varied terrain, presenting an extra challenge for those who didn't get enough lactic acid from Friday's uphill race. The course mainly follows marked trails in the mountain area around Kvitfjell, and the race takes place both above and below the tree line, with the highest point at about 1100 meters above sea level. Even though it is mid-summer, it can be wise to be prepared for weather changes.
course_highlights: Kvitfjell Running Festival has been delivering legendary running experiences since 2021, featuring Northern Europe's steepest ski slope and prime trails in the heart of Norwegian nature.
The course is approximately 25 kilometers long, with 19 kilometers on trails and 6.5 kilometers on road.
In 2024, the festival will expand with yet another race, namely the Stuttlaupet.

description: The Strawberry Run and the Mini Run are two separate races taking place in Valldal. The Mini Run starts at 2:45 PM, while the Strawberry Run starts at 3:30 PM. Both races have their start and finish at Rådhusmarka, and there will be an awards ceremony at the pier after the race.

name: Sørlandstesten 11
description: The Sørlandstest is a low-threshold recreational race for everyone who wants a positive running experience, regardless of ambition level. Whether you are training for a bigger goal, feeling the competitive nerves, or just want a social and active day – this is the race for you! There is room for both beginners and experienced runners, and the most important thing is that you show up with a good mood and a desire to run. We cheer just as much for the one who crosses the finish line first as for the one who completes their very first race.
course_highlights: The Sørlandstest offers a flat and fast course up Setesdalsveien to Strai, before participants turn around and run back.
The race features distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a 600 m children's race, making it accessible for all ages and skill levels.
The start and finish are located on the opposite side of the road from Gumpens Auto, providing a simple and accessible location in Kristiansand.

name: Løp til Verdens Ende
description: Run to the World's End is a duathlon where teams of two run trail and swim in open water, without a break between the two disciplines. The running distance is longer than a full marathon, in addition to eight kilometers in the water. According to the organizer, this is a fantastic way to utilize the archipelago, but there is no room for transitions between the two activities, so participants must run and swim in wetsuits and running shoes. It is recommended to use flotation devices to make it easier.
course_highlights: Duathlon with trail running and open water swimming without breaks between the disciplines.
The race distance is longer than a full marathon, in addition to eight kilometers of swimming.
Participants must wear a wetsuit and running shoes, and it is recommended to use flotation devices.

name: Kongsvinger Skogsmaraton
description: Kongsvinger Forest Marathon is Inland's only and Norway's second forest marathon, taking place on August 3, 2024. Here you can choose from many different distances, including the full marathon, half marathon, and Kongsvingermila. Experience an unforgettable day filled with joy, community, and competition in a hilly and varied forest area north and west of Sæter farm. The marathon course follows forest roads and good trails, and there are 3 aid stations along the route.
course_highlights: Kongsvinger Forest Marathon offers distances of 42.2 km, 21.1 km, 10 km, and 4.2 km.
The marathon route runs through a hilly, varied, and beautiful forest area, with the main course following forest roads and good trails.
There are 3 water stations set up for participants during the race.

name: Gaea Norvegica Trail
description: Gaea Norvegica Trail is a multi-day, self-supported race, known as Norway's longest and toughest ultra. There are two routes: the first is 400 kilometers long and the second is 600 kilometers long, both completed over a 5-day period. The race is ITRA-certified and offers 6 UTMB points. Are you brave enough to take on nature and see how you fare? Join us and experience the stunning beauty of Norwegian nature while following the geological Oslo Rift formation from Oslo to Hamar.
course_highlights: The route follows the Akerselva river to Maridalsvannet, continues into Nordmarka up to Eidsvoll, and then heads northeast before ending at Hedmarksvidda.
The total elevation gain in the race is 8300 meters, and assistance is not allowed; participants must carry all clothing, food, and drink in their backpacks.
Gaea Norvegica Trail is ITRA-certified and offers 6 UTMB points, making it a challenging experience for ultrarunners.

name: Møkster Maraton

Møkster is a beautiful, small island at the edge of the sea, located in Austevoll municipality south of Bergen. Here, participants can experience stunning nature, a guest harbor, a shop, and a restaurant. The routes traverse fields and roads, asphalt and gravel, through farmyards and along old farm roads, providing an absolutely extraordinary experience.
course_highlights: Møkster Marathon was held for the first time on Saturday, August 4, 2012, and it became an unforgettable day for organizers, spectators, and runners.
The race goes over fields and roads, asphalt and gravel, through farmyards and along old farm roads.
Møkster is a small island with about 35 permanent residents and a large group of cabin owners, all with a high percentage of passionate individuals.

name: Skeikampen Rundt
description: Skeikampen Rundt is a trail run set in scenic surroundings of small forests and bare mountains around Skeikampen. The course is approximately 12.2 km long and ascends to 347 meters, and it can be run in either direction, with a descent regardless of the route chosen. The run is moderately challenging and suitable for children, but everyone must enjoy downhill runs. It offers fantastic views of the mountain landscape, including Jotunheimen and Rondane, and concludes with waffles and coffee at one of the cozy mountain cafés.
course_highlights: The trail ascends to the trail junction at Torsdalsleitet, where you get a fantastic view of the surrounding mountains.
The trip is moderately challenging and suitable for children, but everyone must enjoy downhill runs.

name: Trysil Trail
description: Experience trail running, community, and mountain adventures in Trysil! Trysil Trail by HOKA is organized in collaboration with Marathongruppen, ensuring a professional and seamless experience from start to finish. Trysil Trail is more than just a race – it’s a weekend filled with after-run activities, social runs, training sessions, and an equipment fair. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced runner, inspiring experiences and nature encounters await you in the spectacular mountain landscape.
course_highlights: Trysil Trail is not just race day – it’s a weekend of running, community, and incredible experiences.
The weekend offers camaraderie, after run, and memorable experiences, in addition to two races through beautiful terrain.
Trysil Trail 14K starts in Fageråsen and follows the Mountain Loop, while the 24K has an additional detour around Skrufjellet.

name: Bodøryggen
description: Bodø Run Bodøryggen, which takes place on Saturday, October 1st, is a majestic mountain race of approximately 21 kilometers from Skaug to Bestemorenga in Bodømarka. This race offers a beautiful trail with fantastic views of the Vestfjord, Lofoten Wall, and the city of Bodø. Bodøryggen is a challenging yet rewarding journey with about 1,000 meters of elevation gain, perfect for experienced hikers looking for a memorable experience.
course_highlights: Start at Skaug, steeply up to Skaugtuva before it levels out and the journey can be enjoyed along Bodøryggen / Løpsfjellet.
Bodøryggen offers a spectacular view of the Vestfjord, the Lofoten Wall, the city of Bodø, and Børvasstindan.
The trail is well marked, but sturdy hiking shoes and necessary equipment are recommended due to the length and elevation changes.

Anders Staude from Gular won the race with a time of 16:40, while Rebecca Hilland from Bergen Running Club took the victory in the women's category with 17:57. A total of 222 runners completed the second to last race in the series, with 99 runners finishing the 5 km and 33 completing the double distance of 10 km.

The 8 km course takes you through the old naval base with 30 obstacles, where you will tackle everything from climbing walls and crawling in sand to wading in water. Join for a weekend filled with adrenaline, laughter, and camaraderie, and experience something truly unique as you cross the finish line.
course_highlights: Navy Race presents you with challenges that test both physical and mental strength.
The course takes you through iconic areas as you tackle spectacular military obstacles.
Experience a weekend filled with adrenaline, laughter, and camaraderie.

description: Hof Toppers Ultrarun is back on Saturday, August 9, the same day as the Hof Toppers Duathlon. This 75 km ultrarun takes participants on a fantastic route that includes 7 of the 10 peaks in Hof, offering the chance to experience the beautiful nature of the area. The event has received praise for its friendly volunteers and impeccable service, although the asphalt sections can be challenging for the knees. With well-known peaks like Ryksåsen, Hvittingen, Montebello, Skibergfjell, and Snippane, this is a race for those seeking a hardcore ultra trail experience.
course_highlights: The 75 km ultramarathon included 7 of the 10 peaks and took participants through a variety of beautiful locations around Hof.
The officials were friendly and the service was impeccable; overall, it was a very good event.
Self-written highlights of the race include Ryksåsen, Hvittingen, Montebello, Skibergfjell, and Snippane.

The short distance means high intensity from the start, and with runners on the same course, there's always someone to catch up to—or to be chased by. This is the race for you if you want a fast yet challenging run in the terrain.

name: Grue Backyard
description: The ultramarathon Grue Backyard is completed over 12 laps of 6.7 km each, with a new start every hour. The first lap starts at 09:00, with 1 hour between each lap, and the twelfth and final lap starts at 20:00. If no one finishes the last lap, there are no winners. If multiple participants complete all laps, the winner is the one who crosses the finish line first in the last lap.

name: Mjøsen Backyard Race
description: With 12 laps and a total of 2856 meters of elevation gain, Mjøsen Backyard takes you through a challenge equivalent to running from the deepest point of Lake Mjøsa up to the water surface six times. This is the race for you who want to challenge both body and willpower, and experience the joy of mastering one of Norway's most unique racing concepts. How long can you keep moving? The laps start every hour on the hour, and your pace determines how long your break is before the next start.
course_highlights: Mjøsen Backyard is a backyard race consisting of laps of 6.7 km that are run up to twelve times.
The race starts and ends at a gathering place with a refreshment station, restrooms, and a chair to sit on.
Even though the ultimate goal is to reach 80.4 km, you are warmly welcome to run as many laps as you want – or can manage.

There are many ups and downs, but the course runs through Stavanger's most beautiful surroundings. Additionally, there will be a children's race of 700 meters for kids aged 2 to 9, starting at 11:00 AM.

description: Lustrafjorden Skyrace is a spectacular race that takes you through some of the most impressive landscapes in Norway. This race is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful in Norway, but also one of the toughest, with a focus on all participants being winners, where the sense of achievement and the experience of nature are more important than the time. The event has an informal and social atmosphere, with a high enjoyment factor and a medal for everyone who finishes.
course_highlights: The course runs along the fjord and up into the mountains, where participants can experience breathtaking views of Lustrafjorden and the majestic mountains surrounding it.

The organizers describe the course as Norway's most beautiful half marathon route and believe the race has the potential to grow in size.

name: Twilight 5000

Runners take to the track under the floodlights and compete in the 5K distance on iconic tracks around the world. New York City, with its rich history and diverse communities, provides the perfect backdrop for the Twilight 5000 series, which takes place at Icahn Stadium along the East River. This race is a celebration of speed, endurance, and the vibrant communities that running creates.
course_highlights: Runners line up on the track beneath the floodlights and race the 5K distance at iconic venues around the world.

name: Den Breiale Milen
description: The Breiale Milen kicks off on August 17 in Frognerkilen, and this year the very successful event is being held on a Saturday. The race, which spans 14.50 km, starts and finishes at Kongen Marina, taking participants on a loop around Bygdøy and Sollerud beach. The event is known for its jovial atmosphere and includes a unique category for nose breathing, as well as a festive afterrun at Oslo's coolest venue.
course_highlights: The race has attracted both elite athletes and recreational runners, and the winner of the men's category, Eirik Aabrekk, set a new course record with a time of 49:19.
Tiril Knudsen, a skier in Norway's elite, won the women's category and expressed excitement about the relaxed atmosphere and the afterrun celebration.
The Breiale Mile is the only race with a separate category for nasal breathing (unisex), which adds an extra dimension and fun to the event.
